# After the Death (Acharei Mot)

They have a portion in the Holy Name, and how much joy Israel has in the Holy Name because they were worthy of the Torah. For anyone who is worthy of the Torah is worthy of the Holy One, Blessed be He <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu"</note>. And we have learned before the Elder <note>A reference to a senior mystical teacher, often an embodiment of ancient wisdom</note> regarding the perfection of all, which is called **Higher Wisdom** <note>The Sefirah of Chokhmah</note>. From this place, springs and rivers flow to every side until they reach this "This" <note>The word "Zot" (This), a mystical name for the Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note>, and from this place the Holy Spirit is awakened.

And this "This" <note>Zot</note>, when it is blessed, is called "Holy" and is called "Wisdom," and they call it the **Holy Spirit**—meaning a spirit from that Holiness above. And when the secrets of the Torah emerge and are awakened from it, it is then called the **Holy Tongue**. And at the time when that holy greatness flows to those two pillars <note>Likely the Sefirot of Netzach and Hod</note> that are established in this "This," as it emerges from there through that level called **Foundation** <note>Yesod</note> to that Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note> and the Watcher, it is then called the **Tongue of the Learned** <note>Leshon Limudim</note> and it goes out to awaken those high holy ones.

Then it is written: ->*The Lord God has given me the tongue of the learned*<- <note>Isaiah 50:4</note>. And why? *To know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary*—referring to the Male and Female <note>The union of divine forces</note>. And this is the secret of the holy incense, and furthermore, it ascends higher and higher; therefore, all his words were spoken openly and not hidden. Of him it is written: ->*Mouth to mouth I speak with him, clearly and not in riddles*<- <note>Numbers 12:8</note>.

Rabbi Yitzchak opened and said: ->*And the Lord gave Solomon wisdom, as He promised him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon*<- <note>1 Kings 5:26</note> etc. "And the Lord gave Solomon wisdom"—this is what we learned: in the days of King Solomon, the **Moon** <note>A symbol for the Shekhinah/Kingdom</note> stood in its fullness. "As He promised him"—just as it says: ->*Wisdom and knowledge are granted to you*<- <note>2 Chronicles 1:12</note>. "And there was peace between Hiram and Solomon"—what is the connection between one and the other? Rather, we have learned: "And the Lord gave Solomon wisdom," and this wisdom is as he established it. 

Rabbi Yose said: He established it in this first way, that Solomon made a likeness for Hiram from that level of which he said, "I am a god, I sit in the seat of God" <note>Ezekiel 28:2; Hiram, King of Tyre, claimed divinity</note>. After Solomon dealt with him through his wisdom, he returned him to Solomon <note>subjugated his ego</note>, and because of this, "there was peace between Hiram and Solomon." And we learned: Rabbi Yitzchak said in the name of Rabbi Yehuda that he [Solomon] arranged a demon for him and cast him down seven levels of Gehenna <note>Hell/Purgatory</note>, and he would go up and arrange him in order every single day by his hand until he was corrected and returned to Solomon. 

And we learned: Solomon inherited the Moon in all its sides, and therefore he ruled through his wisdom. But **Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai** rules in his generation over all the inhabitants of the world; all those who ascend in levels only ascend to the "Deep Peace" <note>A higher mystical state than Solomon's peace</note>.

Rabbi Yose opened and said: ->*O my dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs*<- <note>Song of Songs 2:14</note>. "My dove"—this is the Assembly of Israel <note>Knesset Yisrael</note>, who never leaves her partner. Just so, the dove never leaves the Holy One, Blessed be He. "In the clefts of the rock"—these are the **Torah scholars** <note>Talmidei Chachamim</note> who find no tranquility in this world. "In the secret places of the stairs"—these are the modest Torah scholars who are hidden, for the Divine Presence never departs from among them. Then the Holy One, Blessed be He, inquires after her and says: ->*Let me see your countenance, let me hear your voice; for sweet is your voice, and your countenance is comely*<- <note>Song of Songs 2:14</note>. 

That voice which is heard above is the voice of those who occupy themselves with the Torah. And you will find that all those who occupy themselves with the Torah, their forms are engraved above before the Holy One, Blessed be He, and the Holy One, Blessed be He, delights in them every day and gazes at them. And that voice of theirs ascends and pierces all those firmaments until it rises before the Holy One, Blessed be He. Then it is written: *For sweet is your voice, and your countenance is comely.* And now, the Holy One, Blessed be He, has engraved the form of Rabbi Shimon higher and higher, and his voice ascends above and is crowned with a holy crown until the Holy One, Blessed be He, prides Himself in him in all the worlds and is praised through him. Of him it is written: ->*And He said to me, "You are My servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified"*<- <note>Isaiah 49:3</note>.

Rabbi Chiya opened and said: ->*That which has been is now; and that which is to be has already been*<- <note>Ecclesiastes 3:15</note>. "That which has been already"—this is what we learned: before the Holy One, Blessed be He, created the world, He would create worlds and destroy them until the Holy One, Blessed be He...

It emphasizes that the study of Torah creates a "voice" that delights God and engraves the scholar's image in the celestial realms.</summary>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**After the Death**<-

When the Holy One, Blessed be He <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu"</note>, rose in His desire to create this world and to rule in freedom, He then prepared Himself in His arrangements and crowned Himself with His crowns <note>referring to the Sefirot, or Divine emanations</note> and created this world. And everything found in this world was already before Him; it rose before Him and was prepared before Him. And come and see: all those who dwell in the world who are found in every generation, before they come into the world, they already stood before Him in their images <note>original: "dyukna," the spiritual archetype or "blueprints" of a person</note>. And so, come and see: even all those souls of human beings, before they descend to the world, they are all engraved before Him in the firmament in that very image that they have in this world. And everything they learn in this world, they knew all of it before they came into the world. And we have learned that this is a true, righteous priest. And all those who are not found to be righteous in this world, they are hidden there and distanced from before the Holy One, Blessed be He, and they enter into the hole of the Great Abyss <note>original: "Tehoma Raba," a place of spiritual exile or darkness</note>, and they press for the hour and wait to come to the world. And the order of their matter is as we have learned: just as they are stiff-necked in this world, so they were before they came into the world. And the order of the holy service that He gave them—hints and secrets—they were found in that hole of the Great Abyss, and they were rebellious in their taking from there, and they pressed for the hour and waited to come to the world... until they returned in repentance before their Master. He canceled that very service of his...

Come and see: those who were lacking <note>referring to Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron</note> were not found in protection like them, except for Moses and Aaron, and they are called the righteous of the Children of Israel. And because they approached before the Holy King, they died. And the Holy One, Blessed be He, wanted to rebuke them and spoke again: all those who are found, the Holy One, Blessed be He, performs kindness for all of them, and even the wicked of the world He does not wish to destroy. And so the true righteous... their merit is for them. The merit of their fathers is for them. The merit of Moses is likewise. And how were they destroyed? Rather, thus we have learned from the Holy Faithful One: that the Holy One, Blessed be He, spared their honor and did not honor their bodies within, and their souls were not trapped, as we have established. And come, before they died... it is written (Leviticus 16) "and he shall not come at all times," for they took for themselves... they were called the heavens of Phinehas... to repair the crooked... it is found that all the true righteous, before they come into the world, they are all prepared above and called by their names. And Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, from the day the Holy One, Blessed be He, created the world, he was prepared before the Holy One, Blessed be He, and was found with Him, and his service was straight above and below; of him it is written: "your heart shall rejoice," and the Holy One, Blessed be He, rejoices with him...

Rabbi Isaac opened and said: "While the king was at his table, my spikenard gave forth its fragrance" (Song of Songs 1:12). The companions established this verse regarding the time when the Holy One, Blessed be He, was found at Mount Sinai to give the Torah <note>original: "Oraita"</note> to Israel. "My spikenard gave forth its fragrance"—Israel gave and sent up a good fragrance that exists and rests upon them for generations upon generations, and they said: "All that the Lord has spoken, we will do and we will hear." Another interpretation of "While the king was at his table": while Moses rose to receive the Torah from the Holy One, Blessed be He, and was prepared twice for the Assembly of Israel, they gave off that good fragrance that was crowned upon them and they said [the oath]. For the [Golden] Calf, Israel was weakened... he opened this verse with the secret of wisdom. Come and see, it is written:

> And a river went out of Eden to water the garden (Genesis 2:10)

This river spreads out in its crowns at the time when they couple with it in a perfect union. This Eden and the union within it—it is written of it that it is not known above or below; of the Bride <note>the Shekhinah</note> it is written "no man knew her." And they are found in a Will <note>original: "re'uta"</note> that is never separated until tomorrow. Then the springs and streams go out and crown the Holy Garden with all those crowns; then it is written: "with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him." And at that time, their fragrance is found to be like the good fragrance of Lebanon; then He delights in this pleasure that goes forth. And come and see: at the time when the Supreme King, the delight of kings, sits in His crowns, then it is written: "While the king was at his table, my spikenard gave forth its fragrance"—this is the Foundation <note>the Sefirah of Yesod</note> that brings blessings to unite the Holy King with the Matron <note>original: "Matronita," the Shekhinah</note>.

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> **After the Death** <-
-> **62** <-

Like a Matronita <note>The *Matronita* is a Kabbalistic term for the *Shekhinah*, the Divine Presence, depicted as a noble Queen or Matron</note> at this level, and then all the worlds are settled in blessings; they go forth and the upper and lower worlds are blessed. And this holy structure <note>original: *bonina kadisha*</note> opened, crowned with its crowns, and he proclaims: "Ascend, O you who ascend! Open above!" And it is crowned with this *Chet* <note>The letter Chet, often associated with life/Chayyah</note> to bring forth blessings for all of them, proclaiming from above and below at this holy level. And Rabbi Eleazar, his son, understood these sublime matters that passed through his mind.

**Rabbi Eleazar opened** and said: "And the priest shall see," just as it is said <note>Numbers 25:7</note> "And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, saw..." and so on. Does one truly merit to behold this *Chet* <note>The letter of Life</note> to gaze upon this memory of Wisdom? Those who pass through these matters—and so we have passed—"And he saw," as it is said. These matters are as it is written: "A crown spread out..." <note>Alluding to Genesis 29:2</note> "And behold, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it." These are the children of the Holy One, for they are the Thought <note>original: *ra'ayon*</note> that rises upon it and stands over it, filling it so it may be filled with blessings in that Crown <note>Keter</note>. "For from that well they watered the flocks," for from this Crown we come, both upper and lower beings, and all are blessed as one.

"And the stone was great upon the mouth of the well," for this is the "Hard Judgment" <note>original: *dina kashya*</note> that stands over it from the "Other Side" <note>original: *sitra achra*, the realm of evil/impurity</note> to suckle from it. And all the flocks—these are the six crowns of the King <note>The six sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</note> that gather all together from the mystery of the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note> and pour into it. And when they all join as one to pour into it, it is written: "And they rolled the stone from the mouth of the well." They remove <margin>variant: they fence off</margin> that Hard Judgment and pass it away from it. "And they watered the sheep"—they pour blessings from that Crown to the upper and lower beings. Afterward, "And they put the stone back in its place upon the mouth of the well"—the Judgment returns to its place because the world needs it for its permanence and to rectify the world.

And now, may the Holy One, blessed be He, pour upon you blessings from the source of the stream, and may all the people of this generation be blessed through you. May all your portions be in this world and in the world to come. Concerning you it is written <note>Isaiah 54:13</note>: "And all your children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of your children."

**Rabbi Eleazar opened** and said <note>Psalm 149:5</note>: "Let the pious exult in glory; let them sing for joy upon their beds," and so on. Here we are able to tie the knot of Faith <note>original: *meimanuta*</note> to strengthen the blessings for everyone. All the faithfulness of the Holy One, blessed be He, is to descend for its rectification. And upon this, the High Priest <note>original: *K.G.* for Kohen Gadol</note> is able to be crowned behind, as we have established... and many times we have established this, that the Holy Name is crowned by this.

Come and see: at the time when Jacob desired that his sons be blessed as a knot <margin>variant: as a bond</margin> of Faith, what is written? <note>Genesis 49:28</note> "All these are the twelve tribes of Israel... and this (*Zot*) is what their father spoke to them." "This" (*Zot*) refers to the *Shekhinah* <note>The Divine Presence is often called "Zot" or "This"</note> who was bound to be strengthened with them so that the blessings would be sustained. This is what is written: "Every one according to his blessing he blessed them." What is "according to his blessing"? Like that which is prepared above, according to the blessing of each and every measure.

And come and see: all those measures ascend and are crowned and stand at the head of joy, and there the mystery of the King is crowned. He who searches in the high level of Piety <note>Chesed</note>, the pious ones inherit all that glory above, as it is written: "Let the pious exult in glory"—in this world; "let them sing for joy upon their beds"—in the world to come. <note>Psalm 149:6</note> "The high praises of God in their throat"—to know how to tie the knot of Faith as is fitting. And then, "a two-edged sword in their hand." This "two-edged sword" is the Sword of the Lord, connected to the Holy One, blessed be He, to stand against the flame of Judgments. And why? <note>Psalm 149:7</note> "To execute vengeance upon the nations," and so on.

And Rabbi Phinehas ben Jair grew great—the Crown of Kindness <note>Chesed</note>, the supernal head. Because of this, there is glory above, and the pious shall see. It is the supernal knot, the holy knot, the knot of Faith. And all your portions are in this world and in the world to come. Concerning this *Chet* <note>The letter of Life</note> he said: "And it shall be for you a memorial before the Lord." Rabbi Phinehas stood and kissed Rabbi Eleazar, and he proclaimed and blessed them like the dew of strength. He opened and said <note>Psalm 23:5</note>: "You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies..." They stayed there all that day, and all the companions were rejoicing in the words.

## Main Text (Zohar)

I came to the gathering and the joy of Rabbi Shimon, whose face shone like that of Rabbi Phinehas toward Rabbi Elazar. He was not found <note>original: "lo ashkhach," meaning he was in a state of deep meditative concealment or ecstasy</note> all that day and all that night, and he rejoiced with him. He applied the verse to him: *Then you shall delight in the Lord* <note>Isaiah 58:14</note>, for his portion is greater than that of his people. Concerning this it is written: *His kindness is before him, taste and see...* and from here, in this world, to destroy [evil] over him. Blessed is your portion, Rabbi Phinehas! They merited life for all. Peace to you and peace to your helpers, for the Lord is your helper. The Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: the feminine, indwelling presence of God</term> rejoiced, as did the Holy Constellation and the attribute of Kindness <term>Hesed: the Sefirah of expansive love and benevolence</term> within him, like Rabbi Elazar. Rabbi Phinehas looked upon Rabbi Shimon and blessed him and all the companions. When they saw the master, Rabbi Shimon said to the companions: *It is time to act for the Lord.* <note>Psalm 119:126</note>

Rabbi Isaac opened his discourse and said: It is written, *And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats...* <note>Leviticus 16:8</note> Why is this done? And why must Aaron be the one to cast the lots? And why this entire portion? The secret of the portion is before the Master, the order of the day, and it stands like a cloud to be known.

Rabbi Shimon opened and said: *And he shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats...* <note>Leviticus 16:5</note> Now, what did Joseph see that made him take Simeon to be with him more than his other brothers? Rather, Joseph saw that in every place, Simeon and Levi represent the beginning of Judgment <term>Din: the Sefirah of rigor, law, and severity</term>. For this reason, when they went on the way toward their brothers, Simeon opened first with Judgment. This is what is written: *And each man took his sword...* <note>Genesis 34:25</note> as in the earlier division. *And now, go...* and afterwards it is written: *And the sons of Jacob took...* Simeon and Levi were both rooted in Judgment. He took him [Simeon] so that strife would not be awakened among all the tribes.

We have learned: What did Simeon see in his joy more than Levi? For the Merciful One has compassion and covers him. Rather, Simeon struck and knew that Levi comes from the side of Judgment, but Simeon is bound to the side of "Hard Judgment" <note>original: "dina kashya," the most severe form of divine rigor</note> even more. He saw that if they were mixed one with the other, they would destroy the world. What did the Holy One, blessed be He, do? He took Levi as His own portion. He said: From here on, Simeon is not in the same company; he stands alone on the side of strength. Two pure weavers <note>original: "gardikei," likely referring to angelic forces or cosmic "weavers" of fate</note> were sanctified by his hands... and we establish them as the "strongholds of the earth" every single day. This is the meaning of the verse: *The wind goes round and round...* <note>Ecclesiastes 1:6</note>

The portion of Israel is greater than all the nations. They brought a gift to the Holy One, blessed be He, to purify them and have mercy on them, for they are His portion and His servants. This is what is written: *For the Lord's portion is His people...* <note>Deuteronomy 32:9</note> and it is written: *He made him ride on the high places of the earth* <note>Deuteronomy 32:13</note>—specifically "high places of the earth," for they are the lowest of the high, and therefore the Holy One, blessed be He, attached His chariot to them. This is what is written: *The Lord is with you, says the Lord.* And because of the great love He has for them, He gave them one day a year to purify them and forgive them for all their sins, as it is written: *For on this day [atonement shall be made for you]...* <note>Leviticus 16:30</note> Therefore, on this day, Israel is crowned and rules over all the "weavers" and all the "pure ones," so that they may be like those in the World to Come, and no sin is found in them. We have learned:

**And Aaron shall cast** lots upon the two goats. "And Aaron shall cast" because he comes from the side of Kindness <term>Hesed</term>. "Upon the two goats"—specifically "upon," so that the Matron <term>Matronita: a title for the Shekhinah</term> may be sweetened. *One lot for the Lord and one lot for Azazel.* Why two goats? One should be for the Lord. But the Holy One, blessed be He, said: Give a portion to the Accuser <note>original: "chultah," referring to the "scapegoat" given to the demonic realm to distract it</note>. When the sin is as heavy as a camel, the world cannot endure the weight of both. He finds Israel involved in many services, many levels, many hidden things... he cannot prevail over them when there is peace among them; he cannot act as a prosecutor <note>original: "delitora," from the Greek 'diabolos'</note> against them. He goes and roams the world to destroy Israel in many ways when the hour is ripe, but they cast upon him the burden of all the sins of Israel... like those who empty out food for the dogs under their hands, preparing to remove the evil from all those who act.

# After the Death (Acharei Mot)

Those who transgress the words of the Torah—on that day, the <term>Accuser</term> <note>original: "Delatora" (informer/prosecutor)</note> (page 69) is not permitted to speak against Israel. Every opening above is accessible for assistance, and many joys upon joys are sweetened through it. That decree which issues from the Accuser is silenced, for the <term>Prosecutor</term> <note>original: "Katigora"</note> is transformed into an <term>Advocate</term> <note>original: "Sanigora"</note>. It is fitting for them to confess, for in every place where Israel is found liable before Him, He gives them counsel to appease the prosecutor through the power of the sacrifice and the covering provided by those offerings and ascents that approach before the <term>Holy One, Blessed be He</term> <note>original: "Kadosh Baruch Hu"</note>. Then, the accusers are unable to do harm. On that day, more than all others, as Israel below acts with wisdom, they sweeten all those who possess the power of the <term>Accuser</term> (page 69), and all of it is a sacrifice and service to the <term>Holy One, Blessed be He</term>. Come and see, at that hour of which it is written:
> And Aaron shall take the two goats... (Leviticus 16:8)

They are awakened on that day above and seek to confuse and go out into the world. As soon as the Priest brings them near below, they are brought near above. Then the <term>lots</term> <note>original: "Advin"</note> arise on all sides; the Priest casts lots below and the Priest casts lots above. Just as one lot is designated for the <term>Holy One, Blessed be He</term> below, so it is above; and one lot subdues and rules in the world. The one below issues from the supernal remembrance, and one is bound to the other.

## The Faithful Shepherd (Ra'aya Meheimna)

<margin>It is written: "And he shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat."</margin>

->**The Commandment of the Faithful Shepherd**<-

**"And Aaron shall lean** both his hands upon the head of the live goat and confess over it..." (Leviticus 16:21). Because of this, Aaron leans his two hands—representing the hands of the <term>Holy One, Blessed be He</term>—and leans them upon the head of the "live" goat. It specifically says "live" to include the one above. "And he shall confess over it all the iniquities," just as it is written:
> And he shall confess that he has sinned in that thing (Leviticus 5:5)

We have established that when a soul departs, all that debt is found upon it. So too, "and he shall confess over it"—the Priest confesses alone on behalf of Israel "over it," meaning all of them are found to be "upon it" <note>the goat</note>. Similarly, regarding the sin, it is written:
> And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto the goats <note>demons/satyrs</note> (Leviticus 17:7)

He said to him: This applies here, for there <note>among the idolaters</note> they would offer sacrifices *to* the goats. For this reason, it does not say "they shall no more offer their sacrifices *of* goats," but "unto the goats," for there they performed worship and gave dominion to the goats. But here, it is written:
> And the goat shall bear upon it all their iniquities (Leviticus 16:22)

And the sacrifice is performed only to the <term>Holy One, Blessed be He</term>. Come and see that through the sacrifice, the upper and lower worlds are sweetened, and the "Gaze" <note>of judgment</note> does not rest or rule over Israel. "And he shall send it by the hand of a <term>timely man</term> <note>original: "Ish Itti" - a man designated for the task</note> into the wilderness." What is this <term>timely man</term>? <meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on Parashat Acharei Mot, specifically focusing on the spiritual mechanics of the "Good Eye" versus the "Evil Eye" and how these forces interact with the ritual of the scapegoat and the atonement of Israel's sins.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**After the Death**<-
<note>original: "Acharei Mot" (Leviticus 16:1)</note>

In everything that human beings strive for, there is a designated time for the matter to manifest. There is a person through whom blessings are established more than through another, because that person is prepared <note>destined or spiritually attuned</note> for blessings to be fulfilled through them. Conversely, there is a person through whom other things are destined to manifest; no matter how much they take up their rudder, their hoe, or their labor, they are like one who possesses an **Evil Eye**. Such a person is prepared for lack and is never prepared for good. Even if they recite a blessing, it is not a true blessing and is not sustained. But when they curse, every word of the curse is sustained and covers a person with harm. Therefore, the scripture does not simply write "the eye" in every place, for an unspecified eye refers to the eye of affliction. Come and see, it is written: "And this you shall not remember..." <note>referring to the influence of the stars or fate</note>. Because the "constellation" <term>Mazal: the spiritual flow or destiny from the stars</term> of the "Other Side" <term>Sitra Achra: the realm of impurity or evil</term> is awakened, which hangs there to act as a slanderer against Israel. What is written concerning them? **"He who has a Good Eye shall be blessed"** (Proverbs 22:9). He is prepared with joy, and all his blessings are fulfilled. Regarding this, we have learned: they wander when they are struck with illness and do not know, like a person who has a thorn in their foot and walks with difficulty. So too is the one who is prepared for this <note>the evil eye</note>, as it is written to make known that one person is more [spiritually] prepared than another.

---

A small portion of the "Side" that is over the eye is fixed with many hairs, and it does not look upon the Unity <note>the Divine Oneness</note> unless that person is prepared for it as is fitting. Regarding this, it is written: "as the time is seen." Just as the heart is the center, so in every place where he strikes with his hands, there was death; it was not like anything else brought near to him. It was like a mountain where every place he looked, even for good, everything turned to evil. There was a certain man who saw a [demon] like a goat, and its coverings were like horses. That man came and looked at it and fixed his eyes upon it. For this reason, in all things, a person is prepared for either this or that. And about this it is written: **"He who has a Good Eye shall be blessed"**—do not read it as "shall be blessed" but as "shall bless." <note>The Zohar often changes vowels in Hebrew words to reveal deeper meanings; here, the "Good Eye" becomes the source that bestows the blessing.</note> And so it stands: a man who goes into the desert, when he encounters that hairy spirit <note>the satyr or demon of the wilderness</note>, the "Ape" <note>a term for the deceptive forces of the Other Side</note> ascends the mountain and appears to him like two hands. It did not have the strength to split the mountain because it was enslaved to false deceptions. But the man was commanded to say: "And the iniquities of Your people shall be struck," etc. Because that **Prosecutor** <term>Katigora: the accusing angel</term> ascends and is transformed into an **Advocate** <term>Sanigora: the defending angel</term> for Israel. Then, all the sins of Israel are lightened. All that is written in those "notes" <note>heavenly records of debt</note> to the eye, to remember the sins of human beings, he takes them and casts them to the place called the **Depths of the Sea**. This is what is written: *“And You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea”* (Micah 7:19). This is the rebuke.

"And he shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two hairy goats for a sin offering" (Leviticus 16:5). The word "congregation" is used so that it shall be from all of them, to atone for all of them. For thus all the sins of the children of Israel are suspended, and they are all atoned for at that time.

# After the Death (Acharei Mot)

And it is not sufficient except for one. From which place were the substitutes and the "monkeys" <note>A mystical term for imitative, lower spiritual forces</note> of the animal given? > For on this day He will provide atonement for you...
<note>Leviticus 16:30</note>

Furthermore, Rabbi Shimon said: "And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother to the land of Seir, the field of Edom..." <note>Genesis 32:4</note>. On this day, the Priest is crowned with many crowns. On this day, the service of the Priest is more precious and greater than all other services. On this day, <margin>(it is time for rain)</margin> <term>Chesed</term> <note>Loving-kindness</note> is crowned in the world through the hand of the Priest who offers sacrifices for the sins of the people. First for his own sins, and afterward for the sins of the people; he offers for himself and for the people, and in this, the matter is established. ## Main Text (Zohar)

The paths are established for him and the distance shall be removed. And it is written: *From afar the Lord appeared to me, saying: I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving-kindness* <note>Jeremiah 31:2</note>.

->**And he shall go out**<-
**unto the altar that is before the Lord, etc.** (Leviticus 16:18). Is it truly "unto the Lord"? <note>The verse says "before the Lord," implying a specific spiritual proximity</note>. Come and see: even though there are those who ride and brandish swords and speak against [the light] when the day shines. They go and find heat and bowing and support in faith. During the day, he said, when the day shines, all those words that can be found are like words of praise toward this "Morning" when it awakens. From here we learn that this Morning belongs to the Patriarchs, as it is written: **And Abraham rose early in the morning** <note>Genesis 22:3</note>. At that time when they search between the evenings, all those who teach and complete and reach, the softness changes; the masters of wailing search and sing at that hour, and strife dwells in the world. The hour of delight that awakens before the young ones ceases, and those who burn for mercy pass through the gates of the holes, and the nature of the flesh of sin is like jugs; they go out and hang upon the heads of the wicked, and the witnesses of the glowing coals awaken from above to below. Then the Patriarch returns to his place entirely, and *Abraham returned to his place*. The time passes, and the guilty in Gehenna <note>The spiritual realm of purification or punishment</note> cry out and say: *Woe unto us! For the day declines, for the shadows of evening are stretched out* <note>Jeremiah 6:4</note>. At this hour, a person must be careful in the exile where they sit. When the night arrives, those who change and complete and bow and support search to create the curtain and they gird their swords. Then the judgments below awaken and go and roam through the world, and they go and speak with swords until the night is divided and hidden. After the night is divided, all the others gather as one and say praises; all the praises of the Lord shall they tell. Rabbi Yehuda said: Every head that is found in the morning, the praises of the Lord they herald. Rabbi Yose said: After the spirit goes out that awakens at midnight and departs, they herald praises until the light comes and redeems, and this Morning awakens; then joy and blessings are found in the world. Come and see, Rabbi Hama said: All of them are thus, and above are found the officers <note>original: סרכין (sarkhin) - high-ranking angelic ministers</note> below. At that hour when this Morning awakens and they are stirred, all those of anger and heat, a single Appointed One is placed over them. And Heman is his name, standing opposite below, and under his hand are officers appointed over them to oversee their service. At that hour when it awakens and comes to the time between the evenings, and all those who change and heat sing, the masters of wailing, a single Appointed One is found over them. And Jeduthun is his name, standing opposite below. And under his hand are officers appointed over them to prepare that entire song. At that hour when night arrives, all those of the power of the curtain awaken; then all is hushed and the exemption is found, and the judgments below all awaken and are placed together, window upon window, until the night is divided. After the night is divided and they are gathered, a single Appointed One is placed over them, and he gathers all the witnesses, everything changing for all the lower ones. And Asaph is his name, standing opposite below. And under his hand are all those officers appointed who herald praises. Then, because the morning comes, the Holy One, Blessed be He, awakens and bends the witnesses of heat to sacrifice them; and because everything is stirred, the Morning awakens. Then is the hour of desire for the Matron <note>original: מטרוניתא (Matronita) - the Shekhinah or Divine Presence in her feminine aspect</note> to converse with the King, and the King provides from himself a single thread [of grace].

# After the Death (Acharei Mot)

The reason we bless and spread [the canopy] over the **Matronita** <note>The Shekhinah, the Divine Presence viewed as a Queen or Mother</note> and over those who unite with her: Who are those who unite with her? They are those who labor in the **Torah** at midnight when the night is divided. **Rabbi Shimon** said: Blessed is the portion of one who comes with the Matronita at the hour she descends to receive the face of the **King** <note>Tiferet, the Divine Male principle</note> to converse with Him. Such a person is found with her at the time the King is ready and prepared to receive the Matronita. A voice goes out concerning the rest of the neighbors <note>other souls or angels</note> in his responsibility. What does "in his responsibility" mean? At that hour, the companions of that voice—the voice of when the night is divided—it is pure and leads to the freedom that is hers, where Judgment is sweetened. She enters into the soul of the King, she and all those who unite with her. The voice is found in his responsibility. > *He shall cover thee with His pinions, and under His wings shalt thou find refuge* (Psalms 91:4).

And the voice speaks with him in this way, and he calls to her to spread her wings. This is "A Psalm for the Sabbath Day," "The Lord remembered and called the earth," etc. **El** <note>God</note> is the hiddenness of Wisdom and is called **Chesed**. **Adonai** is **Gevurah** <term>Strength/Judgment</term>. **YHVH** is the completion of all, **Rachamim** <term>Compassion/Mercy</term>. And because of this, "He remembered and called the earth," etc. **Rabbi Eleazar** was sitting before **Rabbi Shimon** and said to him: We have learned that **Elohim** in every place refers to **Din** <term>Judgment</term>. Yet we find **YHVH Elohim** or **Elohai** <note>My God</note>—there are places called Elohim, such as "El YHVH Elohai," "He shall call Elohai," and yet these are Mercy in every place? He said to him: It is so, as it is written in the verse:
> *Know this day, and lay it to thy heart, that YHVH, He is the Elohim* (Deuteronomy 4:39).

And it is written:
> *YHVH, He is the Elohim* (1 Kings 18:39).

He said to him: From where do we know that in a place where there is Judgment, there is Mercy, and to place in a site where there is Mercy, there is Judgment? He said to him: Come and see that it is so. **YHVH** in every place is Mercy, but at the time when the wicked turn Mercy into Judgment, then it is written YHVH but we pronounce it as **Elohim**. For all the lower spirits, there are three levels, and each and every level is all one, and **Zeir Anpin** <note>The "Small Face" or emotive Sefirot</note> is all one, and they are tied as one and do not separate one from another. Come and see: **Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshamah** <note>The three levels of the soul: Vital, Spirit, and Higher Soul</note> and all those intentions that flame up—all of them shine and flame and are watered and blessed from that **river that flows and goes out** <note>The Sefirah of Binah/Understanding</note>, for everything is included in it and all is within it. And this river is called "Mother" to the **Assembly of Israel** <note>The Shekhinah</note> because it descends with her and does not separate from her. Because of this, every entrance and exit and inheritance for every side and opening is opened within her. And because of this, Mercy is found from her and Mercy is opened in her. And because we call her "Mother," the female **Gevurah** and purity go out from her, and it is called Mercy. Just as this is completed, they are awakened from the side of Judgment, and because of this, it is written with Mercy and punctuated <note>vowelized</note> so as to be moved by Mercy and to draw down Judgment in this order. **YHVH** is this one level. The second level is from the side of the voice that goes out and awakens another level called **Gevurah**, and this is called **Elohim**. It is all one; the letters and the secret are one from **Zeir Anpin**, and in him it returns. And so that you do not find this difficult, it is written "YHVH, He is the Elohim." For "YHVH, He is the Elohim"—all the letters are He, and He is one, and this is the second level. The third level is **Tzedek** <term>Righteousness/Justice</term>, the final Crown <note>Malchut</note>, for in it is the Judgment of the King, and it is found to be one. Thus it is written and thus it is called, and in all of them it is called. And this conclusion, this Crown, is completed and goes through those three levels that are called by the names of Judgment, and all are tied as one, all are parts as we have established. **El** is pleasing before the Holy One, Blessed be He. We have heard in the place where it is written "Chesed to Abraham," and it does not stand apart from him. "El" is confirmed in him; we have established the purpose in one, the end is tied in the heart and the spirit.

# After the Death (Acharei Mot)

## Main Text (Zohar)

And the secret of the matter is this: **Asher** <note>original: *Asher* (אשר). In Kabbalah, this word is often linked to the higher realm of Keter or Binah</note> is the inclusion of everything. When the hidden understandings are concealed and not yet specified, but are included in one place, then it is called **Asher**, the inclusion of all that is hidden and revealed. After the conclusion and the end of the **Crown** <note>term: *Keter* (Crown) - the highest and most hidden of the ten Sefirot/Divine emanations</note> emerged to be found, then it is called **Asher**—meaning Kindness <note>term: *Chesed* (Kindness) - the fourth Sefirah, representing expansive benevolence</note>, which is to say the numerical value of 72 <note>note: The name of 72 letters is associated with Chesed</note> gave birth to **Asher**, which is ready to conceive and to give birth to all. **Asher**, meaning the "Opening," for **Father** <note>term: *Abba* (Father) - the Sefirah of Chokhmah/Wisdom</note> is the general principle of everything, and **Asher** is the specification. **Asher** indicates that **Mother** <note>term: *Imma* (Mother) - the Sefirah of Binah/Understanding</note> has conceived and is ready to bring forth all the specific details and to reveal the **Holy Name**. Afterward, one seeks to know the specific detail of the matter—what it is—until he specifies and says **Asher** <note>gloss: the Foundation (Yesod)</note>, for this is the specification and the end of it later: **Asher**, **Asher**.

And it is found in the Book of King Solomon that **Asher** is the "binding of the ring," the higher binding, the fellowship where everything is found in union, for "our fellowship is like death" <note>note: a play on Song of Songs 8:6, "love is as strong as death"</note>. **Asher** is proven to give birth. **Come and see** how the powers move from level to level to show the Holy One, Blessed be He, below as He was at first. **Asher** is the inclusion of all that is hidden and not revealed, as we have said, and the end and the hidden Kindness we mentioned. And it is written:
> "Man knows not the price thereof..." <note>Job 28:13</note>

Afterward, that Crown brought forth the **Higher Mother**, and she conceived and was ready to give birth, and the word **Asher** appears twice to show she is ready to give birth and bring forth everything. Afterward, she turns to give birth, and it is not written **Asher** but **Asher**—meaning the "Opening" shall bring forth and everything shall be rectified. After everything has emerged and each one is rectified as is fitting, He encompasses everything and says **Asher**. This is the specification and this is the sustenance. And in the Book of Knowledge, he knew what the Holy Spirit is that supports the hidden and the revealed, to cleave to it in a way that other people do not cleave; happy is his portion.

Rabbi Elazar came and kissed his hands. He said, "Elazar my son, happy is your portion, for one should not write the **Holy Name** except as is proper. For anyone who does not know how to write the Holy Name properly and to tie the **Knot of Faith** <note>note: the mystical unification of the Sefirot</note>—the knot of oneness—to unify the Holy Name, concerning him it is written:
> "Because he hath despised the word of the Lord..." <note>Numbers 15:31</note>

What is the meaning of **"that soul shall utterly be cut off"**? Because he diminished one level or one knot from them. **Come and see**: At first, the "All of All" was hidden from all sides, understandings were not opened, neither male nor female. The "tip of the letter Yod" <note>note: the smallest point of the first letter of the Tetragrammaton</note> above hints at the **Infinite** (*Ein Sof*). Afterward, that Crown emerged, which enters and exits from it, and the letter **He** conceived from it, as it is written:
> "And a river went out of Eden..." <note>Genesis 2:10</note>

And it flows and does not rest, like a sprout that does not wish to be separated from it. And regarding "my beloved." And if you say the Crown is written as one, yet here there is a gathering of three? It is certainly so. It brought forth three, and in three, everything is included. And it brought forth before that Crown two children that the Mother suckles, and she conceived from them to bring them forth later—the letter **He** in this manner. And they are like those beneath Father and Mother. The Crown, to give birth, brought forth a male son and provided for him, and one must write the letter **Vav**. And he inherits the Wisdom of Father and Mother and inherits two portions. From him, the Daughter is nourished. Therefore, one must write the Crown and the [letter] together, just as at first **Yah** <note>note: the first two letters of the Name, Yod and He</note> are as one and are not to be separated. In the end, here, the [Vav] and the [He] are as one and should not be separated, to establish the matter. And afterward, the matters ascend thus. Happy is the portion of the righteous who know the **Higher Secrets** of the Holy King and rectify them for birth... <note>note: The final lines contain dense permutations and references to Rabbi Judah and Rabbi Yose regarding the "calling of the Earth" and the beauty of the world's creation.</note> When the Holy One, Blessed be He, wished to create the world, He brought everything down according to the pattern above. He made Jerusalem the center of all the earth... and from this place the worlds are blessed and nourished.

# After the Death (Acharei Mot)

No appearance at all, for he is the peace of the body of the world, and to this appearance. Come and see: Jerusalem is not blessed except through a shield <note>original: *magen*</note>. And because it is from above, everything is one, just as it is bound together. Come and see the portion of Rabbi Isaac:
> **And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the Lord, and make atonement for it** <note>Leviticus 16:18</note>
Is it just the "altar" in a general sense? As it were, just as it is done below, it is done above, so that everything is bound one to another. And come and see, as it is written, "and he shall strike and make atonement," just as we have said, so it is also above. And when the Priest <term>Kohen; the priest serving in the Temple</term> below arranges his service as it is above, so too, as it were, [the Presence] is not found above until it is found below. And from below, they awaken to raise the holiness of the Supreme King <term>Malka Ila'ah; a reference to the divine attribute of Zeir Anpin</term>, and all worlds are found as one before the Holy One, blessed be He.

Rabbi Judah said: If Israel only knew how to strike! The Holy One, blessed be He, commanded Israel to be set apart from all other nations, and when they perform the will of the Holy One, blessed be He, His [Presence] clings to them and not one word is missing from them. Come and see: how many chariots and how many hosts does the Holy One, blessed be He, possess? How many appointed rulers are found in His service? When He invited Israel in this world, it was said of them that they are like the holy crowns above, and they are called the "Holy Gate," so that they may be found in His service, bound to all the upper worlds as a single knot. And joys do not enter before Him, and the service is not performed before Him above, until Israel performs it below. Whenever Israel is found in the service of their Master below, so it is above. As it were, at the time when Israel neglected the service below, they caused it to be neglected above, and the service was found neither above nor below. And because Israel neglected the service of the Holy One, blessed be He, they were cast out from the Gate, and so it was above as well.

The Holy One, blessed be He, said: "Let them know how many multitudes, how many hosts are delayed because of you! Know that you are not worthy to stand in the world..." <note>The text here reflects on the gravity of Israel's spiritual responsibilities</note>. "And he shall make atonement"—what is written? "And he did not flee..." and this is the Priesthood. Just as the guilty do not [escape] their sins, etc. For this reason, "And he shall go out to the altar"—the altar in a general sense. He returned "before the Lord"—in a general sense—"and made atonement for it," for Aaron. Afterwards, "And he shall go out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people," etc. "And he shall make atonement for him"—this refers to his portion. My light! And was Kindness <term>Chesed; the divine attribute of mercy</term> not awakened in the world as before? Come and see, it is written:
> **And he shall make atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel** <note>Leviticus 16:16</note>
What is "atonement for the holy place"? Rather, it is a different measure. We have learned: the guilty create a blemish above and awaken judgments, causing the Sanctuary to be defiled, and the powerful "guilty ones" surround it to draw light from it. Then judgments are awakened in the world. Therefore, the Priest must purify everything and be crowned with his holiness, which is the "Head of the King," so that the King may come to dwell with the Matron <term>Matronita; the Shekhinah or Divine Presence in its feminine aspect</term>. And when the Head of the King includes everything, he comes to unite with the Matron and to awaken joy and blessings in the world.

It turns out that everything ascends above and below, depending upon the Priest. For if his lower [aspect] is awakened, everything is awakened, and everything is found in its perfection. And regarding this it is written, "And he shall make atonement for the holy place," as before, "and he shall make atonement for the holy place" to grant peace in the world and to sanctify holiness in the world. And when the joy of the union is found between the King and the Matron, all hidden things and all good things are found in joy, and all the world and all those who find favor before the King are atoned for. Then: "from all your sins before the Lord shall you be clean." And likewise it is written:
> **And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he goeth in to make atonement in the holy place, until he come out** <note>Leviticus 16:17</note>
At the hour when he enters to unite them, and at the moment when the King and the Matron unite, at that hour "he shall make atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation." Come and see: "And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting."

Rabbi Isaac opened with the verse:
> **Then will I remember My covenant with Jacob, and also My covenant with Isaac...** <note>Leviticus 26:42</note>
This verse was established for the time when Israel is in exile. As it were, the Holy One, blessed be He, is with them in exile, for the Shekhinah <term>The Divine Presence</term> never departs from them. Come [and see]: at the time when Israel is found in exile, the Shekhinah is among them, spread out and suffering with them in the exile. And the merit of the Patriarchs is the righteousness that is arranged and found...

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**After the Death**<-

They are found gate within gate, and these gates are aligned above. One is raised below, for the <term>Matronita</term><note>The feminine aspect of the Divine, the Shekhinah</note> is in sovereignty, and everything is strengthened like the King of kings. Regarding this, the Sages of the Great Assembly called it the "Great Assembly," and this is attached at all times when it is attached to the "Assembly of the Living" <note>Chai/18</note>, and the Holy One, blessed be He, called it all to fulfill their [Israel's] needs and to bring them out of exile. And if they are not worthy, He detains them in exile until that decreed time. But if those below are worthy and merit the Lord, the Holy One, blessed be He, is found for the glory of His name and will not remember the assembly against them, as it is written:
> "Then I will remember My covenant with Jacob..." <note>Leviticus 26:42</note> 

If they are all worthy. **Rabbi Hiyya** said: What is the reason that Jacob is mentioned first in everything? It is because Jacob is the inclusion of them all, and the voice goes to the Assembly of Israel, and the Holy Male is attached to it; thus we read "Jacob," etc. **Rabbi Isaac** said: These are in the form of the thirteen attributes which he inherits as an inheritance. **Rabbi Abba** said: These appear included as 8, 8, and 6 <note>Numerical values of letters</note>, and that he should sit upon the throne of them all, and upon the likeness of the throne:
> "A likeness as the appearance of a man upon it from above." <note>Ezekiel 1:26</note>

The letter *Aleph* is hidden because of him and is not revealed, and this is what is written: "For I have sworn by the throne of the Lord" <note>Exodus 17:16</note>, it is written as a shortened form and not fully explored. And these are all in the beginning, though not the very first. And these are in the first beginning, this wisdom is the <term>Yesod</term><note>Foundation; the ninth Sefirah, representing the procreative/connecting force</note> which is the end of the body, and all belong to it. And because of this, they all come one by one, and this is a secret and a brain as we have established. And see, two letters are in this manner, and these are to be taken also thus. And although we have established the matter: the letter *Kaph* is spread out; a bent *Kaph* (כ) is the Matronita, and the other is the letter *Vav* (ו) which is the *Yesod*, because she is found from him. A straight *Vav* is below and is the end of the <term>Tiferet</term><note>Beauty/Harmony; the central Sefirah, representing the King/Male aspect</note>, and because of this, all the letters are joined and attached to one another. And if you say, why is it tied? The Sages intended the bent [Kaph] to arrange its palms toward the straight *Vav*, only for the glory of the King, that it should turn its palms toward the King. And see, if it is not included because of him, it is engraved because of the open and closed *Mem* (מ/ם). The open *Mem* is when it joins with the closed *Samekh*, for they close the path. And although they spread out at times. And there are those who are wise in this, then we see them all as a sealed fountain. **Rabbi Isaac** [said]: Like the desire of the Holy King to remember Israel for the sake of His name, and the other [aspect], the Matronita, is to be trodden upon; then it is written: <quote>"And there shall be no man in the Tabernacle of Meeting when he goes in to make atonement in the Holy Place."</quote> <note>Leviticus 16:17</note>. So too the Priest, at the time he enters to unify the Holy Name and to make atonement in the Holy Place, to join the King with the Matronita, it is written: "And there shall be no man in the Tabernacle of Meeting," etc. Come and see, **Rabbi Judah** [said]: The Priest awakens peace in the world, above and below. And see, on one level he restrains his body, bent from level to level, and the material restrains his body, holding peace this way and that; he spreads his hands and they are blessed like the King. And in everything they need to show the action, and they need to show the covering of the King in the movement of the action, that he should intend until everything is arranged as it ought to be, and they shall be blessed through him. And see: three openings of the letter *Yod* (י) are engraved; letters on the sides to be tied to the *Yod*. And it is said: "Life to the *Yod*" until it ascends into the *Yod*. And they are gathered, his covering and his preparation; the letter *He* (ה) is closed, all of them are the *He* of the world. Return to the gates with the engravings of the arrangements to one as a light, and the nature of the hidden porches; the *He* ascends and is crowned with "Life" <note>Chai/18</note>, and they prepare the gates from where they stand. When he is protected by his crowns like the King, these spread into twelve engravings, crowning the *He* to the *Vav*... the crowns that are crowned as one crown, returning with crown upon crown. Ten crowns are the engraving of the Holy Spirit, one above and one below, reaching to the seven <margin>(from the four, one corresponds to the seven)</margin>. An engraving of engravings in their movements, hidden natures of crowns from above to below, like cups and flowers; it does not ascend nor do the engravings reach one another as they are tied <margin>(Kaph, Samekh, Pe, Tzadi, Vav... Mem, Pe, Gimel, He, Pe, Vav, Vav, Kaph, Samekh)</margin>. Search this out thoroughly, and you shall take the vision of the strength and beauty of His arm, and this is from His hand to remember Jacob, and it is written: "And He gave," and He purified and improved the rock of your strength. Then everything is tied together.

# After the Death

Everything is as one, as this shines into that; the openings shine to all of them. Then they all fall upon their faces and proclaim: "Blessed be the Name of His glorious Kingdom forever and ever." And a Voice is bound with him, as it is written: *And one called to another and said...* <note>Isaiah 6:3</note> "You shall be purified." Only the priests say "You shall be purified," and now, when the priest is purified below, that Voice strikes within him: *From all your sins before the Lord...* Since it is written: *From all your sins you shall be purified before the Lord* <note>Leviticus 16:30</note>, it must mean literally "before the Lord." For we have learned: From the beginning of the year, the books are open and the judges judge; every single day the courts are present and opened in judgment until that day called the ninth of the month. On that day, all judgments ascend to the Master of Judgment, and the **Upper Throne** <note>The divine seat of Mercy</note> is prepared for the Holy King. On that day, Israel below is required to rejoice with joy before their Master, who is destined to sit for them upon the Throne of Mercy, the Throne of Forgiveness. And all those books are open before Him and sit before Him. Then: *From all your sins before the Lord you shall be purified.*

"Before the Lord" literally. Those who recite the verse until now say it and no more; no one else has permission to say "You shall be purified" except the **High Priest** <term>High Priest: The Kohen Gadol, the only person permitted to enter the Holy of Holies</term> who performs the service and offers the **Holy Incense** <term>Holy Incense: The Ketoret, a mystical blend of spices representing the elevation of the physical to the spiritual</term> with his mouth. And when it is to be offered and blessed by his mouth, that Voice descends and strikes him, and the word is made certain in the mouth of the priest, and he says: "You shall be purified." He performs the service, and all those celestial beings who are present are blessed. Afterward, he strengthens his body and raises his hands above in another holy service until he intends to enter another place, the holiest of all. Three rows of priests and Levites surround him, and all the rest of the people encircle him and raise their hands over him in prayer. A cloud of purity hovers over his feet. He takes three steps, and all of them remain in their places and do not follow him. To offer the **incense**, he takes another three steps, and he closes them all off to return to his place. He takes three more steps, closes his eyes, and binds himself above. He enters the place he enters and hears the sound of the wings of the **Cherubim** <note>Angelic figures atop the Ark of the Covenant</note> singing and beating their wings, spread out above, shielding. The sound of their wings is heard, and they all cleave together. If the priest is worthy, a great desire is found there above. At that moment, **Divine Favor** <term>Favor: Ratzon or Re'u, a state of cosmic alignment and grace</term> emerges for the priest; they are sweetened by the scents of the mountains of pure balsam above. The scent travels through that entire place above into the two nostrils and settles there. Then everything is in joy, and no prosecutor is found there. The priest opens his mouth in prayer with will and joy, and reveals his prayer. After he finishes, the Cherubim raise their wings as before and sing. Then the priest knows it is a time of favor and a time of joy for all. And the people know, as it is written: *Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow* <note>Isaiah 1:18</note>. A voice goes out behind him and reveals his prayer. Blessed is the portion of the priest through whose hands joy upon joy is found on that day above and below. Regarding that hour it is written: *Happy is the people that is in such a case; happy is the people whose God is the Lord* <note>Psalms 144:15</note>.

**And this** shall be a statute forever unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls... <note>Leviticus 16:29</note> etc. Rabbi Hiyya opened: *With my soul have I desired Thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek Thee early* <note>Isaiah 26:9</note> etc. "With my soul have I desired Thee in the night"—it should have said "My soul desires Thee." What is "With my soul have I desired Thee"? And "with my spirit within me will I seek Thee early"—it should have said "I will seek Thee." Rather, thus we have learned: **The Holy One, Blessed be He** <note>The standard rabbinic title for God</note> is the Spirit and Soul of all, and Israel says: "You are my Soul and my Spirit, therefore I have desired to cleave to You, and I seek You early to find Your favor." Rabbi Yose said: At the hour when a person sleeps in his bed, his soul departs and ascends and testifies about the person regarding everything he did during the day. The body says to the soul: "With my soul have I desired Thee in the night..."

# After the Death (Acharei Mot)

"Even with my spirit within me, I seek You" <note>Isaiah 26:9; original: *Af ruchi bekirbi ashachreka*</note>. This refers to the Assembly of Israel <note>The *Knesset Yisrael*, a personification of the Jewish people and the mystical Shekhinah</note>, who speaks before the Holy One, blessed be He. She is included even while you are in exile among the nations, where darkness and anger surround her on every side <insert>and relief is far from every side</insert> because of the oppression among the nations. I have sought You out so that You may be found below. "Even with my spirit within me, I seek You"—meaning that even though they are enslaved to foreign labor like all other servants, the Holy Spirit has not departed from me, so that I may seek You and perform Your commandments. Rabbi Isaac said: The Assembly of Israel says this before the Holy One, blessed be He, while she is in exile; even though she is included there, because she stands in a position of defense, she must fear You: "Even with my spirit within me, I seek You." When a person awakens with the Holy Spirit, they should labor in the Torah to do Your will, "for when Your judgments are on the earth" <note>Isaiah 26:9</note>—just as judgment exists on earth to establish the world, so then "the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness." This means they are able to endure the judgment of Righteousness <note>The attribute of *Tzedek*</note> so the world is not left in ruins. When do the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness? When Your judgments are on the earth. Rabbi Hezekiah said: "I have sought You"—this is the Assembly of Israel; "Even with my spirit within me, I seek You"—this is the Holy One, blessed be He.

Rabbi Hiyya was sitting before Rabbi Shimon. Rabbi Shimon rose at midnight to labor in the Torah. All the companions rose with him, including Eleazar and Rabbi Abba. Rabbi Shimon opened his discourse and said:
> **As the deer longs for streams of water, so my soul longs for You, O God.** <note>Psalms 42:2</note>
The companions have explained this verse: these are the people of Israel, to whom the Holy One, blessed be He, gave a holy soul—a holy crown above all other nations—so that they might perform the commandments and delight in the Torah. For anyone who delights in the Torah fears nothing, as it is written:
> **Unless Your Torah had been my delight, I would then have perished in my affliction.** <note>Psalms 119:92</note>
What are these "delights"? It is the Torah, for the Torah delighted before Him, as it is written:
> **And I was His delight day by day.** <note>Proverbs 8:30</note>
And all of this is because the Holy One, blessed be He, comes to delight with the righteous in the Garden of Eden, to delight because He rejoices in them. For we have learned: Happy are the righteous, of whom it is written, **"Then you shall delight in the Lord,"** <note>Isaiah 58:14</note> to enjoy that place from which the river flows and waters the Garden of Silver <note>A mystical reference to the flow of Divine emanation</note>. As it were, the Holy One, blessed be He, delights in them from that flow of the river in which the righteous take pleasure. Therefore, He comes to delight with the righteous, and whoever labors in the Torah merits to delight with the righteous.

***

## The Faithful Shepherd

-> **Ra’aya Meheimna** <-

The Faithful Shepherd <note>A title for Moses, who appears in the Zohar to reveal secrets regarding the commandments</note> said: From the aspect of the Higher Realm, these are the Masters of Wisdom <term>Ma'arei Chokhmata: scholars of mystical insight</term> of whom the verse speaks. They are called the Masters of Torah. And what is the meaning of "As the deer longs for streams of water"? These are the "streams of water" of the Torah that belong to the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: the feminine indwelling presence of God</term>. There is no Torah without humility below. These streams are like a young woman in labor <note>A metaphor for the difficult "birth" of wisdom or redemption</note>, and these are the Masters of Judgment who give birth through the lack of the Shekhinah, as it is said, **"and she who bore you shall rejoice."** <note>Proverbs 23:25</note> They are like the assembly of a young woman... and they cry out many times above until the Voice of the Lord <note>The Tetragrammaton, written here as a cipher *Yadud*</note> is awakened for her. Immediately, **"The voice of the Lord makes the deer to calve,"** <note>Psalms 29:9</note> referring to the Masters of the Mishnah <term>Ma'arei Matnitin: scholars of the oral law</term>. "The virgins in her train" <note>Psalms 45:15</note>—all of them shall have strength like a woman in labor, standing in the pressures of those who oppress them, arguing with many hammers of judgment... and the merit is opened for the birth of children... for the righteous, the masters of Divine measures, the masters of the secrets of the Torah, the masters of deep analysis, the masters of Awe, the masters of Kindness and the pious, the masters of strength and the vessels for the Throne of Truth. Even when the enemy presses them and they are poor... the Masters of the Mishnah... for the wisdom of the scribes shall become corrupt, and those who fear sin shall be despised, and the truth shall be missing... and the poor shall be shamed...

# After the Death (Acharei Mot)

## Main Text (Zohar)

### [Upper Left Column]
In the likeness of that watering from the stream. Come and see, all is delight upon the watercourses. This is the **Assembly of Israel** <note>Hebrew: *Knesset Yisrael*, a title for the Shekhinah</note> when they are found in a strong crown. Delight upon the watercourses, for she is to be restored by the watering of the springs of the stream through the **Righteous One** <note>The Sefirah *Yesod*, the masculine creative foundation</note>. Delight is like a bed of spices. Thus, the delight of the exchange is prepared from this.

### [Upper Right Column]
The Lord shall fly in the day... to open the hundred to the end... crowned by two olives to praise the two Messiahs... and the moisture went between the blessing... her moisture is prevented... two legs, gathering and foundation <note>The Sefirot *Netzach* and *Hod*</note>... two washings in the full book... and the formation shall be established and pass from the world. Until here <note>original: *ad kan*, marking the end of a variant fragment</note>.

---

### [Main Body Text]
In this world and in the world to come. The springs of the stream are those springs, one above, as it is written:
> And a river went out of Eden to water the garden... (Genesis 2:10)

And from there it flows and goes out and waters appropriately, and all those springs go out and are gathered into two springs called Strength and Majesty <note>The Sefirot *Netzach* and *Hod*</note>, and these investigate and stand in that level of the **Righteous One** <note>*Yesod*</note> which issues and flows from it, and the watering is prepared. Because of this, he is worthy as these are found: Righteousness and Justice <note>The union of the masculine and feminine divine aspects</note>. Come and see, it is written:
> The voice of the Lord makes the hinds to calve (Psalms 29:9)

"Hinds" (*ayilot*) is written defectively <note>without the letter 'vav'</note>; this refers to the **Doe of the Dawn** <note>Hebrew: *Ayelet HaShachar*, a name for the Shekhinah</note> who comes at midnight. At the hour when the **Holy One, blessed be He**, enters the Garden of Eden to delight with the righteous, this Voice goes out and calls to all those "hinds" that surround the Holy Throne of Glory, and then it flies from the Throne. This is "makes the hinds to calve," then we have learned this is the covenant. **And strips the forests bare**—this is like the honeycomb. And it is written:
> I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey (Song of Solomon 5:1)

And He proves them all exactly. The Elder said to him:
> With my soul have I desired Thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek Thee early (Isaiah 26:9)

"I have desired Thee" (*avviticha*)—it should have said "You" (*otcha*). "I will seek Thee early" (*ashachrecha*)—it should have said "He will seek Thee" (*yeshachrecha*). Rather, they have established it as being written:
> In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the spirit of all human flesh (Job 12:10)

Come and increase the spirit to be known <note>variant: to speak</note>... to be restored for the worlds. Come and see the service of the heart that a person must serve the **Holy One, blessed be He**, as we have learned:
> And thou shalt love the Lord thy God... (Deuteronomy 6:5)

One should love the **Holy One, blessed be He**, with the love of the soul itself, and this is the service of the soul and the spirit. Just as these are found in the body and the body loves them, so should a person attach himself to love the **Holy One, blessed be He**, with the love of his soul and spirit to cleave to Him. This is what is written: **"With my soul have I desired Thee in the night."** That is to say, literally. **"Yea, with my spirit within me will I seek Thee early"** to cleave to You with a precious love. For a person must, out of love for the **Holy One, blessed be He**, rise every night to labor in His service until the morning awakens and a thread of loving-kindness is drawn over him. For we have learned: all the portion of that person whose love is this, he loves the **Holy One, blessed be He**. And so are the righteous of truth; they love the **Holy One, blessed be He**, in such a way that the world is sustained through them, and they rule over all harsh decrees above and below, so that the world may exist for their sake.

Come and see, the Voice and the Word <note>The union of *Tiferet* and *Malchut*</note> are found like the spirit and the soul above in the Holy King, with love as is fitting. He rules at the gate below, and whatever he decrees upon the world is fulfilled. From where do we know this? From Elijah, as it is written:
> As the Lord liveth, before whom I stood, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word (1 Kings 17:1)

Come and see, at the hour when the holy souls descend from above to below, and those righteous of the world draw them down from the King and the **Matron** <note>The Shekhinah</note>, they dwell in that hour when the soul stands before the King, and the will of the King is to look upon her. As we have established, at the hour when the Holy One breathed the spirit with all strength and grace... all the hosts were made and stood in their existence. This is what is written:
> ...and all the host of them by the breath of His mouth (Psalms 33:6)

And from then they were delayed until the **Holy One, blessed be He**... to die...

# After the Death

He has an opening. And come and see: there are times when the world was created before the Holy One, blessed be He, and they remained still until the time arrived for Him to bring them down to the earth, and they rule above and below. He turned and saw, "The Lord before whom I stood" <note>original: *Adonai asher amadti lefanav*; see 1 Kings 17:1</note>. It is not written "who does not stand," but rather "whom I stood." And after he returns to his place and ascends to his portion, those others do not ascend until they die, because they did not stand [before Him] previously like those others. Because of this, Elijah was made into a messenger angel <term>messenger angel: *malakha shelicha*, a being that bridges the human and divine realms</term> above. And those who are more closely attached to the King [are found so].

It is found in the *First Book of Adam* that all the holy spirits above perform missions, and they all come from one place where they are sustained by two levels that are included as one; because of this, they ascend higher and their level is greater. And so it is, and all those who were hidden there when they arrived and ascended during their lifetimes—such as Enoch, in whom death was not found—we have established this matter regarding Enoch and Elijah.

And come and see: five crowns and five thousand levels for the righteous ascended in [Divine] Will before the world was created. The Holy One, blessed be He, prepares them for this world in every single generation; they ascend and strengthen the world and are bound in the **Bond of Life** <note>original: *tzrora d'chayyi*, the collective treasury of souls</note. And the Holy One, blessed be He, is destined to renew the world like them. Concerning them it is written:
> *For as the new heavens and the new earth...* <note>Isaiah 66:22</note>

**You shall afflict** your souls <note>Leviticus 16:29</note>. According to its plain meaning: because Israel is found before the Holy King, and they give their will to the Holy One, blessed be He, and are found in Him so that their sins may be atoned. And since they ate and drank on the ninth [of Tishrei] and delighted the soul by ceasing from food and drink, it is found that the crowning of the soul's affliction is in two parts, and it is as if they fasted on both the ninth and the tenth. "Your souls" <note>plural</note> is to include everything—the spirit and the soul—and they are found on this day to be atoned for their sins. Come and see:
> *For on this day He shall atone for you.* <note>Leviticus 16:30</note>

"On this day." The moon stands in its fullness. Rather, "on *this* day" specifically, for in it the **Holy Ancient One** <term>Holy Ancient One: *Atika Kadisha*, the highest, most hidden aspect of the Divine</term> is revealed to provide atonement for the sins of all.

<term>Another explanation: *Davar Acher*</term> "You shall afflict your souls." Rabbi Isaac opened:
> *There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.* <note>Ecclesiastes 9:14</note>

"A little city." This has been established. But "a little city" is as it is said <note>as an example of a saying</note>: "We have a strong city; He sets up victory as walls and ramparts" etc. And it is written, "He did not desire the city." A "little city" is small indeed, for it is the smallest of all. Though there be many mountains and strong, fortified metropolises, they call it the "Holy City." "And few men within it"—these are the ones who merit to ascend into it and to guard it. As it is said:
> *Who shall ascend the mountain of the Lord? And who shall stand in His holy place?* <note>Psalms 24:3</note>

And regarding this, "and few men within it." "And there came a great king against it"—this is the Holy One, blessed be He, to join with it and to guard it. "And besieged it," as it is said:
> *For I, says the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about.* <note>Zechariah 2:9</note>

"And built great bulwarks against it"—for He built walls and armaments and beauties from all precious stones. And all the glory of the King enters within it. Because of this, they are all included in all the crowns of the King, and all the King's crowns are crowned within it; therefore, "and few men within it." It is written:
> *Now there was found in it a poor wise man.* <note>Ecclesiastes 9:15</note>

This is because he is included in every "poor" thing, as it is said: "And he built store cities [*miskenot*, related to *misken*/poor] for Pharaoh." He is crowned with mighty crowns like the crowns of the **Torah**, like the crowns of the commandments of the King's Torah. "And wise"—for he merits wisdom within it; and "wise"—for he is wiser than all to enter into the **service** <term>service: *pulchana*, referring to divine worship or labor</term> of his Master, in order to merit it and enter it. This "and he by his wisdom delivered the city"—"delivered" [*millet*] is like "to save it" or "to rescue it." If he is worthy, "he by his wisdom delivered the city." "Yet no man remembered that same poor man"—and the [Evil] Inclination did not remember to perform the commandments of the Torah, to labor in the Torah like that poor man who is broken in everything. Because—
