## Commentary Sections

### Repentance (Teshuvah)
<note>Right Column</note>

Rabbi Isaac and Rabbi Judah were walking on the road to Lod. Rabbi Judah said, "Let us speak words of Torah as we go." Rabbi Judah opened his discourse and said: *If a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit...* <note>Exodus 21:33</note>. What is written after it? *The owner of the pit shall make it good...* Come and see: so it is with one who causes the world to darken through his sins. Even though he has denied the world and caused the "Female" to sin... yet if he performs **Repentance** <note>original: *Teshuvah*</note>, it is as if he literally remakes himself. For that which he blemished above, he repairs; as our Sages said, Repentance repairs everything. It repairs above, it repairs below, it repairs the person himself, and it repairs the whole world. His companion Rabbi Judah <note>likely a scribal error for another sage</note> opened and said: "It has already been explained to you that Repentance is the highest of all..."

### The Faithful Shepherd (Ra'aya Meheimna)
<note>Left Column - This section uses highly condensed Kabbalistic code regarding the Hebrew letters of the Name of God</note>

This refers to Cain... and through our sins the **Holy Temple** <note>original: *Beit Mikdash*</note> was destroyed... and there is nothing left but "Words" alone and not the Kingdom. And whoever returns in Repentance, they all return the letter *He* <note>ה</note> which was oppressed... and this is the secret of Repentance: returning the *He* to the *Vav* <note>ו</note>. This is the secret of the word: *Take with you words, and return to the Lord; say unto Him...* <note>Hosea 14:3</note>. Whenever our lips are blemished... when a man sins, he immediately causes the *He* to be distanced from the *Vav*, and the *Yod* <note>י</note> departs. Then the "Woman" <note>the Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note> falls, the Temple is distanced, and Israel is exiled among the nations. But whoever performs Repentance causes the *He* to return to the *Vav*, and our redemption entirely depends on this. For as the early masters said: "All the deadlines for redemption have passed, and the matter depends only on Repentance."

It emphasizes that Repentance (Teshuvah) is the mystical process of repairing these defects and reuniting the letters of the Divine Name to bring redemption.</summary>

# Naso

| Since judgment was joined to it, it is not found until the appointed times. After it is completed and one has performed **Repentance**, he rectifies all the worlds. This is implied by what is written: *And I will wipe away all these memories in the end of days* <note>original: "ומחיתי כל הדכרין הללו באחרית הימים"</note>, and it is written: *And you shall return to the Lord your God...* (Deuteronomy 30:2). *For the Lord your God is a merciful God...* (Deuteronomy 4:31). In the "end of days" there is no wiping away except to include the **Assembly of Israel** <note>Knesset Yisrael; the mystical personification of the Jewish people/the Shekhinah</note> who is in exile and is found in their distress; He never abandons them. Because of this, the **Holy One, Blessed be He**, tempers judgment with kindness in the world, desiring that they should return and enter into Repentance to do good for them in this world and the world to come, and to be saved from that which stands before Repentance. Come and see: when they merit, the Assembly of Israel is called "Repentance" <note>Teshuvah; literally "Return"</note>. And if you say "Higher Repentance" <note>Teshuvah Ila'ah, associated with the Sefirah of Binah/Understanding</note> is not found everywhere, rather this is called Repentance when Kindness and Mercy are toward it, and through it, she returns over all those hosts and cleanses them. And "Excellent Repentance" is when the Letter *He* (ה) is joined to her and takes her with strength to protect her in Repentance; then all is rectified above and below, and the end and the whole world are rectified. One guilty person in the world corrupts many... woe to the guilty and woe to his neighbors! Come and see: Joseph, because he did not wish to follow the seductions of the Mistress <note>Potiphar's wife</note>, many people were protected through him until they all turned to him... and then they were all saved. And the Holy One, Blessed be He, had mercy on him afterward and did good for many hosts in the world... This is what is written: *I called out of my distress to the Lord, and He answered me* (Jonah 2:3), and it is written: *From the straits I called to God; God answered me with a vast expanse* (Psalms 118:5). | This is what is written: *And you shall return to the Lord your God*—until the Unity. Therefore, "Return" is not called from a day, for from the cause of Repentance one stands for life... and therefore everything is in the whole, for they entered into the particularity of **man** <term>Bar Nash: A human being, often referring to the archetypal or mystical Man</term> without toil and without weariness. The letter *He* (ה) is in Repentance; and concerning it, it is said: *For by everything that proceeds from the mouth of the Lord does man live* (Deuteronomy 8:3). This stands upon the head of **man**; concerning it, it is said: *And the Lord shall look back.* But in the soul, life walks. And because it rests upon the head of **man**, it is said to **man** to walk... so that the Shekhinah <note>Divine Presence</note> does not depart from the head of **man**... And if you say that for this reason he protects the worlds, even though the heavens and earth and all their hosts were not created through them... he protects... so that the Sitra Achra <note>the "Other Side" or evil forces</note> does not prevail over the worlds... especially over the guilty among the nations, the "Mixed Multitude" <note>Erev Rav</note> who are mixed with Israel... but certainly according to the Image <note>Diyukna</note>... "I have a good gift in my treasury..." and when he protects Israel, they have no weariness or servitude. And just as there is toil and weariness, there is "Sabbath and rest" to receive life upon the head of **man**... and the Image is upon **man**... for **man** moves at all times to walk in good paths and to fulfill the **248 commandments** <term>248 positive mitzvot, corresponding to the limbs of the body</term>... the letter *He* (ה) which in its recognition rises to the Crown... and specifically to dwell on the head which is called "Fear"... and concerning them it is said: *And God destroyed Sodom...* Two good images are for life, for the whole and the received. **Man** from the side of the letter *Yod* (י) and received from the side of the letter *He* (ה)... *Yod* (י) rests to protect the head of **man**... so that **man** shall fear the Place <note>God</note> and crown his limbs so that he does not transgress the negative commandments. The letter *He* (ה) rests on the head of **man** and there enters the love of the Holy One for His 248 commandments, to fulfill the positive commandments. *Yod* (י) lives on the head of **man** and brings forth the *Vav* (ו) upon the mouth of **man**, words to study the Torah... and in this unity, because of the change and the return... to protect the dwelling... |

## Main Text (Zohar)

...and they are divided. If one is worthy, he dwells [in holiness]; if not, he is cast out from all. And also "the Sabbath, and He rested" <note>Exodus 31:17</note>, and also may His Name be blessed <note>original: יתגז"ל, likely shorthand for Yitbarach Shemo</note>. Hand and foot, and they are consumed as nothing. By her <note>the Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note> all worlds are created, and all exist in water and earth and glory. And all creatures are stirred, as it is written:
> These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created (Genesis 2:4)
Through the letter *Heh* He created them <note>A classic wordplay: *Be-hibaram* (when they were created) is read as *Be-He baram* (With the letter Heh He created them)</note>. And He does not distance Himself from the world even for a moment, for if He did, everything would be destroyed and nullified and would not exist in the world. The letter *Heh* of the Name *YHVH* is not a mere breath, but through her everything exists. Every living thing moves by the power of the Name. Names come and rest upon it—that which is called "impurity" rests upon the disqualified, such as the Angel of Death, darkness, gloom, and a burden upon the body of a man. At those times, a man is called "dead." Therefore, the word was said to cover him in death, for the Lord God <note>YHVH Elohim</note> restores us and we live. All the positive commandments that were destined to be in the many charges of her <note>the Torah/Shekhinah</note>, all of them mourn for him. And the secret of the matter is that they were meant to be his greatness and his inheritance, etc. And Rabbi Eleazar said: The commandments mourn for him, for the supernal image was meant to rest upon his head. And just as the image does not rest upon a righteous man until they raise up for him all the good deeds he merited for the World to Come, so too the image does not rest upon the head of the wicked, who are gathered into evil traps to inherit Gehenna <note>Purgatory/Hell</note>. And because of this, there is "vanity" and there is "vanity." There is a treasure of which it is said:
> For by everything that proceeds out of the mouth of the Lord does man live (Deuteronomy 8:3)
And there is a vanity in which one is embittered:
> This also is vanity and a striving after wind (Ecclesiastes 1:14)
And come and see: when a man is able to recognize the countenance that rests upon him, and the appearance of his face—"their faces were turned backward"—also in the image one can recognize the living countenance that dwells upon him: whether it is a Lion, or an Ox, or an Eagle, or a Man <note>The four faces of the Divine Chariot in Ezekiel's vision</note> from the arrangement of the Holy One, Blessed be He, and his merit; or from the chariot of Metatron, the Prince of the Presence; or from the evil chariot of Samael <note>The primary figure of evil/Satan in Kabbalah</note>; or from the chariot of the four elements of the world. There is no elder who does not know the excess of good or the excess of evil over the treasures of the world. And because of this, there are many types among human beings, each according to its kind. The Torah rises in the land like a living creature according to its kind. And because of this, "with the measure a man is born, so they birth for him," and every countenance passes over him. These are the six days of Creation; for each one there is a countenance and that level which hosts him. There is no wisdom [without it]. And there is one in whom there is good, even though the "clay" of the guilty has no good in it; on the third day, he is praised. Therefore, it says of it "it was good" twice. And every day has a vow from the outside, so that no man should return to the good because of the darkness that comes. On the first day there was light, and darkness was hidden within it. Unless a mother finds him in song, and those guards are like thorns to all.
And there are guards for the long ones, like snakes and scorpions and fiery serpents, and they guard that good so that it should not go where it is not worthy to enter. If not for this, all the guilty would enter into the Torah. Because of this, He appointed the guilty to go and swallow them into the Torah, like angels of destruction who are not called "seers." And snakes and scorpions and beasts are all called [guards] for all... but he should go to a place that is not his. Anyone who is good, all these guards are for him... he becomes an accuser. And they will look to leave his ranks and they will say of him: "This man is good and righteous, an heir of heaven, he needs to enter your curtain." And they say to you: "Open for me the gates of righteousness." If not for that good, the guard would say to them: "Open for him at this gate called Love, or at this gate established for Repentance." Every righteous man goes according to his level, and the verse goes:
> Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter (Isaiah 26:2)
etc. Now it is necessary to return to the Gate of Repentance. For are there ten "eyes" to Repentance for the delight of human beings? All of them merit all these, all their faces are equal. There is a man who is completely wicked all his days, and he transgressed many negative commandments and uprooted them and filled them [with sin], and afterward he did neither good nor bad... and the Holy One, Blessed be He, spoke a word to him... to perform the Higher Repentance. There is a man who, after trials come upon him and he is atoned for, goes in the way of rest and prophesies in everything, as in the awe and love of the Holy One, Blessed be He; he does not merit the Lower Repentance, which is called the letter *Heh*. And this is the Lower Repentance. And there is a man who, after he is brought near through suffering and destiny, performs Repentance and delves deep into the Torah with awe and love of the Holy One, Blessed be He, and not for the sake of receiving a reward; such a one merits the letter *Vav*... and in heaven he is called by it. And this is the exile, and it is written "Vav" regarding the "Heh." And the word Repentance (*Teshuva*) is thus: *Tashuv-Vav* (The Vav shall return) to the *Heh*. And to return it... does not dwell in every man, but only in...

<meta>This page continues the discussion of Kabbalistic physiognomy and the spiritual significance of the human form, specifically focusing on the letter Aleph as a divine blueprint and the consequences of one's actions on their spiritual "image" (Diukna).</meta>

## Naso

->**Naso**<-

The letter **Aleph** is the impression of the **Supernal Image** <note>original: *Reshimu de-Diukna Ila’ah*; the spiritual blueprint of the human form</note>. We call the secret of the support and the cheeks and the narrow places a source of pleasure and rest, for these cheeks are represented by the Aleph. Because the children of Israel depend on these subtle structures and the support of the rectification within it, it stands before the congregation to subdue and seal their divisions. Through many rectifications, the impression of the beard <note>original: *dikna*; often referring to the thirteen attributes of mercy in the Zohar</note> is meant to reside in the brain; and the brain is like a hollow space for the body and the belly. The leadership of its crown and the power to nourish the body and the belly are external, and the supernal secret is ordered thus: the living man who is prepared to receive the "Living One" <note>God</note> has it hinted to him. A person does not know when they are being treated with loving-kindness, so that it may remain hidden and not revealed, for it is not in your hands—arise! Every person who busies themselves with the "Form" <note>the spiritual image</note> so as to walk with shoulders high <note>in pride</note>, this becomes revealed to all, because in exchange for his work he has made himself a fool. The spiritual business of the Form is withdrawn, and his eyes look upon it, and they walk in the midst of the house.

The Holy One, blessed be He, keeps watch when the hands, feet, and body act with expertise in the commandments. Regarding "Another Thing" <note>the *Sitra Achra* or evil side</note>, the nose is shown to be distanced from Him. Let him go out with his lips in a time of "water" <note>Torah or grace</note> to increase the Image that is upon every man, so that afterwards he may be sustained, as it is written: *He weighed and measured them all.* He balanced and gave life according to the taste of the throne's foundation, to provide for the circular Image and according to the wisdom of the "throne-bearers." Worthy is the one who rises and stands before the throne, for all the signs of Israel are covered by the flowing waters, and they engrave the Image upon the head of a man.

And he looked at the angels, the "Angels of the Worlds" who give birth, etc. These are the "vapors" <note>breaths/vanities</note> that ascend and bind themselves to the body through washing, weighing, and hope—one surrounding the whole, the cheeks and the scent making two, and the fear that moves the support making three. And through these "Angels of the World," two are taken to correspond to the four heights and the supports and the washings. The spirit upon it is the "cluster of the exile," the courtyard of the kidneys, because of the vapors of all that lives; seven corresponding to the Throne, for the Image is covered and washed. And "Let there be a judgment for the world," and these seven correspond to the seven days of Creation. There are no creatures that are cursed—the sea and the dry land, such as the beasts and birds—as they were originally established, and these are the generations revealed from them. And because the whole was shattered in this cycle, all of Israel who are oppressed are examined with wisdom and expertise, and the precious one is elevated above every living thing that swims,
> and over every bird of the heavens, etc. <note>Genesis 1:28</note>

And he did not act unfaithfully against the base, for these are the weights for the living creatures of the field and the wilderness, and for the birds and the fish of the sea. There is no man who leads the "cluster," or leads the arrows, or leads the flesh, or leads the milk. And all these are not separated from the business of the Image; they are stretched out toward the pattern. A man who is "castrated" <note>spiritually barren</note> has the spirit upon him, as it says:
> And all the peoples of the earth shall see, etc. <note>Deuteronomy 28:10</note>

And whoever turns away his deeds, his Image is seized, and the name of the Lord does not dwell in a place that is turned away. In that inner place, a screen of "crowns" is spread to remove the miracles of the darkness. When a man is like a beast, his Image is turned away; thus it is turned away below so that he does not act, nor does he have a master, nor does he stand in grace, so that he may be impressed above and below. A screen is pulled over his interior, and immediately the grace in him is no longer known to the holy ones. These are the portions for the Holy One, blessed be He, and they are distanced from his house to the outside, and they tend to his soul from the inside, but the screen is from the heart. Because of this, the words of the King are distanced from him. For the words of the King do not dwell nor are they rectified even in a place where the King is turned away. Therefore, they gather behind him like companions in the houses of the body. Just as the King has destroyed the rectification through the foundation, and the "hunters" <note>destructive forces</note> approach him and increase his darkness and bitterness, these are the sufferings. And if he has no rest, the merits are diminished from his house. And how are they diminished? Rather, all the merit he had from above is given to these **Angels of Destruction** <note>original: *Malachei Chavala*</note>, and they take it with them, and his spirit is weakened, etc. And there is no laughter above, Heaven forbid, at all below; in every merit he performs, he finds no rest, and the "visions" he performs bring the Angels of Destruction closer to him, and he receives darkness and focused camps.

In all this, Israel would bring [the goat] to Azazel <note>the scapegoat of Yom Kippur</note> to the heart of the wasteland, because of the seventy "turned away" ones, to fulfill the verse:
> If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink. <note>Proverbs 25:21</note>

And immediately, when they are ordered in the Image, the screen of the wasteland is removed from the interior and ascends. And the spirit of the King says:
> The Lord also has put away your sin; you shall not die. <note>2 Samuel 12:13</note>

And immediately the miracle of the Lord is prepared, and the dark garments of suffering are torn from him; he receives, returns, and is healed. And because the Holy One, blessed be He, is ordered above, He is ordered in the Image, and the hidden interior is revealed. He returns his mind to his house, and all his path is good. This is complete repentance before the Holy One, his God. And for him, the kingdom is engraved as a whole. Amen.

-> Naso <- -> 124 <-

The indwelling Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah"</note> at night goes to be sanctified. Through her, all the commandments and the body are sanctified together with the ten emanations <note>original: "Sefirot"</note>. Each person, when they perform their specific commandment and no more, acts in a way that reflects and hints at the Holy One, Blessed be He. Because of this, the emanations rest upon them. Anyone who fulfills this commandment properly is considered as if they fulfilled all 248 positive commandments <note>original: "248 Pekudin de-Aseh"</note>, for there is no single commandment that is not included within all of them.

## Main Text (Zohar)

### Right Column

**Any man** <note>Numbers 5:12</note> whose wife goes astray, etc.
Why does the verse repeat "Man, man" <note>original: "Ish, Ish"</note>? Rabbi Elazar said:
It is written, "to commit a trespass against the Lord." Rabbi Elazar said:
"Man, man"—why the repetition? For every man faces his own laws. However, "Man, man" implies a man who is truly a man and maintains his closeness, as it is written, "You are a man from your youth," etc. Then he is a man in the world, a man toward his wife. If she commits a trespass against him, it is as if she faces two: one above and one below.
One against the Assembly of Israel <note>the mystical community of souls</note> and one against her husband. Just as it is above, so it is below; this is how one must look at it.
It is written, "and she goes astray"—she goes to another. And it is not like what is written regarding what is forbidden by law, such as not damaging that "other" by returning to him. And you said, "the man shall bring his wife to the Priest" to judge her case. Why to the Priest <note>Kohen</note> and not another? Because the accuser <note>Satan</note> acts against the Matriarch <note>the Shekhinah</note>, and all the blessings of the world are blessed through the Assembly of Israel. A woman below is blessed with seven blessings, corresponding to the Assembly of Israel. The Priest is called to investigate the matter of the Matriarch and to support her in all that is needed. Therefore, it must be the Priest and not another. And if you say he performs the judgment, it is not so; rather, he strives to bring peace to the world through this process. For if that woman is found pure, the world is strengthened through them. Not only that, but she will conceive a male child, and peace will be made upon her. And if she is not found pure, the Priest does not perform the judgment himself; rather, that Holy Name which was erased in the water performs the judgment and tests her. The Priest does not bring himself into the matter except when she places herself before him, face to face.

-> **The Faithful Shepherd** <-

The commandment to judge the laws of the Sota <note>the suspected wife</note>: "If a spirit of jealousy passes over him and he is jealous," etc. <note>Numbers 5:14</note>. # Naso

## Main Text (Zohar - Parashat Naso)

...and they are transformed from their proper state and emerge as bones and stand in a certain likeness until they are consumed. Once they are consumed, they are like fingernails <note>original: "כטפורן" - referring to the hard, external husks or shells</note> for the work of the upper world. And there emerges from the side of the mouth a blemish upon the world, and the supernal waters give them life in that likeness. And for the scent, there is the scent of the smoke. Those waters are transformed into whiteness in the upper realm, just as the corruption spreads and the Holy One shows it to all. Through this wisdom, it is proclaimed: "Come, all you inhabitants of the world!" In both of them they stand, and concerning that place, they reached wisdom and stood so that they might be purified.

Happy is the portion of Israel, whom the Holy One, blessed be He, desired, as it is written: **to cleave to Him** <note>Deuteronomy 11:22</note>. Rabbi Hezekiah opened the discourse: **"Your wife shall be as a fruitful vine..."** <note>Psalm 128:3</note> etc. Just as this vine does not accept any other graft upon it, so below, Israel stands in this manner—she does not accept anyone upon her except her own partner. This "vine" <note>referring to the Assembly of Israel/Shekhinah</note> does not accept anyone but her partner. And regarding **"a fruitful vine in the inner chambers of your house,"** what is "fruitful" <note>Hebrew: *poriyah*</note>? It means she flourishes and runs; she is "fruitful" in that she produces branches to every side. **"And grace in the inner chambers of your house"**—and not outside like a waste-heap, so that she does not come to be exposed like a <term>Krit</term> <note>a term implying being cut off or exposed immodestly</note> upon her.

And Solomon said: "She who passes by is like a snare in the end." And you are a firm bond, just as grace is a bond of the womb. That place is for the "Covenant of the Inquiry," and in this, one is bound to Him like the **"inner chambers of your house."** Rabbi Hezekiah said: A rebuke shall come upon that man when he cleaves to his wife from the side of the external spirit. And this is one of the terrors that is within it.

And a woman who lets the hair of her head be seen outside <note>referring to the prohibition of a married woman exposing her hair</note> to adorn herself with it, causes poverty to the house, and causes the Assembly <note>the Shekhinah</note> not to be honored in that generation, and causes another matter <note>an evil spirit</note> to dwell with her. And *Hangris* <note>a demonic name or force associated with immodesty</note> is the side that is below, from the head outward. And if this is so within the house, how much more so is it a waste-heap? And how much more so is other impudence? But it is written: **"Like a fruitful vine in the inner chambers of your house."** Rabbi Judah said: The side of the spirit is below...

## Commentary (Raya Mehemna)

<note>The "Faithful Shepherd" section, usually identified as the soul of Moses speaking to the Zoharic circle.</note>

...for darkness has reached him. There are three "husks" <term>Kelipot</term> <note>spiritual shells of evil</note> in the exile, and the "Mixed Multitude" <term>Erev Rav</term> <note>those who joined Israel at the Exodus but cause internal strife</note> are like them—hidden, green at times, and dry. They toil as fugitives. So are those who buy the redemption and reach below and above, holy in every connection. And they are the ones who buy from their own pain. And if they wish to mend themselves in the exile, what is written here? **"No hand shall touch him, for he shall surely be stoned or shot through"** <note>Exodus 19:13</note>. As the side of the power, so shall it be fulfilled in Israel: **"The Lord alone shall lead him, and there is no strange god with him"** <note>Deuteronomy 32:12</note>. **"But the wicked shall be silent in darkness"** <note>1 Samuel 2:9</note>—these are the Mixed Multitude. And because of this, he said their eyes are darkened, and they shall not enter the Land of Israel.

**The Faithful Shepherd** explained: "A Woman of Valor" <note>Proverbs 31</note> is to be gathered in the world. This nation, this daughter, is the building of the Priest who desires to raise it. Give me a portion of the secret to reveal to you your hidden deficiencies and to do kindness with you. As Samuel said regarding the times of the people: "Cursed is he who... from his mouth." What is it to the Faithful Shepherd? Like a compassionate one, he made the soul of the child. He did not say "with all your might," for here he is like an uncircumcised one. "And he turned this way and that, and he saw that there was no man" <note>Exodus 2:12</note> to help me and to take me out of this burial that is below me. "And he made his grave with the wicked" <note>Isaiah 53:9</note>, and they do not recognize me.

And those Mixed Multitude dwell as shepherds over Israel. This is the pain of the Holy One, blessed be He, of whom it is said: "And you gave my pasture to the serpents." And those Mixed Multitude are wealthy... they shall not go up without rest at all... the masters of the commandment... for the world is a wonder...

## Main Text (Zohar)

<note>The text begins mid-sentence discussing the spiritual dangers of a woman exposing her hair.</note>

What does "like olive plants" mean? Just as the olive tree—whether in winter or in summer—its leaves do not fall and its strength <note>original: "chasichu," referring to its enduring vitality</note> is always found, so her children will rise in strength above the rest of the world's children. ## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Naso**<-
<note>Naso is the name of the Torah portion, meaning "Take a census" or "Lift up."</note>

Two [angels] stand by him who write before him everything he did in this world and every word that went out of his mouth; and the awe <note>original: *dechilu*</note> of them all is written before him. Then, when he is remembered, the spirit and the appointee over the person can recall what they have seen. And he returns to them—for what reason? Because that engraved deed he performed rises and stands over him to be gazed upon, and they stand to gaze upon him. All of them are like dead things, yet they are etched before him and stand before him, and they are not removed from him until the hour he is judged for them in this world.

Come and see: all those words a person performs in this world are all prepared before him and are not lost from him. And at the hour he goes out to the grave, they are all ready before him. Three heralds <note>original: *kerozin*</note> proclaim: one in front of him, one to his right, and one to his left. They say: "This is so-and-so who rebelled against his Master! He rebelled above, he rebelled below, he rebelled against the Torah, he rebelled against its commandments. See his deeds! See his words! It would have been better for him had he not been created."

Until he reaches the grave, all the dead are stirred from their places because of him and they say: "Woe, woe, that this one is buried among us!" His deeds and his words precede him and enter the grave, standing over that body. The spirit <note>original: *rucha*</note> goes and wanders, hovering over his body. Once the person is buried, the inhabitants of the graves <note>The spirits of the deceased already interred.</note> gather at a holy time <insert>variant: a thin time</insert> and there come out from beneath them three terrors who oversee the "Judgment of the Grave" <note>original: *din ha-kever*</note>. They hold three rods in their hands and judge the spirit and the body as one. Woe for that terror! Woe for his deeds! At the hour of distress, he is seized by the King’s collar and his judgment is weighed, and he is penalized because no advocate <note>original: *sanegora*</note> is found for him.

By the King’s bonds he descends, and [the Angel of Death] is caught before him at his feet. A sharp sword is in his hand, raised, full of eyes, and he sees within the house two flames, all of which are from the deceptive harlot <note>A reference to the *Sitra Achra* or the "Other Side," representing evil forces.</note>. What is here for him? Before him is a change, full of eyes; his garment covers this dead man. This is certainly so, for many people see the Angel of Death and stand before him, while the people surrounding them do not see him. And regarding his form, is it not written:
> "He makes His angels spirits..." <note>Psalms 104:4</note>
How can he be seen without a body? Rather, this teaches us—as the companions have established—that once he descends to the body and appears to the vision of those below, he does so in a lower garment <note>A physical or semi-physical manifestation.</note>. If he were seen [in his true form], the world could not endure him, and certainly not see him; all the more so since all the people of the world have need of him. Three drops are on his sword... and the companions have already established this.

Once the person sees him, his whole body trembles and the spirit wanders, unable to settle because of the King's pressure. The spirit of the whole body goes out like all the drops of the body, being drawn out from their places like a hair being drawn out of milk <note>A classic Talmudic metaphor for a painless death for the righteous, though here used for the extraction of the soul.</note> by one who is skilled with milk; then the wine is purified. Woe for what he did! He does not deny it, but lives to fulfill the debt of his sin. Until that hour arrives, the person fears and seeks to hide, but cannot. Once he sees that he cannot, he opens his eyes and sees [the Angel], gazing at him with open eyes. Then he surrenders his body and his soul. That hour is the time of the Great Judgment for everything he was judged for in this world.

Despite all this, the spirit goes and wanders through all the limbs and informs all the parts [of the body]. All the parts of the body are informed when the spirit reaches each and every part. When it is drawn out from it, a great trembling falls upon that part, and the spirit departs from it, and immediately that part dies. So it is with all of them. Once the spirit reaches the point of exit, it is drawn out from the whole body. Then the Divine Presence <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note> stands over him, and immediately it flies from the body. Happy is the portion of one who strives for Her! Woe to those who are far from Her and do not cleave to Her.

How many terrors a person passes through when he departs from this world! One is that supreme terror we mentioned when the spirit leaves the body. One is the terror when his deeds and words appear before him and heralds proclaim over him. And one is the terror when he enters the grave.

<meta>This page continues the discussion of spiritual laws and the mystical significance of the Nazirite vow, following the themes of divine judgment and the rectification of the soul. It specifically addresses the prohibitions of the Nazirite and their connection to the primordial sin of Adam.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

And there is one judgment corresponding to him. And one judgment for his benefit. And one judgment that is pleasant even if it involves a penalty. And one judgment of wrath, which wanders and defiles the world and finds no place until his deeds are completed, and seven cycles pass over him. For this reason, a person must, while they are alive in this world, fear their Master and not be consumed every single day by their deeds, but rather sit in repentance before their Master. When King David looked upon those judgments that await a person when they depart from this world to the Holy One, he said <note>Psalm 103:1</note> **Bless the Lord, O my soul**—while you have not yet departed from the world, now that you are found within the body. **And all that is within me, bless His holy name**—give thanks and praise in the spirit now while you are found with them, to arise and bless the holy Name, before the time arrives when you will no longer be able to bless Him or give thanks to Him. Come and see: once a person is worthy to be hidden away as is fitting for the Holy One, blessed be He, in this world, they are sanctified with the holiness of their Master.

->**Wine**<-
**He shall abstain from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, etc.** <note>Numbers 6:3</note>. Since he is forbidden from wine, why are grapes also forbidden? For here we must observe that it is written elsewhere: **Do not drink wine or strong drink, etc.** <note>Leviticus 10:9, referring to Priests</note>, yet there it does not say "grapes." Why then for the Nazirite are grapes withheld from him? Rather, this act and this matter are a high mystery that is separated from the spirit entirely. And it should be known that this is the power through which the First Adam <note>Adam Kadmon/The first human</note> sinned; it was grapes that he squeezed <note>A common Zoharic tradition that the forbidden fruit was the grape</note>. For wine, strong drink, and grapes are all found on one side: wine is above, and they have established that "strong drink" <term>Shechar: an intoxicant</term> is that which intoxicates, for strong drink issues from wine. Grapes collect all of them into their interior. And it was that power through which the First Adam sinned, because everything was drawn to one side. And the purity of the humble is not diminished at all by this. Rather, no action from the side of the "Spleen" <note>The Spleen often represents the source of melancholy or "black bile" in medieval physiology, linked here to the "Other Side" or harsh judgments</note> should be seen in him at all. Come and see the exchange from the teachings of Rav Hamnuna the Elder, and it is thus: It is written, **He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long** <note>Numbers 6:5</note>. He is required to increase the hair of his head and his beard, and to be separated from wine, strong drink, and grapes, because all of these are from the side of the "Spleen," and hair does not hang from the side of wine. Consider the side to which the Levites hold; they provide the wine <note>The Levites sang during the wine libations in the Temple</note>, and therefore hair does not hang upon them. For this reason, when the Levites rose to their place, they were required to remove all their hair entirely, and **they passed a razor over all their flesh** <note>Numbers 8:7</note>. Grapes are the lower heat that gathers wine and strong drink within them, and for this reason, he is separated from every side of the "Spleen" so as not to show their influence in his growth. Regarding grapes, hair and beard do not hang from them, for a female is required to shear her hair when she comes to be joined with the male, and a beard is not found upon her. For this reason, he lets the hair of the head and beard grow, and the secret of the matter is that the Nazirite is dedicated to God <note>Elohim: the Name associated with Judgment</note> and not a Nazirite to the Lord <note>YHVH: the Name associated with Mercy</note>, separating himself from the Master of all. Come and see, regarding this it is written: **And he shall make atonement for him, for that he sinned by the soul, etc.** <note>Numbers 6:11</note>. Regarding this, it does not say "he sinned against the soul," but "by the soul." And what is the sin? It is not the grapes, but because his side is wine and strong drink, and he diminishes the place of judgment. A sin. What is the sin? Rather, he diminishes the spirit... and he must make atonement for himself because now he comes to be joined with them, and they do not receive him thus until he consults the Priest, who shall atone for him. Because he was separated from them at first, now that he comes back to them, he needs to be restored through the repair of atonement so they will receive him, and this is the spirit of the matter. The Nazirite of God <note>Elohim</note>... but the matter is good, for because of this he is not a stranger, and it is prepared for him to be joined to his own as is fitting for him. And he who is holy... that holiness is like a daughter of a strange god, and he leaves his place below for that holiness, and for this reason... and he has no portion in that world. Come and see, because it says **Let my soul die with the Philistines** <note>Judges 16:30, regarding Samson the Nazirite</note>, and his portion was diminished like the portion of the Philistines, that his soul should die with them in that world, so too...

<meta>This page concludes a discussion on the sanctity of the Nazirite and the Levites before transitioning into the famous opening of the "Idra Rabba" (The Great Holy Assembly), one of the most significant sections of the Zohar. It includes a cautionary commentary by Abraham Galante regarding the use of physical metaphors for the Divine.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar - End of previous section)

A proclamation was made upon the throne: "Go away, go away, you masters of the Nazirite vow! 'Go around, go around,' they say to the vineyard, 'do not come near!'" <note>original: "סחור סחור לכרמא לא תקרב" - a Talmudic idiom meaning one should avoid even the appearance or vicinity of sin</note> and the companions have established this. Regarding the righteous, what is written of them? *And thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: sprinkle water of purification upon them, and let them pass a razor over all their flesh* <note>Numbers 8:7</note>. Once they have passed the razor and performed this act, then they are called "pure" in lineage, but not "holy." However, this Nazirite, because he separates himself from that side <note>the side of impurity or mundane physical desire</note>, is called "holy" and not just "pure." For this reason it is written: *All the days of his separation he is holy unto the Lord* <note>Numbers 6:8</note>. *He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long*—because of this it is written: *the hair of His head is like pure wool* <note>Daniel 7:9</note>, referring to that which triumphs above. Rabbi Judah said: When the hair is truly at the gates <note>referring to the spiritual emanations or "gates" of wisdom</note>, know that it is holiness, as it is written: *His locks are wavy* <note>Song of Songs 5:11</note>. Come and see, Rabbi Shimon: if only human beings knew the words spoken regarding this hair and its arrangements (<margin>variant reading: in the hair and the bundles</margin>), they would recognize their Master, for it exists in the spirit of the arm of Higher Wisdom. Until now, we have dealt with the Torah; from here onwards, we deal with the Crowns of the Torah—the Crown and the Seal, Holy unto the Lord.

---

## Commentary
**Abraham says:** <note>Abraham Galante, a 16th-century Safed Kabbalist</note>
As I have written previously, this is to remove a stumbling block from the path of those students upon whom the light of the hidden, true Tradition <term>Kabbalah: the received mystical tradition</term> has not yet shone. They might err and become entangled, thinking that all the descriptions that Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai included in this holy book—such as the "brain of the skull," the "hairs of the head," the "eyes of the head," the "nose of the beard," or the "lips and the beard"—are physical descriptions. Heaven forbid that one should diminish the Great Holiness and the Holy Portion by thinking this! For in these places, the most hidden secrets of the Most High are alluded to. Rather, they are the mysteries of the Attributes and the <term>Sefirot: the ten creative powers or emanations of God</term> and ultimate internal matters. All the metaphors used by these Sages are for the sake of imagination and are merely signs for things that are simple <note>non-composite/spiritual</note> and hidden. They do not refer to anything physical or accidental, which belong to the <term>Kelipah: "husks" or forces of impurity</term>. Heaven forbid to anyone who would direct their thoughts toward the Blessed One in any physical way, and certainly not toward the Master of the Universe and the Ultimate Purpose, may He be blessed and included in the enclosures of Wisdom.

## Main Text (Idra Rabba)

**It is taught:** Rabbi Shimon said: How long shall we remain as a wall supported by only a single pillar? It is written:
> *It is time to act for the Lord, for they have made void Your law.* <note>Psalms 119:126</note>

The days are few, and the Creditor is pressing. The herald cries out every day, and the "harvesters of the field" <note>the mystics who gather divine insights</note> are few. Those who are at the edge of the vineyard do not pay heed and do not know where they are going. Assemble, companions, to the threshing floor <note>the "Idra," the meeting place</note>, clothed in armor and with spears in your hands! Be prepared in your counsel, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, in vision, and with the hands and feet of the King. Let us crown the King over us, to give strength to the thrones and the seats, to decree judgments (<margin>variant reading: words</margin>) of truth—words of the Holy Supernals who will come to listen to them and to know them. Rabbi Shimon sat and wept, saying: "Woe if I reveal, and woe if I do not reveal!" The companions who were there remained silent. Rabbi Phinehas rose and saw that the Divine Presence was before the Master. It is written: *The secret of the Lord is with them that fear Him* <note>Psalms 25:14</note>. These companions are those who fear the Lord; they are ready to receive Him, and they have already entered the house of the wedding canopy—some entered and some departed. Three companions sat before Rabbi Shimon: his son Rabbi Eleazar, Rabbi Abba, and Rabbi Judah. Then came Rabbi Jose bar Jacob, Rabbi Isaac, Rabbi Hezekiah bar Rav, Rabbi Hiyya, Rabbi Jose, and Rabbi Yessa. They gave their hands to Rabbi Shimon, raised their fingers upward, and went out into the field among the trees and sat down. Rabbi Shimon sat in their midst and said: "Let each one place his hands in the lap of the other" (<margin>variant reading: their hands</margin>). He took them, opened his discourse, and said:
> *Cursed be the man that makes any graven or molten image, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret...* <note>Deuteronomy 27:15</note>

<meta>This page begins the "Idra Rabba" (The Greater Assembly) within the portion of Naso. It follows the introductory gathering of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai and his disciples. The text transitions from the general assembly to the profound mystical discourse on the "Kings of Edom" and the primordial state of the universe before its rectification.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

And he concluded with the **Crown** <note>Keter: the highest emanation of the Divine</note> and all the people answered and said, Amen. Rabbi Shimon opened and said: *“It is time to act for the Lord, for they have made void Your Torah.”* <note>Psalm 119:126</note> What is the meaning of "they have made void Your Torah"? And what is "It is time to act for the Lord"? This refers to the **Ancient of Ancients** <note>Atika de-Atikin: the most hidden aspect of God</note>, for if the rectifications <note>Tikkunim: divine repairs or arrangements</note> were not performed in this, it would be as if the Torah were voided. And concerning the **Ancient of Days** <note>Atik Yomin</note> it is said: *“Happy are you, O Israel; who is like you?”* <note>Deuteronomy 33:29</note> and it is written, *“Who is like You among the mighty, O Lord?”* <note>Exodus 15:11</note>

He called to Rabbi Eleazar, his son, and sat him before him, and Rabbi Abba on the other side. And behold, they were all strengthened, for all grace exists to be rectified. And they were silent. They heard a voice and a resonance, but they did not see who was speaking. What was this voice? It was the voice of the **Higher Assembly** <note>The souls of the righteous and angels</note> gathering together. Rabbi Shimon rejoiced and smiled, saying: *“O Lord, I have heard the report of You, and I am afraid.”* <note>Habakkuk 3:2</note> There, fear was appropriate, but here, the matter depends on love, as it is written: *“And you shall love the Lord your God,”* and it is written, *“I have loved you, says the Lord.”*

Rabbi Shimon opened and said: *“A talebearer reveals secrets, but he who is of a faithful spirit conceals a matter.”* <note>Proverbs 11:13</note> This verse is difficult; if it says "talebearer," why does it also say "goes about" <note>original: "holech"</note>? It should have said "the talebearer reveals." Who is the one who "goes about"? It is one who is not settled in his spirit and is not faithful. The word he hears moves within him like a wave of water until he casts it out. Why? Because his spirit is not a stable spirit. But of one whose spirit is stable, it is written: *“he who is of a faithful spirit conceals a matter.”* A "faithful spirit" is one that is established, as it says: *“And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place.”* <note>Isaiah 22:23</note> The matter depends on the spirit. And it is written: *“Suffer not your mouth to cause your flesh to sin.”* <note>Ecclesiastes 5:5</note> And the world is only sustained through **Secret** <note>Raza</note>. And if in worldly matters a secret is needed, how much more so in the "Secrets of Secrets" of the Ancient of Days, which are not even handed over to the high angels.

Rabbi Shimon said: I do not speak to the blind who cannot see. To the path where there is no vision, you will stray. These are the pillars of the worlds. Behold, the **Secret of Secrets**! When Rabbi Shimon opened his mouth, the earth trembled and the companions were shaken. He began and said:

> **“And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.”**
<note>Genesis 36:31. In Kabbalah, these "Kings of Edom" represent primordial worlds that were destroyed because they could not contain the Divine Light.</note>

Fortunate are you, O righteous ones, for the Secrets of Secrets of the Torah have been revealed to you, which are not revealed even to the holy ones on high. What is the beauty and praise in this? And what is the merit? It is the bowing before the **Faith of Faiths** <note>The highest level of certainty in the Divine</note> which shines to the depths, and the worlds are submerged, and from it shines the pit of the brilliant ones, through which the righteous are examined for the World to Come. This is what is written: *“The righteous shall be as a light before Me.”* From that pit, they are spread into three hundred and thirteen paths, as it is written: *“All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth.”* May it be the Divine Will that this wisdom is not withheld from this assembly. And what the companions will say to me is that this verse is difficult—why was it necessary to write this? For how many kings were there before the children of Israel existed and before there was a king for the children of Israel? What is seen here? This is what the companions have awakened. Rather, it is a **Secret of Secrets** that humans cannot know or comprehend or evaluate by their own minds.

**We have learned:** The Ancient of Ancients, the Hidden of All Hidden, before He prepared the rectifications of the King <note>The manifest Godhead</note> and the crowns of crowns, there was no beginning or end. He carved and measured within Himself and spread before Him a single veil, and in it, He carved and sketched the Kings and their rectifications, but they did not endure. <note>This refers to the "Breaking of the Vessels" (Shevirat Ha-Kelim), a central concept where early divine structures collapsed.</note> This is what is written: *“And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.”* The "First King" refers to the Primordial King. And all those that were carved but did not endure were called by names, but they did not last until He subdued them and hid them. Afterward, He ascended in His will to create the light, and He prepared the hidden rectifications for two thousand years. This is according to the ancient books of the Ancient of Ancients, the Secret of Secrets, to be rectified and established.

## Naso

-> **Naso** <-

**And the Whiteness** (meaning it is found and not found; not literally "not found," but rather below it is not known, because He is the **Ancient of Ancients** <note>original: Atika De-Atikin; the most hidden level of the Divine Crown</note>, wise in His known arrangements) as it is found that the countenances of the Ancient of Ancients, the Hidden of Hiddens, are marked as known and unknown, the Master of the white garment (as it is written: "His garment") and the appearance of His garment (as it is written: "was like snow") to subdue upon the throne of those who are seated, to subdue for them four hundred thousand worlds. The whiteness of the **Skull** <note>original: Gulgalta</note> of His head spreads out, and from the light of this whiteness, the righteous shall inherit the World to Come, which consists of four hundred worlds <note>Reference to Abraham purchasing the field of Machpelah for 400 silver shekels, Genesis 23:16</note> as it is written: "silver current with the merchant." In the Skull there sit every day thirteen (as it is written: thirteen) thousand worlds that lean upon it and look toward it. And there is visible upon the Skull the silver **Dew** <note>original: Tala</note> of the outer stillness, and it fills His head every day. And from that Dew which is shaken from His head—that which is of the outer stillness—the dead will be awakened for the World to Come, as it is written <note>Isaiah 26:19</note> "Your dead shall live, my corpses shall arise; awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust, for Your dew is as the dew of lights" and it is written "for Your dew is as the dew of lights." And its whiteness is like the whiteness of the Ancient One, and from that Dew the holy upper beings are sustained, and it is the manna that grinds for the righteous in the World to Come. And it is written that this Dew is for the "Field of Holy Apples." "And when the layer of dew lifted, there on the surface of the wilderness was a fine, flake-like thing." And the appearance of that Dew is white like the appearance of the color of a **crystal** <note>original: Bedolach; often translated as bdellium or pearl</note> in which all colors are found <note>Probably short for 'the Holy One' or 'the Holy One, Blessed be He'</note> and its eye is like the eye of crystal. This white Skull shines to thirteen thousand sides: to four sides on one part, and to four sides on another part, and to four sides on the side of the other part, and one above the Skull (meaning to the upper side). And from this spreads the **Nose** <note>The "Nose" represents the attribute of Mercy and the "breath" of life</note> which subdues three hundred and seventy myriad worlds, and it is called **Long-Suffering** <note>original: Erech Apayim; literally "Long of Nose/Face"</note> (meaning the nose that subdues). And because of the Ancient of Ancients, He is called **Arich Anpin** (Long Face), and that which is outside is called **Zeir Anpin** (Small Face) in contrast to the Ancient Holy Grandfather, the Holy of Holies. And when Zeir Anpin looks upon this Dew (as it is written: the Dew) below, he is rectified and his coverings spread out and there is joy; at that time, he is called the "sweetness of the Ancient One." And from this Skull, one white side goes out to the skull of Zeir Anpin to rectify the head, and it reaches after the skull below where there is no [imperfection]. And all the skulls give white whiteness (as it is written: for whiteness) to the **Ancient of Days** <note>original: Atik Yomin</note> when the worlds are in [darkness] under the [vault], and this one does not break the skull below when the worlds are in [darkness]. In the hollow of the Skull is the **Membrane** <note>original: Kruma</note> of the whiteness of the **Hidden Upper Wisdom** <note>original: Chokhmah Stima'ah</note> which never ceases. And in this, it is not found and not opened, and by this Membrane, the brain of this Hidden Wisdom is covered. And because of this, this Wisdom is hidden and does not open through that Membrane. And in this brain, which is quiet, the Hidden Wisdom is still and settled like good wine on its dregs. And this is what is said of the "Wine of the Elder," whose knowledge is hidden and whose brain is hidden and pure. And this Membrane is separated from Zeir Anpin, and because of this, the brain spreads out and goes forth into thirty-two paths. This is what is written: "And a river went out of Eden..." <note>The river going out of Eden is a metaphor for the emanations</note> because the Membrane is separated so that it does not cover the brain, and in any case, the Membrane is separated below. And this is why his [innards] are prepared (meaning the moisture of the Ancient of Days, in whom hangs the "Perfect in Knowledge," revealed from all sides and hidden and pure and quiet like good wine on its dregs). It was taught: In the Skull of the head hang a thousand thousand myriads and seven thousand and one hundred [locks] of hair, white and pure like pure wool that is not tangled one with another, so as not to show confusion in His arrangements. Rather, everything is in its proper place, so that no hair goes out from another hair, and every single lock has four hundred and ten hairs, according to the numerical value of "Holy" <note>The Hebrew word 'Kadosh' (Holy) equals 410 in Gematria</note>, and every single hair is gathered...

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly) from the Zohar, focusing on the mystical physiognomy of the Divine. It specifically transitions from the description of the hair to the "Metzacha" (Forehead) of the Ancient One and the Lesser Face.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

There are four hundred and ten worlds; and every single world is hidden and concealed, and none know them but He. And for these four <margin>Other versions: four hundred</margin> hundred watchful clouds, in every single strength there is an oath that issues from the Hidden Brain of the Crown <note>Keter</note>, which shines and is concealed within that brain of the Lesser Face <note>Zeir Anpin</note>. And from this, his brain is established <margin>Other versions: is prepared</margin>. Then that brain flows into thirty-two paths, and every single lock of hair blazes and hangs, established in its arrangements. And behold, it is written:
> His locks are wavy, black as a raven.
<note>Song of Songs 5:11</note>
The locks of hair are established on this side and on that side upon the Skull. And three in every single strength are called the "Danger of the Assembly" <margin>Other versions: The Tabernacle</margin>, hidden ones that issue from the Hidden Brain. And from the three sides of the Throne, it is known what it is—if the Living Place of Mercy is upon it from all sides. And forty elders, and even all those thousand who are stirred in its arrangements <margin>Other versions: in his arrangement / in the voids</margin>. And in the eyebrows of his eyes, locks of hair hang in their arrangement, clean as wool, reaching down to his shoulders, until the tops of his shoulders, so that the nape of the neck is not seen, because it is written:
> For they have turned their back to Me, and not their face.
<note>Jeremiah 2:27</note>
And the hair rises upon the shoulders that are purified so as not to be exposed, as it is written "to be purified." The openings from which the hair issues from the Crown of his ears are included in the balance, one not exceeding the other. This is the third arrangement, and it is a beautiful arrangement hanging down to the lower parts, clinging to the sparks of the parched cheeks, to be and to cling to the arrangements of the Hidden Ancient One of all. Thirteen locks of hair stand on this side and on that side of the Skull, corresponding to his face. And in your cheeks, the hair is divided; there is no support like this Hidden Ancient One of all. He is proven to be seen and not seen, hidden and not hidden. And this is in his arrangements when they are arranged. And regarding this, look to the children of Israel to heal their hearts, as it is written:
> Is the Lord among us, or not?
<note>Exodus 17:7</note>
For the Lesser Face is called "The Lord" <note>The Tetragrammaton, YHVH</note> and the Long Face <note>Arich Anpin</note> is called "He" <note>The hidden 'I' or 'He'</note>. And why were they punished? Because they did not act with the proper preparation, as it is written:
> And because they tested the Lord, etc.
<note>Exodus 17:7</note>

**In the parting** of the hair, a single path prevails to give [light] to the four hundred and seventy worlds. And from it is carved the path in which the righteous are illuminated for the World to Come. This is what is written:
> But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, that shines ever brighter until the full day.
<note>Proverbs 4:18</note>
And from this path, it separates into six hundred and thirteen paths which are divided in the Lesser Face, as it is written:
> All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth, etc.
<note>Psalms 25:10</note>

**The Forehead** of the Skull is the Will of Wills. The Will of the Lesser Face corresponds to the Forehead of the Ancient One, as it is written:
> And it shall be on his forehead always, for acceptance [Will], etc.
<note>Exodus 28:38</note>
And that forehead is called "Will" <note>Ratzon</note>, for it is the revelation of the whole head and the Skull which is covered by four hundred and twenty worlds. And when it is revealed, the prayers of Israel are accepted. When is it revealed? Rabbi Shimon was silent. He then opened and said: When is it revealed? It is revealed in the grace of the Afternoon Prayer <note>Mincha</note> of the Sabbath. He said to him: Why? He replied: Because at that time <margin>Other versions: on weekdays</margin> the judgment below in the Lesser Face is revealed, but the Forehead called "Will" is revealed [from above]; at that hour, anger is stilled <margin>Other versions: and Will is stilled</margin> and prayer is accepted. This is what is written:
> But as for me, may my prayer to You, O Lord, be at a time of favor [Will].
<note>Psalms 69:14</note>
And the "Time of Favor" comes from the Ancient One when the Forehead is revealed. And because of this, it is established in the likeness of the forehead as it is written. Rabbi Shimon said to Rabbi Eleazar his son: Blessed are you, my son, by the Ancient of Days; may you find the Will of the Forehead in the hour you need it. Come and see <margin>Other versions: in a small way</margin> below: when the forehead is revealed, there is no impudence found at all, but only kindness and merit for the whole kingdom. And behold, when the forehead is revealed, the lower parts and the Will rise to be delayed, and all angers are stilled and subdued before him. From this forehead shine four hundred houses of judgment; when it is revealed, the voice of the "Time of Favor" is called out, and they are all delayed before him. This is what is written: "The Place sat" (meaning, He sat on His throne and the place...).

# Naso

And the darkness is not found (and he gazes) and it is hidden; blindness does not exist in this place because it is hidden and not found for disgrace, so that the masters of judgment might look and gaze but not be able to act. Three heads are revealed in two hundred and seventy thousand myriads, in which the eyes of the world to come are focused, the living beings of Eden that shine to the higher Eden, the supreme Eden that is not revealed and is hidden in its crown and does not separate to others as we have said. And as for the Eden below, it spreads out into paths into thirty-two directions of paths, and even though this Eden spreads into paths, no one knows it except the Holy One, Blessed be He <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu"</note>. And the "Small-Faced One" <note>term: Zeir Anpin; the emotive/manifest aspects of the Divine</note> does not know the Eden above, nor do the paths know it, except for this "Long-Faced One" <note>term: Arich Anpin; the vast, merciful aspect of the Divine</note>. That pure one knows its ways and he knows its place. The pure one knows its ways—not the Eden below which the Small-Faced One knows—but "He knows its place," which is the Eden above that the Ancient of Days <note>term: Atik Yomin; the most primordial aspect of God</note>, the hidden of all, knows.

**The Eyes** of the White Head gaze constantly. There is no covering upon the eye and there are no eyelids upon the eye. As it is written:
> Behold, He who guards Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.
<note>Psalms 121:4</note>

This refers to the "Israel Above" <note>The spiritual archetype of Israel</note>, and it is written: "Your eyes are open in kindness." And everything below is found in mercy. There is no covering on the eye and no eyelids on the eye when the White Head does not desire them. Rabbi Shimon said to Rabbi Abba: To what does this allude? It is to teach and to cover, and since there is no covering on the eye and no eyelids on the eye, they do not stand still and do not require a covering for the eye. For the Ancient of Ancients does not require a covering. And by His goodness, He praises all, and all are sustained by Him, and He does not sleep, as it is said: "Behold, He who guards Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps," referring to the Israel Above. It is written:
> Behold, the eye of the Lord is toward those who fear Him.
<note>Psalms 33:18</note>

And it is written:
> The eyes of the Lord range throughout the entire earth.
<note>Zechariah 4:10</note>

There is no contradiction: one refers to the Small-Faced One <note>Zeir Anpin</note> and the other to the Long-Faced One <note>Arich Anpin</note>. Therefore, there are two eyes, and they return <margin>variant: and they return</margin> to be a single eye; this is white within white, and a white that includes all white.

**The first white** shines and ascends and descends to find <margin>variant: to gaze</margin> the dwelling in the fire. Three strike in this white and divide into three chambers <note>term: konichin; hollows or sockets</note> to investigate "Glory and Majesty," and they push away and burn like sickness in purity. **The second white** shines and ascends and descends and strikes and goes out <margin>variant: and divides</margin> into three other chambers to investigate "Strength, Kindness, and Beauty" <note>The sefirot: Gevurah, Chesed, and Tiferet</note>, and they burn like ladders in joy. **The third white** shines and shines and descends and ascends and goes out from the hiddenness of the brain and strikes in the seventh middle chamber and carves a path to the lower brain and carves a path for all that is below, and all the chambers below are set aflame. Rabbi Isaac said: He and the Ancient of Days, and this eye went out upon you like a claim that was needed. Furthermore, there are thirty whites like white, and a white that includes all white.

**The first white** shines and ascends and descends to the three chambers on the left side, and they burn and are engraved in this white like words to the wise, their bodies like good priests and like spirits over what they were previously. **The second white** descends and ascends and shines to the three chambers on the right side, and it is engraved and they burn and are engraved in this white like words to the wise, like good priests and like fragrances over what they were previously. **The third white** shines and ascends and descends and goes out like the secret of the white deep within the brain, and it strikes on the male side when needed and when desired; and in the brain of the head, it shines to three crowns to be guarded as is necessary for the skull to the right before the Ancient One, the hidden of all. And three are not closed in this eye, and they are two and appear <margin>variant: and they return</margin> as one; all is this right and this left as one. He does not sleep, unlike the eyes of the "Small One" <note>Zeir Anpin</note>; there is no one to protect Him, for He protects all and He watches over all, and from the providence of this eye, all are nourished. If this eye were to close for even a single moment, all things could not exist. Therefore, it is called the Open Eye, the Supreme Eye, the Holy Eye, the Eye of Providence, the Eye that does not sleep.

# Naso

## Main Text (The Great Assembly)

It is not written "support," but rather "Eye," for it is the light of all. It is the Eye that is the sustenance of all, and concerning this it is written: **"He who has a bountiful eye shall be blessed"** <note>Proverbs 22:9</note>. Do not read it as "shall be blessed" <note>Hebrew: *yevorach*</note> but rather "shall bless" <note>Hebrew: *yevarech*</note>, for this aspect is called "Bountiful Eye" <note>literally "Good Eye"</note> and from it, everything is blessed. In this state, there is no light for the lower eye to utilize from this faith—faith except for all the lines <margin>variant: to hope</margin> from the power of the white light of the Supernal Eye, which is called "Bountiful Eye." No one knows this except for that Supernal Eye, which is holy and acts with loving-kindness toward the lower eye. In the future, the righteous and the celestial merit-holders will see with this wisdom: **"For they shall see eye to eye"** <note>Isaiah 52:8</note>. And we see in the scriptures, since it is written "eye to eye" in a deficient form <note>missing the letter Vav</note>, that through the mercies with which the Lord comes (and the Eye of the All-Highest is revealed, to be hidden and yet to show itself to the lower eye, for the world could not otherwise stand and exist).

We have learned in the *Assembly of Concealment* <note>Sifra Detzniuta, a foundational cryptic text of the Zohar</note> that from the lower eye, all the supernal light is hidden within it, and that supernal light enters into the lower one, for from it all light is nourished. It is written "eye to eye" in mercy when the Lord comes, and it is written: **"Behold, the eye of the Lord is toward those who fear Him"** <note>Psalms 33:18</note>. And it is written: **"The eyes of the Lord range throughout the entire earth"** <note>Zechariah 4:10</note>. If they are worthy: "the eye of the Lord is toward those who fear Him"—this refers to the Supernal Eye. If they are not worthy: "the eyes of the Lord range"—referring to the lower eye. For we have learned: Why did Joseph merit that the "Evil Eye" had no power over him? Because he merited to gaze upon the "Bountiful Supernal Eye." This is the meaning of: **"Joseph is a fruitful bough, a fruitful bough by a spring"** <note>Genesis 49:22; the Hebrew word for "spring," *ayin*, also means "eye"</note>. Why is it "a fruitful bough by a spring"? Meaning, he rose above the reach of the [evil] eye to gaze upon it. And it is written: **"He who has a bountiful eye shall be blessed, for he gives of his bread to the poor"** <note>Proverbs 22:9</note>.

What is the reason <note>Aramaic: *mai ta'ama*</note> this is called "Kindness"? Because in the likeness of the lower realm, there is an eye, and there is an eye of impurity, and they are two in two colors. But here [in the Supernal King], there is no [second] eye; both of them rise as one level and all is the "Right Side" <note>the side of Mercy/Chesed</note>. Because of this, it is one Eye and not two. We have learned: This Eye is an eye of constant open observation, always capable, always rejoicing <margin>variant: and seeing</margin>. It is not like this in the lower realm, where everything is in sweetness and wisdom and sustenance in seven colors; it is not always open, for there is an eyelid—a covering <margin>variant: without holy eyelids</margin> <margin>variant: he has eyelids that cover</margin> over the eye. Concerning this it is written: **"Awake! Why do You sleep, O Lord?"** <note>Psalms 44:24</note> and **"Open Your eyes, O Lord"** <note>2 Kings 19:16</note>. When it is opened, there is someone to see—to be opened for good, or for one who is not opened for good. Woe to the one who is opened when the eye is mixed with sweetness and stands below to receive it, and the eye is covered from them more than the dwelling of the Ancient of Days, whose Eye is white within white, a whiteness that includes all whiteness. And all is a portion for the one who hates [evil]. One of these whites is certainly that of which it is written: **"He who has a bountiful eye shall be blessed."** And it is written: **"O house of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the Lord"** <note>Isaiah 2:5</note>.

We have learned: Regarding all that pertains to the Ancient One, the matter is written but not spread out in clarity, except for one place where we see the Lesser Countenance <note>Zeir Anpin</note> being blessed, as it is written: **"For I have sworn by My soul"** which refers to the Lesser Countenance. And it is written: **"Thus shall you bless Israel."** This refers to the "Israel" of the upper realm. And it is written: **"He shall bless Israel"**—written without the "Thus" <note>Hebrew: *koh*</note> to show separation. Does it say "Israel"? No. We have learned: The Ancient of Days is wine, precious and shining beautifully. We have learned: It is written: **"I watched until thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days sat"** <note>Daniel 7:9</note>. What are these "thrones that were set"? Rabbi Judah said: Arise in your place to establish the throne for [the King]. According to Rabbi Judah, it is written "a throne of sparks of fire," and the Ancient of Days sits upon this throne. Why? For we have learned: If the Ancient of Days did not sit upon this throne, the world could not endure before that throne. When the Ancient of Days sits upon it, He subdues <margin>variant: it is subdued</margin> that throne. He who sits is the ruler at the time it is written of this throne; and He sits on the throne which is the first throne, "set in place" so that no stranger shall rule or ride upon it, but only the Ancient of Days. According to Rabbi Simeon and Rabbi Judah, the chariot shall be prepared and He shall sit thus from the Ancient of Days. And come and see, it is written: "Wait for the Lord, the Merciful," and for the Rider, it is so; it is all the letter *Qof*, and He is hidden from all sides, a standing light. In a standing that the Face is not known. And come and see what happens since...
