<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly), specifically focusing on the symbolic anatomy of the Divine "Faces" (Partzufim). It follows the discussion of the "Hidden Brain" and now transitions to the "Nose" (Chotma) and the breath of life.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Naso**<-

Since the Ancient One <note>Atika, the highest manifestation of the Divine</note> does not teach the Small Face <note>Zeir Anpin, the emotive aspects of the Divine</note> except through the nose—from one nostril life, and from the other nostril life for all. For this nose is the nasal cavity <term>Pardashka: the internal structure of the nose</term> in which it is written that the spirit dwells for the Small Face. We call this "forgiveness," and within it rests the spirit of the spirit that emerges from that Hidden Brain. One spirit emerges for the Small Face to descend into the Garden of Eden, and one spirit of life through which people are destined to merit the creation of the generation and the knowledge of wisdom. And from that second nostril, a spirit emerges from the Hidden Brain and is destined to rest upon the King Messiah, as it is written:
> **"And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and the fear of the Lord."** <note>Isaiah 11:2</note>

Here there are four spirits, and in this one spirit that we mentioned, these three are established. Rabbi Yomi rejoiced in the day of the King Messiah; this is the "He" and "Vav" <note>referring to parts of the Divine Name</note>, and they shall say to one another: "Teach this wisdom," for it is written:
> **"And they shall teach no more every man his neighbor... for they shall all know Me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them."** <note>Jeremiah 31:33</note>

And at that time, the Ancient of Days shall awaken the spirit that emerges from the Hidden Brain of all. When this ascends, all the spirits below will awaken with it. And who are they? They are the two holy crowns of the Small Face, and they are the six other spirits given to him, as it is written: "the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and the fear of the Lord." For we have learned it is written: "And Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord," and it is written: "There were six steps to the throne," and the King Messiah is destined to sit upon his throne. These are six, and the spirit of the Ancient of Days is above them—making seven. As it was said, there are three spirits that include three others. Rabbi Shimon rejoiced; may his spirit rest in the World to Come. Regarding this it is written:
> **"Thus saith the Lord God: Come from the four winds, O breath..."** <note>Ezekiel 37:9</note>

And what do the four winds of the world do here? Rather, for the four spirits, three are awakened, and the spirit of the Hidden Ancient One makes four. And so it is, that when this one emerges, three emerge with it, which are included within three others. And the Holy One, blessed be He, is destined to bring forth one spirit that is included of them all, as it is written: "From the four winds come, O spirit." In this verse, it does not say "to" the four winds, but "from" the four winds. In the days of the King Messiah, they will not need to teach one another, for their spirit, which is included of all spirits, knows everything: wisdom, understanding, counsel, might, knowledge, and the fear of the Lord, because of the spirit that is included of all spirits. Therefore it is written "from the four winds," which are the four included in the seven supernal levels that we have seen. And the lowest of them all is in this spirit of the Ancient of Ancients that emerges from the Hidden Brain to the nostril of the nose.

And come and see the difference between nose and nose. The nose of the Ancient of Days is life from all sides. Regarding the nose of the Small Face, it is written:
> **"Smoke rose up in His nostrils, and fire out of His mouth devoured..."** <note>Psalms 18:9</note>

Smoke rose in his nostrils, and from the side of the smoke, the furnace burns. When the smoke rises, it reaches the Crown <note>Keter</note>. It is found to be bitter from it. What is "from it"? The exchange of smoke from them, the nose from that sin. Three things: when Rav Hamnuna the Elder wanted to focus his prayer, he would say: "To the Master of the Nose my heart prays; to the Master of the Nose I supplicate." And this is what is written:
> **"And for My praise I will refrain [literally: 'muzzle my nose'] for thee."** <note>Isaiah 48:9</note>

The Ancient of Days said this verse. Below the path of the nose are three hundred and seventy worlds, all of which cling to the Small Face. This is the addition to the "Correction of the Nose." And see, all the "corrections" <term>Tikunim: the divine features or arrangements</term> of the Ancient of Days are for those below, yet not for those below <note>meaning they influence the lower worlds but remain transcendent</note>.

Rabbi Shimon opened and said: Woe to him who stretches out his hand against the Image and the preciousness of the Holy Elder, the Hidden One, the Pure One of all. The Image of that praise! The Image that is hidden and more precious than all "corrections." The Image that neither those above nor those below know. The Image that is the praise of all praises. The Image that no man, prophet, or holy one has approached to see. The Image that has three sides until the speech of all. It is placed as a portion, most precious of the precious, hidden of the hidden, the faith of the faith of all. Come and see, like the movement of the book.

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Great Assembly (Idra Rabba) from the Zohar, specifically detailing the symbolic anatomy of the Divine Beard. # Portion of Naso

The book of this beard, the concealment of all, issues from its ears and surrounds the holy mouth; it descends and fills, and issues in a great offering of fragrance from within the precious path <note>original: "orchah dikira"; some versions read: "within the beard"</note>. It descends like a cluster and issues down to the navel of this precious, faithful, and perfect beard, from which flow thirteen springs—springs of the good oil of greatness <term>Oil of Greatness: "Mishach Rabuta," referring to the divine abundance or anointing oil that flows through the sefirot</term>—arranged in thirteen rectifications.

**The First Rectification:** The hair is arranged from above, and its radiance comes from that rectification of the crown of the head, which rises in its arrangements above the ears. It descends before the opening of the nose like a thread in a cluster that rises to the top of the mouth.

**The Second Rectification:** The hair is arranged from the top of the mouth and rises to the other top of the mouth in a balanced arrangement.

**The Third Rectification:** From the middle of the area beneath <note>some versions read: "that rises"</note> the nose, from beneath the two nostrils, a single path issues, and the hair is parted at that path, filling this side and that side; the strands of hair rise in a perfect arrangement around that path.

**The Fourth Rectification:** The hair is arranged and descends beneath the mouth, from one end to the other end, in a perfect arrangement.

**The Fifth Rectification:** Beneath the mouth, another path issues like the cluster of the path above, and these two paths are marked upon the mouth from here and from there.

**The Sixth Rectification:** The hair is arranged and rises and issues from the throat upward to the head, covering the offering of good fragrance up to the top of the upper mouth, and the hair descends from the head to the opening of the path beneath the mouth.

**The Seventh Rectification:** The hair parts, and two "apples" <term>Apples: "Tappuchin," a symbolic term for the cheeks, representing the radiance of the divine countenance</term> are revealed in the offering of good fragrance; they are beautiful and pleasant to behold, for because of them the world exists. As it is written: "In the light of the King’s face is life."

**The Eighth Rectification:** A single thread of hair issues around the beard, and they hang like a cluster down to the navel.

**The Ninth Rectification:** The hairs of the beard mingle and are found with those hairs that hang like a cluster; they hang down, and none are bent over.

**The Tenth Rectification:** The lower hairs beneath the beard mingle and cover the throat beneath the beard.

**The Eleventh Rectification:** No hair protrudes beyond another, and they are measured in a perfect proportion.

**The Twelfth Rectification:** The hairs do not hang over the mouth, and the mouth is cleared on all its sides, and the hairs are seen surrounding it.

**The Thirteenth Rectification:** The hairs hang beneath the beard from here and from there in great dignity; all is in beautiful dignity, covering down to the navel. They do not seal <note>some versions read: "to the bottom"</note> any of the wisdom of the offering of fragrance, except for those beautiful white "apples" that bring forth life to the world and appear as joy to the "Watchers" <term>Watchers: "Irin," a class of high-ranking angels</term> whom they cover.

Through these thirteen rectifications, thirteen springs of the oil of greatness flow and issue; they flow to all those below, and they shine with that oil and drink from that oil. In these thirteen rectifications, the precious beard is arranged—the concealment of all—belonging to the Ancient of Ancients. It is arranged from the two beautiful "apples" which cover the wisdom of the Lesser Countenance <term>Lesser Countenance: "Zeir Anpin," the more accessible, emotive aspect of the Divine</term>. And all the whiteness and smallness found below is enlightened and sparked by that Whiteness. These thirteen rectifications are established in the beard, and in the perfection of the beard they are called the "Rectifications of the Son of Man," for all who look upon the beard find faith hanging within it.

We have learned in the assembly of the book: these thirteen rectifications that hang in the precious beard are found in the world and are opened in the thirteen gates of mercy. It is fitting to stretch out one's hand to the Whiteness as one who gazes upon the thirteen rectifications of the beard. [The text here contains fragmented liturgical or mnemonic instructions]. Rabbi Isaac stood and began, saying:

> "Who is a God like You, pardoning iniquity..." and "He will again have compassion on us..." and "You will show truth to Jacob..." <note>Micah 7:18-20. These verses contain thirteen phrases corresponding to the thirteen attributes of mercy.</note>

Thirteen, thirteen are prepared here, and all of them issue from the thirteen springs of the oil of greatness of the rectifications of the beard.

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly). The previous sections established the mystical anatomy of the "Ancient of Ancients" (Atika Kadisha), the highest manifestation of the Divine. This page focuses specifically on the "Holy Beard" (Dikna) and how its hairs represent the flow of mercy and the Thirteen Attributes of Compassion.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Naso**<-
<note>The title of the Torah portion: "Take a census/Lift up."</note>

The Holy Beard of the Ancient of Ancients. Three hidden things within the hidden things are the formation of the Beard; it is hidden and concealed, hidden and yet not hidden, concealed and not written in its formations, known and yet unknown. The first formation: we have learned that every single hair does not cling to another, and the fullness of the "water" <note>The flow of divine influence or "light"</note> of the Beard is to be formed from the formations of the hair of the head. One hundred and thirty-eight <note>The numerical value of the word "Beard" (Dikna) in Gematria is 154, but the text here refers to a specific count of hairs or paths</note> are formed to show all the hairs of the head and the hairs of the precious Beard together; one hair is not included in another <note>Other versions: from the balance of its formation</note>. And further, they are soft and visible, not harsh; they are seen as the strands of the Beard, not harsh but fine and thin. And those of the head are not thin but straight; rather, all the hairs are ordered from the head and the beard. Those of the head hang over the shoulders to go to the spirit of the *Lesser Countenance* <note><term>Zeir Anpin</term>: The more accessible, emotive aspect of the Divine, often associated with the "Son" or the "King" in Kabbalah</note> from that "oil of anointing" of the brain. And because of this, they were not thin, and it seems to me they are below to be soft. We learned, what is it that is written:
> Wisdom cries out in the street <note>Proverbs 1:20</note>

And at the end it is written:
> In the broad squares she raises her voice <note>Proverbs 1:20</note>

This verse has its beginning at its end and its end at its beginning. Rather, "Wisdom cries out in the street" when it flows from the Hidden Brain to take hold of the face of the brain of the *Lesser Countenance*. Because of those hairs, they all connect outside the two brains to become one brain, for there is no existence for the lower brain except through the existence of the upper brain. And when it flows from this one to that one, it is written "she raises her voice" as one. And because it flows from brain to brain through those hairs, they now connect outside the two brains to become one brain; through those hairs, they do not become short/cut off. For if they were found to be short, Wisdom would not flow to the brain through them. Because of this, there is no wisdom in a person unless it is from the pressure of the "holy narrowness" <note>A reference to the concentrated source of divine light</note> which then expands into the broadness, as it is written:
> The words of the wise are heard in quiet <note>Ecclesiastes 9:17</note>

And from here we learn: whoever has the hair of his head short, wisdom is not found with him. And it seems to me those are soft <note>Other versions: soft</note> to bring benefit to all, and they show that they go down to the spinal cord which issues from the brain. And because of this, the hair of the head does not hang over the hair of the beard, for the hair of the head hangs and rises over the ears to the back and does not hang over the beard, so that it should not be necessary for these to mix with those, for they are all separated in their paths. We learned: all the hairs, whether of the head or of the beard, are all white as snow. And we learned: the "laugh" <note>Or "whiteness/purity"</note> of the Holy Beard—they are all because they are strong against the strong ones, to strengthen those Thirteen Attributes of the Ancient of Ancients. And these attributes, before the softness, are prepared, and these attributes are hidden here and mixed with others. <note>Other versions: those below, and they strike below, and thus they stand before the prepared softness; the hairs are straight to reveal them and not to be mixed with others, etc.</note>. And see, you might say there are no others like them for the Lord. For we have learned the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy from the Holy Ancient One:
1. **Who is a God like You** <note>Micah 7:18</note> etc.
2. **Who pardons iniquity**
3. **And passes over transgression**
4. **For the remnant of His inheritance**
5. **He does not retain His anger forever**

8. **He will subdue our iniquities**

10. **You will show truth to Jacob**
11. **Mercy to Abraham**
12. **Which You have sworn to our fathers**

And these are the thirteen formations of the Holy Upper Beard, the Hidden of the Hidden, strong to break and to subdue all decrees of judgment. Who is like the Holy Upper Beard, the Hidden of the Hidden, from which nothing is hidden <note>Other versions: is subdued</note>? And because of this, all the hairs are short and strong in its formations.

The male principle <note>The aspect of active expression/judgment</note> seeks to hint at a voice and to proclaim words. What is the difference between this and that? Regarding the nose, from beneath the nostrils of His nose it is written: >And the anger of the Lord was kindled< and He covered and went. That the spirit of anger emerges from those nostrils, and whoever is purified before Him, [the anger] passes and is not found before him, for >The spirit of the Lord blows upon it< <note>Isaiah 40:7</note>. Regarding the merciful ones, it is written: "And passes over transgression." And it is written: >And a wind passes and cleanses them< <note>Job 37:21</note>. ## Main Text (Zohar)

Above and not below; above, He "passes over transgression," while below, He does not prepare for it forever, for He "delights in mercy" <note>Micah 7:18</note>. And that configuration is established so that there is no [judgment], for the Mercy <term>Chesed: The sephirah of loving-kindness and expansive benevolence</term> from above is like the Mercy below—to pass over [sin]. Thus, below He gives Mercy to pass over [transgression] in every place where it is written. The "Concealed of all Concealed" <note>A title for the highest, most unknowable aspect of the Divine</note> reveals a path that is good for all, which comes to be seen as a counsel to do good for all. That which is hidden and not revealed has no counsel, and there is no one who knows it; it is like the "Upper Eden" which no one knows but He Himself, the Ancient of Ancients. And concerning this it is written: *How great are Your works, O Lord! Your thoughts are very deep* <note>Psalms 92:6</note>. Come and see: seven [configurations] are established for the World to Come from the Ancient of Ancients.

**The Eighth Configuration** <note>Tikkuna Temina'ah</note>: The hair is arranged and rises from below to above, covering the "offering of good spices" <note>The cheeks</note> up to the beginning of the upper mouth. The hair of the head descends to the spirit of the opening of the lower path of the mouth. Rabbi Yose stood and established this configuration. Rabbi Yose stood, opened [his discourse], and said: *"My mercy shall not depart from you"* <note>Isaiah 54:10</note>. And it is written: *"With everlasting mercy I have had compassion on you"* <note>Isaiah 54:8</note>. These verses seem to contradict regarding "Mercies." But they do not contradict, for we have learned: there is Mercy and there is Mercy. There is internal Mercy and there is external Mercy. The internal Mercy is that which we spoke of regarding the Ancient of Ancients, which is hidden in this side of the Beard called the "corner of the beard." A person must not destroy this side because this is the internal Mercy of the Ancient of Days. And like the Priest below, it is written of him: <term>They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard</term> <note>Leviticus 21:5</note>, so as not to destroy the path of Mercy of the Ancient One, for the Priest comes from this side. And come and see, in the "Assembly of the Book," Mercy is needed in everything to be drawn down and gathered, and not to be cut off or removed from the world. And that which is written, "My mercy shall not depart from you," refers to the Mercy of the Ancient of Days. "With everlasting mercy" refers to the Mercy called "Worldly Mercy," which is the place where it is written, "I said, the world shall be built with mercy" <note>Psalms 89:3</note>; it is the Mercy of the Ancient of Ancients, which is the Mercy of Truth. And "Mercy of Truth" is not said of a fleeting life, but of the life of Wisdom. And likewise it is written: *For He delights in mercy* <note>Micah 7:18</note>. This is the eighth configuration of the precious Beard of the Ancient of Ancients.

**The Ninth Configuration**: The hair is parted, and two "apples" <note>The rounded, hairless parts of the cheeks</note> are seen in the "offering of spices," beautiful and pleasant to behold. Rabbi Eleazar opened and said:
> **"As the apple tree among the trees of the wood..."** <note>Song of Songs 2:3</note>

Just as this apple is comprised of three colors, so the Holy One, Blessed be He, [manifests through] two apples comprised of three colors. These two apples are the ninth configuration, which includes all the configurations of the cheeks, and through them is sustained the verse: **"In the light of the King’s face is life"** <note>Proverbs 16:15</note>. And come and see, from these apples, "faces" go out to the world and show joy to the *Lesser Countenance* <term>Zeir Anpin: The emotive attributes of God, often associated with the Tetragrammaton</term>, as it is written: **"The Lord make His face shine upon you"** <note>Numbers 6:25</note>. And it is written: "In the light of the King’s face is life." "In the light of the King’s face" refers to those two apples of the "offering of spices" of the cheeks. "The Lord make His face shine"—this refers to the external face, for when they shine, the world is blessed. And come and see, whenever these external lamps shine, the whole world is blessed and no anger is found in the world. And if it is so externally, how much more so for the two apples that shine constantly, with constant joy upon them. When the two apples are revealed, the Lesser Countenance is seen in joy, and all those lower lamps are in joy, and all those below shine, and all worlds are joyful and perfect in every perfection, and all are glad and shining, and all goodness never ceases. They are all filled as one taste; they are all glad as one taste. Come and see, the external face sometimes shines and sometimes passes away, and likewise it is written: "The Lord make His face shine upon you." "Make His face shine" implies an adjustment or rising. This implies it is not constant, except when the upper apples are revealed. Truly, those hidden apples shine and sparkle constantly, and from here light flows to three hundred and seventy sides, and all the sides of the first configurations of the Beard are contained within it. Regarding this it is written: *He will turn again and have compassion on us* <note>Micah 7:19</note>. "He will turn again" implies that sometimes they are hidden and sometimes they are revealed. Regarding this it is written: "He will turn again and have compassion on us," and all of them below are the voice of His mercy. This is the ninth configuration.

## Main Text (Zohar)

The **seventh** arrangement includes the two cheeks of the Ancient of Ancients <note>original: *Atika De-Atikin*, the most hidden aspect of the Divine Crown</note>. > And one called to another and said: Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of Hosts (Isaiah 6:3).

The Scroll of the Torah corresponds to them; the Daughter is holy, the Temple is holy, and He is holy. The Torah was given in twenty holinesses, in fifty levels, in thirty surrounding days in the world; the Tablets, the Window, and the Temple all depend on Fortune, and this "hanging" <note>the hair of the beard</note> depends on Fortune. And it is written:
> And His kingdom rules over all (Psalms 103:19).

Do not think that those who are in these holinesses do not depend on Fortune. Rather, this is how we established it in the *Book of Concealment*: this precious, holy thread upon which all the hairs of the beard hang is called **Fortune** <note>original: *Mazal*</note>. Why? Because all the holiest of holies of the Holy One, Blessed be He, depend on this "Fortune." And he spoke and said that they are "Holy" only on the surface—ten holinesses—until one enters the Temple. Once one enters the Temple, it is called "Holy" like the ten holinesses, in the manner of the Above, which is not called "Temple" until the ten holinesses are joined and united. Everything depends on Fortune, which is this thread upon which all the hairs hang. And why is it called *Mazal*? Because from it hang the constellations <note>original: *mazali*, a play on words between 'divine flow' and 'astrological luck'</note> and from it the upper and lower worlds are sustained. And because this hangs, and upon it depend all the matters of the world, upper and lower—even the Scroll of the Torah in the Temple, which is crowned with ten holinesses—it does not fall outside the collective of other holinesses. All of them depend on this, and the sustenance of this arrangement is subdued <note>variant reading: "esteemed"</note> before Him and humbled. This is what is written:
> He will subdue our iniquities (Micah 7:19).

He said to him: Rabbi, you are blessed by the Holy of Holies, the Ancient of all. The **ninth arrangement**: the hairs are balanced with those hairs that hang, and they do not overpower one another. Arise, Rabbi Isaac. Rabbi Isaac stood and said: These are the hairs that are balanced with those that hang; they are called the "Locks of the Sea" because they emerge from the brain of brains. And what place is hinted at? All the masters of scales, those who cleanse the throne and are humbled. He said to him: You shall be blessed by the Ancient of Days. The **tenth arrangement**: the hairs descend beneath the beard and cover the throat of the beard. Arise, Rabbi Judah. Rabbi Judah stood, opened, and said:
> And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord... (Isaiah 2:19).

"For fear of the Lord"—this is to let you know that He who is the male aspect is called "Fear of the Lord." And the "Glory of the Head" <note>original: *Hadar Galgaley*</note> are those hairs beneath the throat, and they are called the Glory of the Head, two giving **Truth to Jacob** <note>referring to the attributes of mercy</note>. And the eleventh is that they do not overpower one another. **Kindness to Abraham** is the twelfth arrangement, where the hairs do not hang over the mouth, and the mouth is cleared on all sides, and the hairs are arranged beautifully around it so that no coarseness is found. Just as coarseness is required in some places, here in the Crown <note>Keter</note>, no coarseness is found. For the hairs of the beard are distant from the mouth; they are pure, and in it all mercies are prepared, even though it is not found in the goodness <note>variant reading: "the good"</note> of the spirit that covers. For there descends from this Holy Mouth <note>original: *Puma Kadisha*</note> a spirit that precedes the holiest of holies. This spirit strikes; it is the spirit that is refined <note>variant reading: "purified"</note> within it, in which the Lesser Countenance <note>original: *Zeir Anpin*</note> is clothed. And from what spirit are all those below clothed? When that spirit goes out, it is spread into thirty-seven thousand worlds, and each one spreads <note>variant reading: "is distributed"</note> individually below. And whoever is worthy to be clothed by it, is clothed. And because of this, the hairs do not cover the Holy Mouth, because the spirit subdues them and does not want any hair to mix with it and be called holy. And this is the hiddenness of all, which does not attach Above or Below. It flows hidden, like the most hidden of hidden things that is not known.

## Main Text (Zohar)

This is the one that was not [previously] arranged and had no formal arrangement. Because of this, the spirit that goes out and clothes itself in the faithful prophets is called the "Mouth of the Lord," <note>original: "Pei YHVH"</note> yet for all the hidden aspects of the Ancient of Ancients, it is not revealed, and they do not see how He knows mercy when He takes pity. Because of this, His hairs surround the area of the mouth and spread out from all sides. And in the desire for their elevation, the spirit is found to be clothed, spreading to many sides in joy. After all its sides are leveled in its surroundings, this is what is written: *Kindness as in the days of old,* <note>A mystical interpretation of Micah 7:20</note> and this is the holy, supreme correction of the corrections, from which thirteen <note>13</note> corrections spread above and thirteen corrections below. Thirteen corrections for all the tribes of kindness. This is what is written: *Kindness as in the days of old.* The thirteenth correction: the hairs hang down from beneath the beard on this side and that side in beautiful glory, in sapphire glory, covering down to the navel. They are not seen by the sages who approach the fragrance, except for those beautiful, white "apples" <note>A Kabbalistic term for the radiant parts of the cheeks/face</note>.

Rabbi Shimon said: Blessed is the portion of the one who is found in the life of this supreme holy splendor, who waits for Him. Blessed is his portion in this world and in the world to come, for he waits for the paths in the supreme holiness <margin>(and He hid from us) (another version: but He gave us wisdom)</margin>. And all these supreme corrections of the holy Image were arranged, crowned, and preserved in their places. And this thirteenth correction is a beautiful correction, in which there is a desire for sweetness, to sweeten the scent; opposite it hang all those fragrances, hidden and white. From it hang the upper and lower beings. This is the perfect correction that completes all corrections; it completes everything.

**We learned:** Six corrections are called "Days of Old" <note>original: "Yemei Kedem"</note> which are called the days of the ancients, the first ones. And those found in the *Small Face* <term>Zeir Anpin: the emotive attributes of God, often associated with the created world</term> are called "Days of the World" <note>original: "Yemei Olam"</note>. And you find that the six Days of Old are all arranged in the correction of the Image <margin>(another version: of the Beard)</margin> of the Ancient of Ancients, the Hidden of All Hidden, included within them. And this thirteenth one includes them all, and all the lights above and below. Because of this, everything is included in this *Mazal* <term>Mazal: literally "constellation" or "luck," but here referring to the "Flow" or "Influence" emanating from the Beard</term> which is filled by everything, as it was said: "and he shall not be cleansed," <note>referring to the verse in Exodus 34:7; the Zohar reads this as a positive attribute of the Flow</term> it was not included with them, rather it includes everything. And at that time when the Ancient of Days awakens in the corrections above, that is called "One Day," pure kindness, and from the hair of the beard, this is what is written:

> It shall be one day which is known to the Lord
<note>Zechariah 14:7</note>

He is alone, more than all. He is the one who includes all. He is the one called by the known Name. After they were arranged, after there was day and night—for there is no day without night—from that time on, they are the "Days of Honor" of the Beard. And He alone is found; He is called neither day nor night, for it is not called "day" except from our side, and it is not called "night" except from our side. And because this correction includes everything, it is not known and not seen. From Him and through Him flows the oil of greatness <note>Anointing oil</note> to thirteen sides, springs for all those below. By that oil, the thirteen corrections of the supreme holy Beard were arranged. And these corrections in this Beard are arranged and prepared in many directions, yet it is not seen how they spread or how they go out. They are concealed from all and hidden from all; no one knows the place. In this Ancient One, in their simplicity, they are all included. As it was said: He is known and not known, hidden and not hidden. Concerning Him it is called:

> I am the Lord, that is My name; and My glory I will not give to another
<note>Isaiah 42:8</note>

And it is written:

> It is He who has made us, and we are His
<note>Psalms 100:3</note>

And it is written:

> And the Ancient of Days sat

<note>Psalms 139:14</note>

**Rabbi Shimon said** to the companions: I will spread this veil for those who see a vision over us here, from the brain of the hiddenness where all corrections are stored and bound in this place. And one veil, the delight of the Holy One, blessed be He <margin>(another version: in the holy brain)</margin>, is spread like four garments to the four sides.

## Main Text (Zohar)

In one place, he sits from below to above, and one shovel is in his hands; and like a shovel, it has four keys <note>original: "maptachin," referring to openings or spiritual portals</note> prepared <insert>variant: prepared</insert> from all sides. Curtains divide and gather it from above to below, and likewise for the support of the second, third, and fourth. And so, support to support, for the other eighteen legs of the supports, they are established in the Throne of carvings <insert>variant: in the movement of carvings</insert> within that curtain, and so to the four sides. There are fifteen repairs <term>Tikkunim: spiritual rectifications or "garments" of the Divine</term> that are established upon it, and they find what is needed to be crowned and to ascend, each one as is fitting.

And when they were being repaired, each one that was lacking ascended further and was crowned and repaired by that rectification which was established here by the mouth of each one of us. And at the time when one of us opens his mouth to repair that specific rectification, that rectification would sit and wait for the word that comes out of your mouths; and then it ascends to its place and is crowned. All the supports from here and from there rejoice to hear that which they did not know. They incline toward your voices, just as the heavenly hosts stand here for your sake. You are meritorious in the World to Come, for all the words that come out of your mouths are all holy words, which do not turn to the right or to the left. It is a single voice to be heard, and I will hide these words until the end <insert>variant: until the river</insert> to be a merit for me in the World to Come. You shall say: "And here is the place of all these holy words." Concerning them it is written: ->*And your palate is like the best wine... moving the lips of those who sleep.*<- <note>Song of Songs 7:10</note> What is the meaning of "moving the lips of those who sleep"? That even in the World to Come, their lips murmur the Torah before Him.

He began to repair, and the intention of the mind was directed to repair the rectifications of the *Zeir Anpin* <term>The "Small Face" or "Impatient One," representing the emotive attributes of God</term>, how he shall be repaired and how he shall be clothed in his rectifications from the rectification of the *Atik Yomin* <term>The "Ancient of Days," the most hidden aspect of the Divine</term>, the Holy of Holies, the Hidden of Hiddens, hidden from all. For now, wisdom is proven <insert>variant: wisdom</insert> upon them until the end; a smoke shall live and shine, and all rectifications shall be repaired according to their nature. The rectifications of *Zeir Anpin* were repaired from the rectifications of *Arich Anpin* <term>The "Long Face" or "Patient One," the Divine Will</term>, and the rectifications spread from here and from there like a vision of a covering for a canopy <insert>variant: for a shelter</insert>. For a spirit is hidden from all sides in order to dwell upon the Throne, as it is written: ->*And upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man upon it from above.*<- <note>Ezekiel 1:26</note>

"As the appearance of a man"—which includes all forms. "As the appearance of a man"—which includes all Names. "As the appearance of a man"—in which are hidden all worlds, upper and lower. "As the appearance of a man"—which includes all the mysteries that were spoken and repaired before the world was created, even though they did not yet endure.

We have learned in the *Concealment of the Book* <term>Sifra Detzniuta: a foundational, cryptic Zoharic text</term> of the Ancient of Ancients: Before the rectification was prepared in this, kings ruled <note>The "Kings of Edom" mentioned in Genesis</note>, and they were like kings and stormy kings, but they did not endure until He pushed them aside <insert>variant: until He showed them</insert> and humbled them. After a time, He divided the Kingdom into the side of the kingdom of one to another. In this secret, after all of them were established there, they still did not endure until the White Head, the Ancient of Ancients, was repaired. When He was repaired, He repaired all the rectifications below; He repaired all the rectifications of the upper and lower worlds. From here we learn: any head of a people who is not repaired first, the people are not repaired. If he is repaired, they are all repaired. And if he is not repaired first, the people cannot be repaired.

From here: until the Ancient of Days was repaired in His rectifications, all those who sought to be repaired were not repaired, and all the worlds were destroyed. This is what is written: ->*And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom.*<- <note>Genesis 36:32</note> "And he reigned in Edom"—a different spirit <insert>variant: a precious spirit</insert>, the end of the place where all are measured and revealed from there. "Bela the son of Beor"—this is a decree of harsh judgment, the strongest of the strong, in whose sparks are bound thousands upon thousands of masters of wailing and lamentation. <unclear>And his city was Dinhabah</unclear>—as it is written, "What is of the beast," meaning Judgment is here. <unclear>And his wife's name was Mehetabel</unclear>. Since he ascended to be included in it, he did not stand and could not exist, because the Form of Adam was not yet repaired. For the rectification of Adam is a form that includes everything and can sustain everything.

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly). ## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Naso**<-

Everything was established in Him. Because this restoration <note>Hebrew/Aramaic: *Tikkun*</note> was not yet found, they [the prior worlds] could not stand or exist, and they were nullified. You might think they were nullified completely? Rather, they were all included as one, but they were nullified and removed from that state of restoration until the restoration of **Adam** <note>The primordial Divine Human form</note> arrived. And when this image arrived, they all took form <note>Other versions: they were rolled/revolved</note> and were restored to their existence in a proper way and they endured. <note>Another version: aimed toward their restoration and were not nullified.</note> In this state, they were not nullified at all. And do not say that because it is written "And he died," that they were nullified entirely—it is not so. Rather, it is like all those whose power is from a previous level; death is spoken of them as we say, "And the King of Egypt died," meaning he descended from the previous level he held. Once **Adam** <term>Adam: The mystical configuration of the Divine attributes in human-like form</term> was restored, they were called by other names and were sweetened by His existence, and they stand in their places. All of them were called by names different from the first ones, except for that one of whom it is written: *“And his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab”* (Genesis 36:39). He said: Matred—here they were not nullified like the others. He said: Matred—for they were male and female as one, a mystery that does not ascend except as male and female. Because of this, now that they are found as male and female, "death" is not written concerning them as it was for the others, and they endured. However, they were not settled until the image of Adam was formed. Once the image of Adam was formed, they were restored and endured in another existence and were settled.

We learned: When it arose in the will of the Ancient One, the **Constellation** <term>Mazla: Literally "destiny" or "flow," referring to the beard of the Ancient One from which grace flows</term>, to create the glory of His glory, He prepared and invited and brought forth from the "Hard Spark" <note>original: *Botzina de-Kardinuta*</note> one **Lamp** <term>Botzina: A mystical light or spark of creative energy</term>. When it shone <note>Another version: was prepared</note> and His will ascended, it spread to three hundred and seventy sides. A spark struck and beat, going out to a pure ether, revolving and spreading. It brought forth one **Skull** <term>Gulgaltah: The highest crown of the Divine head, representing the hidden Will</term> that is strong on four sides. In this pure whiteness, the Lamp was surrounded, grasped, and included <note>Another version: incorporated</note> within it. You might think "within it"? Rather, it is said "by it." Because of this Skull, it spread to its sides. This whiteness is the "Hidden of Hiddens" of the **Ancient of Days** <term>Atika Kadisha: The most ancient, hidden aspect of the Divine</term>. In the mystery of the building within this Skull, Kindness <note>Chesed</note> spread from one side and Strength <note>Gevurah</note> from the other side. Pure whiteness hovers over it from this side and from that side. What is it? He opened: "God is God" <note>original: *El Eloah Hu*</note>. But when these were taken, this one was included in the pure whiteness, shining to the sight of seventy worlds. A spirit was found from its sides. Because of this Skull, a strong skull was restored like this Skull; within it sit nine thousand myriads of worlds that are supported by them. From here, upon this Skull, the **Dew** <term>Tal: The mystical "Dew of Resurrection" that flows from the highest crown</term> is full of whiteness, which is found from the Head constantly. From this Dew, they sprinkle the dead to revive them. From that Dew which is perfected in two colors: from the side of the Head it is white like the color <note>Another version: of crystal</note> that includes all whiteness. But when all these whitenesses settle in this head of the **Small Face** <term>Zeir Anpin: The "Lesser Countenance," the more accessible, emotive aspect of the Divine</term>, red appears in it, like this crystal where the whiteness is from itself but a red glow appears in it like the color of wine. Because of this, it is written:
> *“And many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to reproaches and everlasting abhorrence”* (Daniel 12:2).
"To everlasting life"—because they are found in that whiteness that comes from the side of the Ancient of Days, the **Long Face** <note>Arich Anpin</note>. "To reproaches and everlasting abhorrence"—because they are found in that redness of the Small Face. And everything is included in that Dew, as it returns:
> *“For Your dew is a dew of lights”* (Isaiah 26:19).
"Lights" is plural (two), and it is the Dew that drips every day to the "Field of Apples" <note>A mystical name for the Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note> in colors of white and red. This Skull holds two colors, to this side and to that side. From this pure whiteness, it spreads from the Skull to thousands of myriads of worlds. Because of this, the Small Face was restored, and when it was needed, his thousands and myriads spread out on the lower side so that he might gaze upon the face of the Ancient of Ancients, the Life of the World. From this Skull, one side goes out to all those below, giving reward to the paths of the Ancient of Days when they enter the calculation of the seasons...

## Naso

Eighteen <term>Scepter-powers</term><note>original: "Sarbitus" - likely referring to emanations of authority</note> and corresponding to this, the skull is split open below; all these are in the calculation. And in this split, paths are found by the power of the Ancient of Days. Within the hollow of the skull, three hollows are found where the brain dwells, and a thin membrane covers them, but not the hard, closed membrane of the Ancient of Days. Because of this, the brain spreads out and shines <note>Variant reading: "and bends"</note> into thirty-two paths, that river which flows out from Eden. And below, in the three hollows of the skull, the brain dwells. From one hollow, it splits open <note>Variant reading: "and spreads"</note> as one fountain toward thirty sides. And from that brain which dwells in this hollow, thirty-two paths of the spirits of wisdom bend.

From the second hollow, another fountain splits and spreads out, and seven gates are opened. These seven gates are completed as times of freedom, the seven years of the Jubilee, and the seven cycles of generations; times when the Holy One, Blessed be He, finds His anger toward Himself and toward the sides within Him. From the third hollow, a thousand faces of generations go forth and are arranged for Knowledge <note>Da'at</note>; it dwells upon them and resides in them. And in this hollow, the spaces dwell <note>Variant reading: "it fills the spaces"</note> between this hollow and that hollow, and they are filled from two sides, all those chambers. This is as it is written:

> **"And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled."** (Proverbs 24:4)

And these three spread out through the whole body, to this side and to that side, and they take hold of the whole body, and the body takes hold of them from all its sides; and in the whole body they spread out and are found. We have learned: from the skull of the head hang a thousand thousands, myriads upon myriads of locks of hair, wise and intertwined one with another, and mixed one with another. And there is no number to the strands of every single lock, for they all look upon it, and they are drawn out and strike downward <note>Variant reading: "the musical accents of the Torah"</note> as it is written:

> **"His locks are curled."** (Song of Songs 5:11)

Like all those sides that are pure, in all those sides that are drawn out, the locks sit, tangled and strong; some are soft and some are strong. And in every single lock sit hanging locks upon locks, flaming and hanging like a strong hero who prevails in battle, heating up with a powerful strength, chosen among the chosen, soft and strong. This is as it is written:

> **"Excellent as the cedars."** (Song of Songs 5:15)

The locks are arranged in hanging extensions, the side to this and the side to that, upon the skull. And below sit heaps upon heaps, reaching those that are intertwined from many fountains of the three flows of the brain. From the fountain of the first hollow of the skull, the hairs are intertwined in darkness and become hanging heaps from several fountains below, drawn from this hollow. From the second hollow, fifty fountains go forth and the hairs are drawn out, intertwined from the fountains in darkness, and they become heaps upon heaps and are mixed with the locks in the openings. From the third hollow, a thousand faces of chambers go forth and are arranged, and the hairs are drawn out in darkness from all of them, and they become heaps upon heaps and are mixed with the locks in the openings. And because of this, those locks hang heaps upon heaps, and all of them are extensions that are intertwined from the three hollows of the brain of the skull. And all those locks hang and cover the side of the ears, and because of this it is written:

> **"Incline, O my God, Thine ear, and hear."** (Daniel 9:18)

And in this hang heaps on the right and the left, like light and darkness, mercy and judgment; and all time and washing hang in this, but not in the Ancient One. In the parting of the hair is found one thin path that begins from that hollow of the Ancient of Days, and from this engraving the secret of the brain spreads out, and the bond of the openings that are divided into the paths of the commandments of the Torah, as it is written:

> **"All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth unto such as keep His covenant and His testimonies."** (Psalms 25:10)

We have learned: in every single lock are born a thousand thousand chambers of strength and wailing, which hang in every single lock. Strong ones take hold and soft ones take hold, from those of the balance <note>Variant reading: "the scales of testing"</note>. Because of this, there is a right and a left. From the hollow of the forehead of the skull, there is a looking-out for observation, and it is never revealed except in the time of desire, and the brain of the righteous stands ready to be visited and to look into their deeds. And whenever this forehead is revealed, all the masters of judgment are stirred up, and the whole world is cooled by the spirit.

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the Divine physiognomy (the "Face" of God), specifically contrasting the "Small Face" (Zeir Anpin), which represents God's interaction with the world through justice and emotion, and the "Ancient of Days" (Atik Yomin), which represents pure, infinite compassion. This section focuses on the Forehead and the Eyes.</meta>

## Naso

At that time, when all the prayers for mercy ascend before the **Ancient of Days** <note>The highest, most hidden manifestation of the Divine</note> and He desires to have mercy upon all, the **Forehead of Will** <note>Ratzon - the Divine favor</note> is revealed. It shines upon the forehead of the **Small Face** <note>Zeir Anpin - the more manifest aspect of God</note>, and the harsh judgment is subdued. Upon this forehead <insert>of the Small Face</insert> rests a single hair that extends from the brain, from which emerge seventy gates. When this forehead is revealed, it is to oversee the sinners of the world—those who are not ashamed of their deeds. This is what is written: 
> "You had a harlot’s forehead, you refused to be ashamed." <note>Jeremiah 3:3</note>
And it is a wonder: this hair is thin like another that rests there, because it is revealed for the sins of those who are brazen in their actions. But at the time when the Holy One, Blessed be He, awakens to delight with the righteous, the wisdom of the **Ancient of Days** shines upon the face of the **Small Face**, and the Forehead is revealed and shines with that light, and that whole time is called the 
**Time of Favor**. <note>Et Ratzon - a period of Divine grace</note> Whenever judgment hangs over the world and this Forehead of the **Small Face** is revealed, the Forehead of the **Ancient of Ancients** is revealed, and the judgment is stilled and not executed. We have learned: in this Forehead, there extend two hundred thousand depths of redness <note>symbolizing judgments</note> that are contained within it. When the Forehead of the **Small Face** is revealed, terror falls upon all the heavenly hosts. But when the **Forehead of Will** is revealed—the Will that shines upon this Forehead—they are all stilled. And it is a wonder: crowns and four regions are found upon it, and they are all called 
**Spots** <margin>Another version: Forehead</margin> and they are all investigated by **Endurance** <note>Netzach - the Sephirah of victory or endurance</note>. In the two sides of this is the end of **Endurance** and the life of **Endurance**, and the life of **Endurance** pushes away the "spots." This is what we have learned: **Endurance** is the spots, and their life is in **Endurance**, and they extend from there into the body in two known ways. And we have learned, what is it that is written: 
> "And also the Strength [Netzach] of Israel will not lie nor repent; for He is not a man, that He should repent." <note>1 Samuel 15:29</note>
This spirit of wisdom, all that **Endurance** extends into the body, and the merits that hang upon the world... He returns and regrets and does not execute judgment on the living. What is the matter that is thin? It is the place called **Kindness** <note>Chesed</note>, and He can change His mind for every living thing after it is called "Womb" <note>Rechem/Mercy</note>, like this Forehead which is below. And it is revealed that this **Endurance** is their judge, and afterwards He relents. What is the matter that does not stand? It is that which is called **Kindness**, for the Face has not been revealed and the seal does not rest alone. Since the Face is not found, it is not called **Kindness**. And **Endurance** is not **Kindness** until after the repairs of the body. The Eyes of the Head are found below the eyes of the "Tarkiyuta" <note>A cryptic Zoharic term for a hidden chamber or celestial covering</note>... they are painted with wisdom, hanging row upon row for the Small One. These are the "repairs" <note>Tikkunim - spiritual structures</note> upon the eyes in the head that rest there. They are hidden from both sides... the masters of oversight who are upon the eyelids, like a covering for the eyes that flash. And four hundred myriads <note>4 million</note> are hidden in their sparks to provide a covering and oversight for the Eye of the **Ancient of Days** over them. And when they ascend, they are like windows... the eyes are opened and become an "Open Eye," and they do not reach the single whiteness of the eye, which is like the power of the spirit in milk. Why "like milk"? In the upper unity of the beginning. At that moment, the oversight of mercy is found. When the prayer of Israel ascends, it is so that He may open His eyes and they may be found in that whiteness. As it is written: 
> "Awake, why do You sleep, O Lord? Arise!" <note>Psalms 44:24</note>
Whenever His eyes are not open, all the masters of judgment suppress Israel, and the nations rule over them. The intention is that He should open His eyes, and they should be found in good deeds and mercy toward Israel, and to close <margin>Another version: and to bind</margin> the eye and take vengeance on the other nations. This is what is written: "Awake and Arise"—"Awake" to be found in that whiteness, "Arise" to execute vengeance on those who suppress them. When the eyes are opened to be seen, they are beautiful in these colors: white, red, black, and green. And this deed <margin>Another version: white</margin> is not revealed so as not to show that it is found in good deeds. And all these colors are covered <margin>Another version: and opened</margin> in that whiteness. From these colors that are revealed, seven eyes go out to oversee, which emerge from the Wisdom.

## Main Text (Zohar)

The eye opens with joy beneath the eyebrows. From the wisdom of the eye <note>The "Wisdom" (Chokhmah) here refers to the inner light or pupil of the eye</note>, from the **redness**, seven runners go forth, subduing the left side. They flame within the five that are on the north side, and they join together to spread through the world to reveal the sins of the lowly. This is what is written: <note>Zechariah 4:10</note>
> These seven are the eyes of the Lord, which range through the whole earth.

From the **greenness**, seven brilliant ones <note>original: *tahirin*, variant: *nahirin* (luminous ones)</note> go forth, which crown the south side and join together to spread through the world to reveal the deeds <note>variant: "dwellers"</note> of men, as it is written: <note>Job 34:21</note>
> For His eyes are upon the ways of a man, etc.

And when they are opened in the **whiteness**, they look to oversee all the masters of truth, to bring good to the world for their sake. All this oversight is for the good of Israel, to look into the depths of the brains of the Ancient Ones <note>referring to the highest level of Divinity, Arich Anpin</note>, for in Him all is mercy, to give life and to be gracious and to do good for them. For when they seek Him, He is found by them. And because of this, it is written: <note>Psalms 44:24</note>
> Awake, why do You sleep, O Lord? Arise, do not cast us off forever.

We have called them two oversights, two openings, two eyes of mercy and redness. The first **color** is red, like a red that includes and completes all other reds. Before it, all other reds are hidden, so that they are not seen around that red of the one side, which is a vapor of wisdom that carves it out.

The second **color** is a blackness <note>original: *uchmana*, often referring to the dark pupil</note>, like a single blackness that goes out from a single abyss, and it provides for and changes many times like a soft powder. And when this power goes out, it stirs up anger and strength upon the sea, and the voice of the sea and its waves are seen, and it does not cease until it provides the soft nourishment that sustains the olives. This power goes out from the abyss and rolls in the strength of the sea and goes outside. It is the wisdom of all wisdoms that are hidden before it. And such is the wisdom of the eye: a wisdom that includes and completes all other wisdoms. Around that wisdom of the one side is a red vapor <note>variant: "to one side"</note> that carves out that wisdom.

The third **color** is a greenness of greens that includes and covers all greens. Around that greenness are hidden two threads: a red thread on one side and a black thread on the other side, and they surround that greenness. And whenever the radiance is hidden and the eye is closed, all those colors are covered and fixed below—the red, the green, and the black. Nothing is seen except for that **whiteness** which is in the Ancient of Days <note>term: *Atik Yomin*, the most hidden aspect of God</note>. And when it reaches all those below, the colors are cheapened <note>meaning they lose their harshness or intensity</note> so that nothing is seen except for that whiteness alone. Because of this, all the portions of the red and the black are cast down to those abysses of the congregation, as it is written: <note>Psalms 42:8</note>
> Deep calls unto deep...

Look at the abysses! What is meant by "from its side"? It is from that closing of the Holy Supreme Eye. Look at the abysses, one within the other. And what was said by the many, that one is like the other in smallness, and this was said regarding the abysses—meaning the whiteness above them is like that whiteness of the eye when it is closed, like the whiteness of the Supreme Eye. And in the future, the righteous are destined to know this, to see with the spirit of wisdom, as it is said: <note>Isaiah 52:8</note>
> For eye to eye they shall see, when the Lord returns to Zion.

And it is written "eye to eye" <note>note: the Hebrew text here plays on the singular and plural forms of 'eye'</note> to show that the Lord is below. And then the opening of the eyes is for good, and the opening of the eyes is for evil. For good, as it is written: <note>Daniel 9:18</note>
> Open Your eyes and see our desolations, etc.

Everything is for good and for evil, as it is written: <note>Isaiah 33:20</note>
> Your eyes shall see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of its stakes shall ever be removed.

Everything is for good and for evil, so that this is not done like that. Come and see in the spring of the book: What is "Your eyes shall see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation"? Is Jerusalem a quiet habitation? For it is written: <note>Isaiah 1:21</note>
> Righteousness lodged in her.

And after this, righteousness was made <note>variant: "and the crown in its place like a spirit, and it stands to be corrected as righteousness"</note>... but "Your eyes shall see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation"—"quiet habitation" is said regarding the Ancient of Days, for at that time all the eyes are opened and ascend, the Eye of Mercy, the eye that has no shadow from one oversight to another. And because of this, it is written "Your eyes shall see" (plural) and not "Your eye" (singular). And as for why it says "Jerusalem" and not "Zion," it is necessary to subdue the place...

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly) from the Zohar, specifically focusing on the anatomical symbolism of the Divine Countenance (Zeir Anpin) and how its attributes of Judgment are tempered by the Infinite Mercy of the Ancient One.</meta>

## Naso

For judgment is found in her <note>referring to the feminine aspect or the lower world</note> and dwells upon her. Furthermore, it is written: *The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous* <note>Psalm 34:15</note>, referring to the "Small Mercies," and *from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year* <note>Deuteronomy 11:12</note>. This is what is written: *Righteousness lodged in her* <note>Isaiah 1:21</note>, and in her are found the fires of judgment more than in any other place.
And there is found to be looked upon by the Single Eye of Mercy, the Eye of the Ancient of Ancients <term>Atika Kadisha; the highest, most hidden level of the Divine</term>. This is what is written: *And with great mercies will I gather thee* <note>Isaiah 54:7</note>. Because there is no mercy—what is meant by "Great"? Rather, there is mercy and then there is Mercy. The mercies of the Ancient of Ancients are called **Great Mercies**, while the mercies of the Small Face <term>Zeir Anpin; the emotive attributes of God</term> are called simply **Mercies**, because in him there is refinement <note>a mixture of judgment and mercy</note> and the Name is not [always] revealed. Therefore, "with Great Mercies will I gather thee" refers to the Ancient of Days.
It was taught: In these eyes, there are two colors, red and white. Two tears labor there, and when the Holy One, Blessed be He, desires to have mercy on Israel, He sends down two tears to be found in the Great Sea. What is the Great Sea? The Sea of Higher Wisdom <term>Chokhmah</term>. That is to say, they are washed in the river <margin>as a stream</margin> in the spring that goes out from the Great Wisdom, and He has mercy on Israel.
Come and see in the collection of the Book: The **Nose** of the Small Face. By the nose, the countenance is recognized. In this nose, the matter is completed, as it is written: *Smoke went up in His nostrils, etc.* <note>Psalm 18:9</note>. Smoke went up in His nostrils, and in this smoke our sins are consumed. And what is the memory? For there is no smoke without sin, and no sin without smoke. And they all ascend <margin>ascend</margin> and go out from the nostrils.
And come and see: three things hang and are included in this smoke that goes out from the nose. The nose is established, and it is written that smoke goes out, wisdom and redness, and in it are two colors, and they call it "Anger" and "Wrath." From its side come Anger and Wrath, as it is written: *For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure* <note>Deuteronomy 9:19</note>. For we see the smoke, wisdom, and redness. The guilt of the land <note>outside the Land of Israel</note> as it is written: *Before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah* <note>Genesis 13:10</note>. And this is the target by the merit of the burning fire.
And come and see: there are five Strengths <term>Gevurot; powers of judgment</term> in this Small Face, and they ascend to one thousand and four hundred Strengths that spread out in the nostrils of the mouth, like arms in hands and in fingers. And because of this, it is written: *Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord?* <note>Psalm 106:2</note> and it is written: *Thine, O Lord, is the greatness and the power* <note>1 Chronicles 29:11</note>. Even so, it licks up when all the Strengths are joined as one; they are called one **Strength** <term>Gevurah</term>. And all these Strengths labor to descend from His nostrils, and from this hang thousands of thousands and fourteen hundred myriads in each one of them. And all the smoke that goes out from His nostrils, there hang thousands of thousands of myriads and four hundred from the side of this Strength. And all these Strengths hang from the nose, as it is written: *One generation shall praise Thy works to another, and shall declare Thy mighty acts* <note>Psalm 145:4</note>.
And when this Strength rests, all the Strengths are ignited, and we merit until they descend to *the flaming sword which turned every way* <note>Genesis 3:24</note>. It is written: *If the foundations be destroyed* <note>Psalm 11:3</note>... and it is written: *Before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah*, and it is written: *And the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah* <note>Genesis 19:24</note>. Rather, come and see: this is the Judge of the wicked, etc. But they are turned from judgment and will be overturned, etc. It is written: *To the Lord our God belongs the knife* <note>likely a reference to the sword of judgment</note>.
However, at all times when the Ancient of Ancients, the Head, is illuminated, the **Will of Wills** <term>Ratzon; the highest Divine Favor</term> is revealed, and mercies that encompass all are found in everything. And the feast that is not revealed at all times <margin>time</margin> when the Small Face is ready, and the mercy covers that ancient judgment of all. For it was taught: when the Ancient of Ancients is revealed, the Will of Wills, all the lamps that are called by this name are shining, and mercy is found in all of them. But in the hour when the Hidden of Hidden is not revealed and these lamps do not shine, judgments are awakened and a spirit is made. Who causes this judgment? The Will of Wills when it is not revealed. And because of this, they turn and lower mercies into judgment. And that which was said, "Behold the word of the Lord from the heavens," was said regarding the "Hairy Face" <note>a term for Zeir Anpin</note>. And it implies what is written "from the heavens," even the song of mercy, then to bring out one who has no judgment in him at all. Come and see these small nostrils, and all the masters of prayer to go out...

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly) from Parashat Naso. It focuses on the mystical anatomy of the Divine, specifically the "Nose" (Hotma) and the "Ears" (Odna), explaining how divine mercy and judgment are channeled through these features. It also addresses the liturgical mystery of the "Paseq" (separating) accent mark in the Torah.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

To bring forth and to emit <note>original: "כפיק"</note>... and the male passes through and is glad. This prevents that Nose from emitting smoke. The Nose of the **Holy Ancient One** <note>Arich Anpin, the most hidden aspect of the Divine</note> is called "Long-Suffering" <note>original: "Erech Appayim," literally "Long of Nose/Anger"</note> in every respect. And we have learned the secret of the name **Lord, Lord** <note>YHVH YHVH</note>: there is a separating accent <note>the *Paseq* mark</note> between them. In every place where there is "Male and Female" <note>a pairing of names</note>, a separating accent is placed between them.

For example: **Abraham, Abraham**; **Jacob, Jacob**; **Samuel, Samuel**. In all of these, a separating accent is placed between them. Why is there a separating accent between them? Regarding **Abraham, Abraham**, we have learned: the first was not complete, but the second was complete. For it is taught: he became complete as a servant before Him, and because of this, a separating accent is placed between them, for now [at the second calling] he was not as he was at first.

Regarding **Jacob, Jacob**: the latter was complete, but the former was not complete. For now he was brought the news of Joseph, and the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note> rested upon him. Furthermore, now he was revealed on the earth, walking in holiness within the twelve boundaries and seventy branches, which was not the case at first. Therefore, the latter was complete and the former was not, and a separating accent is placed between them.

Regarding **Samuel, Samuel**: a separating accent is placed between them. Why? The latter was complete and the former was not, for now he was a prophet, and before this he was not a prophet.

But regarding **Moses, Moses**, no separating accent is placed between them. For from the day he was born, he was complete, as it is written:
> *And she saw him, that he was good.* <note>Exodus 2:2</note>

And also here, regarding **Lord, Lord**, a separating accent is placed between them. The first is complete and the second is complete, and they are from the side of the Male aspect, descending from the **Holy Ancient One** to the **Small Face** <note>Zeir Anpin, the emotive attributes of God</note> in mercy. Thus we have learned: how much power comes from the lower side to direct mercy below.

And when the **Ancient One** is revealed in the "Length of the Nose" <note>the attribute of patience</note>, everything is rectified in mercy. The Nose is drawn back and the heat <note>anger</note> is gathered in; it does not emerge at all. The rectification for the heat is that it is gathered into the two nostrils of the Nose. From one nostril, smoke emerges in a flame and is fixed in the "Great Abyss." From the other nostril, fire emerges that burns in its words and flames out into the four worlds. On the left side, it prepares for war. In this, it is called "The Lord is Zealous." The heat of the Lord burns and destroys all fear.

The heat is only sweetened by the heat of the Altar. And the smoke that emerges from the other nostril is only sweetened by the smoke of the sacrifice on the Altar. All of these depend on the Nose. Therefore it is written:
> *And the Lord smelled the sweet savor.* <note>Genesis 8:21</note>

For all things depend on the Nose. (The Nose stands to be seen in the gathering of heat and its rectification, etc.) Therefore, it is accepted with favor. And this is what is written:
> *And the anger of the Lord was kindled.* <note>Numbers 11:10</note>
*And the anger of the Lord will be kindled... and My anger will be kindled... His iniquities... the anger of the Lord...* All of these are said regarding the "Length of the Nose."

Regarding the smoke, it is written: *Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear.* This is the Ear that is subservient, with hairs hanging over it. It is a hollow for hearing, and the hollow is made like winding paths within, just as a lion makes <note>original: "ככארי"</note> a path in a curve here and there. Why in a curve? In order to hear good and evil.

And from this curve, many hollows hang, all of them carved out, as it is written:
> *For a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.* <note>Ecclesiastes 10:20</note>

Inside the hollow, a drop from the cavities of the brain drips into this hollow of the ears. From that drop, the voice enters that curve and is swept up in that drop, whether it be good or evil. Good, as it is written: *For my mouth shall speak truth.* Evil, as it is written:
> *And the Lord heard, and His anger was kindled, and the fire of the Lord burnt.* <note>Psalms 78:21</note>

And this hollow is fixed for the male, and the curve enters into this nostril where the drop from the brain is, in order to gather the voice inside so it does not go out. It takes it into the "Length of the Nose" from all sides. The voice is the secret of the *Vav* <note>the letter representing Zeir Anpin</note>, the voice that reveals the secrets of words, revealing secrets with power. This is the rectification from above to below, to gather secrets so they do not go out.

And it is taught: at the time when there is distress in the world and the hairs are revealed over the hollows, the voice enters the hollows into that nostril that drips from the brain, and it is gathered in the brain and emerges through the nostrils of the Nose. Then the Nose is awakened and heated, and heat and smoke emerge...

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly) from the Zohar. It focuses on the "Ears" of the Divine countenance, specifically how prayer and sound ascend from the lower realm (Ze’ir Anpin) to the Ancient of Days (Atika Kadisha), and the interplay between Judgment and Mercy.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

All the "Mighty Deeds" <note>Gevurot - the attributes of severity/judgment</note> and the execution of vengeance arise from these. When sins provoke anger, the smoke of that indignation rises and strikes the "Head of the Brain." Then, two tears well up and emerge from the light and the moon-like radiance, flowing out through that channel of the eye. They are found and delayed (**Note:** *some versions say "and prepared"*) until all voices are heard and seen. Because of this, it is written:
> **And the Lord heard it, and His anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them** <note>Numbers 11:1</note> 
This refers to that "hearing" of the voice that was awakened above. We have learned that it is written:
> **Incline Thine ear, O my God, and hear; open Thine eyes, O Lord, and see** <note>Daniel 9:18</note> 
(**Note:** *Teaching*) Kindness <note>Chesed</note> is brought forth, for all the various "hairs" <note>mystical emanations</note> that hang from the ears are called the "Ears of the Lord," as it is said, <term>Incline, O Lord, and hear</term>. These ears hang from the hollow of the brain and guard the gates that emerge from that hollow. There is one gate that provides and suffices, opening into the hole of the ear, as it is written:
> **For the ear trieth words** <note>Job 34:3</note> 
And it is written concerning merit and the kidneys. From the expansion of that hollow, gates are hidden which expand into the body until the heart divides that hollow into right and left. One side is called "Examination" and the other is called "Examination," for from there they expand. Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note> flies from the brain to the ear to distinguish between good and evil. Thus, in the "Kindling of the Face" <note>the expression of Divine anger or favor</note>, there is a side of good and evil, right and left, Mercy <note>Rachamim</note> and Judgment <note>Din</note>. This ear is included in the brain, and because it is included in the brain in one hollow, it is included in the Supernal Voice. This is called <term>Hearing</term>, and within Hearing, Understanding <note>Binah</note> is included: 
> **Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one** <note>Deuteronomy 6:4</note> 
(**Note:** *And to be included*) For everything is established in one balance. These words are for those who hear their brothers, to listen, to contemplate, and to know. Regarding this, it is written:
> **O Lord, I have heard the report of Thee, and I am afraid...** <note>Habakkuk 3:2</note> 
This verse makes it known that the Holy Ancient One <note>Atika Kadisha</note> hears, looks, and knows. Praise is given for these "Repairs" <note>Tikkunim - the mystical structures of the Divine face</note>. "And I am afraid"—fear is what breaks that "Kindling of the Face" <note>Anger</note> before Him, for He looks and knows. What is written next?
> **O Lord, revive Thy work in the midst of the years** <note>Habakkuk 3:2</note> 
This is said regarding the <term>Ancient of Days</term>. Wherever the name "Lord Lord" <note>YHVH YHVH</note> is found together, it refers to two levels: one for <term>Ze’ir Anpin</term> <note>The Lesser Countenance/The Son</note> and one for the <term>Ancient of Ancients</term> <note>The Father/Source</note>. Even though they are all one, the brain investigates them. When is it called a "Full Name"? At the time it is written "Lord God" <note>YHVH Elohim</note>, for this is the Full Name of the Ancient One, which includes all of Ze’ir Anpin. Otherwise, it is not called a Full Name, as we have established. "And the Lord knew"—the Full Name is established in the writing of the forehead. Everywhere "Lord God" is established as a Full Name, "Lord Lord" is the totality of everything, and at that time, the awakening of Mercy is in everything. "O Lord, revive Thy work in the midst of the years" is said to the Ancient of Days. "Thy work" refers to Ze’ir Anpin. "In the midst of the years" refers to the ancient years of the past, not the "years of the world" <note>mundane time</note>, but the primordial years. "Revive them" literally—give them life. Revive Ze’ir Anpin, for all his light and life come from the sum of those primordial days. Therefore it says:
> **In wrath remember mercy** <note>Habakkuk 3:2</note> 
This refers to that <term>Supernal Kindness</term> <note>Chesed Ila'ah</note> which awakens mercy for all—for those who need mercy and those who are judged for mercy. It was taught: Rabbi Shimon said, "All this depends on me, for all those who stand above. From here, these words go into all worlds and they all rejoice." What did they do? They spread a curtain over us, hiding us as they ascend. The Ancient of All hides them, He who is hidden and concealed from all. When the curtain is removed for us, the companions know that all these words are awakened here. This is your portion, companions who are here, and my portion is with you in this world and the world to come. Rabbi Shimon opened and said:
> **But ye that did cleave unto the Lord your God are alive every one of you this day** <note>Deuteronomy 4:4</note> 
What is this Holy Name? As it is written, "He forgives your sins." Who is like You? Because of the restoration of their study, it is a holy medicine in this world and the world to come, and even more so here.
