<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly), focusing on the mystical anatomy of the Divine. Having previously discussed the "Ancient of Ancients" (Keter), the text now transitions to the "Small Face" (Zeir Anpin), specifically detailing the nine arrangements of its Beard.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

For there <note>in the higher realm of the Ancient One</note> they are not distinguished, because that light of the sparks of the Beard descends here and the foundation <note>original: *sadanka*</note> is hidden within it. It is written that it is refined, but not at the time it descends. When it descends from the precious, supernal, holy Beard—hidden and concealed from all—like the **oil of holy will** <note>original: *mishcha de-re’uta*</note> to the Beard of the **Small Face** <note>original: *Zeir Anpin*; the manifest aspect of God</note>, do not say the Beard is not found. Neither Solomon nor the sages mentioned or called it "the Beard," yet it is found in the prophecy of the Book. Everything that is hidden and stored away is not mentioned or revealed; that matter is higher and more precious than all, because it is secret and concealed. And the Beard reaches a state that is the praise, perfection, and preciousness of the entire hidden Countenance, yet it is not to be revealed. The Beard is the perfection of the Countenance and its brightness; in the hair of the face, it is established in **nine arrangements** <note>original: *tikunim*</note>. And at the time when the precious Beard of the **Ancient of Ancients** <note>the highest, most merciful level of Divinity</note> shines upon this Beard of the Small Face, they flow like springs of supernal oil. In that higher Beard, twenty-two arrangements are found, from which the twenty-two letters of the Holy Torah are crowned. This Beard is found emerging from its corners, descending and ascending, covering the "offering of spices." What is this "offering of spices"? As it is said: <note>Song of Solomon 5:13</note> **"As a bed of spices"**—not "beds." In nine arrangements is this Beard of the Small Face established. The hairs of the Beard are black, arranged in a beautiful formation like a handsome man, as it is written: <note>Song of Solomon 5:15</note> **"Choice as the cedars."**

**The First Arrangement:** The hair is arranged from above, and that fragrance emerges like a resting place for the ear. It comes out from the collective of the ear and descends beneath the hair of the head, from under the locks that are over the corners [of the face], descending before the opening of the ears, layer upon layer, until the beginning of the mouth.

**The Second Arrangement:** The hair emerges and rises from the beginning of the mouth to the other end of the opening of the mouth, and descends beneath the mouth to the other end, layer upon layer in a beautiful arrangement.

**The Third Arrangement:** The "faithfulness" <note>the area of the philtrum</note> that is beneath the nose. From beneath the two nostrils emerges a single path of strong hairs; they fill that path, but hair is missing from the center of it. It stands on this side at the corners of that path, and the path is not visible at all below, but rather that path is above, descending onto the top of the lips, and there that path is submerged.

**The Fourth Arrangement:** The hair emerges and is established, rising and covering the cheeks of the "offering of spices" of the Ancient One.

**The Fifth Arrangement:** The hair is parted, and **two apples** <note>original: *tapuchin*; referring to the cheeks</note> are seen, appearing red like a red rose. They flash and shine, and seventy worlds are illuminated from there.

**The Sixth Arrangement:** The hair emerges like a single thread in the "cleansing" of the Beard, hanging down to the beginning of the intestines <note>the upper abdomen</note>, but it does not descend as far as the navel.

**The Seventh Arrangement:** The hairs do not hang over the mouth; the mouth is cleared on all its sides, and the hairs sit in an arrangement all around it.

**The Eighth Arrangement:** The hairs descend to the bottom of the Beard, covering the neck so it is not seen. All the hairs are fine, layer upon layer, filling all sides.

**The Ninth Arrangement:** The hairs are mingled with those that join together; all the hairs are in a perfect balance, over those hairs that hang down. All are in a beautiful balance, like a mighty man, a master of battles. Through these nine arrangements, nine springs of the **oil of greatness** <note>anointing oil</note> flow and emerge. And from that oil of greatness from above, they flow to all those below. These nine arrangements are found in this Beard, and the perfection of the arrangement of the Beard is only called so when the strength is recognized below. For whoever sees the Beard, it stands in its permanence, and mighty power <note>Gevurah</note> hangs upon it. Thus far the arrangement of the Supernal Beard of the Small Face. Rabbi Shimon said: "Fortunate is my lot! The Holy One, blessed be He, calls this holy." These are the arrangements of the Beard in these its formations.

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly) from the Zohar, specifically focusing on the "Rectifications of the Beard" of the Divine Persona known as Zeir Anpin (the "Small Face").</meta>

## Naso

->**Naso**<-

Rabbi Eleazar stood, opened his discourse, and said: *“Out of the distress I called upon the Lord <note>original: Yah</note>; the Lord answered me with liberation... better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.”* <note>Psalm 118:5-9</note> We have learned here that there are nine rectifications of the beard. These are the rectifications that King David required in order to subdue the morning kings <note>referring to the harsh forces of judgment or opposing nations</note> and the other nations. Come and see: after he mentioned all the surrounding nations in the phrase *“In the name of the Lord I will cut them off,”* he then mentioned the rectifications he needed because of those surrounding nations. In this arrangement, there are nine rectifications which are the Name of the Lord <note>original: YHVH</note> to protect us from the world, as he said, *“In the name of the Lord I will cut them off.”*

And it was taught in the *Belovedness of the Book* <note>a reference to a specific section of the Idra</note> that there are nine rectifications. Later, David mentioned the Holy Name six times and three times "God" <note>original: Elohim</note>. And if you say there are only two, there were actually three included in the blessing of "God." We learned that there are six Names written: 1. *“Out of the distress I called upon the Lord <note>Yah</note>.”* 2. *“The Lord <note>Yah</note> answered me with liberation.”* 3. *“The Lord <note>YHVH</note> is with me, I shall not fear.”* 4. *“The Lord <note>YHVH</note> is with me as my helper.”* 5. *“It is better to take refuge in the Lord <note>YHVH</note>.”* 6. *“It is better to take refuge in the Lord <note>YHVH</note>.”* These are the three where it is written *“The Lord is with me, I shall not fear”* and so on. One is "God." Two: *“It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in man.”* Three: *“It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.”*

And come and see: in every place where "Man" <note>term: Adam - the primordial human form</note> is mentioned, it is to mention Man in the Holy Name so that he may be seen. For there was no "Man" until he was seen through the Holy Name. As it is written in the first Psalm, *“To God, the voice in the Name,”* a matter that was *“Lord God”* so that he might be seen. Because of this, "Man" is not mentioned here except through the Holy Name. And we learned it is written: *“Out of the distress I called upon the Lord <note>Yah</note>,”* and *“The Lord <note>Yah</note> answered me with liberation”*—these are two. From them, the Name *Yah* is for the voice, two over the hairs that rise up and push away the hairs that hang down. <note>This describes the mystical anatomy of the Divine Beard, where hairs represent flows of energy.</note>

*“The Lord is with me, I shall not fear,”* and *“The Lord is with me as my helper”*—this is the Name that is not lacking, the Name of the Holy Voice, through which Man is mentioned. And as for what he said, *“What can man do to me?”*—it is because all those holy crowns of the King are suspended when he is arranged in the rectification to be called "Man," the image <note>term: Diukna - the divine configuration</note> that includes everything. And that which ascends within them is called the Holy Name and is sweetened. (Variant: *And that which is damaged is sweetened by the rectification of the Holy Name... and he is called "Jew" after he rectifies "Man" in everything.*)

And these are the nine rectifications that David spoke of, because whoever grasps the Image of the King can do whatever he desires. Why? Because the image is not the body, but the body follows the image, and the image does not follow the body. And it stands in two ways. One, as we said. Two: 1. *“Out of the distress I called upon the Lord <note>Yah</note>.”* 2. *“The Lord <note>Yah</note> answered me with liberation.”* 3. *“The Lord is with me, I shall not fear.”* 4. *“What can man do to me?”* 5. *“The Lord is with me as my helper.”* 6. *“I will see the fall of my foes.”* 7. *“It is better to take refuge in the Lord.”* 8. *“Than to trust in man.”* 9. *“It is better to take refuge in the Lord.”* 10. *“Than to trust in princes.”* (Variant: *7. It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in man. 8. It is better to take refuge in the Lord. 10. Than to trust in princes.*)

What is meant by *“Out of the distress I called upon the Lord”*? Rather, everything David said here was about the rectification of the Image. Rabbi Judah said: *“Out of the distress I called upon the Lord”* refers to the hairs of the Image that spread out as a beard from the Kindness <note>Chesed</note> that is far from the ears. Because of this, he said *Yah, Yah* twice. And after the beard spreads and descends from its borders to expand (Variant: *he said "The Lord is with me, I shall not fear" after the beard was thin and all those things that were needed etc.*), he is called "Man." And regarding this expansion, David needed to subdue kings and nations under him for the glory of this Image.

And we learned in the *Belovedness of the Book*: anyone who sees in his dream that he is holding the beard of a superior man in his hand, it is a sign that his hand is at peace with his Lord, and his enemies are subdued under him. We learned: the Supernal Image is arranged in nine rectifications, and that is the image of *Zeir Anpin* <note>term: Zeir Anpin - the "Small Face" or Lesser Countenance of the Divine</note>.

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Naso**<-

The first [arrangement] is prepared: hair emerges from before the opening of the ears, beneath the locks that hang over the ears. And the hairs descend, strand upon strand, until the beginning of the mouth. Behold, all these strands of the beard are stronger than all the strands of the locks of the head. The hairs of the head are long and curved, but these are not so; rather, the hairs of the head are plucked from here and there <note>meaning they are scattered or distinct</note>. And now, when the white hair of the Ancient of Days is found, and the hair of the Lesser Countenance <note>original: *Zeir Anpin*, the emotive/manifest aspect of the Divine</note>, it is written: *Wisdom has built her house* <note>Proverbs 9:1</note>. What is the meaning of this? It refers to the hair-coverings that are called the "two brains." Two brains? No, rather there are four brains. Three brains are found in the Lesser Countenance, located in the three hollows of the skull of the head, and one brain remains quiet in its place, which includes all three brains. From it, a dangerous path is found <note>referring to the flow of influence</note>, included and weighed in the white hair. So that the Lesser Countenance may have three brains, there are found four brains in this Lesser Countenance. Because of this, the four sections written in the *Tefillin* <term>Phylacteries: ritual leather boxes containing Torah scrolls worn during prayer</term> are completed, in which the Holy Name of the Ancient of Days—the Ancient of Ancients—is perfected. And the hair-coverings are the perfection of the Holy Name, as it is written:
> And all the peoples of the earth shall see that the name of the Lord is called upon you, and they shall be afraid of you. <note>Deuteronomy 28:10</note>
This refers to the "Name of the Lord" literally, which are the four compartments of the *Tefillin*. And because of this, "Wisdom has built her house" is found in the verse. For the Ancient of Ancients, the Concealed of all Concealed, is not found and His Wisdom is not prepared—His actual Wisdom, which is the Wisdom concealed from all and not distinguished. And because four brains are found for this Lesser Countenance, four locks of hair are found emerging from it to the four sides, spreading out from one lock that emerges from them all. And in three, they are four. And behold, this Wisdom which is perfected in four is found in these hairs, which hang in heaps upon heaps, and all are dark and strong, and they extend and flow, each to its side. They pass through and are long, and from them hang [curls] that are not dangerous. This is the meaning of:
> His locks are wavy <note>Song of Songs 5:11; original: *taltalim*, meaning heaps or curls</note>
They hang in heaps, and all are hard and strong to awaken with Mercy where there is no [other] rectification. They are like a hard rock that makes holes and channels beneath the hair. And because they are strong in every direction, there is a hair for every path. And because these hairs are black and tangled, it is written:
> He reveals deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death. <note>Job 12:22</note>
And behold, the hairs of the beard are strong on their own, surrounding the hairs of the head, because their perfection is spread out and found, and they are strong in their way. Why are they strong? Because they are all Judgment. For in these arrangements, Mercy and Judgment are found. And when the light of the locks descends, these are all Mercy. Come and see: all these hairs of the beard are all strong, for all those of Mercy must be strong to subdue the Judgment. And all those of Judgment—behold, they are all strong. Thus, they must be strong from both sides. When the world requires Mercy, the Mercy is strong and prevails over Judgment. And when it requires Judgment, the Judgment is strong and prevails over Mercy. Therefore, they must be strong from both sides. When Mercy is required, the hairs of Mercy stand and the beard is seen <margin>it is looked upon</margin> in these hairs, and all becomes Mercy. And when Judgment is required to be seen, the beard is seen in these hairs to establish Judgment. But when the Holy White Beard <note>of the Ancient of Days</note> is revealed, all of these and all of those are illuminated and rectified, like one who descends into a deep valley [to find water] from what is within it, and they are all established in Mercy, and no Judgment is found. And they all awaken; when they shine as one, they are all hidden in Mercy. Therefore, the verse stops and says: "The Lord your God... and abundant in Kindness," but it does not say "and Truth" <note>referring to the attributes in Exodus 34:6</note>, because the spirit of the word is awakened from the lights that shine from the Ancient of Days to the Lesser Countenance. And when he said "Kindness," the arrangements of the beard found in the Lesser Countenance are quieted, which descend from the Ancient of Days and shine within it.

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly) from the Zohar, specifically within the portion of Naso. It focuses on the anthropomorphic symbolism of the Divine, explaining how the human form reflects the celestial structure of the Sephirot.</meta>

# Naso

-> **Naso** <-

They were established in their colors according to this image; the image testifies to them. It was according to this image when the crowns and diadems were joined, and the perfection of all was achieved. For this reason, the image of Adam <note>The Primordial Man or the human archetype</note> is the image of the upper and lower worlds, which are included within him. Because this image includes both the upper and lower realms, the **Holy Ancient One** <note>Atika Kadisha, the highest, most hidden aspect of the Divine</note> established the arrangements, and the arrangement of the **Small Countenance** <note>Zeir Anpin, the emotive attributes of God</note> was formed according to this image and arrangement.

Do not say: "What is the difference between this one and that one?" For all is as a balance <note>metkla; a state of equilibrium</note>, yet from them, the paths are distinguished, and from here, Judgment is finalized. From the side of these, they were separated one from the other. These secrets were not handed over except to the "Reapers of the Holy Field" <note>A term for the circle of mystics initiated into these secrets</note>. As it is written:

> **The secret of the Lord is for those who fear Him** <note>Psalm 25:14</note>

And it is written:

> **And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, etc.** <note>Genesis 2:7</note>

(What is the arrangement in the third arrangement?) The dripping of the drop (and this is "And He formed" <note>Hebrew: *Vayitzer*</note> written with two *Yods*). Why? It is the secret of the **Holy Ancient One** and the secret of the **Small Countenance**. What is "And He formed"? It is a lamp <note>Hebrew: *Ner*</note>. A lamp is fire within fire, and this is "And He formed." And who is fire within fire? The two Names that are called "The Lord God" <note>YHVH Elohim</note>, and this is the secret of the two *Yods* in "And He formed," which is a lamp, fire within fire. The arrangement of the complete Name is "The Lord God." Just as they were included in the image (what is in the image?), this upper one is called "Adam," which includes the upper Male and Female. Regarding this, it is written "the Adam," to include the Male and Female. The word *Et* <note>A Hebrew grammatical particle</note> is to include and count the merit that comes from the Male and Female. "Dust from the ground"—dust is an image within an image (what is the dripping of the drop within?).

And why all this? So that the "Hidden of all Hidden" might ascend and enter into him, reaching the end of all hidden things. This is what is written:

> **And He breathed into his nostrils the breath of life** <note>Genesis 2:7</note>

The soul <note>Neshamah</note> of all life, above and below, depends on Him and on that soul, and they are sustained by it. "And man became a living soul" to be strengthened (what, to be emptied?) and to enter into the arrangements in his colors, to ascend and become like a chain from level to level until the end of all levels. For that soul is found in everything and spreads through everything, and its power goes out into the limbs. Whoever cuts off life from the world, it is as if he cut off this soul and shows that he belongs to another chain besides this one. Therefore, he and his memory shall be lost for generations upon generations.

Like this light, He ordered and established all of them, Male and Female. When the image was established in its arrangements, the latter ones surrounded (what, from behind?) between the two arms. The **Crown** <note>Keter</note> where the hair of the image hangs is called **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note>. This Beauty spread out and established two arms, and it ascended behind and made the skull of the Female. It is all hidden from all sides like hair on the face of the head. In all that is holy, they were made like this Beauty, Kindness <note>Chesed</note>, Male and Female. This is what is written regarding Beauty: "According to the beauty of a man, to dwell in a house" <note>Isaiah 44:13</note>. Thus the face of the head of the Female was arranged; one lock of hair hangs from behind the **Small Countenance** and hangs over the head of the Female. The hairs on the head are all red, including all colors. This is what is written:

> **And the hair of your head is like purple** <note>Song of Songs 7:6</note>

What is "purple" <note>Argaman</note>? Colors that are included within it. Thirdly, this Beauty spread out from the transition of all, pierced through, and passed to the other side. It established the face of the Female until the **Navel** <note>Tabbura</note>. From the navel, they surrounded, and at the navel, it was completed. Furthermore, this Beauty spread out and the intestines of the Male were established; it entered and established in this place all mercies and all sides of mercy. These intestines were marked to establish the death of the King <note>A reference to the "Kings of Edom" or shattered vessels</note>, changing the circuit of mercies and establishing them in the movement of their trembling, as it is written:

> **Therefore my heart [intestines] yearns for him; I will surely have compassion on him, says the Lord** <note>Jeremiah 31:20</note>

Thirdly, this Beauty includes mercy and includes judgment. Mercy spread into the Male, passed through, and pierced (another version: and prepared) to the other side, establishing the intestines of the Female on the side of Judgment, and her intestines were established. Thirdly, the Male was established on the side of his measures, supports, and rulers—arrangements included in him from here and there, and from them, mercies, and from the Male, all are for the place...

It uses the biblical creation of man as a blueprint for understanding the flow of divine soul and mercy through the celestial structures.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly) from Parashat Naso. It follows the discussion of the primordial "Kings of Edom" who reigned and died before there was balance, symbolizing unbalanced forces of Judgment (Gevurah) before the emergence of Mercy (Chesed).</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

When the Male principle begins to be hollowed out <note>referring to the preparation for union</note>, then the whiteness of the Female begins to spread there, to be carved out and spread across her sides. And fifty "nakednesses" <note>uncovered judgments or vulnerabilities</note> are revealed on the side of the Judgments. Five types of the letter *He* <term>He (ה): the letter associated with the feminine emanation, Binah</term> spread through the matter. And forty-eight [aspects] are seen: a voice in the heat of nakedness, hair in the heat of nakedness, a thigh in the heat of nakedness, a hand in the heat of nakedness, a foot in the heat of nakedness. And these two accompany every female structure, and two eyes are more than the nakedness.

And we learned in the Assembly of the Book: when the Male spreads out and is established in his arrangements, he is established with the arrangement of a garment that measures. And a voice was there, for he measured his ways, and through them they spoke. And forty-eight worlds and all of them hang upon the "Mouth of Wisdom" <term>Chokhmah: the second Sefirah, representing the flash of intuition</term> to be called *Yod* <note>The first letter of the Divine Name YHVH</note>. And once the letters *Yod-He* are revealed, the Mouth of Wisdom reveals Kindness <term>Chesed: the Sefirah of expansive love and mercy</term>. And Wisdom rises to be called Kindness. And we learned: why is it not called Kindness until *Yod-He* are revealed? Because that is the mold of Wisdom.

And come and see: it is not called a "companion" and Kindness does not ascend within it until the *Yod-He* of Wisdom is revealed. And once it is revealed, it is called [Kindness] and it rises before "He who walks before Me," and he shall be "perfect"—truly perfect. As it is written <note>Genesis 17:1</note>: *And be perfect to Him*, and I was kept from my iniquity. The words of the beginning and the end... all who reveal the *Yod-He* are protected so that the lack of the Throne <note>the deficiency in the world</note> does not enter, so that the world to come is not lacking for them, and they shall be bound in the bond of life. He strikes the deficiency of the Throne, as it is written: *And the husband of the daughter of He...* and because of this it is written: *And I was perfect to Him.* And since the secret of "perfect" is revealed, I was kept from my iniquity.

And when Wisdom spreads out—not the spreading of the Crown <term>Keter: the highest, most hidden Sefirah</term>—Judgment <term>Gevurah: the Sefirah of restraint and power</term> is considered. They considered their Judgments in the parable of the Female, and they were fixed in the Female in one place to stir within the "nakedness" like them, for the whole body of the Female [is judged], and in that place, it is called "nakedness" for all of them. And that place is prepared for that Wisdom to be called Kindness, so that Judgment may be humbled and not include Wisdom within the Judgments. Thus Kindness stands included in Wisdom—Kindness within Kindness. (Who and what is included, Kindness within Kindness?) And the left-side Judgment is subdued so that it is called Kindness, included from both its sides.

And because of this, they were all destroyed <note>The Kings of Edom</note> before the arrangements of the Ancient of Ancients <term>Atika de-Atikin: the most hidden aspect of the Divine</term> were prepared. And the worlds were not yet established in their arrangements to endure, for the Female had to be sweetened <note>mitigated by mercy</note>. They did not endure until Kindness descended upon her, and then they endured, and the arrangements of the Female were humbled through Wisdom, which is called Kindness.

Then the Kingship <term>Malchut: the final Sefirah, associated with the manifest world</term> returned and shared a scepter of royalty in a place where all Judgments are found, and the arrangements went below. It is written that they were "lacking"—the Kingship was lacking and could not be humbled until everything was repaired and Kindness emerged. Then it says, *And he died, and he died* <note>Genesis 36</note>, for they could not endure or be humbled, for there was no male [balance]. And his seal was thus, for he remembered them all. And so it is written <note>Genesis 36:37</note>: *And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.* And here they were not sealed... for Kindness was not yet established in its greatness. *Shaul of Rehoboth by the River*—for there was no order yet. (From which side?) Before the order of spreading out, he emerged from "Rehoboth by the River," and this is Understanding <term>Binah: the third Sefirah, the "Mother" from whom the fifty gates of light open</term>, from which fifty gates are opened, the world of lights and lamps. He returned from Rehoboth by the River.

And all of them did not endure. Do not say they were nullified, but rather they did not endure in that Kingship which is from the side of the Female, until the Crown was awakened and spread out. From all of them it is written: *And he reigned in his stead.* Then Hadar [reigned] over him. And his city was Pau <note>Genesis 36:39</note>... he who merits the Holy Spirit. And his wife's name was Mehetabel... all of them were humbled... and she is called Mehetabel because it is not written of the others. Mehetabel [means] "How good is the immersion," for she was the daughter of Matred, arrangements from the side of Judgment, "Gold-refiners" <note>Me-Zahav</note>. And they were humbled and included... for "What is Gold?" <note>Me-Zahav</note>—Mercy and Judgment together, so they would not cling below to the Male on his sides to be separated like arms. Like the joints of the arm of the Male: one right, one left...

***

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Raba (The Great Assembly) from Parashat Naso. It focuses on the mystical anatomy of the Divine, specifically the arms (the Sefirot of Loving-kindness and Might) and the process of the "Dormita" (the mystical slumber) required for the union of the masculine and feminine aspects of the Divine.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

Three knots were knotted in Him, and two arms were rolled forth and included as one. Three knots are on the right and three knots are on the left. The three knots [of the right] were included within the three knots of the left, and in this manner <note>original: "k'gavna"</note> of this arm, it is written: *The loving-kindness of God <note>El</note> endures all day long.*
Regarding this, it is written: *The arm of the strength of Your right hand,* and the "Yod" of the Right Hand of the Lord is called by the three knots of Loving-kindness <note>Chessed</note> to inherit their laws.
And do not say that it is so <note>original: "hachi"</note> because three cavities of the brain are found in the skull. All three of them spread out and are knotted throughout the entire body, and the whole body is knotted in these three. They are knotted in the arm, and yet <note>original: "umihu"</note> it is in the manner of the three—David and good wine—to the right, because he joined with them in Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note> and sat there upon the throne of days. And in this manner it is written: *The strength of his fortress...* because he sits at the right. This is what is written: *And you shall rest and stand for your lot at the end of the Right,* meaning the strength of one who merits the affection of the King. And all of them are the portion of the one to whom the King spreads His right hand and receives him there. The right stood when the knots sat to spread out; and this arm stretched out its hand, but the knots did not spread. This arm stretched out to extend, sitting in the vessel, etc., in the three knots we mentioned. And when the guilty are awakened and spread through the world, three others are awakened which are harsh Judgment <note>Din</note>, and the arm is stretched out. And when He stretches out His right arm, it is called by all "the Arm of the Lord" and "the Arm of Might" <note>Gevurah</note>, as if to say that the "N" and "P" <note>referring to mystical letter permutations</note> are included in the three others.
The right investigates all, and Judgment and Mercy are stirred together on the right of the Lord as one, as it is written: *Your right hand, O Lord, shatters the enemy* <note>Exodus 15:6</note> because Mercy is awakened in it. And the three are as one; the Right holds the three of Loving-kindness, and they sink instead of the spirit <margin>(A sign for the lack of the Right)</margin> and spoke and established and mixed (the "L" and "P" for the cup) the sickness of the investigation. And the Arm of the Lord washes and strikes; the arm is suspended. Because of this, it is called the "Living Beauty" <note>Tiferet HaChai</note> and it washes, as it is written: *Who led Moses by His right hand.* "This" is the Right, "Arm" is the Left, as it is written: *His glorious arm,* as it is said.
And come and see: when the Left is joined, four words and fifty-two swords are joined in every single finger. And in every single finger, ten faces are found from these two swords. Go and calculate how many are grasped there. And the Right stands, called the "Help of Holiness" which comes from the Right Arm from the three knots. And even though the hand investigates, it is a help, as it is written: *And My hand shall be a support for you.* And the strikes are joined instead, and four magnitudes and supports, and five strikes pass behind the swords in the whole world, and they are called "The Hand of the Lord." *The hand of the Lord was upon him.* And even though in every place "The Hand of the Lord" refers to the Left, the Right of the Lord was included in His hand like the Arm, and it became a help and is called "Right" and "Life."
For the life of the Hand of the Lord, three [knots] descend when harsh judgments are awakened to descend into the world. Here it is written: *The secret of the Lord is for those who fear Him.* And come and see in the humility of the Book: that all judgments found in the Male are powerful at the beginning and relax at the end; and all judgments found in the Female <note>Nukba</note> are relaxed at the beginning and powerful at the end. And Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note> does not pass him as one; the world could not endure them until the Ancient of Ancients <note>Atik di-Atikin</note>, the Hidden of All, spread this one from that one and joined them to be found as one. And when He spreads them, He casts a deep sleep <note>Dormita</note> upon the Small Face <note>Zeir Anpin</note>, and He spreads the Female from the back of his sides and prepares all her adornments and humbles her for the relaxation of her union, to bring the woman to the male <margin>(What is for the will)</margin>. This is what is written: *And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man* <note>Genesis 2:21</note> *and he slept.* This "and he slept" is what is written: *Awake! Why do You sleep, O Lord?* *And He took one of his ribs.* What is "one"? This is the Female. And she was prepared and crowned, sinking Mercy and Loving-kindness as one. This is what is written: *And He closed up the flesh in its place,* and it is written: *And I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh* <note>Ezekiel 36:26</note>. And at the time when the Elder <note>the Ancient One</note> desired to enter, there were signs and sheets and whirlwinds, and He did not finish them until the Queen <note>Matronita</note> was in her preparation and sat before Him. When she sat before Him, He made those bolts known to them, and they were not sealed. Once the Queen sat with the King, they were united.

***

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly) within the portion of Naso. It focuses on the mitigation of harsh judgments and the mystical origins of Cain.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

And they returned, covered in their coverings. Who can go between them? Who is he that can approach them? Because of this, the concealment of the Ancient King is known in all this. The spirit that rests, calming from level to level, and all the rest joined together to be measured, but not as one. And that which everything was measured by—because of this, the judgments were sweetened <note>The term "sweetened" (itbasmu) refers to the Kabbalistic process of mitigating harsh judgment (Din) with mercy (Chesed).</note>, not as one, and they were not established (<insert>other versions: and to establish</insert>) upon Him, He shall be established. And we learned in the *Book of Concealment* <note>Sifra Detzniuta, a foundational and highly cryptic Zohar text.</note>: The **Holy Ancient One** <term>Atika Kadisha: The highest manifestation of the Divine</term> desired to see if the judgments were sweetened and if these two adhered one to the other. And there went out from the side of the attachment of the powerful spirit—which the world could not endure—that which is written: > *He has not dealt so with any nation; and as for His judgments, they have not known them.* <note>original: Psalm 147:20 (paraphrased)</note>

*And she conceived and bore Cain, and said: I have acquired a man from the Lord.* <note>original: Genesis 4:1</note> This was possible because she [Eve] had not been sweetened, and the powerful Eve went while the filth of the harsh spirit was present. And because of this, she was not able to be sweetened. And when this Cain went out from the side of the attachment, he went out powerful, a powerful knot, harsh in his way, harsh in his judgments. Once he went out, she was weakened and sweetened after this, and she embraced a more pleasant master. And there rose before Him that which was a powerful knot, and all the judgments were not mixed (<insert>other versions: were not clarified</insert>) before Him. Come and see what is written: > *And it came to pass, when they were in the field...* <note>original: Genesis 4:8</note> In the field—which is known above, and together as the **Secret of the Field of Apples** <term>Chakla deTapuchin: A symbolic representation of the Shekhinah or the garden of the Sephirot</term>. And the judgment went out to stand and be seen, because it was a knot from him, and he covered it and hid it beneath him until the Holy One, Blessed be He, was awakened by this and removed it from before Him. And He struck it into the breach, into the breach of the powerful one, and it was included in the possession, in the blast of the spirit that measures the dwellings upon them, and they shall be gardens for this world according to its ways.

And even though they are hidden, they spread out one into the other and are mixed as one body, and the body shall be like the souls of the wicked, powerful in spirit from both of them as one. One strength to his side and one to his side. Happy are the righteous who learn their souls from this holy breath that searches one in all, everything after the holy crowns and coronets are joined a second time in the manner of being established.

Happy are the righteous, for all these holy words that were said by the Holy Spirit are upon them; the spirit of all the holy ones is included in it, the spirit of the upper ones and all the lower ones end in them (<insert>other versions: the upper and lower ones judge them</insert>). And all of them come from their source, which waters the members of the **Field** <note>The Field of Holy Apples</note>, and these words shall precede and you shall look into them and you shall know your Creator, covered in coverings, with an eye of understanding. And test yourselves for the World to Come, as the end of the matter says: > *Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart...* <note>original: Deuteronomy 4:39</note> that the Lord, the Ancient of Days, He is God, He is One, blessed be His Name forever and to all eternity.

Rabbi Shimon said: I have seen the upper ones below and the lower ones above. The upper ones are below in the image of Man, which is the arrangement of all of them above. And we learned it is written: > *But the righteous is an everlasting foundation* <note>original: Proverbs 10:25</note>, which includes the six in a single knot together. And in the verse where it is written: > *His legs are as pillars of marble* <note>original: Song of Songs 5:15</note>. And you shall see in the *Book of Concealment* that all of them are included in the two upper ones as a general rule and a specific detail. And together they are included in the two lower ones in detail and general rule. In the two upper ones as a general rule, as it was said in the image of all these arrangements in detail, in the count of the hands, five against five. In the two lower ones in the count of the legs, which are detail and general rule, for the body was not established with them, for they wait outside the body, and therefore they were not in the body until they were from it. And if so, see: > *And his feet shall stand in that day...* <note>original: Zechariah 14:4</note> rather, the legs of the body from the side of the judgments (<insert>other versions: of the wonders</insert>) to perform vengeance, and they are called "Masters of the Legs." And their strikes are powerful and they join from the side of the judgments that are below in the lower crowns. And we learned that all the heat of the arrangement above in the Holy Body, in Male and Female, all of it is drawn toward Mercy (Chesed), this from that, and they are divided one into the other and rise one into the other, just as blood is drawn into the shoulders and hands, to this side and that side, to here and there. This descends to the place of the Master, and they laugh from the movements (<insert>other versions: chatterings</insert>) of the body to the embrace of one another, strengthening one another until all the worlds are established and blessed because of them. And we learned that all the heat is a crown for him.

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse from Parashat Naso in the Zohar, focusing on the "Holy Body" (Gufa Kadisha) as a cosmic blueprint. It explores the necessity of the union between masculine and feminine principles for universal harmony.</meta>

## Naso

Those who are not included in the Body are all distant and impure; anyone who approaches them to learn words from them <note>referring to demonic or external forces that lack the divine structure</note> is led astray. Come and see the love for the disciples of the wise: it is not merely because of what is seen in them, but because they are included in that **Holy Body** <note>original: *Gufa Kadisha*; the metaphysical structure of the Divine emanations</note>. You might say to me: "But the holy angels are not within the definition of a 'body'?" Not so; for if they were not seen as part of the pattern of the **Holy Body**, they would not be holy and would not endure. For it is written:
> *His body was like beryl* <note>Daniel 10:6</note>
And it is written:
> *And their rims were full of eyes* <note>Ezekiel 1:18</note>
And the "pious ones of power"—all of them are within the **Category of Adam** <note>original: *Klala d'Adam*; the primordial human form that serves as a map of the universe</note>.

We have learned: all those spirits that wander, which were not established in the "Adam" form and left the category of the **Holy Body**, do not cleave to it and are impure. Because of this, they all pollute, twist, and fly through the world, entering the depths of the Great Abyss to cleave to that first spirit that emerged outside the category of the Body to investigate below. They rule and fly through the whole world, fluttering about, but they do not cleave to the category of the Body. Therefore, they are outside of all dwellings above and below, for they are defilers, as it is written of them:
> *His dwelling shall be outside the camp* <note>Leviticus 13:46</note>

But from the spirit of the "breath" <note>original: *hevel*</note> that was more firmly established within the category of the **Holy Body**, others emerge who are more fragrant and cleave to the Body. Yet not all of them cleave; some hang like a vision and emerge from this category, fearing, polluting, and wandering based on what they hear from above and below, and from this they know what is said to them.

We learned in the Assembly of the Book: once they were sweetened above in the **Category of Adam**, the **Holy Body**, male and female were joined. Blessed is the portion of the female in the sweetening of all things! For through her, the upper and lower worlds were sweetened. From here, the world above and below was perfected from the crown of the **Holy Body**, and the worlds are joined and grasped one in the other, becoming **One Body**.

Because they are all one body, the **Divine Presence** <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note> is above and the **Divine Presence** is below; the **Holy One, Blessed be He**, is above and the **Holy One, Blessed be He**, is below. He pours out the spirit and places it in one body. All of them are seen only as the one **Holy One, Blessed be He**, "Lord of Hosts, the whole earth is full of His glory," for all of them are one body.

Come and see: once they were sweetened one with the other, it is written:
> *We will make you circlets of gold with studs of silver* <note>Song of Songs 1:11</note>
This refers to the binding of the spirit and mercy (a matter to be sweetened so that it exists in mercy). It was sweetened by the masculine, and therefore one does not ascend without the other, like a date palm which does not flourish unless male and female are together. Regarding this we learned: whoever removes himself in this world from the **Category of Adam**, later when he leaves this world, he does not enter the **Category of Adam** to investigate the **Holy Body**, but remains like a vision that is not called "Adam" and is excluded from the category of the Body.

**Circlets of gold we will make for you with studs of silver**
They were sweetened with mercy, and there is no judgment that does not have mercy within it. Regarding this it is written: "Your cheeks are comely with circlets, your neck with beads," like rows, just as it is written "circlets of gold we will make for you," etc. "With beads"—as it is written, "with studs of silver." "Your neck" refers to the category of the Female; this is the **Matron** <note>original: *Matronita*; the feminine aspect of the Divine</note>. Here is found the Sanctuary above and Jerusalem below. (What is the Sanctuary of all?) The Sanctuary and all this matter is in the Masculine, and everything becomes one category of **Faith**. From this faith, all faith is built and gazed upon.

And come and see: even when a man dies and the soul leaves him, he is lacking. One must prepare a place for him in a "house" <note>the grave</note> to give him rest upon the earth, for the sake of the honor we have shown, so that no disgrace be seen in him. As it is written:
> *Man in honor does not abide; he is like the beasts that perish* <note>Psalms 49:13</note>
"Man," who is more honorable than all honor, "does not abide" [overnight]. Why? Because if they were to treat him like a burden, they would be "like the beasts that perish." Just as animals are not within the **Category of Adam** and the Holy Spirit is not seen in them, so too here: a body without a spirit is like an animal. Yet this body is the honor of all; let no disgrace be seen in it.

We learned in the Assembly of the Book: whoever shows honor to this **Holy Body**, it is as if he acts upon the inner spirit in the Body of the worlds, for because of this...

<summary>This page explains that the "Holy Body" is the essential structure of holiness, encompassing angels and humans alike. It emphasizes that the union of masculine and feminine divine aspects (the Holy One and the Shekhinah) creates a single, unified reality of mercy.</summary>

<meta>This page concludes the Idra Rabba (The Great Assembly) in the portion of Naso. It follows the previous page's discussion on the mystical anatomy of the Divine and transitions into the narrative of the companions' ecstatic departure from the world.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

This does not dwell in the holy chamber in the way of "Righteousness shall lodge" <note>original: *Tzedek yalin*</note> <note>Isaiah 1:21</note>. It is written: **Righteousness lodged in her**, because this breath of the King’s image is a crown from the choice part <note>The text discusses the indwelling of Divine light within the human form</note>. As it is seen in the silver, so the likeness is seen, and they saw within it the expansion of the **Daughters of Kindness** <note>original: *Benot ha-Hesed*</note>; these are the ones who were hidden, and all of them are within the feminine boundaries of the mystery. **The Daughters of Kindness**—this refers to the well-known Kindness <note>The Sefirah of Hesed</note>. And it is written: **And they bore children to them, these were the mighty men of old** <note>Genesis 6:4</note>. From that which is called "the world" <note>original: *Olam*</note>, as we have established, and from the waters of the world. Worthy is the portion from which spirits and demons go out into the world to cling to the wicked. They were gathered as one to cover these swords that were not as one. The fallen ones, Uza and Azael, were as one. The "Sons of God" were as one, and this is the mystery, and all is below.

It is written: **And the Lord regretted that He had made man on the earth** <note>Genesis 6:6</note>. This is to exclude the Supernal Kindness <note>Hesed</note> which was not as one. "And the Lord regretted" refers to the Lesser Countenance <note>term: *Ze’ir Anpin* — the emotive aspects of the Divine</note> who was hidden. **And He was grieved in His heart.** It does not say "He grieved," but specifically **He was grieved** <note>original: *Vayit’atzev* — reflexive form</note>; the grief depends on Him, to exclude one who is not grieved. **In His heart**—it does not say "within His heart," but **to His heart** <note>original: *El libo*</note>, like one who is grieved and receives from another, for this "brother" <note>a wordplay on *Achi*</note> is the heart of every prophet.

And the Lord said: **I will blot out man whom I have created from the face of the earth** <note>Genesis 6:7</note>. This is to exclude the Supernal Kindness. Do not say the lower Kindness alone; it is not to exclude it entirely, because one did not stand without the other. And it is full of the **Hidden Wisdom** <note>term: *Chokhmah Stima’ah* — the primordial, concealed Divine intellect</note> of all, for everything was established like a living being. This is what is written: **I, Wisdom, dwell with Prudence** <note>Proverbs 8:12</note>. Do not read it as "I dwell" <note>original: *shakhanti*</note> but "I have caused to dwell" <note>original: *shikhanti*</note>. And the heat of this "Man" did not allow the world to stand, as it is written: **The Lord by Wisdom founded the earth** <note>Proverbs 3:19</note>. And it is written: **But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord** <note>Genesis 6:8</note>.

And all of them depend on the second brain, which is the brain. And Wisdom is everything, but not the Hidden Wisdom that was strengthened and established in the "Repair of Man" <note>The mystical configuration of the Divine attributes into a human-like structure</note> to be settled in its repairs. Furthermore: **Wisdom gives strength to the wise man more than ten rulers** <note>Ecclesiastes 7:19</note>, for they are the repairs that accompany Man. And Kindness <note>Hesed</note> is the internal repair where the spirit stands. This is what is written: **For Kindness shall pursue** <note>A variation on Psalm 23:6</note> the eyes, and the Lord sees into the heart, which is the innermost of the inner.

And through this repair, the perfection of the faith of all was established, which stands upon the Throne, as it is written: **And the likeness of the appearance of a man was upon it from above** <note>Ezekiel 1:26</note>. And it is written: **And behold, with the clouds of heaven, one like a son of man came, and he came to the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before Him** <note>Daniel 7:13</note>.

Until here are the hidden words and the clarified meanings. In this portion of words, let the wise man know and not stray in them, for these were not given to any other. And let the rebellious be happy and go out, as it is written: **For the ways of the Lord are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the transgressors stumble in them** <note>Hosea 14:10</note>.

It was taught: Just as Rabbi Shimon and the companions stood, and the living Master like the nourishing waters that are revealed here, they were built and dug in the chamber of the **World to Come** <note>term: *Olam Ha-Ba* — the spiritual realm of reward</note>. And they prepared from this world a pure and sapphire light so that it would not be revealed to any man of the world. He turned and saw, and I turned back, for behold, it was revealed before the **Ancient of Ancients** <note>term: *Atika d'Atikin* — the most primordial level of Divinity</note>, the Concealed of all Concealed. This was not done for my own honor, nor for the honor of my father’s house, nor for the honor of the companions, but so they would not err in their unity, and would not be ashamed at the gates of His palaces, and would not be amazed by their own hands; and all is their portion in the World to Come.

It was taught: Before the companions left that Assembly <note>term: *Idra*</note>, **Rabbi Yose, Rabbi Hizkiyah, and Rabbi Yesa died.** And the companions saw that holy angels were carrying them to that curtain <note>term: *Parsa* — the veil separating the Divine realms</note> that hangs above. Rabbi Shimon said a word and they were covered <note>or "entangled"</note>. For he said: "Open a place for the souls of the righteous that have been elevated, for things have been revealed through you that have not been revealed since the day Moses stood on Mount Sinai." As it is written: **And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights** <note>Exodus 34:28</note>. Just as there, so here—these are the ones who did not occupy themselves with vanities. Worthy is the portion of Rabbi Shimon, and the portion of all these companions who stand in the way, for behold, there has been revealed to you what has not been revealed to all the heavenly hosts.

## Commentary
The page consists of a single block of the main Zohar text from the conclusion of the *Idra Rabba* (The Great Assembly). There are no secondary commentaries printed on this specific page. The text describes the departure of the souls of three sages during the mystical assembly.

**Key Kabbalistic Terms:**
- **Lesser Countenance** (Ze'ir Anpin): The six emotive Sefirot, often associated with the name YHVH and the "Son" in the Zohar's family metaphors.
- **Hidden Wisdom** (Chokhmah Stima'ah): The first flash of intellect within the Divine, which remains largely inaccessible to human thought.
- **Ancient of Days** (Atik Yomin): The highest, most ancient level of the Divine Will.
- **Assembly** (Idra): The circle of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai's students.
- **Curtain** (Parsa): A metaphysical barrier that filters the light between higher and lower spiritual worlds.

## Main Text (Zohar)

...heads and spirits, and they are invited and meritorious above all other days. There is joy for all those who are outside, as it is written: <note>Isaiah 66:23</note> *And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, etc.* These come to gaze upon the Likeness. Why "from one new moon to another"? Because they are crowned in the holy chariot. And "from one sabbath to another" because the Oath <note>The word for Sabbath, Shabbat, is linked here to Shavuah, oath</note> is crowned for all those openings of the days, as it is written: <note>Genesis 2:3</note> *And God blessed the seventh day, etc.* And meritorious is this Oath, for through it, one shall be crowned and sanctified more than all; and there are thirteen <note>original: "תלת עשרוון"</note> who are blessed in the Oath, and they are the righteous who delight in the hidden treasure of the World to Come. And it is written: *And you shall call the Sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, honorable.* Who is "the holy of the Lord"? This is Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, who is called honorable in this world and in the World to Come.

## Ra'aya Meheimna (Faithful Shepherd)

**The Faithful Shepherd**
**The Commandment**

**Speak** unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying: On this wise ye shall bless, etc. <note>Numbers 6:23</note> Rabbi Isaac opened: *But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear Him, and His righteousness unto children's children.* How great is the importance of the Presence <note>original: "פנויה" / "שכינתא"</note> of the Holy One, Blessed be He, for within the blessing is humility, and within the delight is peace. It is written that whoever possesses the fear of sin, they shall merit them; and who are the seers and their beloved? Those who possess humility and piety <note>original: "חסידות" — Chasidut</note>.

<margin>
This is to bless—the Priest <note>Kohen</note> shall bless the people every day with a high standing <note>with raised hands</note> to humble himself and to bless with a blessing every day, to draw down blessings above and below, for the faces of light shine upon the world. Just as there are fifteen <note>referring to the fifteen words of the Priestly Blessing</note>... just as the right side is greater than the left, because perfection belongs to the right more than the left. And regarding the blessing that the Priest blesses the people, he must lift his hands above his head and look with a "good eye" <note>generosity of spirit</note> etc. The Priest spreads his hands, and the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note> rests...
</margin>

...rests upon them to let it be known that the Holy One, Blessed be He, says to give blessings, for those who receive are blessed from two sides: from above to below. From above, the Divine Presence rests upon them to make it known, and through the Priest who blesses. For the words that are performed awaken words above, in the manner of the spreading [of hands] to humble oneself, as it is written below, that the Divine Presence comes to rest upon him. And so it is that many things in the world awaken things above, for through the awakening below, the matter is awakened for the Master above. And we have established that the Priest must be meritorious, and this is the reason for the Levite and the reason for the Scribe. And how many are the lights of beauty... to humble themselves and awaken the Divine Presence to rest upon them. They awaken the crown of the levels to the lengths above and afterwards, and all is according to the secret of the parchment. And he shall say to him when he stands to humble himself in the standing that he tastes in the exile and in the blessings, and he turns to the Holy One, Blessed be He. And this is the standing for those who awaken, for this is holy and the secret of faith. He stands to humble himself... and their standing crowns the rulers... and with this, he should know to bless with a "good eye" in the appointment of the Divine Presence as it has been said. This joy of the blessing goes out... sixty <note>original: "סתין"</note> who are sufficient and fly in the firmament, and sixty great ones are appointed over every single letter. And they all dwell upon all these blessings. What is the reason? These sixty... for the sixty always stand in the world, and all the secret of their radiance is to pass the Holy Name to go out... it rises above until it reaches the Throne above, and all is the Supernal Divine Presence and the Lower Divine Presence dwelling and looking into those blessings. And all the visions of the sixty... and concerning this it is written: <note>Numbers 6:27</note> *And they shall put My name upon the children of Israel.* And then the Holy One, Blessed be He, agrees with them to bless them as has been said.

---

**We have learned:** Who is wise? He who learns from fear and walks in humility. Humility is superior, and included in all of them is: *The reward of humility is the fear of the Lord.* Anyone who has the fear of heaven merits humility; anyone who has humility merits piety; anyone who has piety merits the Holy Spirit <note>original: "רוח הקודש" — Ruach HaKodesh</note>, as it is written: *The reward of humility is the fear of the Lord* leading to piety, as it is written: *But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear Him.* Every person who possesses piety is called... and the laughter of the Lord.

<meta>This page continues the mystical commentary on the Torah portion Naso, specifically focusing on the spiritual requirements of the Priesthood (Kehunah) and the beginning of the Priestly Blessing. It connects the earthly Priest to the celestial realm of Lovingkindness (Chesed).</meta>

## Naso

->**Naso**<-

The letter *Vav* includes everything. <note>original: "ו' כלילת הכל"</note> <note>Malachi 2:7</note> >For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.<
Why did the Priest merit to be called "a messenger of the Lord of hosts"? Rabbi Yehuda said: Just as there is a "messenger of the Lord of hosts" who is a Priest above <note>referring to the Archangel Michael, who serves as the High Priest in the heavenly Temple</note>, so too the Priest below is a "messenger of the Lord of hosts." And who is this messenger of the Lord of hosts? He who resembles the white light, the Great **Chesed** <term>Chesed: The Divine attribute of Lovingkindness and expansive benevolence</term>, for there is no greater dominion or whiteness than the High Priest when he enters the innermost Sanctuary. The High Priest below is called a "messenger of the Lord of hosts" because he comes from the Supernal side. What did he receive? He received mercies upon mercies, and because of this, the Priest is not found on the side of Judgment <note>Din/Gevurah</note>. Thus the Priest merited and was treated with kindness because he inherits the "kindness of our God, which is from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear Him."

What is meant by "everlasting to everlasting" <note>literally: "from world to world"</note>? Rabbi Yitzhak said: Just as below it is through holy kindness, "world" is one and "world" is two <note>referring to the two worlds, the hidden upper world and the revealed lower world</note>. Rabbi Hiyya said to me: "From the world and unto the world" refers to this. The letter *Het* <note>numerical value 8</note> refers to the two worlds and is sanctified in the letter *Mem*. Rabbi Eleazar said to Rabbi Yitzhak: How long will you keep your words hidden? "From the world unto the world" all refers to the Supernal Spirit—Kindness above and Kindness below. This is "world and world." And it is written "days of old" and "years of old" <note>literally: "days/years of the world"</note>, and we have established that these all refer to the Supernal Holiness. "Upon those who fear Him"—to all those who walk in the path of Kindness, they shall be called "Kindness" <note>Chassid</note>.

It was taught: Rabbi Eleazar said that through union <note>spiritual or marital coupling</note> one inherits deep Kindness; all pieties are entirely Kindness. And Judah and the repair of Kindness are all male and female. But if so, are they all for Kindness? For whoever is found as male and female is called "Kindness," and then they are truly "found." Furthermore, the spirit of humility is within him, and furthermore, the spirit of Kindness is within him. But one who is not found as male and female <note>i.e., an unmarried man</note> has neither Kindness, nor humility, nor piety within him. Because of this, they are not entirely Kindness. But once he is called "Man" <note>Adam</note>, the spirit of Kindness is within him, <note>Psalm 89:3</note> >as it is written: I have said, the world shall be built with kindness.< And his strength cannot be exhausted when he is found as male and female. <note>Psalm 103:17</note> >And it is written: But the kindness of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him.< Those who fear Him are all for Kindness.

This "kindness of the Lord from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear Him" refers to those Priests who come from the side of Kindness and are designated to reveal the life from the world to the world below. "Upon those who fear Him" refers to the Priests below, as it is written <note>Leviticus 16:6</note> >And he shall make atonement for himself, and for his house.< Do not diminish the status of "Man" <note>Adam</note> for any of them. "And His righteousness unto children's children" refers to the side that merits the Assembly of Israel. Rabbi Yehuda said: If so, what is "His righteousness" and "His kindness" in this context? Rabbi Eleazar said: Focus on the secret we learned in the Zohar, that "water was taken," etc. And it is written "And you shall take Kindness," and this is the completion of the Priesthood, which is **Chesed** (Kindness). And "This" <note>Zot</note> is the Female, while Kindness is the Male. Because of this, the male who comes from the side of the white light is not called "Kindness" alone. And "This" is called **Tzedek** (Righteousness/Justice) which comes from the side of the Female. Because of this, it is called "Kindness and His Righteousness," and it is written "And His Righteousness." What is "And His Righteousness"? His Righteousness is his female partner, so that she is not excluded from the whole. Because of this we learned: Any Priest who does not have a female partner is deficient in his service, as it is written: "And he shall make atonement for himself, and for his house" <note>"his house" is a traditional idiom for "his wife"</note>.

Rabbi Yitzhak said: Because the **Shekhinah** <term>Shekhinah: The Divine Presence, often associated with the feminine aspect of God</term> does not dwell upon one who is not wise, and in this, he requires more than all the rest of the people for the Shekhinah to be pious through him. And once the Shekhinah dwells within him, the Priest of Kindness dwells, and they are called "Pious Ones" <note>Chassidim</note>, as in the matter of <note>Psalm 145:10</note> >Your people shall bless You, O Lord, and Your pious ones shall bless You.< And it is written <note>Deuteronomy 33:8</note> >Let Your Thummim and Your Urim be with Your pious man.< And because the Priests are called "Pious," they are required to bless. Because of this it is written: "Male to his kindness and his life," etc.

**Thus shall you bless.** <note>Numbers 6:23</note> What is the reason? Because they are called "Pious Ones," and it is written "and Your pious ones shall bless You." **Thus shall you bless the children of Israel, saying unto them.** "Thus shall you bless"—in the Holy Tongue <note>Hebrew</note>. "Thus shall you bless"—with awe. "Thus shall you bless"—with humility. Rabbi Abba said: "Thus shall you bless." Come and see, this level is called **Koh** ("Thus"), for all judgments are awakened from the power of... Rabbi Eleazar said: What is "from the power of Koh"? Meaning, the power derived from *Koh*. And it is written: "And the Priest... you have not heard until *Koh*..." what is for the nations and what is written in the Zohar, "You shall know that I am the Lord," and all are one. And it is written: "And not..."

<summary>This page discusses the spiritual nature of the Priest (Kohen) as an earthly representative of Divine Kindness (Chesed). It emphasizes that a Priest must be married to properly channel the Shekhinah and perform the Priestly Blessing.</summary>
<keywords>Chesed, Priesthood, Shekhinah, Marriage, Priestly Blessing, Male and Female, Righteousness, Humility</keywords>

--- Page 295 ---
<meta>This page continues the discussion of the Priestly Blessing from the previous section of Parashat Naso, focusing on the mystical union between the Sefirah of Chesed (Lovingkindness) and Malchut (Kingdom).</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

...they merited this <note>the Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note> which is prepared to dwell on earth. From this source, all "Judgments" <note>strict justice/Dinin</note> are awakened, but she is strengthened by **Lovingkindness** <term>Chesed: the attribute of mercy and expansion</term> and is thereby sweetened. For this reason, this matter was handed over to the Priest <note>Kohen</note> who comes from the side of Lovingkindness, so that through him, that specific level called **"Koh"** <note>original: כה; a mystical name for the Shekhinah</note> shall be blessed and sweetened. 

**"Thus (Koh) shall you bless"**—meaning, even though she is found entirely within Judgments, you shall sweeten her and bless her. As it is written <note>Numbers 6:23</note> **"Thus (Koh) shall you bless the children of Israel."** Do not read it only as "thus," but bless this "Koh" with Lovingkindness so she becomes sweetened toward Israel, so that the Judgments do not overpower her. 

**"Thus shall you bless the children of Israel, saying to them (Amor Lahem)."**
It is written "Saying" <note>original: אמור; spelled defectively in the Torah</note> to indicate that one should not speak in a way that departs from the private domain; one does not publicize the matter, for they were not commanded to publicize it. This is why it is written *Amor* (Say) and not *Tomru* (You shall say). 

However, <term>Rabbi Yehuda</term> taught: "Saying to them"—if they merit it, it is said plainly. <term>Rabbi Isaac</term> opened his discourse with the verse <note>Ecclesiastes 2:13</note>: **"Then I saw that wisdom has an advantage over folly, as far as light has an advantage over darkness."** He opened from afar... "And I saw"—for when one looks properly, we understand it in this way: it is certainly something to behold. And who are they? The vessels, the Cherubim, and the Angels. If so, was he moved before the profane? For it is written that they did not see, lest they see the shame. Yet here it is written "And I saw," and he did not fear? But regarding the profane, it was written previously. Rather, hold onto this: it is written <note>Psalms 27:3</note> **"Though a host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear... in this (Zot) I trust."**

**"In this (Zot)"**—this refers to our Master. And "Zot" <note>This/Malchut</note> is the portion and inheritance to take possession of and to execute vengeance. And it was taught: The Holy One, blessed be He, prepared David with holiness and with wisdom, the supernal holy crowns of all that are supported by Wisdom. David became wise and inherited the prophecy in both ways, and like the Crown of the Kingdom above, he was for strength and might. The treasures of this Kingdom shall not depart from their descendants for generations upon generations. 

And come and see: at the time when this Crown of the Kingdom <term>Malchut</term> is awakened to the "Gathering of the Generation," there is no one who can stand before it. "And I saw"—for I saw the radiance, because he is of the "Gathering of the Generation," as it is written <note>1 Samuel 18:14</note> **"And David was successful in all his ways, and the Lord was with him."** 

In the end, he desired and rejoiced in this, which is the source of Wisdom. The portion and lot of the Levite and the flight of this judgment is "folly" and "darkness"—not the opinion that <term>Rabbi Shimon</term> stated: At the time when this **"Koh"** is awakened in its Judgments, the inhabitants of the world cannot stand before it. But at the time when the Priests spread their hands—they who come from the side of Lovingkindness below—the Lovingkindness from above is awakened and joins with this "Koh." Then she is sweetened and blessed with radiant blessings for the children of Israel, and the Judgments are removed from them. 

**"Thus (Koh) shall you bless the children of Israel"**—and not another. For this reason, it is the Priest, and no other, so that he may awaken this Crown of Lovingkindness through his hands, for he is called "Kind," as it is written "To Your kind one (Chasidcha)..." and he stands and comes from the side of Lovingkindness. And it is written <note>Psalms 145:10</note> **"And Your pious ones shall bless You (Yevarchucha)."** Do not read it as *Yevarchucha* (shall bless You), but as **"Yevarchu Koh"** (They shall bless Koh). For "Thus (Koh) shall you bless" must be done with the Explicit Name <term>Shem HaMeforash: the four-letter name of God</term>, and "Thus shall you bless" must be in the Holy Tongue <note>Hebrew</note>.

Come and see, <term>Rabbi Yehuda</term> said: At the time when the Priests below stand and spread their hands, all the holy Crowns above are awakened and prepared to be blessed. they shine from the joy of the Male <note>the masculine aspect of the Divine</note> which is found for them from the side of the "Depth" that flows constantly. The blessings are then directed to all the worlds, and they are all blessed and repaired. At that time, there is freedom and sweetness in all worlds. 

It is like a King who desires to unite with the <term>Matronita</term> <note>The Divine Mother/Queen/Shekhinah</note> and wishes to bring her in with her attendants. All sides are awakened at that time... the King comes to unite with the Matronita. Behold, this Matronita is the **Assembly of Israel** <term>Knesset Israel: the spiritual archetype of the Jewish people</term>. 

Come and see, <term>Rabbi Isaac</term> said: The Priest must place the right hand over the left, as it is written <note>Leviticus 9:22</note> **"And Aaron lifted up his hand (Yado) toward the people and blessed them."** It is written "his hand" (singular) and not "his hands" (plural), because the right is found over the left. <term>Rabbi Eleazar</term> said: This is a mystery, because it is written "And the Lord is your shade." Come and see: the Priest who wishes to bless... must add holiness upon...

# Naso

## Main Text (Zohar)

Regarding his holiness: when his hands are sanctified through the washing of holiness, his hands are filled with that holiness. For the Priest <note>Hebrew: Kohen</note> must receive holiness from a source of vision, as it is written <note>Numbers 8:14</note> **"And you shall sanctify the Levites."** Behold, they are holy. And it is written concerning the Levites <note>Numbers 8:2</note> **"And also your brothers, the tribe of Levi..."** the tribe is joined as one. From here we learn that every Priest who spreads his hands <note>to bless the people</note> must be sanctified by the holiness of the Name, so that holiness is added upon his holiness. Therefore, he should not receive the water for sanctification from a common person <note>literally: "son of man"</note> who is not holy. In the *Humility of the Book*, it was taught: the Levite is to be sanctified, but the Priest requires sanctification first through his hands. They reversed it so that he is sanctified by the hand of the Priest. They said: Come and see, the Priest does not require it, for a Priest who is not disqualified <note>term: *pagis* - referring to a priest who is ritually unfit or "profaned"</note> requires the holiness of the Priest to ascend. If he is disqualified, he does not ascend. If he is profaned, he is flawed. He should appear in his place for prayer like a poor man and a beggar, for he is flawed. Yet he is called holy, as it is written: **"And you shall sanctify the Levites."**

Rabbi Phinehas said: He is even called pure, as it is written <note>Numbers 8:6</note> **"And you shall purify them."** Because of this, the Priest must add holiness upon his holiness. Come and see: a Priest who spreads his hands <note>in blessing</note> must not join his fingers one to another, so that the holy crowns <note>term: *keterin* - the divine emanations or Sefirot</note> may be blessed, each one individually as they have established it. And because the Holy Name must be expressed through distinct letters so as not to mix one into another, he should not intend any other words within them. Rabbi Isaac said: The Holy One, blessed be He, desires that the upper beings be blessed so that the lower beings may be blessed, and the upper beings are blessed through the hands of the lower beings—those who are holy with a supreme holiness, who are holier than all the holy ones below, as it is written: "And those who sanctify You shall bless You." Rabbi Judah said: Any Priest who does not know this secret <note>Hebrew: *raza*</note> and the prayer of the blessing, and whose mouth is not a source of blessing—his blessing is not a blessing. This is what is written <note>Malachi 2:7</note> **"For the lips of a priest should guard knowledge, and they should seek Torah from his mouth."** What is "knowledge" <note>Hebrew: *Da'at*</note>? It is Knowledge in its general sense. And "they should seek Torah from his mouth"—why seek it from his mouth? "Torah" in its general sense is the Supernal Torah. That which is not called "Torah" simply refers to the Written Torah and the Oral Torah; they must be called by these names. Why? **"For he is an angel of the Lord of Hosts."** And we have learned that the Priest must focus his intention on the supernal matters to unify the Holy Name as is required.
