## Main Text (Zohar)

As they have established: *He has not beheld iniquity in Jacob* <note>Numbers 23:21</note>. These are the commandments that are like the dust, like seed, and like a planting all at once, as the companions have established. *And who can count the fourth part of Israel?* <note>Numbers 23:10</note>—this is just as you would say, "you shall not let your cattle gender with a diverse kind" <note>The word for "fourth part," *reva*, shares a root with the word for "mating" or "breeding," *tirba*</note>. One out of "Thus" <term>Koh: a mystical name for the Shekhinah or Divine Presence</term> was a refuge as before, like Balaam when he did not know how to direct an evil response.

---

### And he took up
**And he took up his parable and said.** It is not written "And he spoke and said"; why does it say *And he took up his parable*? Rabbi Hiyya said: He was raising his voice like a thief <note>original: *le-ganva*</note>; that one speaks and "lifts" his parable in anger, as it is written: *And thus [Koh] shall you speak* <note>Numbers 23:5</note>, and we see it was from here. Come and see: once Balaam saw that in everything he desired—even with all those gifts—he was unable to uproot that [nation], he then tried to strike at the root of this *Koh* <note>The Divine level through which prophecy was channeled to him</note>. The Holy One, blessed be He, saw this and said: "Wicked one! You have come from the furnace to uproot? You will not be able to uproot for yourself." What is written? *And God met [Vayikar] Balaam* <note>Numbers 23:4</note>, as has been said <note>The word *Vayikar* implies a "chance" or "unclean" encounter</note>. Afterward, when he saw he was unable, he returned and said: *He has blessed, and I cannot reverse it* <note>Numbers 23:20</note>. It should have said "I will not reverse it," but instead it says *I cannot reverse it*—meaning, regarding that which is written *Thus [Koh] and thus shall you speak*, I am unable to turn it back. Balaam said: "I sought to enter into two levels through this *Koh*; I intended to enter into this level of **Jacob**, but I could not. I sought to enter them from the side of **Israel**, but I could not." For what is the "building" there? They are not seen to be bound to evil species; this is what is written: *How goodly are your tents, O Jacob* <note>Numbers 23:5</note>. Secondly, there are two levels like fire, and corresponding to them are their pillars; for Balaam saw that this and that were found corresponding to **Jacob** and **Israel**.

> *Behold* <note>Hebrew: *Hen*</note> corresponds to **Jacob**, who is bound to *Koh*. *The people* corresponds to **Israel**, who is bound to the *Throne* <term>Kisse: the Throne of Glory</term>.

Once he saw he was unable, he said and feared: "It is not by [my] power like Jacob etc." because *the Lord his God is with him* <note>Numbers 23:21</note>. *And the Lord was with Isaac*—in this [level of the Throne] I cannot prevail, and in this [level of Jacob] I cannot prevail, as it is written: *For there is no enchantment in Jacob...* <note>Numbers 23:23</note>. And not only that, but all those above and all their sides, none of them know what is hidden in the laws of the Supreme King until they ask these two: **Jacob** and **Israel**. And what do they say? *What has God wrought!* <note>Numbers 23:23</note>. Rabbi Eleazar said: They are so full of it [divine insight] that he did not say it, but rather he sharpened his voice against it, yet he did not know it, and his voice was not heard.

---

### Behold
> **Behold, the people shall rise up as a lioness, etc.** <note>Numbers 23:24</note>

They strike with strength like Israel. At the time when the morning shines, one rises and strengthens himself like a lion for the service <term>Pulkhana: Divine service or worship</term> of their Master with many songs and many praises. They labor in the Torah at night, and in the night that is sought, etc. When one lies down to sleep upon his bed, he precedes [his sleep] with the Supreme Name to crown Him above and below. How many officers of the law <note>Angelic guards</note> approach before them at the hour they open their mouths upon their beds with the name of Israel and seek mercy before the Holy King with many verses of mercy. Rabbi Abba said: *Behold, the people shall rise up as a lioness.* This people is destined to rise above all nations; they are like a lion, recognized and strong, and the sharpness of all the beasts of the field shall be raised above them. It shall not be found that they lie down upon their prey for all the people, for *he shall not lie down until he eats of the prey*. He did not see "the people shall rise up as a lioness" except in regards to bringing the sacrifice <term>Korbana</term> and their protection before their King upon the altar. And come [and see]: at the time the sacrifice was bound upon the altar, they would see the likeness of a lion crouching over that sacrifice and consuming it. And Rabbi Abba said: We have seen that it was a supreme angel, and he appeared to them in the likeness of a mighty lion crouching upon the altar and eating the sacrifices of all Israel. If they were not so virtuous, they would see the likeness of a brazen dog crouching over it; then Israel knew they required repentance, and then they would repent. *He shall not lie down etc.*—these are the nighttime sacrifices, such as the burnt offerings. *And drink the blood of the slain*—for the Holy One, blessed be He, wages their war against their kings. Rabbi Eleazar said: *He shall not lie down*—what does "he shall not lie down" mean? Rather, like every single night, when it is night, it is not "night" [in the sense of darkness] because the commands of the Kingdom surround it.

## Main Text (Zohar)

He lay upon his bed until the morning light, and they performed five exchanges of evil kinds that accompany him.
Rabbi Isaac said: These "exchanges" refer to the side of impurity <note>The Sitra Achra or "Other Side" in Kabbalistic thought</note>, as it is written:
> A thousand shall fall at thy side... (Psalms 91:7)
And as it is written: "Let the saints be joyful in glory... let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand" (Psalms 149:5-6). The removal [of protection] shall not surround them, and they shall have no power to execute judgment upon them.
Rabbi Hezekiah said: Three times he began to curse and to cast spells of sorcery <term>Charashin: occult practices or "silent" magic</term>, yet Israel was blessed three times.
Rabbi Hiyya said: Correspondingly, Israel is blessed three times when they go up to appear before the Holy King <note>A reference to the three pilgrimage festivals</note>.

**And when** Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments <term>Nechashim: omens or divinations</term>, etc. (Numbers 24:1).
What is meant by "to seek for enchantments"?
Rabbi Yose said: For this reason, the first two times he went with all his sorceries and sought to speak and to curse Israel. When the Holy One, blessed be He, saw his desire, He said: "It is good for Balak that he spoke to you; they do not need a word from him." And from below, what was prepared? As it is written: "And thus shall you speak."
"Thus shall you speak" <note>original: "Koh tedaber"</note> and not otherwise. "Thus shall you speak" refers to the power that rules over all rulers, sorceries, divinations, and evil kinds, so that they cannot damage him.
Come and see: that wicked man, whenever he looked at Israel, he looked at two levels—Jacob and Israel—to damage them either in this one or in that one through sorcery. Because of this, every single blessing blessed both Jacob and Israel.
"And Balaam saw that it was good..." How did he see? He saw that when the King is destined to cover His throne, the evil kinds cannot remain in their existence, and all sorceries and divinations do not succeed.
Come and see: twice it is written "And God met" and "And the Lord met Balaam" (Numbers 23:4, 16).
And it is written: "And thus shall you speak." But now, since he saw that no Divine wrath was found and his sorceries did not succeed, then "he went not as at other times."
Once he separated and removed himself from his sorceries, he was forced to see... and he rested from trying to damage Israel.
What was the awakening here?
Rabbi Eleazar said: "God" <note>Elohim</note> and not "the spirit of the Lord," but rather a spirit from the left side <note>The side of Judgment</note> which is called "the depths" for those kinds of sorceries of his.
Rabbi Levi said: He stirred up this exchange of exchanges, and the Holy Spirit did not rest upon him.
Rabbi Yose said: If so, is it not written: "And the spirit of God came upon him" (Numbers 24:2)? And in all those other times it is not written so!
Rabbi Hezekiah said: It is stated plainly. Come and see, it is written:
> He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed... (Proverbs 22:9)
Do not read it as "shall be blessed" <note>yevorach</note> but as "shall bless" <note>yevarech</note>. And Balaam had an evil eye; there was no one with an evil eye in the world like him. For every place he looked with his eyes was cursed. For this reason, when a person sees a traveler in the wilderness or a person from the west, he covers his head with a cloth so that the [evil] eye cannot dominate him.
So too here, when Balaam saw that he could not damage Israel with his sorceries and divinations, he sought to look at them with an evil eye, because every place he looked with his evil eyes was cursed.
Furthermore, what is written? "And he lifted up"—he lifted his desire against Israel. It is written: "He set his face toward the wilderness," as the translation <note>The Aramaic Targum</note> explains: in order to have a side of assistance to damage them.
The Holy One, blessed be He, saw what was written: "And Balaam lifted up his eyes and saw Israel."
Since God saw his intent was to destroy them by the gaze of his eyes, the Holy One, blessed be He, immediately gave protection to Israel at that moment. This is what is written: "And the spirit of God came upon him"—it was *upon* him <note>meaning, God's presence hovered over Israel as a shield against his gaze</note>!
And the wicked man was like one who spreads a cloth over his head during the day so that the change of these things—the lion and the donkey—cannot rule over them.
> How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob (Numbers 24:5)
Come and see: anyone who wishes to cast an evil eye cannot do so unless he first praises and honors the thing he wishes to curse with the evil eye. And what are the sorceries? He says: "See how good this is, how many children he was given," so that the evil eye may rule over it.
So too here, he said: "How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob," how beautiful they are, how [great] they are...

## Main Text (Zohar)

Those forms of worship involve many surrounding laws to occupy themselves with, which are prepared for those branches <note>spiritual offshoots or lower powers</note> that carry the desire for the "Voice in the Garden of Eden." Who can see those branches that are found among those hidden kings?

**And he took up** his parable <note>original: *vayasol mos melanov* - a corruption of *vaysa meshalo*</note> regarding a man who has knowledge of books and comes to show another man who is found in the field. To look at those hands <note>perhaps referring to palmistry or manual signs</note> that are busy surrounding them with praise, he said: "How wonderful they are, how graceful are those who occupy themselves with the crown of wine from the side of the Supernal Crown." Who has seen such graceful hands among the precious wise men, clothed in precious garments, whose translation is like a house to look into, and they are placed in the Ark of the Covenant? Thus Balaam tried to find what goodness was in them. See how many surroundings, how much grace, etc.

Afterward, **he took up his parable** and said: "Do not delay in the drop of fruit <note>metaphor for seed/lineage</note>, for this is like a hammer to the Torah..." from those who provide shade. By the will of the Waters, for all this did not happen by chance; the Holy Spirit rested upon them. God is not a man that He should lie <note>Numbers 23:19</note>; the wicked cannot deny Your eyes. Behold, the holiness is spread over them. Then he said: **God brings them out of Egypt...** <note>Numbers 23:22</note>. All the people of the world cannot deny them, for a mighty supernal strength protects them and strikes their enemies. And it is written:

> <note>Numbers 23:22</note> God brings them out of Egypt; He has as it were the lofty horns of the wild ox.

For a man cannot raise his hand against them because of their height. It is found that regarding them, all the nations are as nothing, and there is no one who can deny them. Even the smallest power cannot stand against them. **He couched, he lay down as a lion.** He does not fear, because he is found to be a mighty one like a lion, and with strength to fall upon all those children of the nations. He crouched among them and lay down like a lion, and he is found within the laws of the Torah and the carvings of the Torah. And even so, the other nations have no dominion or freedom over them, for even the whole world cannot uproot them. As it is written:

> <note>Numbers 24:9</note> He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a lioness; who shall stir him up?

They cannot make him rise from his prey. **He couched, he lay down as a lion, etc.** This is not found in the world—to deny the Wicked One <note>Balaam</note>. For at first, he was jealous of what was found in Egypt, and by his hand, he bound a knot against Israel so they would never leave their labor. This is the meaning of "who can deny them," for all their labor was intended so they would never leave their servitude for eternity. But **God brings them out of Egypt**, and against Him, the wise men and sorcerers of the world have no power.

***

**And now,** behold, I go unto my people, etc. Rabbi Judah opened: *Thou shalt not deliver unto his master a servant... he shall dwell with thee, in thy midst.* How beloved are the words of the Torah! How beloved is the Torah before the Holy One, blessed be He! For the Holy One, blessed be He, gives merit through it. Come and see: at the time they left Egypt, Balaam heard that the locks and the knots and all those bindings did not succeed against them. He went to the **Mountains of Darkness** <note>original: *turi chashoka*</note> and reached those **iron chains** <note>original: *salsalai de-parzla*</note>.

And so it was, he reached the words of those who arrived there. When a man enters the recesses of the mountains, he sees a flame <note>or "goat"</note> that is the brother of the one who was sacrificed. Immediately he speaks to it, and then a voice goes out and there gather to him great **serpents** <note>original: *chavayan*</note> that are refined, and they are called the "Arrangers of Wisdom," and they wake up to face the man.

And come and see: its beauty and its head are like the head of a serpent, and it has two tails. It strikes and approaches, and it wakes the man who sees it. He opens his lips and brings a specific incense, holding a **white rooster** <note>original: *tarnegola chivvara*</note>. He throws it before her, and he subdues their strength until he reaches the head of the chains. He strikes the head of the chains like a sword and reaches the abyss. And there in the abyss, one is supported, and he is like an eye in the abyss. He opens and looks, and immediately the head of the chains is bound. When the man reaches the head of the chains, he kicks it three times, and they call to him. Then he bows and prostrates on his knees and closes his eyes until he reaches them. Then he sits before them, and all those serpents surround him... he opens his eyes and sees them... and he falls on his face and draws near to them. Afterward, they hand over to him the roots and the sorceries, and he sits...

<meta>This page continues the discourse on Parashat Balak, focusing on the mystical interpretation of Balaam’s prophecies. It transitions from the failure of Balaam’s sorcery to a detailed eschatological vision of the Messianic era and the celestial signs accompanying it.</meta>

# Balak

## Main Text (Zohar)

Twenty times all the appointed ministers and leaders prepared to go their way with that wisdom, and all those beasts stood before him because he emerged from the mountains. Among them was that mighty serpent that swallows all the brains within them; he performed a word of sorcery upon them and transformed himself into a mountain-like form with them. He sought to accuse them and turn them backward, but the Holy One, Blessed be He, restrained them all and ruined all the wisdom that was upon him. All the sorceries of the world could not draw near to them. And this is what happened now: once Balaam saw that he could not harm Israel, he turned back and resembled them, and they stood before Balak—things he did not wish to say—in order to reassure them. His counsel was like the beasts and the strength of Midian, who are beautiful, and the tinkling of the bells that fly and do not rest. And know that it is written: ->"So says the Lord of Hosts: O my people... be not afraid of Assyria"<- <note>Cf. Isaiah 10:24</note>. Since his counsel was dark and confused, he said, "Behold, I shall cast myself down; in your own pit you shall fall." What did that King who rules over all sorceries do? He appeared before him as the wing of a bride, etc. They have no authority for a distant time. What was the secret of the counsel? From where do we say this? From here: that he arose against him and established a path of stumbling, and said, "From that which I live for tomorrow," so that the words would not be fulfilled regarding him (another version: <note>other books</note> so that the words *would* be fulfilled regarding him) in the Supernal Knowledge, in freedom.

**I see him,** but not now; for behold, these words—some of them were not to be fulfilled at that time, and some of them are for later, and their time is in the time of the King Messiah. We have learned: The Holy One, Blessed be He <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu"</note> is destined to rebuild Jerusalem and to establish one fixed star, sparkling with colors like runners, and it will emit sparks of light, glowing from it in the firmament. Seventy stars will gaze upon it and be consumed, and it will shine and blaze for seventy days. On the seventh day, it will be seen for all the days of the lower month, and it will be gathered into the seventh corner at the end of seventy days. At first, it will be seen in the city of Rome <note>original: "Romi"</note>, and on that day, three high walls of that city shall fall, and a great palace shall fall, and the ruler of that city shall die. Then that star shall spread out to be seen in the world. At that time, mighty wars shall be stirred up in the world on all four sides, and faith will not be found among them. In the middle of the world, when that star shines in the middle of the firmament, a single great King shall arise and rule the world, and his spirit shall shine over all kings. He will stir up wars on two sides and prevail over them (at the time that was prophesied (another version: that will be prophesied) regarding the star). The holy earth—these are its surroundings for the hill that was like the Sanctuary, and one cave from beneath the earth. From that cave shall emerge a mighty fire to burn the world. From that cave shall grow a single great, supernal bird (another version: branch) that shall rule over all the world, and to it shall be given the kingdom. The holy supreme ones shall gather, and then the King Messiah shall be revealed to all the world, and to it shall be given the kingdom. Just as it is revealed, they shall be found in distress after distress, and the enemies of Israel shall prevail. Then the spirit of the Messiah shall be stirred up against them, and he shall destroy the serpent and all the land that is crowned and honored like Syria. Then it is written: ->"And Israel shall do valiantly"<- <note>Numbers 24:18</note>. The dream arose and trampled, and Seir shall be a possession for his enemies—those who sinned—and then "And Israel shall do valiantly." At that time, the Holy One, Blessed be He, shall arise to revive His people, and death shall be hidden by the right hand of the Lord <note>original: "Hashem"</note> with strength to give life, for it is to live. And then ->"And the Lord shall be King"<- <note>Zechariah 14:9</note> and it is written: ->"And saviors shall ascend, etc."<- <note>Obadiah 1:21</note>. See what is written: "For as the rod shall rest," etc. Rather, when Israel emerges from exile, the Shekhinah <note>the Divine Presence</note> emerges with them, and with her they shall go out. It shall be like the death of the rod; the Holy One, Blessed be He, shall guide her. Rabbi Isaac said: This is the Tzadik <note>the Righteous One/the sefirah of Yesod</note>, for he guides and the opening is established in her. To Rabbi Shimon: The Tzadik is the investigator, and from the day that it was doubled in exile, blessings shall not depart. The King comes to the world from this Tzadik. At that time, what is written? "And you shall draw water with joy"—this is the Tzadik—"from the springs of salvation"—these are Father and Mother <note>Hokhmah and Binah</note>. Another explanation <note>original: "Davar Acher"</note>: The window is great and a voice and the bride are seen in deep desires then, and that length of the Lord shall not fail, etc. They led and judged and the Sabbath was established, etc. All of them, and they shall be sent.

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Portion of Pinechas**<-

---

**And He Spoke**—The Lord spoke to Moses, saying: "Pinechas the son of Eleazar..." <note>Numbers 25:10-11</note> Rabbi Eleazar opened the discussion and said: *“Hear, my son, the instruction of your father, and do not forsake the teaching of your mother.”* <note>Proverbs 1:8</note> "Hear, my son, the instruction of your father"—this refers to the **Holy One, blessed be He**. "And do not forsake the teaching of your mother"—this refers to the **Assembly of Israel** <note>The Shekhinah, the Divine Presence</note>. What is "the instruction of your father"? This instruction is the **Torah**, which contains many rebukes and many punishments... and one should not erase or fail to rectify through repentance. For anyone who exerts themselves in the study of Torah, it is as if the world... for many gates are opened for them in that world <note>the afterlife</note>. Just as they study with the proper flavor <note>understanding</note>, so too the gates of that world bend before them. For such a person, they announce at all the gates, saying: "Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter."

For they have established in the secrets of the King's service that there is no joy for the **Holy One, blessed be He**, like a person who exerts themselves in the Torah. When a person awakens at night to exert themselves in the Torah, all the righteous in the **Garden of Eden** <note>Paradise</note> listen to their voice, and the **Holy One, blessed be He**, is found among them, as we have established: *“You who sit in the gardens, companions listen for your voice; let me hear it.”* <note>Song of Songs 8:13</note> Rabbi [Eleazar] said: This verse contains the spirit of wisdom. "You who sit in the gardens" refers to the **Assembly of Israel**, who is in exile with Israel and goes with them in their distress. "Companions listen for your voice"—these are the upper hosts <note>angels</note>, who all listen to your voice, the voice of praise from the exile. "Let me hear it"—as a bride, "show me your appearance, let me hear your voice." Let me hear the voice of those companions who exert themselves in the Torah.

Rabbi said: As it were, all those who merit to exert themselves in the Torah and perform their service at midnight are united with the **Matronita** <note>The Queen/Shekhinah</note> when the day shines, to receive the face of the King and to be strengthened by His possessions. Not only that, but a thread of **Grace** <note>original: *Chesed*</note> is stretched over them, as we have established. If anyone merits below in their possessions and gives of themselves... words of piety to receive those who are their accusers... Therefore, whenever a person causes, as it were, the **Assembly of Israel** to be joined with Him, they protect him... and all merit that there should be warmth for those below and sustenance to exert oneself at this hour. When Pinechas [acted] at that hour, he merited that the **Grace** of Pinechas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the Priest, should rest. "Pinechas, son of Eleazar..." this is what is written: *“The scepter of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot [of the righteous].”* <note>Psalms 125:3</note>

Rabbi Shimon said: This man of whom it is written in the exile... and did not merit to be rectified... the accuser in the truth of the King. And he merited to be close to the Face; that is "shall not rest." And just as it was hidden regarding the root, and because of it a good cup... he was tested as a **completely righteous man** <note>original: *Tzaddik Gamur*</note> in the mold... as we have learned: Who is a "completely righteous man" and who is a "righteous man who is not complete"? One who has not ascended... is a righteous man but not a "completely righteous man." This is known regarding ancient **reincarnations** <note>original: *Gilgulim*</note>, and in his **wisdom** <note>original: *Chokhmah*</note> he builds and fixes mountains, and from it wells, and he planted orchards. He was tested and found to be "complete," for this is according to his wisdom... and enter, for this is the rectification of his preparation as of old, to look into it. And he did not know... to hide what was engraved from his side... and added to it. And so it is for a man who builds a building like sapphires... to see and look upon suffering... a crooked side from all sides... until he destroys it and fixes it as of old from his side; his wisdom is good and beautiful.

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Phinehas <-

From the crown of the Right <note>The Sefirah of Chesed/Mercy</note> he was twisted <note>original: "ve-eikis"</note>, and because of this, the work of the night is not called by the wings of the heart; a "Righteous One" <term>Tzadik: the foundation/Yesod</term> is called a complete support, and until the end, the wicked one emerges from him. Come and see that Phinehas took the first part, for he received the sister <note>referring to the covenant of peace</note> and merited greatness. This Arm <note>original: "derua," referring to the Sefirah of Gevurah/Strength</note> was not seen by him, and the Levite erred and took it. Phinehas was not seen in it at that time, but because he received the blood of the banned <note>the sinners Zimri and Cozbi</note>, he profited for all and ascended above all, and everything was mended through him, and he merited to be found as a High Priest. From that error, the priest was thus, and Eleazar was thus, and they are the priests who burn for the two, because he received the blood of the banned which mended that which was twisted.

**Rabbi Yehuda** opened: "Preserve my soul, for I am pious; save Your servant..." <note>Psalms 86:2</note>. The end of the verse must be examined, and then the whole verse. At the end of the verse it is written: "who trusts in You" <note>original: "haboteach elecha"</note>; it should have said "trusts in You" <note>original: "becha"</note>. What is "trusts *to* You"? Rather, as it were, David trusts Him so that his portion shall not pass from his belly, as it is written: "the vision of the wait," and He gave the engraving to thank You. "I arose" should have been said, but rather "to arise for eternity." "Preserve my soul"—it should have said "Preserve!" <note>imperative</note>. But we have learned that there is no choice that does not contain high and precious mysteries. "Preserve" refers to the receiving; he said "preserve" for that portion to which he is attached. For when the soul <note>original: "kafat"</note> departs from this world, if it is worthy, many high hosts go out to meet it, to crown it and bring it into the dwelling place of its location. It bathes in the river of light to be united with You. But if it is not worthy, many "officers of destruction" <note>angels of punishment</note> are ready to meet it, and it finds no rest outside. Woe to that soul that rolls around like a stone in a sling, as it is said: "and the souls of your enemies, He shall sling them out as from the hollow of a sling" <note>1 Samuel 25:29</note>. And David sought his prayer before the Holy One, blessed be He: "Preserve my soul," so that they do not push it outside, and when it arrives to be received, they shall open the gates for it and receive it before You.

"For I am pious" <term>Hasid: one who acts with loving-kindness/Chesed</term>—and is he called pious? Rabbi Yehuda said: Grace <note>original: "Chen"</note> is as it is written: "the sure mercies <note>Chasdei</note> of David." Because of this, "preserve my soul" so that it does not feel shame by going outside.

**Rabbi Isaac** said: Every son of man who has a portion in the Righteous One <term>Tzadik</term> inherits that land, as it is written: "And your people are all righteous..." <note>Isaiah 60:21</note>. And the life of the Righteous is called "Pious" <term>Hasid</term>. David saw that after he said he was a "Pious One," he said "I am pious." And because of this, "preserve my soul" to be bound to You.

**Rabbi Hiyya** opened: "He ordained it in Joseph for a testimony..." <note>Psalms 81:6</note>. The letter *He* was added <note>changing "Yosef" to "Yehosef"</note> because he resisted the sin of the woman. And the Holy Tongue <note>Hebrew</note> was added to him: "I heard a language I knew not." We learned: the *He* is a testimony. Come and see: at the hour when Potiphar's wife tried to seize him for that matter, Joseph made himself as one who did not know her language, and so every time, until the final claim came, as it is written: "And she caught him by his garment..." <note>Genesis 39:12</note>. She caught him because he made himself as one who did not know the language. And the Holy Spirit cries out toward her: "To keep you from the strange woman, from the alien who flatters with her words" <note>Proverbs 7:5</note>. What is the voice? Every word that a man binds himself with to be attached to the Shekhinah <term>The Divine Presence</term>, he merits the cup of testimony, and he is called by the name of the Lord, as with Joseph.

**Rabbi Yissa** opened: "By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion" <note>Psalms 137:1</note>. This must be examined; it should have said "as it is written: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning." What is "when we remembered Zion"? Rather, when the Temple was destroyed and the fire was set to it, the elders went into exile. Who is "Zion"? It is the Righteous One <term>Tzadik</term>, as we have established, for it is written: "The righteous perisheth..." <note>Isaiah 57:1</note>. "When we remembered Zion"—when we remembered him and his value, we wept. Rabbi Yissa said: Because Joseph guarded the covenant <note>sexual purity</note>, he merited that he was honored with a rank above all, as it is written: "And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him..." and it is written: "and he set him over all the land of Egypt."

<meta>This page continues the discourse on the portion of Pinhas, specifically addressing the transformation of Pinhas’s soul and the mystical nature of the priestly garments as discussed in the Zohar.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

And not only that, but when Israel crossed the Arnon stream as they did previously, the waters did not remain in their usual state before the Holy One, Blessed be He, as it is written: *The wicked are like the troubled sea* <note>original: "היש רפש"; the text applies Isaiah 57:20 homiletically to describe spiritual turbulence</note> which requires healing, as it is written: *When the enemy comes in like a flood...* <note>Isaiah 59:19</note> the deep, and so on. Come and see: is it for honor? It is seen as death, because they saw death; and for one who did not wish to cling to it, it is written "and death." And he said to them in weeping and crushing, for their records were few for the future to be with them. Because of this, all the houses of the world, since it is written *and they shall be sanctified before Him* and it is written *and he rose and there was laughter,* so was he crowned above near the supernal Veil <note>The *Parokhet*, a mystical barrier between divine realms</note>, and the elders below placed their hands upon the master of the worlds, and this one took his portion in the other world. **Pinhas** merited in this world and merited in the world to come, and he merited to endure more than all those who went out from Egypt. He merited the supernal priesthood <note>The OCR reads "כספא" (silver/money), but the context and Rashi script suggest "כהנתא" (priesthood)</note>, he and all his sons and their crowns. And you might say that he did not merit the priesthood until he performed this act? See, there are those who say he did not merit it prior to this. However, as we have established, "under" implies he received it as a reward, meaning that through this act he gained a priesthood that he did not have before. Come and see: any priest who kills a soul disqualifies his priesthood forever. Why is he certainly disqualified? Because he is of the level of Prophecy <note>The text likely refers to the Sefirah of *Chesed* (Mercy/Kindness), which is the root of the priesthood; killing invokes *Gevurah* (Judgment), which is antithetical to the priest's nature</note>. And Pinhas, by law, should have been disqualified from the priesthood [for killing Zimri], but because he was zealous for the Holy One, Blessed be He, it was necessary to add to him an eternal priesthood, for him and his sons and their crowns for all generations. Rabbi Isaac said: Come and see, Pinhas is a mystery above and a mystery below, for even before he went out into the world, he was counted with those who went out from Egypt. Rabbi Eleazar, Rabbi Yose, and Rabbi Hiyya were walking in the desert. Rabbi Yose said: It is written:
> Behold, I give to him My covenant of peace <note>Numbers 25:12</note>
"Peace" from the Angel of Death, so that he should never have power over him and he should not be judged by his judgments. And if you say that he did not die and did not see death—in truth, he passed from the world and returned to it throughout all generations, because this supernal covenant was grasped by him. And when his physical existence departed, his supernal form and his beautiful image remained to depart from the rest of the people of the world. Rabbi Eleazar opened and said:
> And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid [his hands upon him] <note>Deuteronomy 34:9</note>
Before the King, the Lord, and so on. Come and see: woe to the wicked who do not look upon the glory of their Master! Every single day a herald calls out to them, but they do not pay attention. If a man comes to look into the commandments of the Torah, many advocates stand to mention him for good. If a man comes and transgresses the commandments of the Torah, they act as accusers against him for evil before the Holy One, Blessed be He. Joshua was a High Priest <note>Referring here to Joshua son of Jehozadak from the book of Zechariah, not Joshua son of Nun</note>, and to establish him, what is written of him?
> And Satan stood at his right hand to accuse him <note>Zechariah 3:1</note>
And if it was so for this righteous one, how much more so for the rest of the people of the world who do not look to their Master. Before this, what is written?
> Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments <note>Zechariah 3:3</note>
To establish him. But these <term>garments</term> <note>original: "כנדיס" (Kandys); a Persian-style robe or tunic</note> are certainly the spiritual garments in which the soul is clothed in that world. This is to clarify that for all who wish to enter the Garden [of Eden], there are royal garments for them. How are they? As it is written here:
> Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments and stood before the angel <note>Zechariah 3:3</note>
Who is this angel? This is the angel appointed over Gehenna <note>Purgatory/Hell</note>, who is in charge of whoever falls into his hands to be judged, until it is said: "Take off the filthy garments <note>original: "הכנדיס הטנלוס"; likely a corruption of "the impure robes"</note> from him." From here we see that the deeds of a man create for him those repulsive garments. And he said to him:
> Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with festal robes <note>Zechariah 3:4</note>
These are <term>other coverings</term> <note>original: "אלטימיס"; possibly from the Greek 'stole' or 'himation', meaning fine robes</note> that are prepared, through which a man gazes at the radiance of the glory of his Master. Come and see this prophecy: Pinhas did not depart from the world until the merits of Aaron were prepared before him, through which he ascended to the world to come.

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Pinchas <-

Who comes with goodness; this is the sealing of life, and all are gathered to be sustained, as it is written <note>Numbers 25:12</note> **"Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace."** While they were walking, the sun grew strong, and they sat beneath the shade of a rock. As they remembered [the teachings], Rabbi Eleazar said: "Certainly, the Bride <note>The Shekhinah, the Divine Presence</note> is the joy of the soul."

**Rabbi** Hiyya said to Rabbi Eleazar: "These days from Rosh Hashanah until Yom Kippur—all of them are a burden <note>original: "tarcha"; referring to the spiritual labor and judgment of the season</note>, for so we must stand during them." Rabbi Eleazar said: "It has been discussed, and a heavenly proclamation has awakened interest in it." Rabbi Hiyya said: "Certainly it is so, for I have heard a holy, supernal fragrance regarding this matter." He said to him: "Speak that word." He replied: "I have not yet fully stood upon its meaning." Rabbi Eleazar said: "Even though the companions have established the matter—and it is well—the secret of wisdom regarding the dwelling of these days is hidden among the nests <note>referring to deep mystical chambers</note>." He opened his discourse and said: "Metatron <note>The Prince of the Countenance</note> is the sign of His holy arm; this is the one Arm through which salvation is extended, upon which the resurrection depends, and upon which the divine visitation depends. And why? To raise the Assembly of Israel <note>The Shekhinah</note> from her dust and to receive her into her Prophet <note>The masculine divine aspect</note> to unite as one. And when He rises, He awakens to receive her. Since they [the world] dwell in the world under judgment, that Arm is placed under the head to connect, as you say <note>Song of Songs 2:6</note> **'His left hand is under my head.'** Then the judgment is quieted and sins are atoned. Afterward, the Right hand comes to embrace; then joy dwells in the world and all faces shine. Afterward, there is a union in the Body <note>The central pillar/Tiferet</note>, and then everything is called 'One' without separation. Then is the perfection of all and the joy of all—and certainly, this is not found at other times in the same way as these days from Rosh Hashanah until the final day of the Festival <note>Sukkot/Shemini Atzeret</note>. This is the secret of the verse: the Arm awakens and moves to receive the Matronita <note>The Queen/Shekhinah</note>. Then the whole world is in a state of laughter/rejoicing, and it requires oversight and words of complete repentance <note>term: Teshuvah; returning to the Divine source</note> to be found with Him before the Holy One, blessed be He. Afterward, the Matronita prepares herself, and the children of the Palace <note>The Jewish people</note> are required on the ninth of the month <note>Erev Yom Kippur</note> to make joy and to immerse like an eagle to purify themselves, just as the Matronita does. On the following day <note>Yom Kippur</note>, her union stands in the manner of the beginning, 'under the head,' as you say: 'His left hand is under my head.' Then Israel is in a fast for all their sins, and she atones for them, for the Supernal Mother <note>Binah</note> is the clarity of atonement for the Matronita during the union, and all the children of the Palace are atoned. Since the Left receives her on this day, and the spirit of the Matronita is upon the Left, on the first day of the Festival <note>Sukkot</note> the Right awakens to receive her in order to embrace. Then all is joy and all faces shine, and the waters are poured out <note>The water libation</note> upon the Altar. All people must rejoice at all times of the festival, for the Right spreads to every place where joy dwells, to take delight. Afterward, on the eighth day <note>Shemini Atzeret/Simchat Torah</note>, it is the Joy of the Torah, for then is the union of the Body, the union of all, so that all becomes One. This is the perfection of all, and this day belongs to Israel specifically; they have their own intimacy in which no other [nation] has a portion. Regarding all of Israel in this world and the world to come, it is written <note>Deuteronomy 14:2</note> **'For you are a holy people to the Lord your God'** etc."

**Pinchas** son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, turned back My wrath from the children of Israel, etc. Rabbi Judah opened his discourse: "Remember..." <note>The text here transitions into a discussion of the covenant and the protection of the 'sign' of the covenant (circumcision)</note> Who is it that rises... and covers... for those who guard the blessing and remember the Covenant, because this is the established holy covenant that the Holy One, blessed be He, renews.

## Main Text (Zohar)

**Right Column:**

Rabbi Yose said: The rainbow appears below to manifest to the world that whenever the "Throne" <note>referring to the people or the lower realm</note> sins against the King, and the King intends to deal harshly with it, the <term>Matronita</term> <note>The Shekhinah, the Divine Presence, depicted here as a Queen or Noble Lady</note> appears before Him in the precious garments of the King. And in a time when there is a righteous man in the world, he serves as the Covenant; for his sake, the Covenant stands and there is favor upon the world. If there is no righteous man, then the rainbow appears, for the world stands to be reproved, were it not for this rainbow. 

Rabbi Eleazar said: This rainbow is never found except in garments that appear before Him in green, red, and white. 
**Green** is the garment of Abraham, which was found (some say: this color) when Ishmael emerged from him. 
**Red** is the color of Isaac, who took hold of the red, and it was found when Esau emerged from him; that redness was then absorbed below until the planet Mars, to be seen in his face. 
**White** is the garment of Jacob, for in him no shame was ever found. 

Rabbi Abba said: "And He is the life of all," referring to the holy intentions. 
**White** is the paleness of the lower realm, like white in fire. 
**Red** is certainly Isaac.

And in the manner of the double, the voice is doubled for him; all his doubling is the doubling of **Understanding (Binah)**. For him is the place of awakening in shame and in the building of which it was said: "Understanding is the voice that raises the fallen booth of David" <note>Amos 9:11</note> in the doubling. And she took with her sixty, like the **Kingdom (Malkhut)** <note>The lowest Sephirah, associated with the physical realm and the community of Israel</note> which are the cities, like the harp of the paths of the "Shema" prayer. And they are opposite the side of his tractate, and "bones without number"—these are the "maidens following her," her companions, which are the Laws <note>Halakhot</note> that have no number. And the double voice is for him, so shall it be for him within the 'K' of Binah, which is the Name <note>original: "יה'"</note> cut. And from ten, the 'V' is for him doubled within the capital which is below, like a husband from the heavens, a light voice, thus he returns. And it is called "double," and not in all, and not a doubler, because in it is the Name <note>original: "יה'"</note> and he died in the nest toward the 'H' 'H' <note>The two letters Heh of the Tetragrammaton</note> of which it was said: "And the ancient law," this first one of which it is written "a window rising from the First House," and the second from the Second House, to be for them a drink.

And its taste is like the accents <note>musical notations for chanting Torah</note> and the Torah is like carobs <note>referring to the poverty of the sages who lived on carobs</note>. And they were forgotten by the word, and why is it called "by the soul"? In exchange for the acceptance of Kindness <term>Chesed: the attribute of loving-kindness</term>... the King said to the Lady... and the standing of Jethro, whose name was called Keni <note>the Kenite</note>... **He stood** in the holy days and said: regarding this it is written, "I have acquired a man with the Lord" <note>Genesis 4:1</note>, a hint to this in the heights of holiness...

And for this, Rabbi Elazar <note>Rabbi Elazar ben Pedat</note> was in great distress, the reason being that he had no mouth <note>sustenance</note> but a measure of carobs from Sabbath eve to Sabbath eve, like all the beloved of my people. Before him, a Heavenly Voice <note>Bat Kol</note> went out and said: "The entire world is nourished only for the sake of Hanina my son, yet Hanina my son is satisfied with a measure of carobs from Sabbath eve to Sabbath eve." <note>A famous Talmudic quote regarding Rabbi Hanina ben Dosa's poverty and merit</note>.

And those who do not know this secret say: "Children, life, and sustenance <note>original: *Bane, Chaye, u-Mezone*</note> do not depend on merit, but rather depend on the Constellation <term>Mazal: the astrological influence or 'flow' from above</term>." But this Constellation is to be sweetened, for the Constellation is like a flow that was not destined to show him mercy... as it is written, "And He brought him outside" <note>Genesis 15:5</note>. And the explanation given to him was: "In this world, by the merit of your grandfather," and He raised him above the stars...

Until here for the Rabbis, and it must be explained in the straight path. Come and see: all the creatures of the world, before the Torah was given to Israel, were dependent on the Constellation <note>Mazal</note>, even "children, life, and sustenance." But after the Torah was given to Israel, He removed them from the obligation of the stars and constellations. And this is to be learned from Abraham, because he was given the prophecy to receive the holiness... it is said of him "These are the generations of the heaven and the earth when they were created" <note>Hebrew: *Be-hibare'am*</note>, which the sages read as "For Abraham" <note>Hebrew: *Be-Abraham*</note>. He said to Abraham: "Because the Torah is to be strengthened, the heavens are beneath you, and all the stars and constellations are beneath your feet... for in Isaac shall your seed be called."

And because of this, anyone who toils in the Torah, the obligation of the stars and constellations is nullified from him. But the common people <note>Am Ha'aretz</note>, who are liable... the obligation of the stars and constellations is not nullified from them... according to the power of the *Categorim* <note>prosecuting angels</note>... and it is said of him, "I have been young and now am old" <note>Psalm 37:25</note>, and afterwards it will be good for the Most High Lord... to comfort them as at first in the side of Kindness <note>Chesed</note>...

And this is the secret of receiving every day continually the Work of Creation... and they are sanctified in all times. The will of the step and the radiance... he won the Torah... and wine has two colors, white and red, representing Kindness and Mercy... the white from the side of the Right <note>Chesed</note> and the red from the side of the Left <note>Gevurah/Judgment</note>... the heart is given to the heart... the "Heart" <note>Hebrew: *Lev*, numerical value 32</note> of the Work of Creation, from the *Bet* of *Bereshit* <note>In the beginning</note> to the *Lamed* of *L'eyni kol Yisrael* <note>In the eyes of all Israel</note>, the heart in its calculation... these are the seven days of creation... what is the Book of Creation with this "Book of the Generations of Adam"... to receive the presence...

## Main Text (Zohar)

Thousands of times he spreads to the half, a starling of the Lord, and four wings of the mountain and the moon of Nabrazal and the radiance of the Lord, thirty thousand of the mountain and the moon and the radiance of the Lord, and the radiance is with them under the <term>appointment</term><note>Hebrew: *pekudah*, referring to divine supervision or counting</note> of the levels for three thousand. And the Rabbis established that every nest of the hidden ones rises in the rows to the darkness, and the radiance of the King, the King who shall reign.

**Rabbi** Shimon was sitting and laboring over this Torah portion. His son, Rabbi Eleazar, came before him. He said to him: When a wise man strikes at their work, he is like a living Pinchas. It is well that Pinchas was not in the world when they died <note>referring to the deaths of Nadab and Abihu</note> and the Crown came into the world and their merit was divided. Is it not so that Pinchas was in the world and took a double portion? He said to him: In this secret, a voice and a vision exist, for at the time they were swallowed up from the world, they were not protected under the wings of the **Holy Shekhinah** <note>The Divine Presence, often depicted as a feminine protective wing</note>. Why? Because it is written that they had no covering to see the image of the King, for there was nothing to be found in the High Priest like the consciousness that was before Pinchas regarding the <term>Holy Covenant</term><note>Hebrew: *Brit Kodesh*, referring to the sign of circumcision and the spiritual purity associated with it</note>. He went among many thousands and rebuked the angry ones upon the spear for all of Israel. And the praise of Shimon was among many thousands to bring the spark; his soul flew from him, and two souls that were naked without a memorial approached it and were included as one. His soul was returned as a crown, a spirit to be included within two spirits, and they were strengthened in him. Then his merit increased to stand as a great witness, which had not been seen from before. And he entered into a line where no future priest was found, and his spirit was not cruel; every spark that was false and changed shall bloom like a window. These are the sons of Aaron who shall return to the world, that which was lost in his lifetime. And concerning this, it is written of him: "Pinchas son of Eleazar," and "the sons of Pinchas son of Eleazar," and so on. What is written above this portion? And He said:
> And the Lord said to Moses: Take all the heads of the people and hang them up before the Lord against the sun <note>Numbers 25:4</note>
And so on, because they killed the living crown, because they killed in the days of darkness, it is written "against the sun." Rabbi Judah said: Their death should be in the open, just as they sinned in the open. Rabbi Shimon said: It was not said for that reason, but from here we learn that in the level of "What," a man must perform a rectification for his soul corresponding to this place. These are those who are in the **Holy Covenant**, which is called "Sun." For this reason, the judgment and the rectification are "against the sun" and not in any other place. A man does not need to rectify from a priest in a simple way, but rather in that place where he sinned against it. And whoever does not do so has no proper rectification for eternity. Rabbi Hiyya opened:
"The trees of the Lord are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon which He planted." What is written above? "And wine gladdens the heart of man," and so on. And how does this relate to that? Rather, thus we have learned, as it is written: "He causes the grass to grow for the cattle," and so on. Is it the folly of the beast that brings it down? Rather, it comes to say in the **Holy Spirit**: here He causes the grass to grow, and these wise ones are simple, instead of the spirit that licks the dew to be blessed on the second day of Creation, and all of it comes from below. These are the grass, they were profaned and returned, because they go out in this return in the world, and every single day they are brought near now, and afterwards they descend and return as before. And concerning this, it is written: "He causes the grass to grow for the cattle." This "He knows" is precise as the judgment of his beast, and we have established that a thousand mountains rise for her every single day, and every single mountain provides the spirit of life, and it is food and grass for the labor of the child. These are the **souls of the righteous** who are here, for He rides and rules over this beast, eating and profaning them within it. And by their merit, the whole world comes from that Man of whom it is written:
> And upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man <note>Ezekiel 1:26</note>
And so on. And concerning this, it is written "the child," that which is known in order to give you bread from the earth, to bring forth nourishment to the world from the Holy Land. And this "Wine" is the ancient wine that flows from above:
> And gladdens the heart of man <note>Psalms 104:15</note>
"Man" <note>original: *Enosh*</note>—this is the spirit of that body which ascends.

**[Right Column]**

And from the strength of the body of the *Other Side* <note>original: "Sitra Achra," the realm of evil or impurity</note>, we consider regarding the altar that was built as a single female principle for the altar to strike. For at every hour that the sins of the guilty are present in the world and judgment dwells in the world, the righteous among them are seized on their behalf. For so we have learned: it is written that the holy ones and the damaged are seized for the sickness of the living, because they provide rebuke to the world for their actions. How many are there who rebuke but the world does not accept the rebuke? And the righteous humble themselves before them. And because they did not restrain the judgments upon the world, they shall not die nor be seized for their own sins, for there is joy for the righteous in their connection. Heaven forbid <note>original: "Chas v'Shalom"</note> as a proof that the righteous are removed from the generation. And it is an even greater logical inference <note>original: "Kal v'Chomer"</note> that at every hour that the righteous are seized with illnesses or with afflictions in order to atone for the world, then all the sins of the generation are atoned for. From where do we know this? From all the limbs of the body: at a time when all the limbs are in distress and a great illness dwells upon them, one limb is struck and beaten so that they all may be healed. And which one is it? The arm. The arm is struck and blood is let from it; then there is healing for all the limbs of the body. So it is also with the world: the inhabitants are limbs to one another. At the time when the <term>Holy One, Blessed be He</term> <note>original: "Kadosh Baruch Hu"</note> wishes to provide healing to the world, He strikes one righteous man with sickness and with suffering, and through him He gives healing to all. From where is this derived? As it is written:
> "But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities... and with his stripes we are healed."
<note>Isaiah 53:5</note>
"With his stripes"—this refers to the let blood, just as when one strikes the arm and there is a wound with blood, it serves as a healing for all the limbs of the body. And the righteous man does not seek to rest, but to provide healing for the generation and to atone for them; his spirit is not tested, yet it is bad for him. For the strength of the *Other Side* seeks to rule over the merit of the righteous more than all else, so that the world cannot stand in judgment, and the holiness does not reach them because of his dominance. And the voice and the power seek to rule over the world and in the world to come. The <term>Righteous</term> <note>original: "Tzadik"</note> and so on...

**[Left Column]**

The Master of the Universe is able to cause the spirit to be included within the Supernal Spirit. See how this is compared to those who make small grafts: they bend the branch and graft it into the branch of another tree because the world is lacking, and it produces fruit, and they are included one in the other and produce fruit. At such a time it is said of him: "The Master of the Universe is able." So too, any good person who dwells in a city of wicked people and they are unable to fulfill the commandments of the <term>Torah</term> <note>original: "Orayta"</note> or to labor in the Torah, he must uproot his dwelling and delay his settling, and seek a place where good neighbors dwell who speak the commandments of the Torah, to seek a place to hold onto it. And when he does not do so, it is written: "For a hanged man is a curse of God," and the commandments of a man are compared to a tree. What is written of it? "Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat, thou shalt destroy and cut them down"—cut down from this world and cut off from the world to come. And because of this, one must be uprooted from a bad place and be planted in a good place among the righteous. Why? So that he is not called "uprooted" or "barren." So too, the Torah is all commandments, so that one is not called barren. And because of this, he should not reside in a place of the "uprooted."
Come and see: they would gather before him and say: "Woe to the world when this one is changed!" Also, the spirit is included in the spirit as if it were a single vessel, and it was included at first. We have a tradition, and now the matter is clarified: it shall be as this day, to rule over the world, to rule over the merit of the righteous more so, and not to stray then from the whole world. For if the generation is guilty, the <term>Holy One, Blessed be He</term> takes the righteous as a pledge for their sins. And the Accuser opens his mouth to prosecute, and the Holy One, Blessed be He says: "The time has come for this." Even so, they act to sacrifice, for there is no water in every pit to be found... and they brought a parable of a shepherd who comes and seeks to strike his world and to consume it. What did that shepherd do? He was wise and understood his Master's strength, and he stood and blessed him, and they were all gathered in his crown, and he sought to rule over his Master's sheep... What did the shepherd do at the time he looked at his Master's place? He looked at the sheep and saw them scattered...

And it is good for him that the <term>Holy One, Blessed be He</term> <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu"</note> does not spare [the righteous] in order to provide atonement for His world. At times, if there were not several righteous people and merits for every living creature... a person suffers from illnesses and plagues and does not see any goodness in the world. So too, when the time of the precious righteous ones in the world arrives, then all the merits of their portion are taken by death for the sake of the entire generation. For as long as their time has not yet fully come, then one righteous person is struck and he shields them all, for the world does not yet need all of them [to die]. <summary>This page discusses the mystical concept of the "Suffering of the Righteous" (Tzidduk HaDin), explaining that a single righteous person's illness can serve as a lightning rod for divine judgment to protect the entire generation. It maps the Patriarchs—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—onto the divine "arms" (Chesed and Gevurah) and the body (Tiferet) to explain how divine mercy and judgment are balanced.</summary>

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Phinehas <-

---

### [Right Column]

Within the supernal whiteness, light is not found upon it for even a moment, and the spirit does not rule there. <note>The "supernal whiteness" refers to a high level of the Sefirot, likely Keter, where light is so unified it cannot be perceived as distinct "rays."</note> It is similar to you, as it is written: *Be silent before the Lord* <note>original: "המחשה לא ית'" - likely a reference to Zephaniah 1:7 or Psalm 37:7</note>. Silence is for you; light is not found for you to trouble it. For once those wicks are extinguished, that light is no longer found and is not produced. The light of power is not for you, and it is not found in its physical manifestation. This is like Israel: when they make use of that light to trouble [the darkness], once it departs from the measure of whiteness, that light does not burn. All of them wait to be calmed; they are moved here and there and to all sides like a flickering lamp. For when a "new soul" is mentioned, it is written as "weak" and "lacking." There, they are called weak and not "vinegar" <note>A metaphor for the souls of the righteous vs. the wicked</note>. The souls of the nations who worship idols are extinguished because the light that troubled them is finished. And the Will is found but they are not calmed, for they have no whiteness and do not burn within it. Their light is a troubled one; they stand like clouds within the force that burns. All the light that troubled them is finished, and all the light is gathered. Rabbi Yose said: This is the clarity of the matter, and these are the portions you have merited to see and to hear.

### [Left Column]

In it, his master Balaam had his vision. <note>A reference to the corrupted prophecy of Balaam</note>. And those seers who gaze at the glass that does not shine <note>A technical term for lower-level prophecy</note> for the Throne, they are in Exile to praise the restoration. The body is bent over them, spreading to every arm and food. Blessed is He who cleanses the vision to see the essence of the brain of all, from which it is drawn. It is as if the drop of the nations is considered as dead. And those seers are rejected; thus Isaac <note>representing the attribute of Gevurah/Judgment</note> laughs at them, at both sides. He is balanced like the children of Esau and Ishmael. The head is heavy upon the body, and it seeks to bring forth two arms. And they are all three levels. When the head rises, it seeks to bring forth the mysteries of the head. These three become a chariot for the Holy King. They are strengthened to eat and are heated to protect the sides of the world. Woe to those who cause their own bones to be struck by the first strength and the "spittle" of their hearts. There is no separation between these; the Righteous One <note>The Sefirah of Yesod</note> is for them. They are like those who long for the secret and the labor, and He will weary them. They are like a thief of the sea. These are the visions that go out from us; they are strange, murky, and soiled by the sea. This is nullified by the transgression and the filth of the tongue. The "foolish head" bears the filth of the tongue and casts it outside. They are found in these garments, purified from the filth like a running horse. They cleanse the heart and need to be cleansed further from here.

---

### [Full Width Text]

The ears and the lobes between them <note>The anatomy of the ear is used here as a map for how Divine "hearing" or reception works</note> are for all who hear. They are like the beard in your powerful deeds, to understand and to be heated over your others in weeping. There is no separation in them to lead them. Bless Him and praise Him, for He is like the secret of the Bow <note>The Rainbow/Shekhinah</note> and His Presence is upon them. Who can stand before Him? Blessed is the portion of those who merit to renew the lamp, to prepare the Shekhinah <note>The Divine Presence</note> in Exile. He supports them here, for all who were not in their merit. The spirit of holiness rests upon you toward His Shekhinah. She runs to be found like Metatron, the Prince of the Presence. Silence for you, for the light of their hint bites. Now we must pass through the five comforts, as they judge to ascend to the output of the assembly's strength in Exile. For it is closed upon him. Afterward, for they have seen the anger, they are conquered to know the nest and the bed of the night in the pulses. There is no one who knows them, for the output of the sickness is not for all heavens to be recognized. For the outputs are killed by the **Kashrak** <note>An acronym for the Shofar sounds: **T**ekiah, **S**hevarim, **T**eruah, **T**ekiah</note>. This is the voice that says to the children: *Like a pregnant woman about to give birth, she writhes and cries out in her pangs* <note>Isaiah 26:17</note>.

And all ten Sefirot are included in the three sounds that are the sign of **Kashrak**: **Shevarim** (Broken sounds), **Teruah** (Tremolo), and **Tekiah** (Long blast). For the Exile is called **Shevarim** (Brokenness). **Teruah** is the outcry of the blow, pressure after pressure, with no space between one and the other. Because of this, it is said that the nations oppress them in Exile; pressure happens to them until the Redemption. So too, they received their pulses one after the other, like the departure of a man's soul when there is no space between one breath and the next. The **Kashrak** sound kills the "Samael" <note>The personification of evil</note>. The voice of the **Tekiah**, **Shevarim**, and **Teruah** passes through the rest of the world toward its children. Everyone who passes through enters the world to his heart.

He lies toward the portion for the soul of the Lord in the depth of the mountains, in a world that is simple, doubled, entangled, complex, attached, and squared. At the end, he ascends there... <unclear>illegible letter sequences</unclear> ... and thus he examines and his name is placed... the pious of man and his likeness, the letter *Vav* which oversees the hidden part before it ascends—the barren woman of the water, for she is like a barren woman and his bride until the hunger and the evening wood are removed... "And you shall know that the Lord has brought you out" etc. "For your servant became surety for the youth" etc. <note>Refers to Exodus 16:6 and Genesis 44:32, linking the Exodus and Judah’s guarantee for Benjamin to the soul's journey.</note>

**Rabbi Isaac opened** with the verse: "A song of ascents. Out of the depths I have called You, O Lord" (Psalms 130:1). How beloved are Israel before the Holy One, Blessed be He <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu"</note>, for they are from the side of the "Above of the Above," a vision of the likeness of the Holy One, Blessed be He. Their merits, their benefits, and their lives are their portion which they bring forth to the Holy One, Blessed be He. And through these merits, all the joy of Israel is supported, so that the Holy One, Blessed be He, does not take pleasure in them [the husks/evil side], but rather their merits provide them with vision, help, joy, and the radiance of the vision. Samael <note>The primary figure of evil/prosecution in Kabbalah</note> and all his company accompany them to prosecute and to invalidate the joy.

And the Holy One, Blessed be He, participates in that opening, as it is written: "In all their affliction, He was afflicted" (Isaiah 63:9). This is seen because "I am with him in distress." And Israel is brought close to the Holy One, Blessed be He, and their merits are seen, as it is written: "Let Israel rejoice in his Makers" <note>original: "be-osav" (plural)</note>. That joy of Israel is a vision for them... for when a man acts in the partnership of male and female, the Holy One, Blessed be He, and this spirit—it is written "Let us make man." As we have learned: the Holy One, Blessed be He, made three wisdoms to oversee the wisdoms of the world, and these are the Right, the Left, and the Spirit. Each one supports the other... Just as on the first day, He brought forth help for His wisdom, as it is written:

> And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light. (Genesis 1:3)

And from the second [day], they brought forth water and wisdom for the work, as it is written:

> And God said, "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters..." (Genesis 1:6)

The waters were divided, half above and half below... and thus the waters were separated in this world. On the third day, the work and the will were to bring forth that which was commanded, as it is written: "And God said, 'Let the earth sprout vegetation...'" and it is written, "And the earth brought forth vegetation." All the wisdom of these three [days] brought forth His wisdom, and they did what they were commanded. Three other days were then prepared. On the fourth day, to strengthen the first wisdom... as it is written: "And God said, 'Let there be lights...'" and this was the help. On the fifth day, the waters brought forth the vision of the other wisdom, as it is written: "And God said, 'Let the waters swarm...'" On the sixth day, the earth performed its wisdom, as it is written: "And God said, 'Let the earth bring forth a living soul...'" Since these three wisdoms were established, their works were completed.

### [Right Column]
The Holy One, Blessed be He, said to all the great merits to act, and "Let us make man" was joined as one... like the matter of man, their body... for at first it was as a partnership, so too with the Crown <term>Keter: the highest Sefirah</term>. ## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Phinehas 220 <-

The Ancient One <note>A reference to the *Atika*, a high level of the Divine</note> receives for His joy. The Holy One, Blessed be He, made a condition with you in the joy of His children, etc., full as the joy of the redemption to the Garden of Eden. It was uprooted from there to add and to give life, as it is written: *In them they shall find joy and gladness, and they shall be filled among the nations* <note>original: "בם ימצאו שמחה ותגיל שדכן ויתמלו בגוים" — a variation of Isaiah 51:3</note> for they are added to that [joy], and their life is with Him. The Lord is King. From "and they shall be humbled," a smoke rose before the Lord, for in them is the reception of joy and all the sleepers who are there, etc. In the end, they are the ones who are sent. This ends the quote. <note>End of a quoted passage or commentary segment</note>
---
Just as they do not know in all distress, remember "in them" at the end. It is destined for the prophet alone, and this was made known to the wise and the seers. He returned to me to search, and some say "until he saw," etc. And then that **shadow** <term>shadow</term> <note>Aramaic: *tula*; refers to a protective spiritual canopy or "shade" of the Divine Presence</note> returned as before, and it was inside the house like the image of a man upon his face.
Rabbi Yosei said: We have walked in this place, supported by Rabbi Phinehas ben Yair, and what is this one? They praised this place and he spoke thus: **Phinehas** the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest <note>Numbers 25:11</note>. The letter *Yod* is small <note>In the Torah scroll, the *Yod* in "Pinchas" is sometimes written smaller to indicate a mystical diminishment or specific spiritual state</note> because two exchangeable classes are marked. One class is to be nourished by blessings and the other class is to be nourished by smallness. Blessings are given to the World to Come, and smallness is given to the lower world. The holy covenant exists because he was zealous for this covenant and occupied himself with it. And the way of the spirit is to cut this. At that moment, the Holy One, Blessed be He, said: "What will you do with Moses? This covenant was from Moses, for he was My bridegroom." To lie with her and to rejoice in her, the mind of Moses was for them, and the Holy One, Blessed be He, spoke to Moses.
"Moses, Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, **has turned back My wrath**." It is to your merit that you surrendered your soul for Israel so they would not be destroyed from the world many times. And Moses stood over his canopy and said: "Moses, what do you seek here? She is your bride." The Holy One, Blessed be He, said: "She is our bride, as mentioned in his nickname." Moses said: "Here is the bride of peace, sent to the prophet." The dream was like your pocket, and he was blessed by the complete will. Therefore, say: "He turned back My wrath." With favor: *Behold, I give to him My covenant of peace* <note>Numbers 25:12</note>.
Moses, the source of life, "Behold I give to him," etc. For the Holy One, Blessed be He, paused to say "Behold I give to him the [covenant of] life and peace," but it is only written "Therefore say." And if you say it was removed from Moses, it is not so, for this crown is honored and not diminished. That shadow returned and sat, and it is written: They heard a voice saying, "Clear the place! Clear the place for Rabbi Phinehas ben Yair!" For your children are obligated to be established, and every place that is exact is for the words of the Torah. All who look upon the world, he abandoned that place and gave it to the prophet. And whenever the children are seen in the exactness of the place, they examine the words of the Torah. In this manner, Rabbi Phinehas ben Yair would make a condition to abandon the companions and to look if they had renewed words of freedom.
And that shadow was bound as before, the word of Rabbi Phinehas ben Yair stood. Rabbi Chaki said: "Life and the ascent of Rabbi Phinehas ben Yair! For it is not written 'Therefore behold I give,' but 'Therefore say.'" And when he spoke, the prophet's mouth was from this pious one under your hand, and you did not say it. Blessed is our portion to establish the fixed holy shadow here. He opened and said, serving Rabbi Phinehas: *Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your strength* <note>Ecclesiastes 9:10</note>, etc. How much should a man live while the star shines and smells upon his head, to strive and do the will of his Master? Because that star gives him the power of remembrance over him, and it is written: *Let the power [of my Lord] be great* <note>Numbers 14:17</note>. Like the Lord—this is the power that labors upon the heads of the righteous and all those who look with favor to their Creator. And regarding this we have learned: anyone who sees a sin and a spirit of blessing is in his mouth, like every priest who has life. Certainly, one must awaken every strong inner movement, for every strong awakening below awakens that supernal holy power and it ascends within the Holy One, and the voice is remembered... and it was written.
