<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on Parashat Pinchas, focusing on the transition of Phinehas into the priesthood and the alignment of the lower worlds with the upper Sefirot. It follows the themes of divine reward and the rectification of the soul.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Phinehas**<-

In this way, it is necessary to perform the will of the Master of all life, through **action and calculation** <note>original: *ma'aseh ve-cheshbon*; these refer to the physical performance of commandments and the mystical intentions/meditations behind them</note> and so on. This is in order that there be found a correspondence between this **action and calculation** below and that of the world above, which is called "Action"—the world where all is completed <note>Zohar Pinchas 223b</note>. The "end of thought" and "calculation" refers to the World to Come <note>Binah</note>, which is the pattern for this calculation, where the male principle is suspended and decrees all the powerful decrees and intercalations <note>astronomical calculations for the calendar</note> like a pillar that supports them. And **Knowledge** <note>Da'at</note> is the spirit upon which certain sides depend in **Thought** <note>Machshavah</note>; these are called the "Hidden World," for **Thought** and **Wisdom** <note>Chokhmah</note> are the source upon which everything depends. All of these exist through that power which is the "Ancient One" <note>Atika</note> in the mystery of the "Fortune" <note>Mazal/the beard of Arich Anpin</note>, a level of rest. This power is so hidden that it is not found in this world to be revealed through **action, calculation, knowledge, and wisdom**, for its canopy is above. In that place <note>the Sitra Achra</note>, there is no **action, calculation, knowledge, or wisdom**, for that is the "Other Side," the "Man" who walks and perishes, as it is written: *Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on Sheol.* <note>Proverbs 5:5</note> These matters cause a "chance occurrence" <note>mikreh</note> when the Other Side precedes and overpowers a person's house.

He said to him: "Phinehas is your name! Do not all the people of the world go there <note>to death/Sheol</note>? By your life!" But they immediately turn red <note>blush/repent</note>, as it is written: *The Lord kills and brings to life; He brings down to Sheol and raises up.* <note>1 Samuel 2:6</note> All those wicked ones who did not hasten to repent forever—they descend and do not ascend. But even the completely righteous descend there. He said to him: "In the same way, because it is written how many sins are there, yet they are raised up from there and given a purification like Hanukkah." And from those who merit to ascend like Hanukkah in this world, but were unable and did not ascend from the world of the righteous because their children were under the influence of 'Fortune' <note>Mazal</note>, they are taken and raised up from there.

Rabbi Yose said: It is written, *Adding one thing to another to find the sum (calculation)* <note>Ecclesiastes 7:27</note>. "Calculation" <note>Cheshbon</note> refers to the Gematria <note>numerical values</note> that stand in the **Moon** <note>the Shekhinah</note>, such as her levels. These are for the four <note>directions/letters of the Name</note>. Another interpretation of **action and calculation** is that it refers to the word of blessing. He [the adversary] killed many and kicked at the eyes of Rabbi Chiyya. He doubled his efforts to overpower him. They taught a song of praise because he was subdued! He was subdued and doubled like Korah in his mouth, as it is written:
> *Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bath-rabbim.* <note>Song of Songs 7:5</note>
These "eyes" are his reflections of the **Higher Wisdom** <note>Chokhmah</note> found from above, and from within the "calculation," the strengths, and the intercalations that are filled. They become blessings that go out from the Right Side to all sides. These eyes remain until they are appointed over every "calculation" and intercalation of the **Moon** <note>Sihara</note>, like a carbuncle (or "to sparkle") and the stars and constellations to make a "calculation." And this is "by the gate of Bath-rabbim" <note>literally 'daughter of many'</note>, which is the **Moon** alone.

Rabbi Chiyya said to Rabbi Yose: "This **holy pearl** <note>a profound mystical teaching</note> that was in your hand from the holy company—how beautiful is its life! It has been guided by it, for certainly it should not be brought down to be like any other place until her Husband gives her permission and a portion to enter as before. They increase it for him, for he shall appoint her and give her the secret to bind to that place." Thus, the Holy One, Blessed be He, appeased Moses, and until He gave him permission and strength, He said to him: *Behold, I give him My covenant of peace.* <note>Numbers 25:12</note> This was to sow in his gardens and to walk there; it was not his portion from here until the seven [levels] were scrutinized. A child who is given permission to be among the righteous of the world is placed with them like a bride in truth. And as the world watches and rejoices in this, for the Husband covers and adorns her to be a holy window, and he drips [grace] upon her...
> *In the evening she went... and in the morning she returned* <note>Esther 2:14</note>
...to her Husband. And "in the morning she returned" to the righteous of the world, and all is according to the secret of her Holy Husband who examines them, etc. And from this, He said: *Behold, I give him My covenant*, just as the Righteous One above <note>Yesod</note> gives to him. Is it not "Behold, I give a gift"? To arrange a gift is because this **Covenant** <note>Berit</note> is the profit of the Higher Marriage-Contract <note>Ketubah</note>. And if he were not holy, Phinehas would not have been bound to the level of the High Priesthood, for this **Covenant** is always cleaved to the Higher Right Hand <note>Chesed</note>, and the Higher Right Hand is not ready to enter the Sanctuary, which is the **Covenant**. Rabbi Chiyya said: "Certainly, blessed is the new word I have heard from the holy walls of the academy of Rabbi Eliezer." And a time is coming to bring out a certain pious one... and these are the words of the Elder, the Elder: "Three are required in the same manner..."

<meta>This page continues the discourse on the mystical significance of the Temple and the future redemption. It addresses the theological problem of why the Jewish people suffer in exile if they are close to God, and explains that the physical Temples built by human hands were temporary substitutes for a divine structure intended since the Exodus.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

A small matter is requested of you: one [Temple] below was to be built for you like another Sanctuary, and there were only to be two times of building: the First House and the Second House. A Third House and a Fourth House you will not find in the design. That which was meant to be built has already been built, and there is never anything more, for two Houses were built. The Scripture calls them so, as it is written: > The glory of this latter House shall be greater than that of the former <note>Haggai 2:9</note>. Furthermore, you say that you are closer to the Supreme King than all other nations; but one who is close to the King should be constantly in a higher state, without pain, without fear, and without oppression. Yet behold, you are in pain, in oppression, and in the "tail" <note>meaning the lowest status among nations</note> constantly, more than all the people of the world. Therefore, one should not draw near to such shaking, oppression, and lowliness at all. If you are so close to the Supreme King, why are you so far from Him? Because of this, you have nothing but shaking, oppression, and the "tail," which we do not have. Furthermore, you are not wise, and your children are torn away so that you are like parched land, and your bodies are like ruins. Indeed, we go wherever we wish, and we are as strong as the sand of the sea, all our tribes remaining in their positions. But you, who are not wise, are like mutes without a shepherd, beaten and crushed more than all other nations, a lowly people whom everyone mocks.

The Old Man <note>The "Saba," a recurring mystical figure in the Zohar who reveals deep secrets</note> opened his discourse and said: May it be pleasing to me that I did not hear this from you and did not receive it from you. Rabbi Elazar fixed his eyes upon him, and he <note>the antagonist</note> became a heap of bones. When his anger subsided, he turned his head and wept, saying: > O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! <note>Psalms 8:2</note>. How powerful is the holy strength throughout the earth, and there is no word or matter that comes in the [divine] design that does not proceed from the mouth of the <term>Holy One, blessed be He</term> <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu," the standard Zoharic name for God</note>.

These words that this wicked one spoke—he found a certain day on the road and said that the script of the firmament was arranged before the <term>Holy One, blessed be He</term>. For when Israel went out of Egypt, the <term>Holy One, blessed be He</term> desired to make them on earth like the holy angels above. He desired to build them a Holy House and to lower it from the midst of the heavens, and to plant Israel as a holy vine, in the likeness of the supernal image. > You shall bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of Your inheritance <note>Exodus 15:17</note>, in the place, O Lord, which You have made for Your dwelling. "Which You have made," You, O Lord, and no other. "The place for Your dwelling which You have made, O Lord"—this refers to the First House. "The Sanctuary, O Lord, which Your hands have established"—this refers to the Second House. Both of them were to be the handiwork of the <term>Holy One, blessed be He</term>.

But because it was hidden before Him <note>known in the divine foreknowledge</note> that they would provoke Him to anger, their deeds changed, and the Houses had to be built by the hands of man. Because of this, they did not endure. Solomon knew that because this was the work of man, it would not endure, and regarding this he said: > Except the Lord build the house, they labor in vain that build it <note>Psalms 127:1</note>, for it has no permanence. In the days of Ezra, sin caused them to need to build it themselves, and therefore it had no permanence.

And until now, the first building of the <term>Holy One, blessed be He</term> has not been in the world, as it is written: > The Lord builds Jerusalem <note>Psalms 147:2</note>—He shall be the one, and no other. And for this building we wait; it is not like the building of man, which has no permanence at all. The First House and the Second House, the <term>Holy One, blessed be He</term> will bring them down as one from above. The First House is like a concealment and the Second House is like a revelation. That House shall be placed as a crown, which is called the Second House, so that all the world shall see the handiwork of the <term>Holy One, blessed be He</term>, holy and beautiful, the desire of the King in all its permanence. This First House, which is like a hidden chamber, will rise above that which is revealed, and all the world will see the clouds of glory hovering over the roof of that which is revealed. Within those clouds, the First House will stand in a hidden act, rising in great hidden glory. For this building we wait. It has never yet been in the world. Even the city of Jerusalem shall not be a wall of man, for it is written: > For I, says the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about <note>Zechariah 2:9</note>. If it is written thus of the city, how much more so for the House which shall be His dwelling. And this work was intended to exist when Israel went out of Egypt, but it was withdrawn until the end of days, when He shall remember the Virgin [of Israel].

<meta>This page continues the discourse on Parashat Pinchas (Numbers 25-30). The previous section likely discussed the zealotry of Phinehas; here, the Zohar transitions into a profound anatomical metaphor for the Jewish people's role in the world and a narrative regarding the identity of Phinehas and the nature of the resurrection.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

After five hundred years of bearing the service of the supreme Kingdom <note>original: *Malchuta Ila'ah*</note> more than all other nations, and out of love, the Holy One, Blessed be He, made Israel the heart of the entire world. And so are Israel among the other nations: like the heart among the limbs. Just as the limbs cannot endure in the world for even a single moment without the heart, so too the people of the world exist through the heart among the limbs, and Israel conducts itself among the other nations in the manner of the heart among the limbs. The heart is tender and delicate, yet it is the life and the sustenance of all the limbs. The limbs do not know of pain, distress, or anger at all, except through the heart, for in it is the sustenance and in it is the understanding. The other limbs do not draw near to the King <note>The brain/intellect</note> at all, for they have no sustenance of their own and know nothing. All the other limbs are not close to the King—which is **Wisdom** <term>Chochmah: the highest cognitive Sefirah</term> and the understanding that labors in the brain—except for the heart. The other limbs are far from it and know nothing of it. So too, Israel is close to the Holy King, and the other nations are far from Him. On another lower level: Israel does not eat carcasses, torn animals, filth, or the grime of creeping things and vermin like the other nations. This is because the heart—which is tender, delicate, and the sovereign and sustenance of all other limbs—cannot tolerate anything except the clearest and purest of all blood, and nourishment that is clean and refined above all. The other waste and fat is for the limbs, and all the other limbs do not look at this [purity], but rather they take all the waste and the bad, and they are strengthened by it according to their design. Therefore, in all the other limbs there are boils, growths, or scabs from the discharge of the gall. But for the heart, none of this exists at all; rather, it is clean and refined from everything, and has no blemish in it at all. Concerning this, it is written:
> "You are all beautiful, my beloved, and there is no blemish in you." <note>Song of Songs 4:7</note>

Rabbi Yose came and kissed his hands, saying: "If I had only come into the world to hear this, it would be enough for me."

->**And there**<- was Israel the Tax Collector, etc. — Rabbi Isaac said: This verse should have been written as "And there was Israel," for it refers to Phinehas, and not "the Tax Collector." Rather, the letter *Samekh* is missing <note>A wordplay on the Hebrew name/title</note>. It is not written like "donkey" <note>Chamor</note> but like "engraving" <note>Cheret</note>. And so said Rabbi Elazar: Since the voice of Phinehas ascended to this secret, he did not want to mention Phinehas on the side of merit, for as long as he was not yet established as the High Priest. Before he ascended to the High Priesthood, the text mentions him, saying:
> "And Phinehas saw... and he rose... a spear... and he pierced both of them..." <note>Numbers 25:7-8</note>

Once he ascended to the High Priesthood, his name was not mentioned in connection to their killing, so that it would not be seen [as a blemish] upon him, and the honor of the Holy One, Blessed be He, was placed upon him, for a High Priest is not fit for killing. And the name "the Tax Collector" was placed there as well. Rabbi Shimon was traveling from Cappadocia to Lydda, and Rabbi Judah was traveling with him. While they were walking, Rabbi Phinehas ben Yair met them, with two men carrying loads behind him. He looked and said to Rabbi Phinehas: "They are burdened and cannot walk." Rabbi Phinehas said: "Look at them, for the fragrance of their faces reaches us, like a fine scent made for us." While they were there, Rabbi Shimon emerged from behind a certain rock. When he saw him, he was shaken. Rabbi Phinehas said: "Did I not tell you that the fragrance of their faces reaches us?" Rabbi Phinehas went down and came out and bowed, saying: "I saw in my dream that the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah: the indwelling feminine aspect of God</term> came to me and gave me great gifts, and a fine voice echoed within it, just as I said." Rabbi Shimon said: "From the Persian voice that you heard, I know that a fine voice was given to the woman, like a thin veil." Rabbi Phinehas said: "It is written concerning the veil of the words of Torah; one must have wisdom of the eyes, for its waters and strength abide there." Rabbi Phinehas said: "I was observing that for the Resurrection of the Dead, the Holy One, Blessed be He, will make another city. Just as it was at first, so shall it be at the end; from all of them, the dry bones shall live, for a voice came to them through Ezekiel, as it is written:
> "And the bones came together, bone to its bone." <note>Ezekiel 37:7</note>

As it was at first, and afterwards it is written, "and I will finish."

<meta>This page continues the discussion of the mystical mechanics of the body's restoration. It transitions from the general Zohar narrative into the "Ra'aya Mehemna" (The Faithful Shepherd) section, which often provides mystical explanations for the commandments and the future redemption.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

...and I will cause breath to enter into them, and I will lay sinews upon them, and will bring up flesh upon them, and cover them with skin above, and the breath of life shall be in them. <note>Ezekiel 37:8</note> For just as they were stripped of their garments at first, so shall they be restored. At first, the skin is stripped away, then the flesh, and finally the bones. Rabbi Shimon said: Come and see, at the beginning, all these bones that the Holy One, Blessed be He, brings down and revives, He performs a specific craft with them. Come and see what is written: <quote>Remember, I beseech You, that You have fashioned me as clay; and will You bring me into dust again?</quote> <note>Job 10:9</note> What is written after it? <quote>Have You not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?</quote> <note>Job 10:10</note> You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and have fenced me with bones and sinews. And from the Holy One, Blessed be He, after every human being is revealed from the dust and the time of the <term>Resurrection of the Dead</term> arrives, that single bone <note>The 'Luz' bone, believed to be indestructible and the seed for resurrection</note> that remains will be made like this dough, or like the curdling of milk. It is a flow in a refined line as it descends, and that bone will mix and be dissolved like milk, and afterward He will curdle it and it will be formed into a shape like cheese in its solidification. Afterward, skin, flesh, bones, and sinews will be drawn over it. This is what is written: *Have You not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?* It does not say "You poured me" (past tense), but "You shall pour me" (future tense); it does not say "You curdled me," but "You shall curdle me"; it does not say "You clothed me," but "You shall clothe me"; it does not say "You fenced me," but "You shall fence me." And afterward, what is written? *Life and favor You have granted me*—and not just the spirit of life. *You have granted me* is written in the past tense, not "You will grant." Rather, the verse says: You have already performed kindness with me in this world of life, and *Your providence has preserved my spirit*—to take back at first what was guarded as my spirit. And the secret of the matter: all the souls of the righteous are hidden and concealed under the Throne of the King, and He guards them for their merit. This is what is written: *And Your providence has preserved my spirit.* What is "Your providence"? It is as you say, "let another take his office" <note>Psalm 109:8; the word 'office' or 'providence' (Pekudah) implies a charge or a person in waiting</note>. And let the <term>Matron</term> <note>The Shekhinah, the Divine Presence</note> of the King be the one who preserved my spirit; she guards it as a deposit for him.

And it is the custom of the world that a person serves his ruler, and because of this, a person must entrust his soul to the **Matronita** <note>The Shekhinah, the Divine Presence in its feminine aspect</note>, for she is with him in the house, as it is written: *Into Your hand I entrust my spirit* <note>Psalm 31:6</note>. And that which he was meant to show occurred in another world, judged in another kingdom, and sometimes by Divine Providence like water, etc. And if he is pious and meritorious, all his transitions are judged with a righteous judgment, and they bring him out and spread a canopy before him, pushing him and bringing him out to a place above where they see the Throne, and there they see a prepared throne in the likeness of the Kingdom as is the custom. And in every single night, I do not rest to give him peace and to gather before him.

David said, etc., to give rest to the separated one, for he did not know when he would come to be nourished, not to see that *I am pious*, but rather because the Sages established: "An ignorant person cannot be a **Chasid** (pious one)." To the link of the chain, the goodness of the **Holy One, Blessed Be He**, who gives **Chesed**. He who acts with kindness toward his Creator," because of David who is awakened. And furthermore, he would bind the link above, he was joined with the **Holy One, Blessed Be He**, and because of this: *Keep my soul, for I am pious*. Well do they judge a person every night, for in the time of the World to Come, what will it be? Only the **Holy One, Blessed Be He**, his King, as before, performing honor as before. And he shall say: "May your gathering be protected, O Lord," in the end for these benefits. And they enter to perform honor and mercy, to remember the eternal covenant. This is for the entrustment of the pious one. With a voice from without, this is for the entrustment of one who is not worthy. Privileged is the one who humbles himself before his Master and does not appear outside of the canopy that the Holy One, blessed be He, spreads over him. He said to look upon the Eighth. He said among you: the Holy One shall be among you, the building of those words of the firmament, and he is below as he said, and he wrote "Blessed be He" upon me. He said: there is a beauty to the one who took, who took the priest's garment and from there the crown for Metatron. They wander to your heart and take the exemption of the Shekhinah <term>The Divine Presence</term> for you. And **Chesed** <term>Kindness</term> is until the ten in every explicit way; they are the drops and the sons from **Binah** <term>Understanding</term> until the whole of their movement is light. To **Keter** <term>Crown</term> he arrived, examining and taking all the vision in the grasp to place a command for every **Chesed**, and she shall be called "the one who takes all the kindnesses." The gates and the end of all are the burden of the bride, all of them. He said: now surely the matter will be improved upon its clarity. And further to look there: **Malkhut** <term>Kingship</term> with the base, and not from **Metatron**, from the "Rain" <note>A wordplay on Metatron's name and *Matar* (rain)</note> he is, and the intention is to take two drops. And because of this they are called "Water," from the beginning and the acquisition until here is the "Work of the Chariot" <term>Ma'aseh Merkavah: the deepest mysteries of the divine realm</term>. And its difficulty is from "and not" until the hidden part which is from the side of **Gevurah**, they are called "Strong Water." And the one who brings out the waters is **Yesod** <term>Foundation</term>; all of them are the Chariot for **Tiferet** <term>Beauty</term>, but not the "Work of the Chariot," which is **Malkhut**. And the crowns of these are **Chokhmah** <term>Wisdom</term>, **Binah** <term>Understanding</term>, and **Da'at** <term>Knowledge</term>. And because of this, the Masters of the Mishnah established that "one does not expound upon the Work of the Chariot alone, unless
> he is wise and understands from his own knowledge <note>Chagigah 11b</note>
And there is no Chariot below that awakens the wings of the ascent of **Metatron**, the "Youth" <note>A common title for Metatron</note> who is in the Chariot of the judgments, for he is the curtain of the yoke of the Torah. And from him emerges the "Orchard" <note>Pardes: the four levels of interpretation</note>, the image of the light from four to eleven upon them. He rode it like the spices of the explanation. And that which was said—that he is the curtain—is because every wise son who cleaves to the power of the Torah, his secret reaches his place, and he runs and reaches until the House of Heaven. And not to the Crown, for in it is the Messiah to bring out the water of his own, but not from the flight of the pursuit of water. The Name of 42 <note>The *Ana B'Koach* prayer</note> is included in him; those who go up to the House of the Assembly where **Metatron** comes, the letter *Lamed* is in him, not the voice that erases them, for there the King comes and he is the power to sit upon **Chokhmah** <term>Wisdom</term>. The Name **Y-A** <note>Yod-Heh</note> is the Upper Waters and the Lower Waters, between which there is not even the fullness of a thumb's breadth, which is the letter *Yod* <note>The smallest Hebrew letter</note> that stands between them like the firmament, which is the pillar that stands between water and water:
> and let it divide <note>Genesis 1:6</note>
And this is the word **Y-A-D-O-N-D-Y** <term>A combined name of God used in Kabbalah to unite the transcendent and the immanent</term>: the Upper Waters and the throne upon the thousand, the Lower Waters like the corners shall be sanctified in it. The letters between them are like the nose, the letter *Vav*, which is the crown that is between the mouth. And go, the movement and the sphere—and there is no movement in the sphere without the sides like the nose, the *Vav* of the three... and that is the secret of **Yesod** <term>Foundation</term> which is the foundation of all, and it is established upon the horse. And that which has no second to establish upon it, for it is necessary to found it so that they may be established upon

<meta>This page continues the Zohar's commentary on the portion of Pinchas, specifically delving into the mystical mechanics of the sacrificial service (Korbanot) and how they relate to the human anatomy and the daily prayers.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

...branches and upon their loins, and towards the four winds of the world, two fly. Therefore, the three pillars of the Tree <note>The Tree of Life/Sefirotic structure</note> are thirty, the four Living Creatures <note>Chayyot - angelic beings</note> are sixty, the Throne is ten, nine levels to the Throne. And furthermore, 32, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Man is the ten of his Unity, the Kingship <note>Malchut</note> is the cloak for the loins, a planting of his bosom corresponding to the planting below. Happy are the people of Israel who know the secret of the Matron’s <note>The Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note> diagonals. It is not for nothing that it says "the children of Israel," and "to offer My sacrifice to Me to establish a pleasing aroma."

Rabbi Yehuda said: In the sacrifice, there is no smoke, but there is spirit and there is a pleasing aroma. Smoke comes from the side of the spirit of "every living thing," which is blocked, as it says, "Smoke rose up in His nostrils" <note>Psalm 18:9</note>, and not because of the movement. "A pleasing aroma" and "the scent of your nose is like apples" <note>Song of Songs 7:9</note>.

**Rabbi** Elazar said: What is this second smoke? Smoke and scent are distinct, and the verses bear witness. One says, "Smoke rose up in His nostrils," and the other says, "the scent of your nose is like apples." After she is called "bitter," her smoke rises. And the second is male and mercy. Rather, in the truth of the matter, there are two windows <note>nostrils</note>, and it is said of them, "Smoke rose up in His nostrils." Why "rose up"? Rather, the King who is on the side of the North <note>Gevurah/Judgment</note>, Might is on the right, the spirit blows to the Prophet toward the union, to find it from the side of Kindness <note>Chesed</note> where the **Brain** is located. From there to the food, close to entering the garden, in the **Heart** toward the left, close to crowning. And because of this, "Smoke rose up in His nostrils" from the Throne toward the Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note> which is on the right, and she receives it with sweetness like a resting for a pleasing aroma. And this smoke does not harm, except through the "Other Side" <note>Sitra Achra/Evil forces</note> in the eyes, which are hanging stones appointed over the poor of the world.

What is the "Ox" <note>the sacrificial animal</note>? It is for the spirit that is called the "hollow," which is in the strength of Might <note>Gevurah</note>, and smoke rises in them in the Throne—the smoke of the altar-pile. And we have established that "Nose" <note>Af/Anger</note> is also called "Incense" <note>Ketoret</note>, as in "They shall put incense before Your nostrils" <note>Deuteronomy 33:10</note>. And there are those who find rest in the world through incense, which is a binding of the spirit in mercy with a pleasing aroma, for the translation of "Incense" is *Katura* <note>Aramaic for "binding" or "knot"</note>.

Rabbi Yehuda said: And in this drawing of the spirit, the orphans are dependent on the Holy One, blessed be He. He further said: The holy rest of the Crown <note>Keter</note> descends in the sacrifice...

**The** Faithful Shepherd <note>Raya Mehemna - Moses</note> said: Now we need to know how the prayers were established corresponding to the sacrifices. Rather, three prayers correspond to the three... "You shall perform in the morning." This is the morning prayer, of which it is said, "And Abraham rose early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the Lord" <note>Genesis 19:27</note>, and the Sages established that "standing" refers only to prayer. And the third, the Assembly of the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note>, "You shall perform between the evenings," corresponding to the Afternoon Prayer <note>Mincha</note> which Isaac established, as it says, "And Isaac went out to meditate in the field toward evening" <note>Genesis 24:63</note>.

The Evening Prayer <note>Arvit</note> corresponds to the limbs and fats that are consumed all night, as it says, "And he encountered the place and slept there because the sun had set" <note>Genesis 28:11</note>, and "encounter" refers only to prayer. From this we see he was in the Crown... "And he took from the stones of the place and put them under his head and lay down in that place." Did he not have pillows and blankets to lie on? Rather, like a groom who comes to the bride, even though there was no ground to lie on except with cloths and coverings, he prepares for himself a place to lie, and the bride is there with the will of the heart. And so it was said.

"Rejoice, remember" for the male, and "observe" <note>Shamor</note> for the female. The brain is the male and rules over the heart. The heart rules and rides upon the **Liver**. <meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the "Faithful Shepherd" (Ra’aya Mehemna) within the Zohar on Parashat Pinchas. It focuses on the spiritual anatomy of the human body as a reflection of the Temple sacrifices, specifically how the internal organs process physical and spiritual energy.</meta>

# Main Text (Zohar - Portion of Pinchas, The Faithful Shepherd)

## Right Column

The excess of the liver and the liver itself are as one, and they shall be offered in the sacrifice. This [the liver] represents **Anger**, for the liver is the consumer of the speech-breath <note>original: "ruach de-dibura"</note> for several others [forces] that are not pushed away when there is a voice of vileness and blue-blackness <note>likely referring to the darkening of the spirit during rage</note> to the word and the spirit; and in the two "horns" <note>lobes of the liver</note> it is so.

The **Spleen** is foremost, along with its diaphragm <note>original: "yitret," often translated as the caul or lobe of the liver, but here linked to the spleen</note>. The spleen and its mate, and all those veins of the liver, stand and assist them. They take from the poor and the needy of the sacrifice <note>metaphorically referring to the lower, coarser energies of food</note>, and then everything is brought near to the **Heart**.

The Heart does not take from all of them except that which sustains it, and the light ascends and descends to be nourished by the sacrifice. The Heart then brings [the essence] near to the **Brain**, for the will of the Unification <note>The mystical union of the Divine names</note> is found there, along with the joy of the spirit.

This Brain is the "Male" that rests upon the Upper Brain. The Brain brings [the offering] near to the One who is Hidden from all, who is not known at all. Thus, everything is bound one to another, and the Brain brings it near under the Spirit of all.

The veins of the liver—these are the "wheat" <note>referring to the kernels of thought or sparks</note> and all their hosts. Regarding the **Liver**, as it was said:
> *The lobe of the liver...* <note>Exodus 29:13</note>
—to show that the lobe is not buried <note>consumed/integrated</note> like the rest, except when its taste is diminished. It is like the crown of copper that was made, and he prepared it further. And the lobe of the liver, when it seeks to be buried—the liver, when it is nourished by the leftovers that are not buried at all—afterward, it approaches little by little until it is nourished by the furnace of the vinegar <note>referring to the acidic/digestive process</note>.

And those veins of the liver spread out to others, awakening many merits. All those lessons and separations are all like the liver, which pushes away the root. In holiness, it takes and offers, as it was said: the Heart rests upon the two kidneys, and they are like the two Cherubim. So too is the coating [of the organs]; they are distant yet near, and the Spleen and all the kidneys—each one appears as is fitting until all are bound as one. Blessed is the spirit of the male that is brought near to the Heart; the surrounding spirit is judged and descends and pushes away,
> *And the spirit shall return to God.* <note>Ecclesiastes 12:7</note>

<column-break/>

## Left Column

For all sacrifices must be brought before Him. They are the "blemishes" <note>the physical husks</note> for all the crowns of the kings of the sacrifices, each as is fitting for it, to bring sustenance to the Shekhinah <note>The Divine Presence</note> and to prepare everything for her. And that [sustenance] is for the eyes of the sleeping ones, the foundations for the children of men. He gives them those natural foods for the power of their "fire" to consume them, as the Sages established.

The living [creature] is like a cup; there is none to push it to eat the sacrifices, and the living is not like a cup there, for all of them are from the side of sin. And so it is with the death of a human: if he is meritorious, he passes with knowledge, like a hammer [striking], and he is not like the "dog" of which David said:
> *Deliver my soul from the sword; my only one from the power of the dog.* <note>Psalm 22:21</note>

And because the nourishment punishes their bodies, which tear and break, who can bring the sacrifices that are required? Their bodies are cleansed of "evil blood." Your goodness is entirely bread and fire, just as they thirst for water. But the Holy One, Blessed be He, takes nothing but the **will of the heart** and its devotion, which is the secret of Israel.

The righteous one is the spirit of the secret, the heart of the secret. And when he is healthy, he does not punish the assembly of the sick below them. The root is like the Brain, the Conduct, the Body, and the Bone. They are stirred by the service of the Levites with song and music to reach the [Divine] Intention.

The **Spleen** <note>margin: "The Spleen"</note>—this is for the cheapening of all that is rejected, the murky wine of the refuse. Its veins and their powers are thin, and all the host of the impure are like this; they are the remnants for the Evil Inclination. They guard the reward of the good, appointed over the veins of the [spleen] and the liver.

The **Faithful Shepherd** <note>The spirit of Moses speaking to the Zoharic circle</note> said to him: You have spoken well! For everything follows its kind. There is the Kingdom of the Sitra Achra <note>The "Other Side" or evil</note> against the Holy Kingdom, which is comprised of the ten **Sephirot** <note>term: Divine emanations/attributes</note> and all the visions. And there are those who are servants of the "Old Servant of the House" <note>referring to Eliezer or the angel Metatron in certain contexts</note>. They provide as needed, and it is said of them: *He gives food to all flesh.*

The secret of the likeness of the kings' sacrifices is that they are the **Good Deeds** over which the angels are appointed, to acquire them in their secrets. They are the foundation for the Unification.

It distinguishes between the "holy" organs (Heart/Brain) and those associated with the "Other Side" (Liver/Spleen) which handle anger and waste.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on Parashat Pinhas, specifically focusing on the spiritual mechanics of the sacrifices (Korbanot). It explores how the sacrificial act achieves a unification (Yichud) between the Holy One and His Presence (Shekhinah) while simultaneously subduing the chaotic forces of the "Other Side" (Sitra Achra), symbolized here by the Serpent (Tannin).</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Pinhas <-

God is kindness and truth <note>original: "Elohim Chesed ve-Emet"; likely referencing Psalm 85:11, "Kindness and truth have met"</note> and in everything that draws near to Him for the unification of God, regarding the hiddenness of a certain [divine] level. Their laws are not oppressive toward Him; the <term>Shekhinah</term> <note>The Divine Presence, the feminine aspect of God</note> rests upon them, etc. The letter *Vav* represents the whiteness that spreads to the Serpent <note>original: "Tannin"; the primordial sea monster representing the forces of chaos or evil</note>, and their restoration and their paths are bound as one through the <term>Sacrifice</term> <note>original: "Korban"; from the root meaning "to draw near"</note>. From the "liver" <note>associated in Kabbalah with the lower, more physical desires</note> issues the pressure to bring the Serpent near, etc. And the letter *He* is in the sacrifice for all illnesses and all afflictions of all the limbs of the body; and so it is for them in every single building, whether for the Small [Face] or for the Worlds, and within it they dwell. It is more refined than everything else, and they rely on the commandments. Whether in His Kingdom or in His salvation, all good and all blessings emerge for the limbs; everything must be brought near to the <term>Holy One, Blessed Be He</term> <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu"; the standard Aramaic reference to the transcendent aspect of God</note> and to His Torah in their grasp.

And all strength, all joy, and all perfection that the holy ones require—their sustenance is like a King looking upon His kingdom and providing for all the limbs. He opened and rode, breaking the foundations of the pledge that you shall grow great... <note>The text here becomes highly cryptic, using symbolic shorthand for the elemental foundations</note> ...the secret of the fire that draws near from the water like silence, and the bread like dust... He is the one who makes peace in His heights. And the law of the cup... the scorpion whose power is to suck the water of the kidneys with strangers... dust, which is to say, the ultimate dust.

For as soon as the <term>Holy Name</term> <note>original: "Kudsha Havayah"</note> departs from them, there is no substance left in them. And if you say that it is written regarding all sacrifices "for a unification," and not for the Serpent... it was said regarding the levels that are broken and called "names," and not for their satisfaction... "Everyone who is called by My Name, and for My glory I created him, I formed him, even I made him" <note>Isaiah 43:7</note>. There is no unification for the Serpent in the Kingdom; there is no service or interruption from the right in their dwellings to be sustained in the paths. And because of these [forces] that are broken and cast down to their heads... the letter *Vav* for the garment, the letter *Pe*... the letter *He* for the dust that is subdued.

However, the "Ascending Offering" <note>Olah</note> is above all, which is called the "Foundation" <note>Yesod</note> to say of it: "Who has preceded Me that I should pay him?" <note>Job 41:3</note>. And it says: "To whom then will you liken God, or what likeness will you compare to Him?" <note>Isaiah 40:18</note>. And if they are not worthy, the goodness does not reach him to separate the Serpents... there is no service or world that is bound; the evil one shall not dwell with You. He is the ruler over all, and there is no one who rules over him. He grasps everything, and there is no one who grasps him. And they were not established... and all who rely on them are judged with a curse upon them.

And everything that is separated from them has no likeness there at all. Deep, deep, who can find it? They cannot gaze upon Him, for He is sanctified according to the "Supernal Crown" <note>Keter Elyon; the highest, most unknowable Sefirah</note>, which is a mighty force over all the hosts of heaven and the worlds. And regarding all the Serpents, it is said of Him: "He made darkness His hiding place" <note>Psalm 18:11</note>. And regarding Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note> and Understanding <note>Binah</note> and the "Thick Cloud" <note>Araphel</note>, the <term>Shekhinah</term> is there... they are the bodies... He works over all worlds, and there is no one who can change His will, whether in the upper or lower sides, or in the four directions. No one leaves His authority. He leads all worlds, and there is no second to Him to give Him life... everything is like nothing before Him.

...And there is no drawing near except through all the foundations... to the unique One... to depart from the filth of those who looked at the service. And what are the "Restorations" <note>Tikkunim</note> to bring them near? They shall be Wisdom and the letter *He* and the letter *Vav*... so too are His works... the letter *He* to depart from them... the <term>Holy One, Blessed Be He</term> was revealed over them to receive them. So too the four elements... to the <term>Holy Name</term> from them... what is the difficulty in bringing them near? ...Therefore, in all of them, from the foundation of the sacrifices... "The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer at twilight" <note>Exodus 29:39</note>. And it is written: "And you shall take two..." every male to his mate. And here, the one who brings everything near in this secret, he is the Cause above all, for there is no God but Him. But those things that are the "counsel of the heart," the nature of the service—woe to the one who causes through his intentions to bring in the Serpents! And these are the foundations of the fruit, to remove the Holy One, Blessed Be He, from Israel, so that the nations who worship idols may enter among them. Then there is no closeness to the Holy One, Blessed Be He, and the sacrifices are not considered at all.

And as the Rabbis established the order... to the land of Duma <note>The realm of the dead/silence</note>... who are these? They are all holy... holy waters... foundations... and they are established upon the thigh... your death... and they are commanded...

<summary>This page discusses the mystical purpose of sacrifices as a means to achieve divine unification and protect the community from the "Serpent" (evil forces). It emphasizes that without proper holy intention, the sacrificial act fails to connect the physical world to the Divine Presence (Shekhinah).</summary>

<meta>This page continues the discourse on Parashat Pinhas (Numbers 25:10). It transitions from the mystical reward of Phinehas for his zealotry to a discussion on Jacob’s encounter with angels, exploring the themes of the "Covenant of Peace" and the union of divine forces.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Phinehas**<-

O worthy one, blessed are you to the Holy One, blessed be He, in your way; and then all things are established in their proper manner. *
**He opened** his discourse and said: How great and well-aimed is the counsel and the secret of Enoch <note>original: "Hanoch"; referring to the patriarch who became the angel Metatron</note>—how very fitting it is.
And the "good counsel" is the restoration of the Holy Covenant <term>Berit: the sign of circumcision and the mystical channel of Yesod</term> which is established from below; he restores it and guards it as is proper.
And "you shall make a living thing"—this refers to the "Living One" <note>the Shekhinah or the lower divine vitality</note> here as one, and they shall come from you and be sustained by you, that secret of Enoch from above.
And "you shall delight in the Lord, and He will give you the desires of your heart" (Psalm 37:4). All of this is participation in the restoration of the Covenant, for once the Covenant is found, all is restored. Phinehas, because he stood up for this Covenant, merited everything. And not only that, but he protected the Throne <note>original: "Korsaya"</note> and through him it was established, and he "delighted in the Lord," for he ascended and was bound above and below as one. At first, the Holy One, blessed be He, was hidden in that hole <note>referring to the spear-wound or the breach of the Covenant by Zimri</note>... it was found (that which was of Abraham) from him, and the killing of others as here. After he departed to his house, he did not mention the killing of Zimri, and it was not fitting [to do so], so that he would not be attached at all to the branches of the Other Side <term>Sitra Achra: the realm of impurity</term> and it should not be seen upon him. For anyone who kills the branches of the Other Side has [a trace of it] in him, but Phinehas is attached to the Right Side <note>the side of Mercy/Chesed</note> and has no portion in the Other Side at all, and for this reason it is not mentioned here. As for what was delayed, it was forgotten; he hid it and brought it down from the high level where he was recognized, and it is written "the altar which he struck." And this is the weakness of the altar. Rabbi Phinehas said: Blessed is the generation that hears the words of the Torah, and blessed is my portion that I have merited this. Rabbi Simeon said: Blessed is the generation in which the Grace and the Tradition are found within it. While they were sitting and reconciling one with another, Rabbi Eleazar, the son of Rabbi Simeon, arrived and found them there. He said: Surely it is written, "And Jacob said when he saw them, 'This is God’s camp'" (Genesis 32:2). Rabbi Simeon said to him: Sit and establish the verse. Rabbi Eleazar sat.

---

## Ra'aya Mehemna (Faithful Shepherd)

->**The Faithful Shepherd**<-

**He opened** his discourse and said: "And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him" (Genesis 32:1). What is the meaning of "met him" <note>original: "vayifge'u," which can mean to encounter, to strike, or to pray</note>? It was an encounter for good. But there is an encounter for evil, and there is an encounter for exile. Rather, it is like a lover who is sick with longing; it is written "And he met <note>vayifga</note> the place" (Genesis 28:11), which refers to the exile of the Shekhinah <term>Shekhinah: the Divine Presence</term> who was in that place, just as it is here—this "place" specifically. "And he met the place"—in that site which is visible. Furthermore, "And he met the place" refers to words of appeasement <term>Piyusin: mystical reconciliation</term> from below, the Holy Shekhinah toward the Moon <note>the feminine aspect</note>; the husband toward the wife, with great strength in words of appeasement to reconcile her, as it is written "And he met the place," and afterwards "and he tarried there," for Jacob was certain of the Word. What is written? "And he met him," the order of the Lord to appease him to come toward Him. "And Jacob said when he saw them"—what is "when he saw them"? These were two angels of the day and those who serve at night, and they were hidden from him and afterwards revealed to him. And until here the secret is written: "God’s camp," from here we see they were of the day and became of the night. How were they of the night? It is written of them: "Camp..."

---

## Commentary / Parallel Text (Left Column)

Rather, an "encounter" <note>pegi'ah</note> is an appeasement of all kinds given toward all; there is no matter that unifies the Assembly of Israel like appeasement. And afterwards he performed judgment, and this is "for the mouth is small." Rashi said <note>Reference to Rashi's commentary</note>: "Is it not stored up with me?" (Deut. 32:34). What is this "covering"? For the mouth was open, grinding the flame to the sparks of the basin, washed and completed, for the mouth was found. And because of this, when will the heart be made? For the mouth is a rebel that is saved by prayer. And because of this, the shore is such that it wraps itself to be hidden from the support; blessed is he who hides salty words for your palate, the honor of the meal of obligation... and he feared the rock above, above in many chapters. And because he searched the Name in the place where it is carved, they were faithful over the purities of the sea... wine like the kindness that Jacob spared... and every groom of the bread... for the night to be found; the streams to dismiss him, wine, and he called the name...

## Main Text (Zohar)

**[Right Column]**

The name of that place is mentioned first so that everything should be directed toward it, a congregation for two kings, the Bride, etc. She is called a "voice" <note>Hebrew: *Kalah*, a play on *Kallah* (Bride)</note> for the two. And as it is written there, "a voice went up from the living." And because she is called by the name of the Holy One, Blessed be He, forever, this judgment entered into her, "and he encountered the place" <note>Genesis 28:11</note> according to the mouth. And afterwards, "and he stayed there for the night." And when the attribute of "Who" <note>The Sefirah of Binah</note> is established, it is arranged according to the order of the words that are cast to the side of the permission of the soul itself. And these are with those who establish her as an obligation with you, for I do not give of hers. And at every hour he remembers the cup from the holy vessels, preceding and following him. And it belongs to the King, and he ascends, and he has nothing but "Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord of Hosts" <note>Isaiah 6:3</note> for all worlds. And it was good for the Bride to speak, and behold, it is written, "and he finished the structures," and "he finished" in the chapter of *Hano*. And thus you shall say, for the Rabbis have established that the first wealth is the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term> <note>The feminine indwelling presence of God</note>, and it is loathsome to the prisoner until he returns to the maiden. As at first, the letter *He* was for the One, for that *Vav*, until he returns her to death toward the *Qof*, the gathering. And he who is King shall not remain; there is no hand there, it is not sealed there with the letter *He*. And these are the things one must say to be blessed with grace and supplications. And because of this, they were established as "these" <note>Hebrew: *Elu*</note> in the heart of the Divine Presence with supplications. And it is written as before, until the whole is the Throne, as the secret was said regarding the foundation of the cheapness in the Throne; in weeping you shall act between the evenings. For this is the secret of: when the Merciful One desires, why do I need it? These are the words that shall ascend from the strikes in the darkness of the world; they shall be covered before your heart. Just as a garment covers the body, so too must the holy cover them from the "nakedness of the wanderers" on the bodies, who have no permission to face [the light] and are not burdened. And how hidden are those children of nakedness, the children of men, for every *He* is a covering, and she is found in the hidden places. The daughter of *He* is like a talent and is meritorious. And this is the secret of "under the snow," a path under the servant as it is said. And in every such case, she will suffice, for "she inherits her mistress," for every *He* is her wealth. This is the storm-wind, and when they strayed and she entered her place, she was imprinted with evil. And he is for a thousand, as he encountered her in the house of *Hinbu*; he did not taste of the Bride. And come and see there, "they shall dwell seven days," so too they established seven days for the place in her impurity. (And she is not armed until the Levite... as printed in this portion, page 32, column 2). And these are the sufferings that preceded the planting of the straying for your poor of the world.

**[Left Column]**

From five "creeping things," and those of the day, it is written: The Holy One, Blessed be He, is this. And regarding "And he called the name of that place," he makes wise two traditions. And there are the holy traditions where the strength is placed. Worthy is he who runs to bring in the strength.
Rabbi Shimon said: He who opens a continuous opening...
Rabbi Elazar said: We have established that anyone who says <term>A Psalm of Praise by David</term> <note>Psalm 145:1, commonly known as *Ashrei*</note> every day three times is a son of the World to Come. And what is the reason there? It is because of the sustenance <term>Parnasa</term> and the nourishment of the whole world, which is prepared every day at the time of atonement and in the evening, as it is written afterwards: <quote>In the evening He shall give you meat to eat, etc.</quote> <note>Exodus 16:8</note> If so, why three times every day? Rather, there are two nourishments for the heart which is the witness of the whole world, and one to give an addition to that place of the openings. And these two nourishments are supported, this one from that one. It is written: <quote>And I will establish for them one, the whole in its time.</quote> This is the nourishment of the wealthy, which gives food from "in its time." These are two, as it is written: <quote>And satisfies the desire of every living thing.</quote> <note>Psalm 145:16</note> This is the nourishment of the poor, who bear [their burden] out of will <note>Hebrew: *Ratzon*, also meaning "favor" or "desire"</note> and not from the food itself, as it is written: <quote>You open Your hand.</quote> <note>Psalm 145:16</note> This is the strength for that place where His hands are opened as one who is watchful and forgets nothing. Furthermore, we have learned that it should not be just these two times that he provides every day, for these are the sustenance of man, and he should live more through them because of [divine] pity. Rather, it is because the congregation is within the addition of the song of David the King.

## Main Text (Zohar)

These are the judgments of His Kingdom, and within it are engraved signs. It takes one white and one blue, and concerning these two colors it is said: ->"And under His feet was like a work of sapphire stone"<- <note>Exodus 24:10</note>. For the merit of the sapphire <note>Hebrew: *Sapir*, related to the word for 'clarity' or 'counting'</note> is comprised of two colors, fine and pure: the white and the black-blue of the *Techelet* <note>The biblical blue dye</note>. And regarding these two colors of your likenesses, the masters of wisdom recite the *Shema* prayer in purity, distinguishing between the blue and the white, which is the firmament of the King. The Holy Name <term>YHWH</term> <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter name of God</note>, blessed be He, is included within these colors. The Name <term>YHWH</term> is fine and pure to acquire the "silver of judgment" and the "silver of mercy." And <term>Metatron</term> <note>The supreme Archangel and Heavenly Scribe</note> is like the appearance of the sapphire vision, resembling silver. He corresponds to the Throne, and he has three colors when they spread out... with seventy crowns. They are filled with varieties corresponding to the seventy members of the Sanhedrin <note>The high court of seventy elders</note> for your Throne...

The secret of the Throne is <term>Metatron</term>, the Prince of the Presence, who is called a "small youth" <note>A traditional title for Metatron based on Psalm 37:25</note>. From him come <term>Michael</term>, <term>Gabriel</term>, <term>Nuriel</term>, and <term>Raphael</term>. There are six steps to the Throne, ascending...

...which are called *Yod* and *Chai* <note>Numerical values 10 and 18</note>, Kindness (*Chesed*). Thus it ascends in every crown, all the wings of the gardens... these are the 613 <note>The number of commandments in the Torah</note>. And furthermore, the six steps to the Throne are the mystery of the seven... 182 crowns... for every crown. And there descend eighty ships, the Living Creatures (*Chayot*) <note>The high-ranking angels who carry the Divine Throne</note>... thirty Living Creatures for every crown, and every Living Creature has four faces and four wings. These are the thirty-two for the faces and wings...

The Middle Column <note>The Sefirah of Tiferet, representing balance</note> is the secret of <term>Metatron</term>, who is below, in the likeness of the Beauty (*Tiferet*) of the Heavens. He includes all levels from above to below... from the House of the Curtain <note>The *Parochet*, separating the holy from the most holy</note>. This is the Reed <note>The pen of the scribe</note>... including thirty faces and four wings for every Living Creature...

...Blessed be He in the Throne... thirty-two for the faces and wings, according to the calculation of four times... corresponding to the four camps of the Shekhinah <note>The Divine Presence</note>. And the four camps are for us... like the Day of Atonement (*Yom Kippur*) for Israel, corresponding to "O Lord, open my lips" <note>Psalm 51:17, the opening of the Amidah prayer</note>. The order of prayer begins with the Name <term>YHWH</term>...

The Middle Column is above... there are "Husks" (*Kliphoth*) <note>Forces of impurity or 'shells' that conceal the divine light</note>... for every storm wind, like a king... the Living Creatures of the Husks are in <term>Metatron</term>... in the Middle Column of gold, corresponding to the crown of his kingdom... ->"And he rode upon a cherub and did fly"<- <note>Psalms 18:11</note>. And these Husks are called the "waters of Metatron," small and covered. ->"A great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the Lord; but the Lord was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the Lord was not in the earthquake"<- <note>I Kings 19:11</note>. Take the two husks, green and white, which are the inner husks... strong <term>Kliphoth</term> (Husks) like a covering from above... the third husk is thin... it rides upon the staff and cannot be separated from there... like the body to the soul... the shells of Amalek <note>The biblical archetype of pure evil</note>... the husk that surrounds the brain...

## Main Text (Zohar)

And he ceased to provide power to remove it from him, for the thorns still remain in their place, and they did not all merit the power to receive the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note> in Her kingdom. Before they could be purified, the Holy One, blessed be He, bowed and completed the diaphragm <note>original: *sara*</note> because of the altar of restoration. *[The praise of your foundation]*
And so the shell <term>Kelipah: the "husk" or "shell" of impurity that conceals holiness</term> shall be Kindness <note>Chesed</note> and be called "Power." And "after the earthquake, the Lord was not in the fire" (1 Kings 19:12). The fourth restoration is the word hidden within it: "a still small voice." There is the nest of the King's law. "And from its midst, something like Electrum <term>Chashmal: a mystical fiery substance seen in Ezekiel's vision</term> from the midst of the fire" (Ezekiel 1:4). > And Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven (2 Kings 2:11)

A refining spirit is upon them below; "A wise man's heart is at his right hand, but a fool's heart at his left" (Ecclesiastes 10:2). The spirit that passes through it is the Kingdom, and the Voice kills it, "and my heart is wounded within me" (Psalms 109:22).
And in such a case, one merits to write the spirit of the blowing of his harp, and afterward through it:
> Thus says the Lord: Come from the four winds, O breath (Ezekiel 37:9)
And behold, the cloud within it is a harp. All kinds of harps are guarded: a simple one for one, a double one for one, a triple one for one, and he knows to guard a quadruple one for one. And these are the ten strings <note>original: *dotin*</note> that David made to correspond to them. From there they are suspended and rise to 30, 52, bending in their portions. Just as every awakening of dominion for the nations—the anger and wrath within them—the storm wind knocks at the four boundaries <note>original: *matrin*</note> which are called 50 crowns. And for the servants, the Voice and the terror of the flavors <note>musical accents</note> which are from above.
Gabriel and Raphael all rule over the four boundaries: *Ayish* <note>the constellation Ursa Major</note>, *Bar*, and *Kas*, which are Water, Air, Fire, and Earth. And each one has seven wings. The gall and the spleen are the "Night." <note>margin: The arguments in the spleen are for one; the matters of the lower spleen are a matter of striking with the palm and the book.</note> And those shells that pass from the "Son of Power" are a ladder upon it to the King who stands in fire to cover them for the sake of the Lord <note>YHVH</note>. <meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the *Raya Mehemna* (The Faithful Shepherd) within the Zohar, focusing on the spiritual anatomy of the human body as a microcosm of the Divine. It specifically explores the relationship between the lungs, the breath of prayer, and the angelic hierarchies led by Metatron.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pinhas**<-

**The Torah here** teaches: **In the body** there are breaths. **The speech** bites <note>original: *nashikh*, a play on breath and biting/attachment</note> through three breathings. **And your surroundings** are in the [letter] *Shin*. The lung is for a specific kind [of breath] because it has no softness or thickness at all; it surrounds and cleaves to the heart on the outside, and it covers the barking [sound] and the power of the burning damage of the speech and the spring that is said of them... <note>The text here uses dense metaphorical language relating the physical cooling of the heart by the lungs to the spiritual tempering of divine judgment</note>.

And this voice is "Hear O Israel" <note>Deuteronomy 6:4</note> to the heart, and to make the voice heard in the throat, and it should not be low. The voice, when it goes out toward the **Shekhinah** <term>Divine Presence</term> in the exile, is in a whisper, pressed into the light of the heart, for it is written: <quote>O Lord, open my lips</quote> <note>Psalms 51:17</note>. All the companions are open toward Him, and those who are in the world are like those who sleep. All the parts are for the sake of the voice, and every power falls and bows to the speech...

For the body, the paths pass through, and all the wings [of the lungs] are for every matter... every branch and branch is for the open path toward the Hidden One. For "open my lips" is a gateway toward Him in the exile of the world. There is no one besides Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him, to bring the Shekhinah to the opening toward Him. And because of this, for the offering, the matter is arranged... branches for the King... and the secret of the hidden things of the living [creatures]...

The scholars taught: From the mouth of the Holy One, Blessed be He, strength and life are drawn. At the time when the Voice and the Speech are united, as it is established, and the name **YAHDVNHY** <note>original: "Y-A-D-D-V-N-D-I", a mystical weaving of the names YHVH (Mercy) and ADNY (Judgment)</note> is silent for all. At the time when they are bent and bowed, the separations go from there in the greatness... all are open to receive the ascents to **Metatron** <term>The supreme Archangel who governs the material world</term>, who is appointed because he is the storehouse for all... all are open toward him... the *Ofanim* <note>Wheels/Angels</note> bow to the Speech...

**YAHDVNHY** <note>A combination of the names YHVH and ADNY</note> because "an eye shall fly," the Shekhinah who is sweetened from the ends and the seal... and the master of wings shall tell the matter. The wings [of the lungs] correspond to Metatron below, who is the **Central Column** <term>The Sefirah of Tiferet, balancing Mercy and Judgment</term>, including the right and the left. And it is written: "With two he covered his face, and with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew" <note>Isaiah 6:2</note>. And all this is the Throne... the Holy of Holies... and he meditates on it day and night to lead it to the right, from the side of **Chesed** <term>Loving-kindness</term>. And it is said "The Lord reigns," and He sits on the throne of mercy and is covered in sweetness.

And He dwells in **Chesed**, for Chesed has the numerical value of 72 <note>Chesed (ח-ס-ד) = 8+60+4 = 72</note>, corresponding to the joints and knots of the **Tefillin** <term>Phylacteries</term>. And the name of Metatron... contains "Tat" <note>The number 9 in certain traditions, or part of the name's structure</note>... five knots corresponding to the Five Books of the Torah, and thirteen joints corresponding to the thirteen attributes of mercy... for it is the Shekhinah who is the vision of the likeness of the **Central Column**... four living creatures... and he is called "Cold" from the side of the North... and the Shekhinah is called "Speech" which is the **Central Column**...

The Shekhinah is in all sides to lead with the strength of the **Tefillin** <term>Phylacteries</term> on the left, as it is written: <quote>The Lord has sworn by His right hand, and by the arm of His strength</quote> <note>Isaiah 62:8</note>. "By His right hand"—this is the Torah; "and by the arm of His strength"—these are the Tefillin of the hand. This is the knot of both of them on the left arm. This arm is the **Central Column**... Crown, Wisdom, and Understanding... and the Tefillin are included in the Foundation (*Yesod*) of the Holy of Holies. And Metatron of the **Central Column** is three, and the Tefillin of which it is said: <quote>And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes</quote> <note>Deuteronomy 6:8</note>...

## Main Text (Zohar - The Faithful Shepherd)

<margin>ש</margin> **The letter Shin** of the Tephillin is a law given to Moses at Sinai, and it hints at the verse: *“And all the peoples of the earth shall see that the name of the Lord is called upon you, and they shall be afraid of you.”* <note>Deuteronomy 28:10; Babylonian Talmud, Menachot 35b</note> The Sages established: What is this "Shin"? These are the Tephillin worn upon the head. <margin>ש</margin> **The Shin** of the Tephillin has two varieties of the letter **ש**.
<margin>ש</margin> There is one with three branches and one with four branches. These two varieties represent the Aleph and the two <note>referring to the mystical composition of the letter</note>. And there is no commandment that is not a "visitation" <note>a play on the word *Pekudah*, meaning both commandment and to visit/appoint</note> for the entire Torah. Because of this, know that every commandment is <term>Yah</term> <note>The first two letters of the Divine Name</note> with "My Name," and "His Name" is Yah with "My Remembrance" <note>A classic Zoharic wordplay: *Mitzvah* (Commandment) + *Shemi* (My Name) = 613</note>. Therefore, every commandment is a visitation for the Tephillin, to establish the <term>Shin</term> which includes two from the side of the Female and two from the side of the Male, for the Lord in every place. The sign for this is the 49 gates... according to the image of <term>Metatron</term>, the opener of the gate. <term>Metatron</term> is the name of the prayer in which all those who fall are gathered, and he is the "mouth" in the garden of the Throne of Glory, corresponding to the "covering" of which it is said: *“Praise Yah”*... and not for the pit. The Throne which they received and the Shekhinah <note>The Divine Presence</note> is the Voice and the Speech for every King. And in every voice and speech of the exile, and in every commandment in every place, His dominion is in the upper and lower worlds; He is the life for all, He contains everything.

And they are mentioned without the "Foundation" <note>Yesod</note> which is hidden, which is the Male without Voice, and there is no Voice without Speech, and she is Life at the end in the World to Come. And there is "eating" in the world of separation outside—Voice without Speech. The Voice of the Tephillin is permitted to be called out... the Living of the Worlds desires the Voice and the Speech. *I Will Be* <note>original: Eheyeh</note> is the Voice and the Speech, the will of the Word, the dominion regarding the Elder. And he said: The Shin of the Tephillin... the merit of the three commandments are all in that one. Arise, for the commandment of nullification and merit is mentioned three times. And we pray to remember the two who merit the sign. And our building is the **Shin** of Wisdom, to bless and to bring down [light] into it and its radiance. And the Tephillin dwell on the outside, while the Foundation <note>Yesod</note> is within... open toward the heights of the path of Understanding <note>Binah</note>. This hints that they prepared for this all the structures of the twelve seals... the acceptance of the Great Tallit <note>Prayer Shawl</note> (and thus the Tallit is a branch of sparks... like the size of a thumb...).

And these Tephillin are for the Master, for the mind, and corresponding to the heart. The measure of their straps: they should reach the heart on the left, and until the navel on the right. And the strap of the Lord is upon your thigh... three times... but certainly through the flow of kindness they have life... these twelve correspond to the thirty white stones and thirty gold stones... from the side of the Priestly Blessing, which is the "Will." The <term>Shin</term> is pure; the blessing of a commoner should not be light in your eyes. The Great Tallit... the third branch for the life of Beauty <note>Tiferet</note>, and all voices are removed... from the side of holiness... forgiveness because of the "Two Witnesses" <note>original: Dostim</note> over the vessels of merit from the side of the Middle Pillar for life, hidden for Wisdom...

Every word is interwoven from the sides of the links, a link comprised of three wraps, completing the Holy Shekhinah for you... interwoven in the Middle Pillar, comprising three branches... <margin>ש</margin> from the tastes of the Shekhinah... from the blue <note>Tekhelet</note> of the Shekhinah and the silver of the nectar... the strap of the Tephillin... with three wraps... the knot of the Tephillin is comprised of two crowns... thirteen links... like the image of the right hand. Every link is in the image of the three segments [of the finger] corresponding to the three wraps. In every arm there are three segments for every thumb... the measure between one knot and another... the measure of the right and left eye... the measure of the tongue... the measure of the body on four sides... seven segments... the spirit of life in the humility of the Lulav... three in humility for every side... your stature is like a palm tree... the measure of the stature of the Mikvah... the Shekhinah is "Life" for the four merits...
