<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the "Faithful Shepherd" (Ra'aya Mehemna) within the Zohar's portion of Pinchas. It focuses on the mechanics of the Divine Chariot and the spiritual anatomy of the angel Metatron, contrasting holy structures with the "husks" (Klipot) of the other side.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pinchas**<-

The concept of "smallness" refers to the <term>Klipah</term> <note>The "husk" or "shell" representing spiritual impurity or concealment</note>. These are the types that are cast out, and this husk emerged like a light within the living creatures (*Chayot*) of the Throne. They stand before the King, yet these are living creatures from the "Other Side" which are merely imitations. And what is their nature? They are called **Holy** <note>original: "Kodesh"</note> above, but below they have no such status. Furthermore, they appear in the vision of the Prince of the Throne and enter the hollow of the Chariot of Life. They also appear as a flash to awaken the <term>Shekhinah</term> <note>The Divine Presence, often viewed as the feminine aspect of God</note> from that side, entering the hollow of the Chariot's palace to rest upon it. It is said of this: "Holy is He," speaking of the House of the Throne, the letter *Vav* twice to the right from above. But "Holy" is not said of the husk itself; rather, its memory is "The Holy One." Those who conduct themselves for the sake of the Name are brought out from the four ancient generations, and the fire is awakened and burns within them. But those who do not conduct themselves for the sake of the Name are brought out to be rebuked; of them it is said, "they rebelled against the sin," and they are called "not holy." This is a matter of a "light and heavy" logic <note>A Kal Va-Chomer, a standard Rabbinic logical inference</note>. And for the dogs—dogs of the heart.

**Rectification** <note>original: "Tikkuna"</note>: Action and thought are established from the Throne and above, and they surround from here and below. The Throne's legs of truth correspond to all of them, like scribes. And the secret of <term>Metatron</term> <note>The highest archangel in Kabbalah, often called the "Prince of the Presence"</note> is the sign within his soul, the image of the Prophet, a sign for the Prophets <note>original: "la-nevi'im"</note> above. <term>Metatron</term> is the strong image for the prophets below. <term>Metatron</term> contains the voice and the life for the prophets, and goodness like the **Chariot** <note>original: "Merkabah"</note>. He afflicts himself, and his legs are like the "leg and palm" for the legs that damage, which are all crooked. But the legs of the holy species of creatures are those of which it is said: > And their legs were a straight leg <note>Ezekiel 1:7</note> from the pitcher of water that Israel washed with. Israel is comprised of three colors, of whom it is said "they are the Chariot itself." This is the exchange for the prophets who guard the leg from the side of the house, to cut off the "leg." And the secret of <term>Metatron</term> is the youth who receives the portion in the drawings, and he is called <term>Metatron</term>. All of Israel would carry the voice from the East and they would tremble, and so to the West, the South, and the North. "Holy" is missing for the angels of that side who run to the exile to rest, and run to cleanse and redeem on the Sabbath. For the Matron <note>The Shekhinah</note> will have mercy on her own and see them in the Ark. She calls to them like a treasure before the King, for they all merit from the side of the sword; they are there because of the merits in exile through the speech of the King. They are beaten with swords to give them life through this wisdom. Thus, for all the matters of Israel, <term>Michael</term> <note>The archangel Michael, protector of Israel</note> stands in the depth of the war. And the prophets of the world are like two lips, and everything that emerges for prophecy is covered in scales. In every commandment of the <term>Shekhinah</term> that is there, they judge to bring in and to take out, and they merit her in the exile. And with every staff where they hear the voice of freedom—for "Holy" is there—they judge regarding the horse and the voice. They see the end in the exile, for in every voice of the Lord (YHWH) we are not present, and the sustenance is not present, and the heart does not tremble, and they merit there. And because of this: > And their legs were a straight leg <note>Ezekiel 1:7</note> because > the ways of the Lord are straight <note>Hosea 14:10</note>. Righteousness is more abundant in them, a "straight path." And if the Lord is not before us, it is not a straight path. Furthermore, > And their legs were a straight leg <note>Ezekiel 1:7</note>—the masters of the Mishnah said that one who prepares his legs in exile is like a straight ladder. > Like the sole of a calf's foot <note>Ezekiel 1:7</note>—to establish a remnant in holiness. Because of this, for the laws of the thin ones, one must align his legs, as it is said: > and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot <note>Ezekiel 1:7</note>. And the word "Holy" is for those who are hidden in their exile; thus, align your legs in your corners to open the weapons of the gates of the Palace to enter like the Chariot.

**Rectification**: The hidden nature of the letter is like the Chariot. The Tree of Life is small. The word "Holy" is full for the one who goes in the waters of the poor and dwells in his exile for the sake of the Name of the Lord (YHWH). He will answer to the rest in the striking of the rock, that they may enter the Palace like kings and ascend to the Most High. He will accompany the Name below toward the <term>Shekhinah</term>, who is pushed down, green and yellow, thin and empty. And the memory of the eunuch of the Lord is in his mouth, as his name is "Walking in Peace." It is not to be made profane. And as it is said there, the secret of the head is for your holiness; they are the exiles of the secret in the exile of light, bound by the count, the sun of the wax, the mezuzah of his, and his walking. And the weak ones carry, for there is no strength there, and the provision of "Holy" and the merit is not found there for "Holy" in the water. And so the two Shekhinahs of the generations are more than the Shekhinah of his life. The Lord is in the throne, Heaven forbid, the Holy One is known in His Chariot, the pious Shekhinah in the depth of the King. Thus, "Yah" is straight upon him in the depth of life, from the fullness and the head as mentioned above. The place is not known upon him, and the heart of all, and the years of the heart, the head of the heart, and so the lights of the opening of the eyes to the place.

<meta>This page continues the Kabbalistic discourse from Parashat Pinchas, specifically focusing on the mystical union between the Holy One, Blessed be He, and the Shekhinah (the Divine Presence). It utilizes the symbolic language of the "Faithful Shepherd" (Ra'aya Mehemna) to describe how the various Divine Attributes (Sefirot) manifest through prayer and sacrifice.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

As it is heard, and so it is in the "Red," the mystery of Isaac <note>representing the attribute of Gevurah/Judgment</note>, for the Lord is his life; his sacrifice is his burnt offering, and as it is above, so it is his life in the sacrifice. A herald calls out to him, and she <note>the Shekhinah</note> is brought near to him in like manner. And so it is with Speech; everything is as one when all is remembered, a complete unity. The Shekhinah is his fire, just as the "White Shekhinah" is his salt, his hearing, his Yom Kippur, his night-vigil <note>original: *lilit dilei*, here likely referring to the night-watch or the rectified aspect of the night</note> in its beginning.

She possesses her nest in the hands; the wrapping of the prayer shawl is the gathering of his body; his kneeling is his bowing, and the "Kof" <note>the letter Qoph</note> of the congregations. The standing prayer <note>the Amidah</note> is the elevation of the burnt offering that stands upon it; everything is for the sake of the "Lamed" <note>the letter Lamed, symbolizing height/teaching</note>, and she kneels toward him and is included within him as a power to the inner face, to instill the fear of Mercy upon the Assembly. His bosom is for the Prophet, and there is no cessation of the "Face" for her, nor is there any "scab" <note>impurity/leprosy</note> in her. There is no division; all is humility. There is no cessation of the Face for the one who acts thus. And because of this, Solomon said: *This is the voice of her husband's crown* <note>referring to the Shekhinah as the crown of her husband, Zeir Anpin</note>, and like the firmament in its clouds, the wrapping of the Shekhinah is the bosom of the Matron. Her handbreadth is hers; the night-spirit has no wrapping and does not bend to the "Kaf" <note>the letter Kaf/palm</note>. Thus the "Mixed Multitude" <note>the Erev Rav</note> praises, but the Reading of the Shema is destined to be clarified for her and to enter from the deeds of the harp... nine attributes. **Asenath gazes** with him...

And so the White Shekhinah hears the Holy One, Blessed be He, and her voice is the ascent from the worlds, and her bosom is his ascent. *He shall go before him and walk to do his will.* And the voice lived... everything is for the sake of Speech. *And behold, Rebecca came out.* Her will is toward him to do his will. And like the Throne, so are they in their likeness... all of them are according to her attributes. And because of this, from the Reading of the Shema below and beneath the stature of all the people... the heart wails for the living houses, for all is a plague-spot.

To serve the King, to live for the service, *from His right hand a fiery law for them.* And he casts dreams from the side of Isaac... Habakkuk protected her before: *O Lord, I have heard the report of You, and I was afraid.* <note>Habakkuk 3:2</note> One [attribute] crowns him like the day of Judah in the red. A plague-spot from the side of the male... to connect with them. Three signs... the Crown on the cheek, the empty hearing... and the "Taste" is upon you... from the side of the portion... and two words from the side of the "Daled" and "Lamed"... words there to be transformed... in Egypt, all of them for her freedom. Two fifties... and her clouds.

And he shall arrange among your children the attributes to be crowned for life, the nicknames of the Holy One, Blessed be He, and His Shekhinah, to show their hiddenness... the crown of her husband... and he casts dreams... to give and not to... for the children of Israel: *They shall do no injustice nor speak lies, nor shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths.* <note>Zephaniah 3:13</note> ...not like the Mixed Multitude who are like a scab... like the radiance of all the primary land... and he was afraid to sink into the dust... to connect to him. And so they told of the plague that is not satisfied by all the money in the world. And because of this, the scholars established the Mishnah for her in the Midrash... because the Holy One, Blessed be He, is found in the secrets of the Torah... around him... in the likeness of his blow.

The strength of His Shekhinah is a cloud for them, the Pious One—and His bosom is mercy for him; the Mighty One—and His bosom is victory over all the days of the world; His bosom is wrath—and His bosom is for the camp. The Strong One is like a fortress—and His bosom is a gathering. He is Righteous—and His bosom is Righteousness. He is King—and His bosom is Sovereignty. He and His bosom are Wisdom; He is the Ancient One—and His bosom is her Understanding. He is the Crown—and His bosom is his diadem, a Crown of Beauty. And because of this, the Sages established the days of Sivan... belonging to the Holy Temple, in the likeness of the Holy One, Blessed be He, and His Shekhinah... inside and out... and there is no division there at all... and because of this, he is hidden within, and is not called "All" except through His Shekhinah. And because of this, the Sages taught... in the writing... in the unification... to request mercy from every side. And because of this, from the Reading of the Shema... for her... and his "inside" is like his "outside"... like his Palace... and because of this, Korach said... *You shall be wholehearted with the Lord your God.* <note>Deuteronomy 18:13</note>

**The Seventh Tikkun** <note>Rectification</note> regarding the matter of the Bow <note>the Rainbow</note> which shall be like the matter of the cup of Phinehas. The Sages said: they are the skin of the Chariot. And the Sages said regarding the Bow: Rabbi Akiva expounded upon the Work of the Chariot... and the Ministering Angels gather at the Mezuzot.

It concludes by introducing the seventh rectification (Tikkun) concerning the symbolism of the Rainbow and the Chariot.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Raya Mehemna (The Faithful Shepherd) within the section of Pinchas. It focuses on the mechanics of prayer as a spiritual unification (Yichud) and the symbolic structure of the Divine Chariot (Merkabah) as it relates to the liturgy.</meta>

# Pinchas

-> Pinchas <-

Groom and Bride, such as the prayer of unification and holiness, and the King below; the unification of Voice and Speech <note>The "Voice" usually represents the male aspect (Zeir Anpin) and "Speech" the female aspect (Shekhinah)</note>. The secret of the matter is that prayer is like a **rainbow**, which is a complete Chariot <note>The rainbow's colors represent the different Sefirot/divine attributes working together</note>, and it is clothed above. The "taste" of it is in the blessings. The sages established them as a judgment and a law, because your mind should be in awe of the radiance of separation from above. In the "wings of the living beings," the Foundation of the Right belongs to Abraham <note>Abraham represents the attribute of Chesed/Lovingkindness</note>, turning to the right. The Bride is to the left when they come to the wedding canopy (*Chuppah*) in many types of wrappings. Israel must awaken them below with songs and praises in every manner of inclusion.

When they come to the canopy, Israel is required to give holiness to the whole, with "Holy, Holy, Holy" <note>The Kedushah prayer</note>, so that there may be a connection to Him. They need crowns for the end... and three wrappings corresponding to the three "Holies": *Holy, Holy, Holy*. This holiness is for Israel, and "Blessed" is to bless them with seven blessings. These are the seven blessings of the wedding canopy, following two before and three after <note>Referring to the structure of the Shema blessings</note>. The Bride is at the end, specifically at the "wings of the sea." For her sake, there is the groomsman, and blue (*techelet*) and white to sanctify them... many knots and scrolls are brought near with many pearls and precious embraces. They fill the secrets for Him, specifically like the ornaments and fastenings of the King and the Matronita <note>The Divine Queen/Shekhinah</note>.

Thirty garments for them and thirty in the garden... two names in a unification... his clothing is like his throne... the dew of heaven. Like a man entering the palace to be there in stillness, pure in the blessings of the Bride, who is like a ewe. The **rainbow** is for them a tree in the Chariot, at the Foundation (*Yesod*). It is a deep foundation... and there is no need there to hear the voice of the Bride, for "only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard" <note>Quoting 1 Samuel 1:13 regarding Hannah’s prayer, the model for the silent Amidah</note>. Explicitly, the day draws near, and so a man with his bride... so that his prayer shall not be heard except by the Holy One, blessed be He... for the act of speech must be in a whisper so that another does not hear. Because of this, the Sages established: "Anyone who makes his voice heard in his prayer is among those of small faith."

The "waters of Kindness" (*Chesed*) from above speak in the branches... they are prepared there in the sparks of the Groom and Bride with secret grace and holiness. Hear the sound... Jacob... the tongue... and like the memory of the wicked... <note>The text here contains dense kabbalistic abbreviations and shorthand regarding the movement of the Chariot</note>.

And three... whoever busies himself with it... four sides... and all reaches the heart... thirty... the unification of the life of the blessings of the Bride... the Foundation that rises to the number 72 (*Chesed*)... and he is meritous to be joined in a unification in the ways of the worlds. The "wings" are like Kindness... it is written "when they stood, they let down their wings" <note>Ezekiel 1:24</note>, meaning they are not enslaved until the end of the hour. And the voice is "only her lips moved," for the wings of the living beings and the voice are not heard...

Living beings of fire speak... and in the standing of the prayer in a whisper... the unifications... twelve... in every prayer... included in Kindness... three columns... to make the Chariot heard... prayer is a drawing near in secret... the sound of the wings... just as when they ascend and strike the holy things and enter. So too in the exile, kings ascend and descend... the bed and the strength ascend and descend. Two ascend and two descend... all the commandments of the Torah. Rabbi Akiva opened his mouth with the business of the Chariot... ascending and descending in every male and his female. The King, **Metatron**, rides upon it to the House of the Shekhinah, which is comprised of the ten Sefirot, the Middle Column, which is *Yod-He-Vav-He*.

The Shekhinah is comprised of ten Sefirot... and the Shekhinah is the Rider and the Chariot for the Cause of Causes, who is the Foundation of all and orders all. He is hidden in the revealed... He passes through the soul, the wing, and the garment, and there is in Him no change, no partner, and no second. He sits in the likeness of the entire Chariot from above, appearing in the likeness of all the upper levels. And thirty are the Rider and the Chariot to Him, and above Him there is none.

The **Rainbow** (*Keshet*): it is the *Tekiah*, *Shevarim*, *Teruah* <note>The three sounds of the Shofar</note>. Jacob is the Crown (*Keter*) within it, and "the blast (*Teruah*) of a King is among them." Three colors appear in it: white, red, and green <note>Representing the Sefirot of Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet</note>. From the side of Power (*Gevurah*), it is called a **bow** <note>A weapon of judgment</note>.

## Main Text (Zohar)

The bow is within it, and from the side of the Right <note>The side of Mercy/Chesed</note> it is "like the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud on a day of rain" <note>Ezekiel 1:28</note>. Everything seen on a rainy day is for the sake of the Presence, and everything seen without rain is a sign that there is no [mercy]. It is engraved between the hidden meanings of the lines of the male principle, and hinted at as including the light of the Tetragrammaton <note>The four-letter Name of God</note> from three branches that embrace the life of our foundation. The foundation of the three Names is gathered into three branches... <note>The text here uses dense, cryptic permutations of Divine Names and numerical values (Gematria) relating to the name Shaddai and the hosts of heaven.</note>

**Rabbi** Yehuda said: Let the Master tell us some of the beautiful words regarding the heights of the Mercy of Sukkot. Rabbi Shimon opened and said: "And it was the day" <note>Job 1:6</note>. In every place where it is written "And it was" (*Vayehi*), it signifies distress. "And it was in the days of Amraphel" <note>Genesis 14:1</note>—this implies distress. "And it was the day"—this refers to the day in which there is distress, which is Rosh Hashanah <note>The Jewish New Year</note>, a day when harsh judgment hangs over the world. "And it was the day that Elisha passed to Shunem" <note>2 Kings 4:8</note>—that was also the day of Rosh Hashanah. In every place, "And it was the day" refers to Rosh Hashanah, the day of the end and completion. Why are there always two days [of Rosh Hashanah]? It is so that Isaac <note>Symbolizing Gevurah/Strict Judgment</note> may be included in both judgment and mercy—two days and not one. For if there were only a single [day of harsh judgment], the world would be destroyed. Therefore, it is written twice, "And it was the day... and it was the day."

"The sons of God came" <note>Job 1:6</note>—these are the great ministers, like the sons of the King who are close to the Prophet. They are the appointed ones who constantly hide the King <note>or "act as prosecutors before the King"</note> and they prepare judgment upon the world. "To stand before the Lord"—did they really stand *over* the Lord? Rather, it means they stood over the [execution of] Judgment. Who is the first of them all? It is he who does not honor the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He, and does not honor the Torah and its servants. Furthermore, who is he who does not care for the glory of the Holy Name, that it should not be profaned like common seed? Who is he who does not care for his own dignity? Who is he who does not set honor for this Name? "And the Satan also came among them"—the word "also" includes his female counterpart <note>Lilith</note>. So too, "to stand before the Lord" implies he is liable for the honor of this Name.

Here the ancient pillars of the world <note>the Sages</note> divided. One said: See from the path that Job was of the nations of the world. And another said: He was of the pious of Israel, and he suffered to provide atonement for the world. For one day Rav Hamnuna met a pious man and said: "The river is drying up! Why is there a righteous man who suffers (*Tzaddik ve-Ra Lo*) and a wicked man who prospers (*Rasha ve-Tov Lo*)?" He replied: A righteous man [who suffers] is one whose debts <note>sins</note> are diminished by being paid off in this world; therefore, he is "righteous and it is bad for him" [here]. And anyone whose sins are increased and whose merits are diminished has his reward paid out in this world; therefore, he is "wicked and it is good for him" [here].

Heaven forbid! The judgments of the Illuminator of the world are ancient (some say: deep). But according to the reason that the Holy One, blessed be He, desires to atone for the sins of the world, He places the burden upon their [the righteous's] arm and strikes them all. To the pious one, He strikes the right arm for all the limbs, as it is written: *“But he was wounded for our transgressions”* <note>Isaiah 53:5</note>. As it has been said: On that day of Rosh Hashanah, seventy thrones are set up to judge the world. How many masters of shields and prosecutors stand above! These are on the right to merit, and those are on the left to find guilt, to mention the sins of the world and of each individual. Therefore, a person must specify his sins, each and every one as it is, because for one who specifies his sins, his judgment is not left to the [prosecuting] hand, but rather to the hand of the Holy One, blessed be He, alone. And whenever judgment is in His hands, they are removed from him <note>the prosecutors lose power</note>.

Therefore, they must specify the sins of every limb and every action, as it is written: *“I acknowledged my sin to You”* <note>Psalm 32:5</note> and it is written: *“And You forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.”* From here we learn that it is written: *“This people has sinned a great sin”* <note>Exodus 32:31</note>. Regarding Israel, it is written: *“We have sinned, for we have forsaken the Lord”* <note>Judges 10:10</note>. If you say this applies to an individual but not a community—no, for this verse is written. And if you say it applies to a community but they are not forgiven—no, for it is written: *“And Moses returned to the Lord...”* and he asked for forgiveness for them. Why? Because for one who specifies his sin, the judgment is removed from him, because a person is close to himself and [the testimony] does not come from the mouth of others. Furthermore, the accuser does not surround him to kill him; instead, the sin is removed from the person and he is torn away <margin>from the coupling</margin> [of judgment].

<summary>This page discusses the mystical origins of Rosh Hashanah as a day of judgment, explaining the necessity of two days to temper justice with mercy. It also addresses the classic theological problem of why the righteous suffer, suggesting they serve as an atonement for the world.</summary>

## Main Text (The Zohar)

And at a time that is not fitting for the "Other Side" <note>The *Sitra Achra*, or the realm of evil/impurity</note> to see, the Holy One, Blessed be He, commands him regarding this, and He adds and performs acts of mercy. On the days of the New Year <note>Rosh Hashanah</note>, they prepare as if setting a throne for the King to judge the entire world. Israel stands before Him as in former times in "harsh judgment," which is actually mercy (for what is harsh to those who are angry?). We have learned: "And the judgment of His people and the cause of every day." What is "day by day"? Rather, it refers to the two days of the New Year, which are seen as two times because they are a pair that join as one. For there is the "Upper Day" which is harsh judgment, and the "Lower Day" which is soft judgment, and both are found together. And concerning this, people do not know that they are like the male and female spirits, and they do not know that both are necessary. And at the time when they are powerful, there are three broken sounds <note>The *Shevarim* blast</note> which represent soft judgment. A moaning that moans softly; they do not know, yet they perform both, and all of them go out upon the path of truth. He opened and said:

> **Blow the Shofar at the new moon, at the hidden time, on our feast day.**
<note>Psalms 81:4. The original Hebrew uses "Bakiseh" (at the hidden/full moon), which the Zohar links to the word "Kisse" (Throne).</note>

"Blow" with this Shofar. What is meant by "at the hidden time" (*Bakiseh*)? For this place which is soft judgment is called a "Throne" (*Kisse*). "At the hidden time" refers to the throne of the Upper World <term>K.M.H.</term> <note>Likely an abbreviation for "Keter, Malchut, Hod" or a similar kabbalistic configuration</note>. This is the <term>Fear of Isaac</term> <note>The attribute of *Gevurah* or Severity</note>, which is a throne for the Upper King. Furthermore, "at the hidden time" refers to that which is the "cut" of the Fear of Isaac. And blessed is the one below who is always prepared, for it is not a time like its fellows. This <term>Yeka</term> <note>A mystical designation for a specific sound or attribute</note> is soft judgment. And "Judgment" is that which is "cut" with mercy, and both of them are as one. Because of this, there are two times. And both are a single proclamation.

> **Happy is the people that knows the joyful sound [Teru'ah]...**
<note>Psalms 89:16</note>

It is not written "who *hears* the joyful sound," but "who *knows* the joyful sound." Because (why because?) the wise ones who dwell in the holy path are those who "know" the *Teru'ah* sound. The spirit of the *Teru'ah* is as it is written:

> **You shall break them with a rod of iron.**
<note>Psalms 2:9. The word for "break them" (*Tero'em*) shares a root with *Teru'ah*.</note>

Who is like Your people Israel, who know the supernal secrets, who know how to arrange themselves before Him and to bind themselves to Him? All those who know the secrets of the *Teru'ah* shall draw near to gaze upon this Face of the Holy One, Blessed be He. This is the first hole <note>opening</note> through which the Holy One, Blessed be He, protects them from harm, and therefore one must know it. It is written: **The appendage from the liver** <note>Exodus 29:22</note>, and it is written: **And the appendage upon the liver**. This is the crown of the "Exchange" <note>The counterfeit or demonic realm</note> that rises above it—the appendage from the liver. The sin of the serpent's lust went out from the liver to lead the people of the world astray and to cause them to sin. It leaves the male to perform acts of lust. Because of this, "the appendage from the liver" and "the appendage upon the liver" is the crown of the "Exchange" to rise above it, through which one sins and lusts. It becomes pregnant by its husband, which is the "Liver" <note>Symbolizing the source of anger and base desires</note>, just as the "Gall" <note>Bile</note> is the sin of anger. This [power] is over her male; through it, one sins and lusts, and it rules over the liver, and one sins through anger and more anger. "The appendage from the liver"—it goes out from the liver to strike the whole world and to create "Exchanges" <note>spiritual distortions</note> with everything. Afterward, she rises to the male through whom one sins and lusts, like the perversity of those who snatch, and then she is "upon the liver." Furthermore, "the appendage from the liver" is for an offering to the "Other Side." It is a crown that goes out to force itself upon everything and gives mountains <note>burdens</note> to her husband. And he takes the appendage from the liver from within the liver. And the appendage of judgment goes out—the Gall—and she is the fat that the Angel of Death licks, from which bitter drops go out to kill human beings. This is the sickness of the Gall, bitter as wormwood, and it is suspended in the liver. All illnesses and death are suspended in it. And on this day [Rosh Hashanah], it wanders through the world to devour all the laws of the world. At that time, everyone waits for the moment; Israel is in distress, for they wait for the Matron <note>The Shekhinah</note>, when the Holy Shekhinah will breathe a single breath. Then all Israel is in distress, and then the Shofar is used to awaken that *Tekiah* blast, the Remembrance, and the *Teru'ah* blast.

-> **The Faithful Shepherd** <-

The **Faithful Shepherd** said: Blessed are the companions who flee from all those troubles that come upon Israel. They must awaken with the sound of the Shofar's blast, for this is the sound that ascends. It is the Crown, as it is written: "And they journeyed," for those in whom anger dwells...

## Main Text (Zohar)

At the time when she <note>The soul or the Shekhinah</note> is strengthened by the **vessels** <term>Arkin: literally "veins" or "sinews," referring here to the spiritual conduits</term> to the heart and over all the vessels that the spirit rests upon, which supports at the end and rises.
One takes the vision of the Shofar of the **World to Come** <note>original: "Alma de-Atei," referring to the realm of Binah/Understanding</note> which is destined to be seen, and it extends its favor to **this world** <note>original: "Alma Dein"</note> which is its ascent. And it is written: *“Hide yourself for a little moment”* <note>Isaiah 26:20</note>.
This is a likeness to the World to Come, where there is no destruction or filth, and to remove transgression. And from the extension of its knees, the destruction descends. End
and sin. And because of this, they wandered and gathered folly for themselves to mix with the **Mixed Multitude** <note>Erev Rav</note> who strayed and went after
eating. And it is written that he descends, and whoever goes [after] slaves and the smoothness of her tongue <note>Proverbs 7:5</note> because the rest of the straying ones eat everything...
...it is written of them: "The portion of the **Lord** <term>Y-Y: A substitution for the Tetragrammaton</term> is His people." He kicked to separate from the straying ones. The guilty ones
who are cursed in their exit, all of them cause the spreading of the desire for eating. And it is written: "And he acted as a stranger in all his words." And the vessels are on the side of
the "Thou shalt nots," according to the count of "transgressions" <note>Hebrew: Pesha'im</note>. This voice is **Y-H** <term>The first two letters of the Divine Name</term> in which there is no eating. And it is written: "And they were like the appearance of the burning coals."
And so **Y-H** is from **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> and between them he established the words. The spirit is acquired in the psalms and is worthy to be compared to the congregation before **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term>.
One acquires Understanding. There is no acquisition for a vision less than both of them, which are Wisdom and Understanding. And because of this, it is blessed to be mixed
in the Shofar, which is the World to Come. The world is parched to find the nations, thirteen attributes of mercy according to the count of
V-H, Chokhmah, V-V-H to establish. And the end is the World to Come. **Tekiah** <term>The long, straight Shofar blast</term> is from the side of Abraham. **Shevarim** <term>The broken, three-part blast</term> is from the side of Isaac. **Teruah** <term>The staccato, nine-part blast</term>
is from the side of Jacob. The breaking of the Tekiah is the knot of all of them that are joined: Q-Tekiah, P-Shevarim, R-Teruah. And all of them ascend toward
the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah</term>, for all holiness is paid to You. For no voice can be commanded except the voice from the mouth. So too, there is no other Shekhinah
from the voices of the **Holy One, Blessed be He** <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu"</note> below. In it is the numerical value of 156 <note>The value of "Yosef" or "Zion"</note> as a chariot for the Shekhinah, and the Shekhinah is the prayer of every mouth. And these are the signs: **K-Sh-R-Q, K-Sh-Q, K-R-Q** <note>Acronyms for the sequences of Shofar blasts: Tekiah-Shevarim-Teruah-Tekiah, etc.</note>.
They take the **Shofar** to be mixed in it—Teruah and Tekiah—the "Hard Judgment" with the "Mercies" mentioned; the "Hard Judgment"
with the "Soft Mercy." And then, so shall they be awakened above.

-> ## The Faithful Shepherd <-

The **Faithful Shepherd** <term>Raya Mehemna: Moses, as the mystical teacher of the Zohar</term> said: Rise and stand to appease the voice for the speaker and to dwell and extend as at first, because
"The voice is the voice of Jacob" <note>Genesis 27:22</note>. In Israel, there is no exchange in eating and drinking like the other nations who dwell in **this world**,
where there is exchange in eating. Rather, the exchange is in the Voice, which is the foundation of the **World to Come**.
The letter **Yod** <term>The first letter of the Divine Name</term>—and because the voice of the Shofar is pleasant in its exit to its Master—between them they open from the Crown of the Sefirot and the Brides, and the doors to be strengthened in the World
to Come for a vision. And the World to Come is the inclusion of this world in its ascent. The "Small He" <note>The final letter of the Divine Name</note> in which there is eating...
And regarding this, it was said: The Crown is to be cut as a lot into two for their life, S-S, two houses of judgment. Who can rule
the fire of both of them? The Yod is for the world of Wisdom. And what is written? "All that is honored and all that is powerful..." to answer
the face of the living... And because of this, it is blessed to mix the voices for the vision of the letter **Vav** in the Crown of the Sefirot
for them, and they will be needed in one gathering, every kind and species from the Crown. Immediately when they heard these things, the Masters
and all the companions said: "Blessed are these to be found, to hear these things from the Master of the Assemblies, the Master of the Sages,
the Master of the Kings, the Crown of the Holy One, Blessed be He, and His Shekhinah." He remembered them by their mouths and wrote by his hands for them...
...all the masters of the Shekhinah above and the masters of the Academy below, all of them are prepared to hear these words from your mouth and your explanations
of the secrets and the redemption that will open in them above and below. Do not give reproach to your wisdom and all your hearing...

## Main Text (Zohar)

And all merits and all good deeds, as well as all that turbidity, filth, and dirt which are evil deeds, [go] toward the **Liver**, of whom it is said "a free slave," the **Scapegoat** <note>The "Se'ir" or he-goat sent to Azazel on Yom Kippur</note>. And all its veins are the rest of the nations, the mountain of Esau. **"And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities"** <note>Leviticus 16:22</note>. Read "their iniquities" (*avonotam*) as "the iniquities of the perfect one" (*avonot tam*), of whom it is said, **"And Jacob was a perfect man"** <note>Genesis 25:27</note>. And the merits are the veins and the pulses of the **Heart**. Because of this, the brain and the will subdue all those males <note>spiritual forces</note> from the Liver, which took in the fats and the filth that are settled within it. The King <note>the Heart</note> brings all the fragrance to all the males. For so it was: since the Heart takes all the merits, the fragrance, and the purity, the Liver takes all that is gathered and turned aside from the filth and the dirt, and it throws it to all the other sides against its will. And from the refuse of the refuse of the Liver, the **Spleen** takes, of which it is said—and Ecclesiastes said—it is "superfluous," and ten "wicked blows."

---

-> **The Faithful Shepherd** <-

**The Faithful Shepherd** said: And as for what the Sages established concerning it, "the Spleen laughs," but it is not the laughter of the fool. Because of this, the Sages established that "life is prepared for him" who makes this Spleen laugh. But Ecclesiastes said, **"Anger is better than laughter"** <note>Ecclesiastes 7:3</note>. This refers to the anger of the Heart, which tempers the wrath of the Holy One, blessed be He, who cries out to God through it. In the likeness of this world, evil bloods that cause disease are red; this redness is in the Spleen, in the filth of this world which reddens them in fear and trembling. Furthermore, the membrane of the Spleen belongs to it, and the power of the dust, and it is stronger than all of them, even the Gallbladder. And because the Ancient One <note>Atika</note> creeps [within] them, the Spleen has "tastes" <note>Ta'amim - musical/interpretive notes</note>, and those times are like a time that delays the revelation of the **Mixed Multitude** <note>Erev Rav - those who left Egypt with Israel but caused spiritual strife</note> from eating the heat... <note>The text here becomes highly cryptic, using anatomical metaphors for the spiritual struggle between Israel and the influence of Esau/Samael</note> ...And further, **"And the goat shall bear upon him their iniquities,"** like a worker of the horn to the Serpent with Israel... until the Liver is made like a parable... the Liver and its weight... rising to the mountain like a vault... the Liver and the weight upon them... and it wants to suckle according to the will... and it becomes heavy upon him... and he doubled and attached himself below... and like a garment of a parable that strengthened over him to make all his returns...

**Rabbi Pinhas said:** This portion is prepared for me to hear these words from the **Ancient of Days** <note>Atik Yomin</note>. The whole world is gazing at its colors. Woe to the world that will be left orphaned, not knowing the words of the Torah as is proper! Certainly, it is so: the Liver takes everything, good and evil and the sin of judgment, and gathers all the debts of Israel. So too, it gathers their merits in order to sustain the Throne, and everything is seen. And this [Liver] is close to the Heart. But the Torah of the Heart does not take anything but the merits, the fragrance, and the purity of everything, as you said. And the dwelling of filth and dirt returns to the Liver, and it takes everything against its will. It is written, **"And the goat shall bear upon him,"** this matter is to return so that it may be sweetened for the mouth... I have merited my portion to prove this... He also opened and said: **"O Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty, etc."** <note>Psalms 131:1</note>. Thus did King David call out at the time he was looking over the body of the river and saw the wicked gathered... David did not pride himself... to surrender my soul for the word of my Master... and he took wisdom. And furthermore, he praises and sings night and day without mention. At that moment David said, **"O Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty; O Lord, my heart is not haughty"**—this is the sacrifice of every day and every time before the Holy One, blessed be He, for the Assembly of Israel is found within Him among all other nations and all the forces of service...

## Main Text (Zohar)

...other mouths are open in desire, and immediately the spirit ascends and brings them out from between the clefts <note>original: "gubzin," referring to hidden or narrow places</note>, and the Assembly of Israel delights in them, as it is written <note>Song of Songs 5:2</note> **"Open to me, my sister, my love..."** etc. Happy is the one who merits to have that spirit rest upon them and does not remain stuck between the clefts and the pits between them, as has been stated. And the Holy One, Blessed be He, did not send us to grasp this standing alone, but rather to learn ancient matters. While they were sitting there, a certain river <note>likely a metaphor for a flowing stream of wisdom or a specific angel</note> laughed and took a whip between them and went on; from here on, he practiced sorcery. They rose and went until they reached the portion of Rabbi Phinehas and Rabbi Shimon. Rabbi Phinehas went his way, and Rabbi Eleazar and his companions went their way, and Rabbi Phinehas and his companions went theirs.

He opened and said: <note>Psalms 60:1</note> **"To the Chief Musician, upon Shushan Eduth, a Michtam of David, to teach."** What does "to teach" mean? To teach the children of the world wisdom, and this they have established. "Shushan Eduth" <note>Lily of Testimony</note> refers to the Great Sanhedrin <note>The high court of ancient Israel</note>, of whom it is written "like a lily among the thorns." "A Michtam of David" is a crown of honor that they bestowed upon David when he sent to fight Aram-Naharaim and Aram-Zobah to wage war against them. Rabbi Phinehas said: This is the "Shushan Eduth" that stands within this Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: the feminine indwelling presence of God</term>; clouds and higher levels are with her, and a holy equality for the sake of desire, so that the "Lily" shall be in a proper union.

They rose and went, these here and those there. Rabbi Phinehas went and stayed in the "Crown of Silence," and Rabbi Judah and Rabbi Hiyya were with him. Until they reached a certain mile, they sat under the wings of the eagle. Rabbi Hiyya closed his eyes and saw those stars of the knees <note>referring to specific constellations or celestial movements</note> that were spreading and moving. He said: "Happy are we, for in how many merits are we surrounded by these stars!" Rabbi Phinehas said: "These stars of the knees are known in the strength of their wisdom, for the 'Nest' <note>Hebrew: KaN, numerical value 150</note> is in the mystery of all those stars of the firmament that bless and wake, and all of them see and praise the Holy One, Blessed be He, who paths from the Crown to the stars." And when their time comes to offer praise, He calls them "Nest" <note>KaN</note> by name, as it is written <note>Isaiah 40:26</note> **"He calls them all by name."** And then they run and traverse the knees of light to offer praise to their Master in that place where they are appointed; it is a voice, as it is written <note>Isaiah 40:26</note> **"Lift up your eyes on high and see: Who created these?"** etc.

While they were looking, they rose and went. As they were walking, a man came with a blessing of Esther <note>possibly a reference to a specific prayer or crown</note> upon their heads and stood over them. Rabbi Phinehas said: "Surely this is a time of knowledge; now be enlightened, O eyes that see all these things, for he is worthy to wait for them and to do for those crowns to merit, for this eagle is a crown of mercy." He opened and said: <note>Deuteronomy 32:11</note> **"As an eagle stirs up its nest, hovers over its young..."** etc. Happy is the one in the world who acts with mercy toward his children in this manner, and they have established that it is written "and he walks like an eagle," for the Merciful One hovers over His children. And the present time is an awakening of mercy; this river has come and wisdom is upon us at this hour, as it is written "and he spoke, hear my voice," and not to search for new things, for his awakening is to prepare the wisdom of the river and pass it before them.

Rabbi Phinehas said: "In the flesh, in the flesh! What are you, a living being in the perfection of your Master below? Behold, you are alive for the sake of the word (The Book of Life) to call to the lower realm; behold, here you are invited." The river came and asked, and they were found among them and accompanied them as they sat. Rabbi Hiyya said: "Behold, this is the handmaid of the King; I have merited (The Book of the Torah) in it, that the river and the blessing should be established."

The King of the world <note>referring to Solomon</note> every single day—King Solomon used to ride upon the wings of an eagle and it would carry him four hundred parasangs <note>an ancient unit of distance</note> in a single hour. He would go to a place called the Desert of Tadmor. There is one place near the Mountains of Darkness called Tadmor in the desert, and it is a place where they preceded to live, for Tadmor is in the lap of the desert of the rocks, and there all the spirits and destructive forces gather. And on that eagle that was flying there at that time, when he reached the mountain of the throne toward the river, Solomon would write a note and cast it there, and he would be saved from those spirits. And the eagle would look into the mist of the mountains and see there Aza and Azael <note>The fallen angels who taught sorcery to mankind</note>, and they were there in chains of iron as a harsh punishment, and they were not able (The Book of Zohar) to go out into the world...

## Main Text (Zohar)

To know, to establish, and to rejoice the eyes of the blind—every man—and since they look into the hidden covering, they reach everything like the blessing of the King below. The King covered the world beneath the celestial wheel and concealed it, standing upon hanging authorities and cords that draw near to them. And the ladder then brings forth the root <note>See the section on Mishpatim, page 49</note> (original: *susya*, horse) which is engraved upon them with the seal of holiness, hidden within the breadth of the covering. These mountains said: whatever the King of the world desires, and below, arise! The world shall know the supernal wisdom, hidden and meritorious below, as the study is explicitly mentioned. Is it by intention for the sake of his moon? Rather, what is "merited"? Look with understanding and know that she who merited to know this supernal wisdom is entirely referred to as in the Scripture. While Rabbi Eleazar was sitting with the covering below them, and horses were beneath the breadth, they turned before them and he taught them from it. And Rabbi Phinehas said: I have triumphed over the outside of this covering, which is like the folly of the profane and lower things. "Steed" is from the secret of "His horses"; a profane horse, but this "Steed" is to make His throne, and it is a testimony for the Assembly of Israel <note>Mishpatim page 49</note> (original: *ve-isiki edut le-yisrael*, and a testimony for Israel) and a testimony for Israel upon her. Five leaves, eighty gates; this one strikes many for the Foundation and they ascend to the sanctuary from the clothing for the life of the Tree. All the works of the throne return, etc. They return, known in understanding, and stand in the dwelling of God, for the works of His throne are seen above and heard below. Seen above in the spirit of the World to Come that arrives, and shown below in the spirit of the Assembly of Israel. The "Horse of Testimony" stands with all these signs on page <note>Mishpatim page 49</note>. His throne is as he said: this "Steed" has thirteen leaves, which are thirteen words until the second "God," and they are:

Below, in the manner of the time when you, Israel, merit to be "horses among the nations," and is this not because of the eyes of the peoples? At the time when the "Horse" opens, the spirit ascends; then they bring it out from within the colors. And they shall be taken like... "Open to me, my sister, my love" <note>Song of Songs 5:2</note>, and it is established for us, arranged for us, but only to look toward the path.

<meta>This page continues the mystical anatomical discourse of the Zohar, specifically focusing on the internal organs as metaphors for spiritual forces. It transitions into the "Raya Mehemna" (The Faithful Shepherd) section, where Moses (the Shepherd) discusses the spiritual nature of the liver and spleen.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

Simon said to Rabbi Eleazar: "Eleazar, everything revolves around these points, just as they stood before Him. And I require of you to be precise regarding the High Living Spirit <note>Hebrew: Ruach Alaya Chaya</note>. Come and see: the seal is the **heart**, and it rests upon that which preceded it, which is refined gold. All the wisdom of the heart is like a burning furnace, and for the salt, they appoint those who soften what is gathered. The veins of the heart are like a King."

The **lobes of the lungs** <note>Literally "wings of the lung"</note> are two, and they are compared to a pair of bellows used to blow upon the heart. The King stands before the spirit of the spirit, as it is written: *The shield of the wise is in the sweetness of life,* which is the ability to teach. A wind blows upon them and honors the world in a single moment. For the lobes of the lungs flap over the heart, and the gift of the King surrounds what is written.

The "Living Creatures" <note>The Chayyot, a high order of angels</note> rained down upon Sodom and Gomorrah; the lobes of the lungs are like the Cherubim who spread their wings, protecting the brain so it does not burn. Because the wings above cover with their wings over the **Ark-Cover** <note>The Kapporet of the Tabernacle</note>. This heart is the Ark-Cover; the spirit is not within it like a priest of the moment, but rather the crown of the heart.

And with what does the King fasten the net? With the beauty of the lung lobes. *The wings of a dove are covered with silver*—this is the voice that is not a bull <note>i.e., not harsh</note>, and it speaks then in the exile. They are soft and thin, and of them it is said: *O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth shall declare Your praise.* The spirit is added to His angels, spirits to praise constantly before the King. For the lobes of the lungs are meant to produce the voice that goes out.

The windpipe <note>The trachea</note> cleans the reed of understanding. Thus says the Lord:
> "From the four winds come, O spirit" <note>Ezekiel 37:9</note>
which are the four directions.

And all of this is the spirit that beats in all the veins of the heart, of which it is said: *it shall not be lacking,* for the spirit was to go and to rest.
The <term>Holy Lamp</term> <note>A title for Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, the "Holy Candle"</note> said: "Is it not that the Living Spirit is a support for your foot? It is the heart." The King fastened the net of the Levite; 'Anger' <note>Ka'as</note> and 'Net' <note>Sabaka</note> have the same numerical value <note>Gematria: both equal 70</note>. He said to him: "Blessed are you, Holy Lamp, for you shine before the King and the Matron <note>The Shekhinah</note>."

The **Faithful Shepherd** <note>Moses</note> said: "Behold, we have established that the lobes of the lungs are occupied with the spirits of the moments. These are the two wings of the spirit, and the two kidneys correspond to the 'three waters' of the Throne. The Throne is the heart in its awakening. So too, the place of the Living Spirit is for a moment of life, which is like mercy."

From the heart emerge hearing and smell. Hearing is song; smell is the scent of incense. There are thirty wings for every holy spark so that it does not burn out. Learn from above and below: for the legs that are clean and straight, *the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot.* And regarding the body, it is said: *The Chariot of the Sweetness.*

The <term>Spleen</term> <note>Tchol</note>: The Holy Lamp opened and said: "He saw all the depths of his anger under the sun, and *behold the tears of the oppressed.* Who are these oppressed ones? These are the infants who are taken by force from the world by the **Angel of Death**. Does the Angel of Death kill them? Rather, he is occupied with the labor of the spleen. And *on the side of their oppressors there was power, but they had no comforter.* This 'power' is the spleen, as it is written: *And it was on the next day...* In the firmament of the heavens there was no spirit from the heat. The spleen is the 'illness of the child,' and the crown of wrath passes through it, and tears fall for them."

The spleen is the 'wife' of the **liver**. This is the secret of the fourth [force], like the act of the sorcerers. Because of this, we have no strength in the power of the liver, which is the resting place of the great ones and the death of the guards.

## The Faithful Shepherd (Raya Mehemna)

**The Faithful Shepherd said:** "Certainly it is so. This liver is Esau. Esau is a voice, a thin voice, a voice that gathers all kinds of blood, whether revealed or hidden. It does not distinguish between good and evil; it does not perform the separation in its day. Regarding it, the wise have said: 'Between good and evil there is no taste.' The spleen is not like the liver; it is not a killer, but it is full of the 'waste' of the blood. It cleanses the heart, which is Jacob, the blessing that is compared to the bosom of the world, to be protected like a child."

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pinchas**<-

They acted with defect in her eyes, acting with the venom that is the body of impurity, like a hideous form, a breath for the great ones; and there is no evil female, Heaven forbid, that we do not call "idolatry." And because of this, the Sages established in the Mishnah <note>The oral law</note> that anyone who is stirred to anger is as if he worships idols. Furthermore, there is no "torn" <term>treif; an animal with a fatal defect</term> or blemish among all the illnesses that master the body except from the side of the Serpent, which strikes with coils upon the veins outside. And in order to strengthen the whole body and make it like the image of Jacob, all his life the hidden "eggs" <note>referring to the testicles or hidden vital forces</note> ascend to the knots, and in order to emerge from the nostrils to the world outside—the Living One, not the Shekhinah <term>the Divine Presence</term>—they pressed into the sand for Esther, to the sea that the deep did not emerge from. So too, the Shekhinah is a "secular" companion to him, and the Lord supports him and passes over the bed of illness. And because of this, the Masters of the Mishnah established: He who visits the sick should not sit at the head of the bed, because the Shekhinah is above his head; nor at his feet, for the Angel of Death is at his feet. Woe to all those people who do not see all his merit! The reward of the Lord shall visit him upon the bed of illness at his head, and the Shekhinah surrounds his body at his feet. And because of this, it was said of Jacob:
> And he gathered his feet into the bed <note>Genesis 49:33</note>

And the Shekhinah was not stirred within her, and she received the praise of his feet to the side of the "light" words <note>original: "qalin," a play on words between light/shameful and voices</note> that he said to him on every side. And the "extra" <note>referring to the lobe of the liver</note> did not tear from the "light" words he said to him on every side; his gall and his face were green like the silver of the "Living One," the drop that he threw into it, the broth of the bowl and the rag—broth for all, this is for the Creator. The lobe of the liver is the female. The stomach is a single level leading to death, and this is called "deep sleep," and the side of this level is the destruction of the Angel of Death. And because it is there, it binds him from the side of death.

## The Faithful Shepherd

->**Ra'aya Meheimna**<-
<note>The "Faithful Shepherd" is a section of the Zohar where Moses (the Shepherd) reveals secrets to the Sages.</note>

The Faithful Shepherd said: After the body is divided from the portion of Good and Evil, there is nothing outside the whole body that does not have an excess of gall. And "excess gall" for the intermediate people and the completely righteous is called "Known," for both male and female are good, as in the Mishnah. For the completely wicked, they are called "evil transgressions" outside, male and female, from the side of the "Other Side" <term>Sitra Achra; the realm of evil</term>. And because of this, from the side of the portion of Good and Evil, the stomach contains it, for so the Sages established: "The stomach sleeps." And this is "Sleep is one-sixtieth of death" <note>original: "one-twentieth," though the Talmudic standard is one-sixtieth</note>. And "Sleep is one-sixtieth of prophecy." And because of this, the Sages established from the ancient words:
> Dreams speak vanity <note>Zechariah 10:2</note>

But is it not written:
> In a dream I will speak with him <note>Numbers 12:6</note>

It is not a difficulty: here it is by means of an angel, there it is by an angel. A dream by an angel is one-sixtieth of prophecy; a dream by means of the Serpent's end is from the side of death. And so he established in the Name of the Lord: Just as it is impossible to have grain without straw, so it is impossible to have a dream without idle matters. This stomach is the gizzard. And the Sages established: "The gizzard grinds." For the portion, everything is nullified, and it supports and prays for each and every limb. They are all "good" in the way the Sages established, for five things are done with the sacrifice so that it does not wither, to receive the "Caesar" <note>the ruler/soul</note> to arrange the reception for him. For there is one who receives it by means of the **Lion** to be stirred by it, and the "Face of the Lion" stands for the four of them, and the reception rides upon it and rejoices in it to receive merit. There is a "hand" <note>arm/power</note> that receives it by means of the **Ox** to be stirred by it, and the "Face of the Ox" is prepared for the four of them. There is a "hand" to receive by means of the **Eagle** to be stirred by it, and the "Face of the Eagle" for the four of them, for those two hidden ones or elders—thus it suckles. And there is a "hand" that receives it by means of **Kindness** <term>Chesed</term>, as it is written:
> When any man of you brings an offering to the Lord <note>Leviticus 1:2</note>

Precisely for the "Caesar" to be stirred by it, and his face is the **Face of a Man**. And they live like the likeness of their shadows to receive the "hand." And there are types of "rings" appointed over the bodies, which are from the four elements, and they are to align and receive the four types of "measures" <note>humors</note> appointed over thirty illnesses, which are: Red Gall, Green Gall, Black Gall, and White Gall. And these are the types of kidneys that heal the secret. And there are above them angels and spheres, and they are the "sustenance" for the righteous, delivered to holiness. And there is sustenance from the "Other Side" which are called "Other Measures," while the "Holy Measures" are for the Living Righteous. And these "Holy Measures" are called the "Judgment of the Exiles." And above them all is the Ark of the Covenant over all the bold ones, and every merit is seen for his debts. And because there are fats for "others" <note>the unholy side</note> beyond them, merit is for the righteous, and "no stranger shall eat of it" alone, so that the fats of the Living should not be mixed with the fats of the "others."

## Main Text (Zohar)

The **stomach** <note>original: *itzto-makha*</note> includes everything; it grinds and arranges for all sides to descend. Beneath it, the grinding is completed, and beneath that, the vision <note>referring to the waste/refuse</note> dwells. Beneath it are all those other spirits and guards who are nourished from those external visions. And the surrounding areas take up all the edges, and it takes everything as one and brings it close to the heart, as it is said: "and they did not see." Because of this, it appears upon the altar in the likeness of a lion consuming the sacrifices with strength, and flaming through all the surrounding edges in the mystery of the body, in the likeness of that which is Above.

-> **The Faithful Shepherd** <-

**The Faithful Shepherd said:** In the first likeness (the stomach first takes the sacrifice upon the sixteen <note>referring to stages of digestion or spiritual gates</note>, which is the canopy and the pushing. The canopy is prepared for the King's heart. And there are two "bakers" <note>metaphorical digestive forces</note> who are the sweetness for all foods, raising the scent of everything as incense to the heart. And this is what is written: > "I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk; eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved" < <note>Song of Songs 5:1</note>. This refers to the upper arrangements of the King's hosts and guards, to whom He divides nourishment by the hand of the **Chief of Bakers** <term>Sar Ha-Ofim: A biblical title used here to represent the digestive force that 'bakes' or processes nutrients</term>. The "beloved" surround and turn by the hand of the **Chief of Butchers** <term>Sar Ha-Tabachim: Representing the force that breaks down or 'slaughters' the food</term>.

And the **liver** is on the right, for blessing and children. Regarding this, it says: > "The face of a lion was on the right side" < <note>Ezekiel 1:10</note>. To the heart, which is the matter of the King's right hand—for the heart is commanded to receive those groundings. Correspondingly: > "The face of an ox was on the left" < <note>Ezekiel 1:10</note>, representing the strength of the Master. But the liver—the liver is hard nourishment for the King, who is the heart, and it nourishes to strengthen the living. How does the liver prepare nourishment for the heart? It is a wonder! Is it not in the likeness of Isaac, who loved Esau because "venison was in his mouth"? <note>Genesis 25:28</note>.

These are the worn-out things that are mixed, their actions are in the blowing and the power, for they cannot focus on the worn-out things... For the people of Israel, there is no nourishment for the body except through the signs Above. The two **wings of the lungs** are prepared for the "living" <note>the soul/vitality</note> by the Chief of Butchers. And the two **kidneys** are the Chief of Bakers, who nullify the heart's sorrow... and they nullify that which they receive from the wings of the spirit.

After the King has eaten—who is the heart—it is said of the two kidneys that they provide for all the "friends." And after the wings of the lungs, the "beloved" surround the heart as one. His four ascents are: two wings of the lungs and two kidneys. The wings of the lungs surround like iron walls to receive upon them the King, who is the > "spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord" < <note>Isaiah 11:2</note>, who sits upon His throne, which is the heart.

The spirit that is written of the wings of the lungs is written regarding the two nostrils; it is cool and thick on the left, and grace on the right. From the side of the resting place, which is the throne, there is a cold spirit to the right for **Lovingkindness** <note>Chesed</note> and grace to the left for **Might** <note>Gevurah</note>. There, the heart and the brain are paired together. So too, the heart is the root and the sign... they receive judgment from judgment. The **spleen** takes its guards... "I acquired for myself male and female servants" <note>Ecclesiastes 2:7</note>.

The two kidneys are called "grinders" after the grinders Above... And in the **windpipe** <note>trachea</note> there are six rings... through them the voice rises to be divided into seven voices for the **Divine Presence** <note>Shekhinah</note>. The sound rises to the mouth, which is the throne, and the six rings correspond to the six steps of the King's throne. The windpipe is the ladder upon which the angels of dreams > "ascend and descend on it" < <note>Genesis 28:12</note>, for they rise to it from the heart. And the spirit... dwells in the heart to receive from the resting place so as not to burden the body... the wings of the lungs are the heels for the spirit... like iron walls... all are joined together by the King's commandments... holy spirits of whom it is said...

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pinchas**<-

The children of the Skull <note>original: *Gilgalta*</note> drink from it, and they are the snows of water that ascend to this heart in a white drop. Concerning this it is written: <note>Job 26:14</note> **But the thunder of His mighty deeds, who can understand?** My beloveds come from the side of Might, and because of this (the secret of the moisture) the voice surrounds, as it is written: <note>Psalm 29:3</note> **The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of glory thunders...** "The God of glory thunders"—this refers to the "God of Thunder" by whose hand the living weep. ## The Faithful Shepherd
<note>original: *Ra'aya Mehemna* — a section of the Zohar where Moses, the "Faithful Shepherd," reveals secrets to Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai.</note>

The Faithful Shepherd **opened** and said: Woe to the children of men, for they are fools of heart and closed of eyes! They do not know how the members of the body are prepared. This Trachea <note>original: *Kaneh*</note> is a nest <note>A wordplay on *Kaneh* (trachea) and *Kin* (nest)</note> that includes the body, the Foundation <note>original: *Yesod*</note>, and the treasure of the bosom. It is the flame of Kindness that goes out from the heart and divides into seven breaths <note>original: *Habelin* — also translated as "vanities"</note> of which Ecclesiastes spoke. It is a white tube that enters from the outside. The voice of the bosom is water, which according to the scent is fourfold; it breathes in secret, and from the general rule, the voice of water, spirit, and fire is made. Every voice divides into seven living things: seven for the cold, six for the corners, and seven wings. When they move to fly to the heart toward the mountain—which are like the scents—this is the 166 of the throwing. The Trachea is strength, and "the thunder of His mighty deeds, who can understand?" This refers to the heart, as it is written for the bosom of the King, to be filled with Might and Kindness on the right, the waters of the scent.

And there is Wisdom, the brain; and from the house of the spring, it breathes after the water of the "standing and flowing [streams] from Lebanon" to the bosom. This is hinted at in the tube of the trachea of scent. After the clouds are removed like Understanding <note>original: *Binah*</note> toward the brain, all the host—who has ever seen such a thing?—the speech is like the thickness of the smoke. This smoke is in the arrangement that ascends from the heart to the brain. All the spirits of the world cannot see it; it is hidden from Understanding. When the King is in it, what is in the brain? It is the 166 of Beauty <note>original: *Tiferet*</note>, which includes seven Sefirot and levels. They are for the escape to the bosom, the spirit of Wisdom that goes out from the depth of the heart, for the heart is a spring. Because of this, there is 166 for Wisdom and 166 for Understanding. Within it, the intellect is like a son of a son to the silence; it ascends and acquires the bosom of the silent one. Those who ascend are called [holy], and those who descend are called [holy].

The **Esophagus** <note>original: *Veshet*</note>: it swallows and extracts from the general rule. All the guilty are pressured (their words shall be nullified, as it is written) on the path to sin. Sinners are the innards immediately. As is known, they take from the midst of the sin of the "ascent" which is included in the sin. But the spirit that does not sin is the Lord's, and "my soul shall eat." They see your pains and they labor, surrounding the seven breaths. Thus, all the people of the world do not know how the breaths and their spirit—all the levels of the heart—know and take from them. The esophagus has no examination from them, for they do not know the strength of those who know and examine and take, until it enters the "house of the grinders" <note>The teeth/stomach</note> to be ground and refined. It takes the whole after the pious brain has crowned it. The previous levels take from the liver as before. And they see the five "dream-grinders" <note>The teeth</note> of your innards, and they are prepared. It is written: <note>Ecclesiastes 12:3</note> **And the grinders cease because they are few.** These are the grinders as before; once they are joined, they are as the first ones upon them. They know and take, and the investigators are the medicine for sin. Even the esophagus is the image of the sustenance of the bosom.

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pinchas**<-

At the time when the world enjoys its tastes, they are not for all, nor is the drinking; rather, it is in the gathering, the fragrance, and the delight of the sacrifice, the water, and the libations of the Levites. The creation is crowned, and the sword of the law—which was established in secret—gazes before the Holy One, Blessed be He <note>original: "קב"ה" - Kudsha Brich Hu</note>, for all the days of Joshua the son of Nun, etc.
**He opened** his discourse and said: **"Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is One"** <note>Deuteronomy 6:4</note>. The letter *Ayin* is large and the letter *Dalet* is large in this verse. And at this time, this refers to what is written "unto the Lord," in all contemplations. For we have learned there: an open *Mem* and a closed *Mem*.
The closed *Mem* <note>The Hebrew letter Mem (מ/ם) has two forms; the closed form represents hidden or celestial realms</note> represents the Upper King; the open *Mem* represents the Lower King. As we have learned: **"Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end"** <note>Isaiah 9:7; the word "increase" (למרבה) uniquely features a closed Mem in the middle of the word</note>. It is written regarding the moisture of the Crown <note>Keter</note> when it is written.
Rabbi Hamnuna the Elder said: Every word of unification that is acknowledged every day is scrutinized and proven from above. From here, as we learn, they are there from the "Petitra" <note>A term likely referring to a mystical authority or source</note> to descend from level to level. As we learned in reverse: *S-L-Y*, and like one who is established as liable. The sign is Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note>, as it is written: "My wise ones to his blindness," etc. It is exactly like this.
This is the Holy Unification <note>The Shema prayer</note>. Recount it to them, for so it is in the Book of Enoch: in this manner, the words of one who declares this unity every day are scrutinized and proven from above. It was taught there: the Name is included from the large *Ayin*, which represents the seventy <note>The numerical value of Ayin is 70</note> natural branches of the spirit for the holy palates of Israel. "The Lord our God, the Lord is One"—and the large *Dalet* in the *Tefillin* <note>Phylacteries</note> is for them alone. This is to say: "Open for me the gates of my will." This *Dalet* is the knot of the *Tefillin*.
The spirit of the wise stands within them to connect to the revealed. Silent are the four "load-bearers" as it is written. He said: on the day that the "Will" is found, and this is like the generation until the judgment of the King Messiah, who will be a sign for them in the revealed.
Two straps go out from this side and from that side, a spirit for the two thighs that stands to cover them. They are cut cubits within them, for from above two arms go out, from the right and from the left. And from below the below, after the thighs spread downward to be divided among the hosts. And all the living beings that are divided are ashamed at the end of the thighs. And they hint at the letter *Yod* of the Holy Covenant <note>Brit Milah/Circumcision</note> upon it from above. Then the living beings are divided at the beginning.
Woe, this is life; this is the Covenant. The letter *Vav*—whoever guards this Covenant, it is his life to return forever. But if he is defiled below, [he is cut off]. From here we learn of Pinchas: because for the sake of life he was zealous for this Covenant, he was saved from the judgment above and from the judgment below. Because of this, the letter *Yod* was infused within him <note>A mystical play on the name Pinchas (פנחס) being augmented with the Yod of the Covenant</note>. Is it not written: **"Pinchas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest..."** <note>Numbers 25:11</note>.
And this *Yod* is necessary so that he should not know at all from the prayer of the hand, so as not to create a separation. Every holy thing shines in this for him. The *Yod* is like the male, not like the female. Because of this, for the offering of kindness, one who distances himself from below is distanced from the delight of the World to Come. Like a male he redeems, and life is precise without the *Yod*. Life is pity, and life is suffering without the *Yod*. And like the High Priest, her joy is in the offering. One who does not prepare with myrtle, those who distance this preparation—they will distance him from the delight above.
And regarding this it is written: **"For those who honor Me I will honor"** <note>1 Samuel 2:30</note>. Come and see: Pinchas stood before the merit of the strength of Isaac <note>The Sefirah of Gevurah</note> and provided sustenance. Therefore, a spirit hovered over Pinchas and a provision went out before him, as it is written: **"Then stood up Pinchas and executed judgment"** <note>Psalm 106:30</note>. He stood as a provider before the judgment of Isaac in order to find favor for Israel. Therefore, this is included in that, in the manner of, etc. And life rests upon it. This provision depends only on the eyes of judgment. And here it is found above in Isaac. But it is certainly so, because Isaac is dependent and found in that place where the eyes are prepared, for there are the judgments of the whole world. For the eyes have natural patterns, the place of the world's judgments, and they are called the Sanhedrin. All is one, because Isaac and these are like a measure, and all is well.
This Pinchas snatched and cut; Pinchas pressed the judgment and clothed himself in the powerful Strength <note>Gevurah</note> of this life that comes in joy. Thus he merited the right side; here the left is included in the right. **"He has turned back My wrath"**—the Good King turned back His wrath because he saw before Him that he was spreading out and did not snatch from the side of Isaac. What did he do? He clothed himself in Isaac and entered into that stature like one who is light.
