<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Zohar on the portion of Pinchas, specifically focusing on the "Ra’aya Mehemna" (The Faithful Shepherd) section. It explores the symbolic meanings of the sacrificial offerings, particularly the "fine flour" and "beaten oil," as representations of divine emanations and the purification of the soul.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

In his wrath to destroy the tithe. Corresponding to them, King David took smooth stones from the brook, and they correspond to the five words of the mouth of the common people of Israel: *Hear O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.* <note>Deuteronomy 6:4</note> And what is in the midst of this slaughter? It is the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note>, like a measure of grain for the secular, with the addition of the letter *Vav*, and at the end, the Bride <note>the Shekhinah</note> gazes upon the Life of Worlds. Afterward, a species from Eden emerges to water the garden. What is "Eden"? This is Understanding <note>Binah</note>, just as Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note> emerges, and the letter *Yod* in *Heh* enters to gather the will that assists, and the favor from the sign according to the supernal forces. They spread through the six directions until reaching the Righteous One <note>Tzadik/Yesod</note>, who brings forth sustenance to the Assembly of Eden, into the lap of the Divine Presence. What is the Crown <note>Keter</note>? The letter *Kaf* is Crown, *Kaf* is Understanding, *Lamed* is the Divine Presence for the assistance of Wisdom. The Crown is prepared for Wisdom in perfection, like a tongue for all the worlds of worlds. They all emerge to be included in the Crown, which spreads until the Righteous One, and his lap includes everything. Because of him, they establish the strength and nourishment for all; upon him, everything depends.

---

## Ra’aya Mehemna (The Faithful Shepherd)

**Fine flour** for a meal offering, to be raised to the lap of the Bride before the Supernal King, to strike with them the two arms.

**The Faithful Shepherd said:** The source of Wisdom is here. These are deep matters, and it is necessary to open them before the companions for the blessing of Isaac, whose preparation is in the morning, and with strength to say of them: *My hand also has laid the foundation of the earth* <note>Isaiah 48:13</note>. For the mouth, the preparation of this table is for blessing. For the levels that stood and were appointed, of whom it was said that they are like a knife in his days, and they all answer to those two arms of the King, whose lap is the Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, the Middle Pillar. His word is the Divine Presence, the beginning of his vessel. Fine flour is like the established Matron, the inner Bride from the incense, without any mixture of darkness at all. For behold, they are spared with the Priests, against the voice that provides nourishment, and like the masses of Israel who bring offerings, they are spared by the Priests. And within this, like a stolen cup, and in the honor of the Living One, He selects for her the choice flour from the chaff. So must Israel pass through their likeness, for all that is multiplied is from the darkness. And the secret of the matter is: *Though the Lord be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly* <note>Psalm 138:6</note>. For thus it is said of the darkness, that the "Evil Inclination" <note>Yetzer ha-Ra</note> overcomes the heights, such as when one overcomes sin, or when one overcomes his station and does not allow him to succeed. And they are destined to be drawn to the lap, and when the evil is covered over, the "Good Inclination" <note>Yetzer ha-Tov</note> prevails, like one who is held in a prison of heights. And so too, when the Good Inclination is held by the judgment of a Sela coin, there are many forces; "Denar" is written, the throne of the forces of the Evil Denar. And at the time when a person awakens with his provision in all his limbs, the voice of the Lord is in the mouth, to say to the lack in them and to bind the primeval serpent. But the Divine Presence, her lap rises in purity, where darkness and death cannot mingle with her. She is like a wing that does not receive a graft from the species of the thicket, for they are the statutes, and my statutes are between the arms of the King, may He be blessed. Mixed with beaten oil.

---

## Ra’aya Mehemna (Continued)

**Mixed with beaten oil:** At the time, at that time when one is moved and bent from the side.

**The Faithful Shepherd said:** In the holy time, how much is from the preparation of the King, and the hidden poverty is here "mixed."

Rabbi Shimon said: And the spirit desired. But what is "beaten" <note>katit</note>? Rather, it is the Supernal Spirit of the Lord. For since the lap is oil from his mouth, it is a hint that he is ready to anoint the female who is hidden within him. Soft oil, "beaten," when it is proper for him, it is only "beaten" to extract nourishment, which are the drops of male seed. And to warm that movement from above in every single drop, it is only "beaten," and he gazes, as it is written: "beaten." With beaten oil—and it was said there in the circularity to break, "mixed," which is sanctified in the lying down as the Talmud teaches. And furthermore, a second excellence: "mixed with beaten oil" certainly, which is for freedom. For "mixed" is not like those who gather many judgments, like the anger of the one whose words are crushed, for freedom is not established except through complete assistance upon it. And furthermore, they said: At the time her exile increased, she preferred the judgment to finish the face of the Divine Presence. And regarding "mixed with beaten oil."

<summary>This page provides a kabbalistic interpretation of the "fine flour" and "beaten oil" used in Temple offerings, correlating them to the union of the Sefirot (divine attributes) and the struggle between the Good and Evil Inclinations. The Faithful Shepherd (Moses) explains how physical offerings represent the purification of the soul and the flow of divine sustenance from the "Crown" to the "Divine Presence."</summary>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pinchas**<-

They are written and stand upright from all those supernal drops for those holy letters <note>original: "vavs"</note>. Greatness rests beneath it, ascending toward its apertures, and "life" is not written there so that that staff shall not go out, passing without the descent of the drops. And that [staff] in its hiddenness is not seen from those apertures, and the examination was not proper until the aperture was below. And it is not (page 6, in the manner that is written) to be written lowly, nor shall lowliness be found.

It is written that this is the *Segol* <note>The Hebrew vowel mark consisting of three dots</note> to establish the bread in the world... <note>The OCR here contains several corrupted or highly abbreviated strings like "slkl" and "vput"</note> and furthermore in the *Lulav* <note>Palm branch used on Sukkot</note> it is written... and he is "profaned by our transgressions, crushed by our iniquities" <note>A reference to Isaiah 53:5</note>. And furthermore in the *Lulav*... he did not examine from the worlds for the building of holy drops for those fruits... from the supernal depth for those "one tenth" <note>Hebrew: *isaron*</note> corresponding to the ten righteous ones... and it ascends...

And the secret of the matter is that they were filled with their afflictions, drops descending and ascending, and corresponding to them are the drops and the sign in the spirit of the Lord, and their thoughts correspond to the three brains <note>The three intellectual Sefirot: Keter, Chokhmah, and Binah</note>. The first... the second... the third... and their merit is taken from all the small ones like a city upon them, and they receive upon themselves like a King. Children are found in the lap to ride and rule over the third living creature, and they stand upon it for its two lives, and they open their wings to receive this, like a *Cholam* <note>The vowel mark for 'o' placed above a letter</note> above the lower ones, the *Segolta* <note>A cantillation mark</note>. And this is the Supernal Crown <term>Keter: the highest Sefirah</term> over Wisdom <term>Chokhmah</term> and Understanding <term>Binah</term>. The ten righteous ones are hinted at in the three waters of the Supernal Kingdom <term>Malchut</term> in the great lap, Beauty <term>Tiferet</term>. It ascends... hinting at Victory <term>Netzach</term>, Splendor <term>Hod</term>, and Foundation <term>Yesod</term>, the chariot of the... the fourth... to her, the Holy Kingdom, the letter *He*, the fourth from this Foundation...

**The fourth of the *He*s is the fourth leg for the Supernal Throne, and the lap is the Daily Offering <note>original: "Olat Tamid"</note> that ascends to Him every single day until the Supernal Tabernacle which has no end, and with every burnt offering it comes upon the...**

## The Faithful Shepherd (Section 1)

**He said**, the Faithful Shepherd <note>A title for Moses in the Zohar</note>: That teaching of the *Durka* <note>A cantillation mark</note> is a living creature, and the fourth hand... thus in the lap of the... Foundation <term>Yesod</term> surrounds like a scribe who walks. The *Segolta* is three lives for the living creatures...

**The Daily Offering** <note>original: "Olat Tamid"</note> is a living creature, the fourth leg to the Supernal Throne. This is the Daily Offering in every day from those six days of Creation. It is placed one upon two so that light and perfection may be added to it as is proper, and this has been said.

## The Faithful Shepherd (Section 2)

->**The Faithful Shepherd**<-

**He said**, the Faithful Shepherd: The burnt offering... the Daily Offering to the letter *Yod* and to Aaron... Victory <term>Netzach</term>... and the voice of prayer from those six ascends like the third day to the three, corresponding to Beauty <term>Tiferet</term>. On the Sabbath day, there is added with it... and sanctified for the lap of Understanding <term>Binah</term>, the upper *He*. The *Yod* dwells in Understanding, the Supernal Wisdom <term>Chokhmah</term>. The King is crowned with the Crown <term>Keter</term>, and "all shall give a Crown to You" <note>A liturgical phrase from the Kedushah of the Musaf prayer</note> in the Musaf prayer. "And on the beginnings of your months" etc. How many lines are there for the brain of those two commandments, which are the *Segol*? As at first, the Crown was over two kings... and the secret of the *Segolta*. And regarding the Crown, you said: is it possible for two kings to use one crown? <note>A famous Talmudic motif regarding the sun and the moon</note>. With the help of Heaven <note>original: "S"L"</note>, the Holy One, Blessed Be He, said: "Go and find yourself..." and it is written for the prophets of the two kings in this manner. And this is the *Segol*... the *Segolta* of Beauty <term>Tiferet</term> is *Segol*, and a spirit for the King corresponding to two commandments... the secret of spreading the palms... and corresponding to the holiness of the diadem upon their heads.

The letter *Aleph*... Kindness <term>Chesed</term> is like a Crown... for the children of kings... like a Crown... and the face of the world... to turn from judgment... and because of this, the goat of the goats... and not one for a burnt offering to be a Crown... and the *Segol* ascends... to teach the world... and to the Crown... and all is one. And because of this, they prepared...

<meta>This page continues the mystical commentary on the Book of Numbers (Parashat Pinchas), specifically focusing on the sacrificial offerings of the New Moon (Rosh Chodesh). It transitions into the "Faithful Shepherd" (Ra'aya Meheimna) section, which provides a deeper kabbalistic layer to the laws of the Torah.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

A Heavenly Voice went out and said: "If only it were in this manner!" And afterwards, she <note>The Shekhinah or the Moon</note> was diminished and descended through the levels in this manner. She descended and they received her in this section, a level established in the world. Every part was like a pearl, and afterwards, her holy feet emerged to say... <note>The OCR here contains fragmented mystical abbreviations</note> And what is the secret of the "living creature"? It is the secret of the precise discipline that provides for the "earrings" <note>metaphor for vessels of reception</note> when judgment is cast upon the wicked. And the secret of the King is that the entry was for the Bride, in the manner of a secret and a watcher who enters to call and invite the children of the palace to stand before the seven spheres <note>The Sefirot</note>.

**And on your New Moons...** <note>Numbers 28:11</note> Now, how many "heads" of the month are there for the Moon? For the Moon has no head of her own, except for the side that provides a head for her. Rather, "Heads" refers to two in every single month, and they are Jacob and Joseph <note>representing the Sefirot of Tiferet and Yesod</note> who appear over the Moon. And because of this, the matter is revealed.

**Young bulls...** The sum of these are those who provide for the Moon, so that they may be drawn into her as one. Her body is seen beneath them. One strength is the strength of Isaac <note>Gevurah/Judgment</note>. And where did Abraham go? It is because Esau <note>the root of judgment</note> is awakened there; Abraham withdraws so that he [Esau] will not see him. And who is it that awakens the spirit? Because Esau is destined to be awakened there, Abraham withdraws and is not found there. Isaac is found there, for his love is toward him like wine upon the dregs. Jacob is found there to bless his countenance. Joseph is found there to protect her burden <note>original: *tun* or *tur*</note> toward Rachel.

---
-> **The Faithful Shepherd** <-

**Seven** lambs—these are the seven days of the Moon. **The Faithful Shepherd said:** Worthy is the Prophet who merited to be called "a son of a year" <note>a reference to the purity of the sacrificial lamb</note>. Like Samuel, to investigate the secret of the separation... there were three windows around the ancient ones... there is no doubt in it, and it is destined like a horse for her to be made and to ascend above. It is the world that is holy to Israel. Two are below: one to the right of Kindness (*Chesed*) and its strength... the commandments are found, the letter *Vav* with the Mother <note>Binah</note>. The Daughter <note>the Shekhinah</note> with the Father <note>Chokhmah</note> to the right of Kindness. And the secret of the matter is in the afternoon offering (*Mincha*)... the Name *ADNY* is the Daughter. Since the Daughter is with the Father, there is the pressure of Strength (*Gevurah*) and the voice of the Lord.

Furthermore, **one male goat for a sin offering**—there are two goats of which it is said: > And he shall take the two goats... one lot for the Lord and one lot for Azazel < <note>Leviticus 16:7-8</note>. A goat for the Lord is because of the diminishing of the Moon. One goat for the Lord is taken as a crown for the Foundation (*Yesod*). Regarding the goat of the Left <note>the side of impurity/judgment</note>, it is not written as an "offering," nor a "sin offering," nor a "burnt offering," but rather as a portion for the poor and the afflicted. It forgives everything from several sides, a departure for the portion of Esau... the anger of the Left is toward him, and he approaches to act as the accuser. He is like a hungry dog; whoever wishes to satisfy him, it is written that he gives him meat to eat from the leftovers... the secret of the matter is: "If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat" <note>Proverbs 25:21</note>. In this way, the masculine standing is arranged for the Lord. It is written several times not to approach his heels... they are called "Satyrs" (*Se'irim*), as it is written: > and satyrs shall dance there < <note>Isaiah 13:21</note>. And it says: > They shall no more offer their sacrifices unto satyrs < <note>Leviticus 17:7</note>. Of them it is said: > They sacrificed to demons, not to God < <note>Deuteronomy 32:17</note>. And through this goat, he is separated from everyone, and he carries all the sins of Israel upon him, as it is said: > And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities < <note>Leviticus 16:22</note>.

**And three-tenth parts...** these are her three first levels <note>the higher Sefirot</note>, each of which is ten, in the manner of the upper worlds. **And two-tenth parts...** for the place where the glory of God is seen... Rabbi Eleazar said: We have learned that it is written "for the Lord."

## Main Text (Zohar)

However, if it were not brought near to surely atone, to subdue the impure side <note>original: *sitra mas'aba*</note> and to draw near to the Sanctuary, then Moses and all mankind would not have merited this portion, and He would not have destroyed His holy mountain. And this is the vision: that no other is found with Him to eat of it. This portion is prepared in the Garden from the King’s feast, and because of this, there is joy, and he <note>the Accuser</note> is separated from the side and does not prosecute against them. And were it not for the end of the moon’s waning, they would give him nothing from the King’s feast. And what does he do during the moon’s waning? Rather, because they draw near and gain merit, he takes a portion for his people from the side of the moon’s darkness and is strengthened by it. And as this small part is separated from all, it is prepared for him. And because he desires to guard the moon, they bring him near to the eye-paint <note>an idiom for beautification or preparation</note> so that he will separate from her. And regarding the second, they said: "Bring an atonement for Me" <note>A Talmudic reference to God asking for an atonement for diminishing the moon</note> because I diminished her. Because of My Sabbath, you are attached to this.

<meta>This page continues the discourse on the mystical significance of the festivals, specifically focusing on the seventh month (Tishrei) and Rosh Hashanah. It maintains the dual-column structure where the main Zohar text provides a poetic-mystical commentary on the "Hind of the Dawn," while the Faithful Shepherd (Moses) provides deeper insights into the commandments and the process of redemption.</meta>

# Pinhas - The Faithful Shepherd

## Main Text (Zohar)

**And in the seventh month** etc. <note>Numbers 29:1</note>. Rabbi Abba opened the discourse: <note>Psalms 42:2</note> **"As the hart pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants for You, O God."** This verse has been established by the colleagues. It is written here "hart" <note>Hebrew: *Ayil* - male</note> and it is written elsewhere "hind" <note>Hebrew: *Ayyelet* - female</note>. Are they not one and the same? It is because there is a Male aspect and a Female aspect. At the time when Male and Female are joined, there is the Hart and the Hind. Alternatively, she is called the "Hind of the Dawn" <note>Hebrew: *Ayyelet HaShachar*</note>, and it is all one mystery. Why is she called the Hind of the Dawn? Because she stands at the first light of morning; there is no living creature in the world that awakens like her. For in the hour when the time is pressed and dark—the time which is a vision of sickness, distant and weary from the East—she does not seek to give birth until she returns to her place. She takes hold so that the other living beings may gather to her, collected from the side of the Brain <note>The mystical source of wisdom</note>. And when she comes, all the other living beings gather to her, and the existence is opened with warmth and as a garden for each and every one. And the sign of this is: <note>Proverbs 31:15</note> **"She rises while it is yet night, and gives food to her household..."** and from that which she distributes to them, she herself gazes out and eats more than all of them. And when she is afraid to search after her mate, it is written that she is revealed. Because of this, she is called the "Hind of the Dawn," named for the early morning when we stand before her like a woman in labor, as it says: <note>Isaiah 26:17</note> **"Like a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and cries out in her pangs..."** When does she distribute to them? When she breathes life into them while the night is still dark. The "Early One" is like the Female who returns, for the darkness breathes out all the tastes in her likeness; then a voice of judgment is awakened below. In the firmament, they call out with strength and say: "Those who are near, enter your places! Those who are far, go out, each one to his place, to his station, to his life!" Once His name is engraved, each one is gathered to his place. This is "The law of the sin offering..." <note>Leviticus 6:18</note>. And it is not foolishness like the day, but joy in the redemption that comes after she strengthens herself like a giant and is weary; she is called a "Hind" and afterward she breaks through.

<column-break/>

## Commentary (The Faithful Shepherd)

**The Faithful Shepherd said:** At that time, such-and-such wonders of wisdom were revealed, etc., until it was made as if from the world, as explained in the sections of the *Hekhalot* <note>The Heavenly Palaces</note>, page 67b, and following what is written nearby. **And if you say** the "Hart" alludes to when they are warm, the "Hind" follows the dripping and prepares like them. Regarding hunger, it is written: <note>Isaiah 66:7</note> **"Before she travailed, she gave birth."** And regarding this matter, the end of the verse says: <note>Isaiah 65:24</note> **"Before they call, I will answer..."** Before the redemption, when the seventy-two years are completed in the narrowness of the redemption, the mate who gives birth and the pangs that end in distress come forth. And from there: <note>Psalms 29:9</note> **"And in His temple everyone says: Glory!"** This has been established as the crucible that strikes and causes pain. In the hour when the masters of the Torah deliver [wisdom], it is like wings—those who are scattered like ropes of labor and a throat like a woman giving birth. They are nested among the people of Paran <note>A reference to the nations or the wilderness</note>, and He sustains them with His wings. The Lord is One, to provide well for those who are cast down, only from the Right Hand of the constellation, in the likeness of the binding of the Emanation <note><term>Atzilut</term>: The highest of the four worlds in Kabbalah</note>. The deep and the curtain of the heavens went forth in the days of the Flood. In the end, will they not awaken to the Right Hand of His pruning? The yoke and the woman are upon the "No End" <note><term>Ein Sof</term>: The Infinite Godhead</note>, and His form is in all directions to praise His servant. His works are prepared for the world of the Name *YHVH*, and for His assistance, and for many changes for the enemies of Israel. Their transition is in the name of "The Lord our King," like a swift horse, and for this, it is called *Susi* <note>My horse</note>, and the Lord is exalted above them. **And in the seventh month** etc. The dominion is yours... she gave birth to that one to fulfill what was established. The nations are in hiding, but in the future, they [Israel] are destined to be redeemed. And regarding His "Hand," it is said that it is directed toward the Throne of *Yah* <note>The Divine Name YH</note>. It is time to act for the sake of the ascent. He sustains the horse and the blow... for your judgments. We have heard the Passover from the side of Your hand. And secondly, at that time when the Lord says to the shepherds: "Be quiet," and He supports the Holy Land. Those shepherds—the leaders who did not provide—will not be hidden. Because of this, it is said of them: "Bring the wise men of the magicians," and I was heard by the people according to the hearing of your wise men who were killed on the Sabbath in the exile, in the night and the division of the book. She is called "sick" for them, after the sickness of their night; there is no mast from the side of the breakthrough.

<summary>This page explores the mystical identity of the "Hind of the Dawn" (Malchut) and her role in the transition from the darkness of exile to the light of redemption, specifically linked to the month of Tishrei and Rosh Hashanah. The Faithful Shepherd section emphasizes the suffering of the exile as birth pangs leading to the ultimate revelation of Divine glory.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the Shekhinah, specifically focusing on the imagery of the "Hind of the Dawn" and the birth pangs of the world. It transitions from a single column into a two-column layout featuring the "Faithful Shepherd" (Ra'aya Meheimna) commentary.</meta>

# Pinchas

## Main Text (Zohar)

After they went out and entered into the Mountain of Darkness, and from there the path is narrow, the Hind <note>original: *Ayalat*—referring to the Shekhinah or the "Hind of the Dawn"</note> because of that Mountain of Darkness lifts her leg—a crooked matter—and walks on her leg. She ascends from there toward the Mountain of Light. When she arrives there, the **Holy One, Blessed be He** <note>original: *Kudsha Brich Hu*</note> prepares a certain **Snake** <note>original: *Chivya*—representing a cosmic force or the "Other Side"</note> who comes out and acts as an accuser. She is frightened and from there she turns away and returns to her place like the cycle of the night. They turn the night into a scent until midnight, until the darkness of the morning rises. When the day is crowned, the Hind is struck, as has been said. And at the time when the world needs rain, all the masters of the beasts gather together, and she ascends to the top of a high mountain and wraps her head between her knees and cries out groan after groan. The **Holy One, Blessed be He** hears her voice and is filled with mercy and has pity on the world. She descends the mountain and runs and hides herself, and all the masters of the beasts run to find her but she is not found. She returns to find delight by the water brooks; she strikes the water brooks. Why the water brooks? Because the world has dried up, and if there is water, then there is delight. Like the time when the womb is pregnant: when the time comes to give birth, it is locked. She cries out voices upon voices, until seventy voices, corresponding to the number of words in "May the **Lord** <note>original: *YHVH*</note> answer you in the day of distress" <note>Psalm 20</note>. This is the distress of the **Divine Presence** <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note>. The **Holy One, Blessed be He** hears her and prepares for her. Then He brings out a great snake from the mountains of darkness and it descends between the hidden mountains, biting like a needle. It reaches her strength, descends, and bites her in that place twice. The first time, blood comes out and she licks it. From the second strength, water comes out, and all those thirsty ones in the mountains drink. She is opened and gives birth. Your sign for this is: "And you shall strike the rock... twice" <note>Numbers 20:11</note>. And it is written, "And the congregation drank, and their beasts." At this time, the Zealous One has pity on her for the deed that is written. What is written?

> The voice of the **Lord** makes the hinds to calve, and strips the forests bare...
<note>Psalm 29:9</note>

The voice of the **Lord** <note>original: *YHVH*</note> makes the hinds to calve: these are the words and arrows that awaken those seventy voices. Immediately, "He strips the forests bare" to remove that stain and to reveal her firstborn to drink. And in wisdom He strikes, and in His palace the lily of the law—all those diagonals open and say "Glory!" He strikes "Glory," "Blessed be the Glory of the **Lord** from His place."

---

### [Right Column]

**"And in the third month..."** <note>Exodus 19:1</note> The first month said to her: it is the month in which the water was revealed and strengthened, and it bent the world like a hinge. He crowned the day. Like these fourteen masters of the covenant, which are the letters *Yod* and *Yod* for every side, according to the four sides of the world. And on the first side is the letter *Vav*, and it says for every side, for the four sides, and they are four. Since they are four, they join and are established with those ten. And on the right side, then *Yah* is in the cleansing to establish this *Hayah* <note>note: a play on the word "living being" or "was"</note> (what is there to establish? It is called a "living being" through this arrangement). **Rabbi Eleazar** said: Certainly it is so. Come and see, it is written: "Draw out and take for yourselves a lamb..." <note>Exodus 12:21</note>. "Draw out" means to strike; "draw out" as one who draws from the depths of the pit to this place. "Draw out" and prepare for them, and prepare the awakening. And prepare for them even as they are drawn.

---

### ## The Faithful Shepherd (Ra'aya Meheimna)
<note>Left Column</note>

These words are hidden and it is necessary to open them for the companions. For the hidden words are like the bites of a snake in the lap of the angels. And for those who run, let them be for you to establish them, sitting. And take a parable for the wealth of the living: the strong bite... on the feet... and he does not see his law arranged like his food, as it is written "and he gathered." And the voice of his spirit is like a wall to him. And within it, there is an outer part to the cycle, a hidden secret for its creation. In the tenth, there are nine for every side, corresponding to the nine... as they are drawn to her. The voice of their birth is four from the missing, to establish nine for your sides, which is the letter *Lamed*, and they are forty. Remember the hidden voice of forty-two <note>referring to the 42-letter Name of God</note>, of which it is said "Glory," and of which it is said "Blessed be the name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever." And it is "Glory" for the three *Lameds*, and they strike for every side... the rain... Glory above and two below, and because of this they are called...

<summary>This page explores the mystical birth process of the Shekhinah, using the metaphor of a hind being bitten by a snake to release "waters" (mercy/rain) for the world. It links the seventy words of Psalm 20 to the seventy cries of labor and introduces a numerical analysis of Divine Names in the Faithful Shepherd section.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the Torah portion Pinhas. It transitions from a discussion on the numerical and structural alignment of the "lower days" and the "Tabernacle" into the section known as Raya Mehemna (The Faithful Shepherd), which focuses on the High Priest's service within the Heavenly Chambers (Heikhalot).</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

---
->**Pinhas**<-
---

**[Right Column]**

The term "hidden" <note>original: *kumoskan*</note> refers to the poor. The lower days and the humble ones, who are hidden to be illuminated by the Divine Name <note>original: *Y-H-V*</note> in perfection, rose to become 365 days. "Hidden" is like "poor," lacking the letter *Dalet* from the word "Tabernacle" <note>original: *Mishkan*</note>. The upper days relate to the lower days so that they all become as one, like a single word. And who sustains them? Those crowns of the right side, as it is written: *with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him* <note>Song of Songs 3:11</note>. For the crown prepares him from the eight, with the crowning of the eight. These are for every side, and a single point <note>term: *Nikuda* — a primordial point of light or a specific Sefirah</note> that moves in the center, in this manner: <margin>Diagram of the central point and directions</margin> And that point completes the crown and the surrounding ornamentation, as it was said: "encircle and remember." Below, in the crown, those of the right are nine, like that point, as an ornament for the five. These are the days of the right side, in order to connect and for all to become one. And the intention of those four is to be bound to the four sides, joining together. Then the link, which is the Living Creature <note>term: *Chayah* — a high-ranking angel or spiritual force</note>, flows and covers it, and from the power of the holy ones, the Living Creature is sent, and they call it "Glory" <note>term: *Kavod* — the manifested presence of the Divine</note>. Then the appointed time is sanctified, which was not called "Glory" until now; but now they call it "Glory, Splendor," and they contemplate the whole matter of Glory.

**[Left Column]**

They declare the Unity every day twice, for these are the constant times of Glory. Twice for the Almighty, from mountain to mountain, to take up the ascent of the years and the perfection of the world. And because of this, they sing in the manner of David: *Who is this King of Glory? The Lord strong and mighty* and it is written *The Lord of hosts, He is the King of Glory* <note>Psalm 24:8-10</note>.

---
->### The Faithful Shepherd ###<-
---

**[Right Column continued]**

What is this Palace <note>term: *Heikhal* — a celestial chamber or dwelling place of Divine light</note>? This is the inner, supreme Palace where everything is sanctified. There, those who are worthy to be sanctified are made holy. How do they sanctify him in that Palace? First, the gates are opened, and one hidden key is prepared. One gate is opened to the South side. Then the High Priest <note>original: *Kohen Rabba*</note> enters through that opening, turning to the right, and they prepare to crown him with the crown of holiness. He wears the Breastplate and the Ephod, and the hem of his robe has golden bells and pomegranates upon them—a golden bell and a pomegranate. The holy plate <note>term: *Tzitz* — the golden headplate of the High Priest</note> is upon his forehead to be called "Holy to the Lord," and to be bound with the four golden garments and the four white garments. Upon that plate, one sees letters sparking and gathered within it, and that entire Palace shines with supreme lights because that key opened the gate. Then the Levite enters from the crown of Jacob... to be crowned with his ornaments. Then the key is opened, and he opens one gate in that Palace, which is the gate to sustain the faith, the pillar of the East side. He enters...

**[Left Column continued]**

...that Palace was closed, and he opened a gate to his companion on the South side with seventy-two crowns. After he opened the third gate on the East side with sixty-two lights to assist the gates of the assembly. Afterward, he opened another gate on the North side with seventy crowns. All of these are the secret of the "hidden" ones, the faces of the bow. At first, that sign... to be included in the 364 words... the harp of the moon, the upper and lower harp. When he reaches the upper Living Creatures, who are blessed in the exile, he opens with "O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth shall declare Your praise." Then the Central Column <note>term: *Amuda d'Emtaita* — the Sefirah of Tiferet, balancing Mercy and Judgment</note> is crowned with the surrounding stars... and the voice of the tongue of mercy burns on the right. Jacob disciplined Rachel; then they called to the harp, a wise and hidden harp. From the voice of the sound, then the earth is prepared to be sanctified... like the Tabernacle. And because of this, with the crown... to look upon the Holy Palace... the point and the awakening of the Lord in His descent.

<summary>This page discusses the mystical structure of the Heavenly Palaces (Heikhalot) and the symbolic service of the High Priest. It explains how the opening of spiritual "gates" in different directions (South, East, North) aligns the earthly Tabernacle with the divine realm.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the mystical commentary on the Torah portion of Pinechas. The previous section likely discussed the lineage of the priesthood; here, the text transitions into the esoteric origins of the soul of Moses and the sanctification of the Divine Presence (the Shekhinah).</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

Take and be crowned with hidden crowns and be crowned <margin>and ascend to be filled above all kings, all of them in the reading [that was] missing and now we shall complete.</margin>
According to the arrangement that was taught, they are twelve, and he is crowned
like the engravings of the King and seventy thousand worlds. And he is crowned
with the crowns of the ends of the world upon the ends of the world, with many garments of glory and many holy crowns, to gaze upon
that key <note>The "Key" often refers to the power of Yesod or the opening of divine flow</note> which opens for him all the hidden gates and all the gates of the hidden holy ones, and he is sanctified through them.
And he stands there like a king, blessed with many blessings, crowned with many crowns. Then they all go out
in one union, crowned with their crowns as is fitting. Once they go out, Levi was conceived in his holiness
and he took a living being <note>referring to Jochebed</note> and she conceived and gave birth to herself out of the love of the Torah. How did she conceive herself out of the love
of the Torah? She gave birth to herself smaller and smaller until she became a single point. Once she conceived
herself in the Torah, then it is written: **"And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi"** <note>Exodus 2:1</note>. "A daughter of Levi" certainly refers to the side
of the Left <note>The Levites represent the "Left" or Gevurah (Strength) in the Sefirotic tree</note>. How did he grasp her? A thread reached beneath her head out of love. And if you say, if he grasped
a single point, how can one grasp a tiny point that has no substance? Anything that is a tiny matter
cannot be found. And regarding this, Rabbi Berechiah said: the world is like a soft plant; she was conceived for him, and he turned to her
and loved her. Because she was not great, they could not grasp her at all. But once she gave birth to herself and she was
a single point, then they grasped her and raised her up. Once they raised her and she sat between these two sides
like a middle pillar that stands in the center to be joined with her, like the love of male and female
to be seen as one. Then "Jacob took" <note>referring to the integration of divine qualities</note> all those thin layers that cling to one another, a spreading bride,
until he takes the canopy of the marriage as is fitting, according to the knowledge of one who takes the knots of the clouds as is fitting.
And when he wishes to appoint the matter, they all gather and call to her from within the holy palace: "Glory, Glory, Glory!"
In the holy palace here and below they open and say: "Holy, Holy!" Then Rachel is sanctified as is
fitting, and then it is written: "And the throne of mercy..." and they drew it out, etc. And he entered with a crown to sanctify the horse
to be joined in the stream like a path. And that which she held as a single point, when it spread out, it grew little by little
and was filled and became the letter *He* <note>The letter ה (He) represents the Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note> from them, from all sides, sanctified as is fitting.

---

-> **The Faithful Shepherd** <-
<note>The "Ra'aya Meheimna" is a later layer of the Zohar where Moses, the "Faithful Shepherd," reveals secrets to the rabbis.</note>

### [Column 1 - Right]
**Rabbi Pinechas** opened: According to the value of ten days
to sanctify the Passover, etc. This is to say that they are
the Passover to see God, because it is written: **"Lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians"** <note>Exodus 8:22; "Abomination" here refers to the sheep, which the Egyptians worshipped</note> and it says "the abomination of the Egyptians"
etc. because they worshipped it, it is called the abomination of the Egyptians.
Rather, the matter of Egypt and their god is called
the abomination of the Egyptians. And concerning this it is written "the abomination of the nations,"
for there is no specific wisdom among the surrounding nations.
As it is written: "And a possession for the Lord," Pinechas took the wise men
and divided for us to say: "Shepherd, all are your servants." And for
a matter that ruled over all the earth and waited
for the King, he did everything and worked to show them that they would be desolate.

### [Column 2 - Left]
**The Faithful Shepherd said:** For example, the tongue which is
light to all the wise men of understanding, and they laughed at the tongue
of grace, and they tasted the flavor of the crown of life within it. And every staff
punished by their hand... and because all the wisdoms were from the side
of the "K-L-Y" <note>Original: ק' כ' ל' - likely an acronym or mystical permutation</note>, Akiva said: from where do we know that every blow and every
elder... punished the masters like the Egyptians. Behold, the matter of
the punishment of the plagues, etc. From now on, the secret ascends
the bride to the scoffers... and they strike the sinners for us.
And because of this, and upon this, he was struck with many plagues. And further he said:
thirty days, all the best for the Egyptians... and he forgot
his will to spread out... to the Shepherd and to raise you in all
matters of the nations, and all the towers improved for the sake of the land
of the holy ones.

The "Faithful Shepherd" section discusses the Egyptian "abomination" (their sheep-god) and the spiritual significance of the plagues.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the "Faithful Shepherd" (Ra’aya Mehemna) within the Zohar. It focuses on the symbolic and spiritual warfare involved in the Exodus, specifically how the Passover sacrifice was designed to humiliate the Egyptian deities and how the prohibition of leavened bread relates to the purification of the soul from the "husks" of idolatry.</meta>

## Pinhas

**[Right Column]**

...to them an abomination, and they shall not consider them as a god. <note>The text discusses the Egyptian worship of sheep.</note> The **abomination of Egypt** is the name given to their fear and their worship, and concerning this it is written: *Behold, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes?* <note>Exodus 8:22. The "abomination" refers to the animals the Egyptians deified.</note>
Joseph said: "It is all for the best that your thunderous noise is outside." And that seed of their **Matronita** <note>A Kabbalistic term for the Divine Presence, the Shekhinah, often depicted as a Queen or Matron.</note> is for the will and the rectification of all matters of the world. And all the Egyptians <note>original: "Mitzra'ei"</note> are your debtors for your life, for it was their will, when you saw them, to serve the bread of your inheritance, that seed, and the Egyptians would prostrate to them and consider them as is fitting. And this is what is written: *For every shepherd of flocks is an abomination to the Egyptians* <note>Genesis 46:34</note>; they considered them as you saw.
Rabbi Yose said: Here we have learned that just as the **Holy One, Blessed be He**, took vengeance on those who worshiped **idolatry** <note>original: "Avodah Zarah"</note>, so He took vengeance on the strength of Egypt. And did Joseph perform idolatry for them? Heaven forbid! Rather, Joseph acted for his brothers because he did not make them bow down to their [the Egyptians'] things, but rather to subjugate their things under their hands and to pursue them with a staff.
Joseph said: "See and rule!" See their idolatry; every time they would lean upon themselves. And for this reason, I have brought them down to the best of the land and mixed them into all the land, even to the wine of their life. He began to show the fear of the fear of the Egyptians, for their "mole" <note>likely a reference to a specific deity or zodiacal sign</note> was the donkey.
The **Holy One, Blessed be He**, said: "Prepare yourselves before the sight of their fear, the Egyptians, and seize it [the lamb], and it shall be bound and seized in your prison for one day, and two, etc." And when they brought out the male [lamb], they struck it. And at the hour the Egyptians were striking, the voice of their fear was seized in the prison of Israel, and they could not sacrifice to it. They were in their strength, and it was tied upon them like the sand of their bones, bound for slaughter.
The **Holy One, Blessed be He**, said: "And it shall be held in their stalls day after day, for four days," in order that they should see it held. And when they brought it out in its strength for slaughter, the Egyptians would see how you perform justice upon it, and He did not kill them [the Egyptians] by all the plagues that the **Holy One, Blessed be He**, performed on them; they are the judges who shall act as is fitting for them. Afterwards, they shall roast it over the fire...

<column-break/>

**[Left Column]**

...to the fat and to the male [lamb]. And this is what is written: *And this is the God of Egypt*—punishing the exile. See how those Egyptians are subjugated under His hand like slaves after their kings. To carry them all, they are subjugated under the greatness of the **Matronita**. And over us rules this image in the secret of **YHVH** <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter Name of God.</note>. And all the appointed ministers stood by His hands to profane them for mercy.
In the future, He will take vengeance on their strength, as it is said: *And against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments; I am YHVH.* <note>Exodus 12:12</note> For all nine matters, and still their bones are for a god. And because his deed rose above all the ministers, they are called "gods" by the **Holy One, Blessed be He** of Israel. *They shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for a house* <note>Exodus 12:3</note>. And rule over them and seize it, held in captivity for them for a day, and two, and three. And after this, bring out the male [lamb] before the eyes of all the Egyptians and slaughter it to profane it for them, by the will of Israel to perform justice.
Because of this: *Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof* <note>Exodus 12:9</note>. To show this transition in the water certainly, and to cast his bones in the marketplace in the open. And because of this: *Neither shall ye break a bone thereof* <note>Exodus 12:46</note>. And from the day of the meat, after it was held for three days, they slaughtered it to perform justice upon it. And He did not kill them from all the plagues that the **Holy One, Blessed be He**, brought upon them by the hand of the **Faithful Shepherd** <note>Moses</note>. And not only that, but it reached the point of not eating it in tranquility. And immediately, when its bones were cast in the marketplace, they could not sacrifice to it, for He killed them from everything. And not only that, but to be girded with them: *And your staff in your hand* <note>Exodus 12:11</note>, to subjugate all the strength of their Egyptian-ness in their hands.
And because you walked in haste, it is written: *And YHVH smote all the firstborn* <note>Exodus 12:29</note>. After all this, it is written: *And no leavened bread [Hametz]... seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread [Matzah]* <note>Exodus 12:15</note>, the bread of affliction. And it is written: *Ye shall eat nothing leavened* <note>Exodus 12:20</note>.

To be united, to know, and to be elevated to the work of life <note>original: *chiyusa*</note> and within the inclusion of all and everything. He is called "the male son" regarding the elixir of death; the covenant of life <note>original: *brit de-chayohi*</note> shall be joined before him to be drawn from it and to enter, because life is the letter *Vav* [ו], and life is *Vav* rising over *Lamed* [ל], like a strength that rises upon the neck to overcome weakness. And even though there are many branches in the power, and many students upon them, and those who are called "likenesses" and are called "males," these are the eyelashes of the All, just as it is said of them: **Lift up your eyes on high** <note>Isaiah 40:26</note>. **Lift up your eyes on high and see: who created these?** These are a hint to the entire congregation of the Children of Israel. And these are the "pressed gates." These gates are the openings of the portals to the house, the eyes of success. And the time has opened the world to the powerful academy <note>original: *metivta*</note>, for anyone who does not look into the Torah will eventually be covered <note>i.e., lose their spiritual perception</note>. Kings are strengthened; anyone who covers himself from the words of Torah will eventually be covered. **And the King of Glory shall come in** <note>Psalms 24:7</note>. And there is no "Glory" but the Torah, as the verse implies for one who learns the Torah, which is called "Glory" and is called "King." And do not say that this refers only to the World to Come and no more; rather, He is the King of two worlds, in the image of his Master. And because of this, the verse is repeated twice: **Who is this King of Glory?** It is a wonder: Who is this King of Glory? These are the "pressed gates." These "pressed ones" call out and understand; they are the laws of the Upper Kingdom and the waters of the Lower Kingdom, which are "pressed."

### Right Column
**Rabbi Shimon** opened the discourse and said: **"Lift up your eyes on high, etc."** This verse has been established. But did he not say "Everyone, lift up your eyes on high"? These are the two upper gates, the gates of the Upper Understanding <note>the Sephirah of Binah</note>. And they are the fifty gates of life, and they are mercies <note>original: *rachamim*</note>. Who are they? Each one has a "head" to spread out and to benefit one another and to include one in the other. We have found in the Book of Enoch: "Lift up your eyes on high"—these are the two lower gates, and they are three crowns. The "pressed" letters, and they are three crowns. These "pressed" ones are the great mercies of Israel, and they are the upper ones who are "pressed," who are the gates. And because of this, they are the "seekers" of the Priest, and they carry them on their shoulders and say: **Lift up your heads, O gates!** Lift up to whom? To the Mercies, for they have mercy upon them and rule over them. And it is written: "Open the world." These are the ones, and four are below. **And the King of Glory shall come in**—this is the Supreme King of all, who is the King who spreads glory, who is remembered for going out. And who is He? "The Lord of Hosts" <note>original: *YHVH Tzevaot*</note>. He shall come—to which place? To enter the Torah in a vision of strength, a Master as is fitting. And since this one ascended to the places, then the Torah is said to be upon the whole, a single union, and the Upper Torah is like the Torah that was sought.

And then <term>the Holy One, Blessed be He</term> sweetens the nature of the levels below, like that lower level where one of the living beings <note>Chayot - angelic beings</note> is impressed with His ring and lives.

You might say: are there only six living beings and no more? At that time, the Living One sits upon its openings and is found as a fourth over them. Therefore, they redeem it and take those living ones, just as in this lower level, to fulfill that which is written:
> *“You shall surely send away the mother, and the young you may take for yourself...”* <note>Deuteronomy 22:7. This refers to the commandment of Shiluach HaKen.</note>
Rabbi Hamnuna the Elder said: At this time, they do not take it except literally, because they are from the five of your uprightness. And you might say they are "living things," but rather the nature of the living beings as one flies to be found between the wings of the Living One. And Israel knows how to move like a skilled youth. What do they do? They bring out the sweetness of the wings of the Living One, that atonement with a whisper of the mouth—a word toward her, a whisper of the crown, a whisper and a command of the lot of the firmament. For those living ones and for those voices that rise from below toward the <term>Shekhinah</term> <note>The Divine Presence, often depicted as feminine</note>, the wings of the sun are prepared and the head is bowed. Israel takes hold of that knot, and the Mistress desires to fly and go but cannot go while that knot is in their hands. They burn with their voices, and the Mistress flutters in her strength and flies.

### Column 2 (Left)

The King, <term>the Holy One, Blessed be He</term>, says regarding them: *“Do not take the mother with the children.”* And holy words move from the words of the mouth. And this is pure. They established it: "And you shall make a tradition" as a general rule. And within it is the detail. The "parapet" is the general and the detail. And how many roots of words are strengthened? They are lowered and diminished, such as "chariot" and "stronghold." So too they are lowered; do not read "parapet" (*ma'akeh*) but "word" (*millah*). So too, do not read "their wisdom" but "their ladder," to cleave from the pocket—ascending in Scripture, ascending in Mishnah, ascending in Talmud, like the desire of the refugees.

So too, "on the day that Moses finished" (*kallot*)—the word "bride" (*kallah*) we derive from it. You might say we derive them from the coverings. By the hand of an angel, the house is not burdened for you; they have no power to subtract or to add. Rather, these words are "missing" <note>referring to defective spelling in the Torah</note> so that those who are "full" may fill the missing ones. And regarding all the interpretations that can be made for <term>the Holy One, Blessed be He</term>, everything is in His covering. <term>The Holy One, Blessed be He</term> is ready to do as they say, and to sustain the worlds for them. <term>The Holy One, Blessed be He</term> acts *“according to the Torah which they shall teach you.”* <note>Deuteronomy 17:11</note>

The power of the world's desire can reach... for all who redeem our trust, for all who shepherd after the garden of the profane, until the decree is passed upon them—the officials of the kingdoms in their health. <meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the *Ra’aya Mehemna* (The Faithful Shepherd), specifically focusing on the spiritual secrets of the Hebrew month of Tishrei. ## Main Text (Zohar - The Faithful Shepherd)

-> **Pinhas** <-

During the seventy "apples" <note>A kabbalistic reference to the Sefirot or spiritual fruits</note> of the chosen virtue, everything is included in the embrace of **Beauty** (*Tiferet*), which is born from **Wisdom** (*Chochmah*). This is the holiness of the "Holy One of Israel" and "The Lord is King." All seven aspects of **Foundation** (*Yesod*) are like seven rulers. The world has never seen anything as complete as these seven, which are the gates for the **Shofar** <note>The ram's horn</note> from the side of **Kindness** (*Chesed*), branching out from itself, and the **Crown** (*Keter*) from the side of **Strength** (*Gevurah*).

This is **Kingdom** (*Malchut*) and **Wisdom** (*Chochmah*) in the embrace of **Beauty** (*Tiferet*), which rises to be called "Man" (*Adam*). Everything follows the form of the Supernal Man. On **Yom Kippur** <note>The Day of Atonement</note>, it is written: *“You shall afflict your souls”* <note>Leviticus 23:27</note>. On the tenth day of the seventh month, you shall afflict your souls and blast the Shofar. There are nine types of "afflictions" corresponding to the repair of the "Small Hey" <note>The last letter of the Divine Name Y-H-V-H, representing Malchut</note> which rises to the "Higher Hey" <note>The first Hey, representing Understanding/Binah</note>, where all sins are nullified and turned white as snow.

This is the secret of the "tongue of crimson wool" <note>A thread used in the Temple service that miraculously turned white when Israel's sins were forgiven</note>. Because all the sins of Israel weigh against the **Kingdom** (*Malchut*). It is said that they are purified within their garments, wearing the four white garments <note>The vestments of the High Priest</note> and the golden horn.

**Y-A-D-O-N-O-Y** <note>A meditative combination of the names Havayah and Adonai</note>. They established the blowing of the Shofar on Yom Kippur to take the sound into the embrace of the Divine, as it is written: *“In all their affliction, He was afflicted”* <note>Isaiah 63:9</note>. Everything is according to the service of the **Kingdom**, which is comprised of three levels: **Thought, Speech, and Action.**

*“On the fifteenth day of this seventh month...”* <note>Leviticus 23:34</note> you shall take a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work. *“You shall celebrate it as a festival to the Lord for seven days.”* <note>Leviticus 23:36-41</note> This is the repair of the **Central Pillar**. The festival represents **Kindness** (*Chesed*) and **Strength** (*Gevurah*). The "Ancient Ones" from the side of the **Supreme Crown** (*Keter*) descend to provide for all.

**The Faithful Shepherd** <note>Moses</note> says: The commandment of the **Lulav** <note>Palm branch</note> and the **Sukkah** <note>Tabernacle/Hut</note> corresponds to the seven Sefirot. I wish to prepare for you the Sukkah of the embrace, which protects the world and shields the children. Because it is a "Covering of Holiness," as it is written: *“For I made the children of Israel dwell in booths (Sukkot)”* <note>Leviticus 23:43</note> when I brought them out of the land of Egypt; these were the **Clouds of Glory**.

The Sukkah consists of seven days, corresponding to the seven Sefirot of **Kindness** (*Chesed*). It is said that the Sukkah must be at least ten handbreadths high, opening a gateway to the world from the feet to the head. The ten handbreadths provide shade below. Therefore, the requirement for a Sukkah is that it be no less than ten handbreadths high and no higher than twenty.

The Sukkah gates are from the side of **Strength** (*Gevurah*). Because of **Kindness** (*Chesed*), the Lord descended upon it and revealed Himself. The Sukkah stands for every day to awaken the name *Shaddai* <note>Almighty</note>. It is not like a common dwelling. It is a shadow that protects the body.

Regarding the walls of the Sukkah: the law states there must be two full walls and a third even as small as a handbreadth. This completes the structure. The reason the Sukkah is not less than ten handbreadths is because of **Kingdom** (*Malchut*), which is the end of all levels. It is not higher than twenty because that relates to the **Supreme Crown** (*Keter*), which the eye cannot perceive. Regarding this, it is said: *“For man shall not see Me and live”* <note>Exodus 33:20</note>.

These seven correspond to the seven "Planetary Governors." They are male and female. Therefore, they are doubled, like the *“seven and seven pipes”* <note>Zechariah 4:2</note>. There are seven doubled Sefirot and seven days in the lower realm. Everything under the sun is governed by them.

The **Lulav** <note>Palm branch</note> represents the **Righteous One** (*Tzadik* / *Yesod*). It resembles the spinal column, which has eighteen vertebrae, corresponding to the eighteen blessings of the *Amidah* prayer. The Lulav corresponds to the eighteen blessings of the Bride, and the eighteen mentions of God's name in the psalm *“Ascribe to the Lord, O sons of the mighty”* <note>Psalm 29:1</note>. The Lulav is held in the right hand, included in the Right side <note>Chesed/Kindness</note>.

## Main Text (Zohar)

A great palace <note>Hebrew: *Palatin*</note> is established in greatness from above to below to satisfy the eye with pleasantness. It gathers and contains the secret of the likeness of two openings: the **Lulav** (palm branch), which resembles the spine, the support of all bodies. Concerning this, David said: *All my bones shall say, O Lord, who is like You?* <note>Psalm 35:10</note>. And we have learned: **Malchut** (Kingship) is similar to the heart, in which there are reflections and stirrings. All these are joined in the stirrings of the entire heart. Life is found in the chest, life in its praise first. And what is the reason for the spelling of *Lulav*? It is read as "to him a heart" <note>A wordplay on *Lo Lev*</note>. Because of this, the Lulav is held in the right hand, the side of **Chesed** (Loving-kindness). To the right of the Lulav is Chesed, the right arm. And because of this, they established the Lulav in the right, toward the side of **Gevurah** (Strength/Judgment). To the left is the heart. And because of this, the **Etrog** (citron), which is in the likeness of the heart, was established to be held in the left hand. This is to establish the Lulav in the right and the Etrog in the left, and they correspond to "Remember" and "Observe" <note>The two aspects of Sabbath/Commandments</note>. From here, the "fool" <note>referring to the middle pillar/balance</note> arranges them: the Lulav in the right and the Etrog in the left.

**The righteous came**, along with the Faithful Shepherd <note>Moses</note>, David, and Solomon, and they blessed him. They said to him: You are in holy merit, and from your secret, life belongs to the seven [Sefirot]. And you, in your holy merit, are the mixer in the vessel, for everything dies or is clarified through you, in everything that is said regarding the "Balance of the King."

**And the Faithful Shepherd** was found to be like this, and you are the greatness of your limbs, and all of them are one without any separation at all. From there onward, the branches spread out to all the masters of wisdom, to cover these of yours, to perform them.

**He opened** and said:

> Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it... <note>Song of Songs 8:7</note>

What is the meaning of this? It rests upon the acquisition and the hidden day, the seventh day of Sukkot. The Sages established the water libation for the seven days of Sukkot. On these days, Israel offers seventy bulls as an atonement for the seventy nations, so that the world does not perish from the multitude of their oppression. <note>The 70 bulls offered during Sukkot were traditionally viewed as sacrifices on behalf of the 70 nations of the world</note>. The world is built on kindness. On the first day, thirteen unblemished bulls; on the second day, twelve; on the third day, eleven; on the fourth day, ten; on the fifth day, nine; on the sixth day, eight; and on the seventh day, seven. All of them together are seventy, corresponding to the seventy ministers who are cast down. But you are hidden in the Holy of Holies. Just as there is a pouring of water there, so too in the holy places they are strengthened. The seventh day is the heart, the day of the willow-branch <note>Hoshana Rabbah</note>. And the Day of Atonement is the covering. The Lulav and Etrog—from here the Lulav is the scribe. The **Shekhinah** (Divine Presence) is the Upper World over Israel, the embrace of Repentance. The **Sukkah** is for the Etrog. And just as the Lulav is the "luck" <note>Mazal/Flow</note> and the offerings decrease, so too the nations are diminished for the sake of Israel. Their strength is diminished, those appointed over them who resemble the flood waters. This is to establish the ten laws of the decree against the Accuser. As the offerings decrease, the bulls for them decrease, the nations decrease, and the goodness for them decreases.

**The word** "Power" <note>Hebrew: *Koach*, numerical value 28</note> is a deep secret for the world. Seven, seven, seven, seven for the sacrifice... so too those who are cruel of face. Sometimes there are Good Days: seven for Passover and seven for Sukkot. This corresponds to the Seventh Day. All of this is to provide understanding for Israel. What is the word "Power"? It is for the dedication <note>Hanukkah</note>. Furthermore, all these are blessings for understanding, nine blessings that are completed and flow from above to below and below to above, corresponding to "Power" (28). Furthermore, the Shekhinah rests upon those who are mindful of the Sabbath below, providing a hundred thousand for each one. Furthermore, for those who are mindful of the Covenant, it is said: *And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.* Immediately, for those who are mindful of the Tefillin in perfection, the Shekhinah spreads the Sukkah of peace over them, a canopy spread over them like a bride. Because of this, they established the blessing: "Who spreads the shelter of peace over us." Because of this, the seventh blessing contains all these commandments.

> Many waters cannot quench love

The people of Israel are those who change their faces <note>transform themselves</note>. "Water" refers to all the other nations and those appointed over them. They will not be given permission to extinguish the love, even if a man gave all the substance of his house for love, it would be utterly contemned.

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pinchas**<-

He participated in two commandments with Israel, that their strength might be shown to him. And he gathered and hid the passing of the bull for one ram, for one, this is to rectify the Master of the Necklaces <note>A mystical reference to the adornments of the Divine</note>. For the world that is destined to be cleared for the **Crown** <note>Keter</note>, which is their fear, to speak to them like fish in His sea for all who sin because of a small depth. And what is "passing"? "This shall pass among my people." And there is no "passing" except for the **Kingdom** <note>Malchut</note> from the rain of the **Divine Presence** <note>Shekhinah</note>; the world makes a great feast, and rain for the Kingdom from the Righteous One <note>Tzadik/Yesod</note> who is the foundation, to make a deep **Foundation** <term>Yesod - the ninth Sefirah, representing the generative and connecting force</term> from the spit, and she is called the taste of corn, and they crown them with His Crown, hinting at the **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note> of the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah - the feminine aspect of the Divine that dwells among humanity</term>, the crown of beauty. **Rabbi Elazar** <note>original: "R.A."</note> said: Behold, the division of the rain according to the world is ready for all who are crushed, for all nations; and from the side of the Divine Presence, she is ready only for those who have a portion in the Foundation. He said to him: My son, you have explained well, because the Kingdom is a hint of the food for the foundations of prophecy, for the sake of clothing and water. And what is a "slice" and not a "blue"? It is not the prohibition of the land to eat with their sickness. The letter *Lamed* is for her, who is at the end of the Virgin; the prohibition of the land is for them to eat with the Aramean, for he invites the master of his snatchers to eat at the table of her husband. And if those snatchers are knives to her, she eats but does not burn, and all the more so the daughter. And because of this, like a meal of those who know from you, I am not satisfied to eat now from the salt of the King because of the scoffers among them. He said to him: And has the word not now been given in this until its generation stands forever? This is the Divine Presence who ascends above in the appearance of a level to the bottom, evening and morning in every day, always, and the compassion of "Hear O Israel." And her mouth ascends in the **Central Column** <term>Amuda de-Emtzaita - the middle path of the Sefirotic tree, usually identified with Tiferet (Beauty)</term> which is always with her without a slice; she ascends and does not ascend to rectify the rectifications of the laughter of the Infinite <note>Ein Sof</note>, and they are prophecy from all the spreads. And because of this, she ascends without clothing, and in her, the desires of all the **Sefirot** <note>The ten divine emanations</note> ascend, and they are joined with her. And what is his joining? For a pleasing aroma, a fire-offering of spirit from before the Lord <note>original: "YHVH"</note>. And regarding the Crown it is said: "And he descended from performing the sin offering and the burnt offering." In the lower ascent in the spread from all the burdens to Israel, and in her ascent, she is joined in the Central Column; so too her intentions are hidden in him, and all her hosts build her, and she is called a ladder in which all existences ascend, and like the desires that hang from the Foundation. And because of this, all sacrifices and burnt offerings are for the Foundation, and it is called a "sacrifice" <note>Korban</note> because of drawing near, for all intentions are to the Foundation. And because of this, for the lower and upper, his sacrifice is "one silver bowl," which is the light to be brought near to the Foundation, less than this there is no exile or spread from all the **commandments of the Torah** <term>Pekudin de-Oraita - the 613 laws viewed as mystical connections</term>. And all sacrifices and burnt offerings are for him, except for her; in all the levels that are spread out, they are not accepted before the Foundation except through him. And because of this, it is not said of her "With this shall Aaron enter the Sanctuary." And because of this, he said: "Gather," for if she is finished, the one who prays is accepted; they are not stones ready to stone the Foundation in every level. The hidden parts of the letter *He* of the Foundation, and the Foundation and the secret of the Levites, the hidden *He* from the chamber of *Yod*, from the secret of the end of all existences. And because of this, it is said: "The end of the matter, all having been heard: fear God and keep His commandments." The hidden end is from the side of the upper and lower spreads. And she is the gate to enter all wisdom, for every intention and line, and to enter into every single Sefirah, the curtain of all. And less than him, there is no secret to the foundation of the throne to bathe in the curtain of the lower world. "This is the gate of the Lord, the righteous shall enter through it." Here is the secret of the opening of the hidden things to force the upper and lower, and those lower ones see the intentions to rectify the hidden intentions to bring near the upper ones. She is called the "Eye of the Rain" from the right side, and "her eyes are like doves." And she is called the "Vision" from the rain that begins to spread through the palate and the taste. And she is called the "Scent" of the rain of the column for the gift. And she is called the "Mouth" of the movement of the voice, "mouth to mouth," to remember him. And she is called the "First Commandment," the wisdom of the rain of the Crown to show him, to hint to the palate in it the Crown, and in it, they will crown. She is called the rain to see the upper ones, to remember towards her the desires and the merits of the power of the princes in our vision. And she is the "Daughter of the Eye," for she is the crown of the missing parts from the side of Wisdom; it is written, "With Wisdom He founded the earth." With Wisdom He founded the Daughter. And it is written of her: "Know the secret that includes all the letters," for the rain of the statute is upon the mouth, which is called "All." And when they enter the Daughter, she is called "To the Heart" <note>L-B</note>. And because of this, "All" is for Understanding <note>Binah</note>, the letter *Lamed* below and the *Yod* of the male to unite as one. The letter *He* is included from the Crown to Strength <note>Gevurah</note>, and the letter *He* from the Central Column to the Daughter.

The daughter and those nine, etc. "And this" <note>original: וזאת</note> serves to include the Point, which is the *Challah* offering, including them within the letter *He*. The power of the small *Vav* etc. is the end of this; the *Vav* is called "Voice" <note>the Sefirah of Tiferet</note>, and it is not completed until it opens toward the Male. Because of this, the Voice is supported from below.

**The Eighth Commandment** is to guard the "Remember" <note>the Sabbath/Male principle</note> according to the numerical value, hinting at the Covenant of the thigh on the right. Our predecessors established that one who guards it has no cause for blemish, and such a person does not enter Purgatory <note>Gehinnom</note> if they are careful with their bed-sanctity.

**The Ninth Commandment** is called *Sukkah* <note>the Tabernacle</note>, which stems from *Chesed* (Lovingkindness). It was established to rectify the protection of all things forever. What is its merit? It is like a protective covering over your neck, and it shall be.

**The Fourth Commandment** <note>Note: The numbering in the manuscript often follows mystical associations rather than linear sequence</note> is *Yesod* (Foundation) from the side of Eternity, which is occupied with the sign "Thus" <note>Hebrew: כה - numerical value 25</note>. "Thus shall your seed be," the Covenant of the eight for those seven and her. Because of this, Abraham was like a throne, and it was melted. "Thus shall you say to the House of Jacob" <note>Exodus 19:3</note>, referring to the Middle Column. The ten are the arrangements of their day to protect the Lovingkindness within it. This includes nine Sefirot on the side of the four; the end of the eighth is from the side until *Yesod*. The fourth is *Malchut* (Kingship) before it learns "Thus" to rectify the ten, which are the letter *Yod*. Lovingkindness includes all the second *Yod*.

**The Tenth Commandment** is the Festival of Matzot. On this day, the light of the inheritance is drawn down to write the Pillar of Lovingkindness. The joy required from the side of Atonement <note>Yom Kippur</note> for the five festivals is gathered, as the masters of the Mishnah established: it is close to the fifty <note>gates of understanding</note>. The fourth aspect and the Middle Column include their power. Because of this, it is called "Five," including the five festivals, and the "Waters of Lovingkindness." Therefore, it is a Crown to the Crown, ten by ten, "the spoon is ten shekels by the holy weight," which are the ten. Three are made into "Thus," and they are like the ox. The *Yod* of its time is a seal/crown upon its head, and all is the *Yod* in faith.

**The Ninth Commandment** <note>repeated numbering</note> is the beauty of Prayer. The eight on the left arm are from the side of *Gevurah* (Strength). The eight of the Throne of Atonement and upon *Gevurah* are five spread out. These are the *Tefillin* of the head, representing the Middle Column. The knot and the three straps are the "Wing of the Voice," which belongs to *Yesod*.

**The Seventh Commandment** is the counting of the fringes (*Tzitzit*), including blue and white, representing Mercy. This covers the eight... the blue thread represents the Middle Column, the unity between the two. We establish twenty Mishnahs regarding the blue and white. Therefore, they established the section of *Tzitzit* to be said by day.

**The Twelfth Commandment** is the humility of the *Shekhinah* (Divine Presence) for the altar-offering from the side of the Middle Column, to rectify the birth. From the side of the Righteous One (*Tzadik*), the secret of the Covenant is called "the bucket that draws the wall for the King."

**The Thirteenth Commandment** is the *Shekhinah* for the offering toward the Covenant, from the side of the Righteous One, the Foundation of the World (*Yesod Olam*). Its calculation is like the Middle Column. The "Voice" is gathered there. <note>Psalm 92:13</note> > *The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree; he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.* <note>Numbers 29:1</note> > *It shall be a day of sounding the horn (Shofar) for you.*

**The Fourteenth Commandment** is the Middle Column, which has no assistance except from the Crown (*Keter*). The step to the Pillar has the *Yod* as a crown on its head. This is the Lower Wisdom (*Chokhmah*). They established the counting of the five until *Yesod* to receive the Priest (*Kohen*), the letter *Vav*, to bring it up to the Crown.

**The Commandment** of the crowning... to rectify the *Shekhinah* for the bringing of sacrifices. These are the fifty atonements, the atonement of Lovingkindness and Understanding (*Binah*). It is founded upon *Yesod*. Forgiveness comes from Lovingkindness. <note>Psalm 89:3</note> > *The world shall be built on lovingkindness.*

**The Fifteenth Commandment** is for the offering of the Exile. From the side of the Righteous One, as it is written: <note>1 Chronicles 29:11</note> > *For all that is in heaven and on earth.* The Targum of Jonathan ben Uziel translates this as "He who takes hold of heaven and earth." This is the numerical value of the *Lulav* (Palm branch), the Covenant of the *Shekhinah*, the sanctifications. *Malchut* is unified there. The end of the eight includes the eighteen blessings. Everything is a blessing to the womb of the Righteous One. When one bows and says "Blessed," the *Shekhinah* is raised to rectify the "Palm of Atonement" for her.
