<meta>This page continues the discourse of the *Idra Zuta* (The Lesser Assembly) from the previous page, where Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai reveals the final mysteries of the Divine structure before his passing. The focus remains on the union of the Supernal Father and Mother and the emergence of Knowledge (Da'at) as their heir.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> **Give Ear** <-
<note>Hebrew: *Ha'azinu* — the name of the Torah portion, Deuteronomy 32</note>

In this regard, it is written: **"If you call out for Understanding, and lift up your voice for Discernment"** <note>Proverbs 2:3. The Zohar distinguishes between *Binah* (Understanding) and *Tevunah* (Discernment/Insight)</note>. Since it says "If you call out for Understanding," why then does it add "lift up your voice for Discernment"? It is as we have said: The world above <note>The higher spiritual realms</note> was built through *Binah*. *Binah* consists of "Father and Mother" <note>The archetypal masculine and feminine energies of creation</note>, and they are the letters *Yod* and *Heh* of the Divine Name. Father, Mother, and Son are all within them. *Tevunah* (Discernment) includes all of them—the children, both Son and Daughter. Thus, the letters *Heh* and *Vav* are found within Father and Mother. However, in those aspects where they are joined together and not revealed, they are all called *Tevunah* when referring to the two children, and they are all called *Binah* when referring to Father and Mother. When one wishes to include everything together, they are included in the name *Ehyeh* <note>I AM — the Divine Name associated with the highest crown</note>. Thus, Father and Mother are also called Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge (*Chochmah, Binah, and Da'at*). This is because the "Son" <note>The central pillar of the Sefirot</note> is the signifier of his Father and Mother, and he is called Knowledge (*Da'at*), for he is the testimony <note>Aramaic: *sahaduta*</note> of them both. And so, he is called the Firstborn, as it is written: **"Israel is My son, My firstborn"** <note>Exodus 4:22</note>. Because he is called the firstborn, he takes two portions. And when he is increased by his crowns, he takes three portions. Either way, whether two portions or three, it is all one matter. This is the inheritance of his Father and Mother. What is this inheritance? These are the crowns that were hidden within them. His heritage from his Father's side was a hidden crown called Kindness (*Chesed*), and from his Mother's side, a crown called Strength (*Gevurah*). All of these crown his head, and he is named for them. When Father and Mother shine upon them, they are all called the "Head-Phylacteries" <note>Tefillin of the head</note>, and because of this, he inherits everything. He also bequeaths an inheritance to his daughter <note>The Sefirah of Malchut/Kingship</note>. We have learned that the daughter inherits from her Father and Mother, and not just any daughter, but the one of whom it is written: "and food for all is in it." If you say all this is so, then they are called "Righteous One" and "Justice" <note>*Tzadik* and *Tzedek*</note> as one, and all is a single unity. So too, Father and Mother are included and joined one to another.

The Father is more hidden, and everything is grasped from the Holy Ancient One <note>*Atika Kadisha* — the most primordial manifestation of the Divine</note>, and all this is within the Holy Precious "Influence" <note>Aramaic: *Mazla* — literally 'luck' or 'constellation,' but here referring to the divine beard/flow of grace</note>, the most precious of all. These, Father and Mother, are established within it, as we have said: **"Through wisdom a house is built, by understanding it is established, and by knowledge its rooms are filled with all precious and pleasant riches"** <note>Proverbs 24:3-4</note>. And it is written: **"For it is pleasant if you keep them within your belly"** <note>Proverbs 22:18</note>. All of these are as I have said, and they are revealed from the Holy Precious Influence.

Rabbi Shimon said: I have not revealed everything until now, and all these things were hidden until this moment. I desired to hide them for the World to Come, for I am now grasping onto that place, as it is written: **"And the stability of your times shall be a hoard of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge..."** <note>Isaiah 33:6</note>. Wisdom is hidden from the eye, and the hidden Will of the Holy One, blessed be He, covers it without end or measure. Regarding His palace, it is written: **"For the Lord is a God of knowledge"** <note>1 Samuel 2:3</note>. "Knowledge" (*De'ot* - plural) refers to the fact that Knowledge inherits everything when the palace is to be filled, as it is written: **"And by knowledge its rooms are filled."** For this reason, Knowledge is not called by a name that is revealed, for it is hidden within [the Father and Mother] and is weighed in the brain like a body. "For the Lord is a God of knowledge"—in the books of Aggadah <note>Homiletic traditions</note> we have learned: Do not read it as "Knowledge" (*De'ot*), but as "Testimony" (*Edut*), for he is the testimony of them all, the testimony of the two portions. **"He established a testimony in Jacob"** <note>Psalms 78:5</note>. Even though he is King, he is established as in the books of Prophecy. All is well, and all is as it should be when the matter is concealed. Father and Mother are both hidden here, and they are hidden within the Holy Influence of the Ancient of all Ancients; they are hidden and included within Him. He is everything. Blessed be He, and blessed be His Name forever and to all eternity. All these words were words of joy, holy words that do not shame those who merit them. All these hidden words are for your palates, O righteous ones. Until now, these words were covered; they are words of awe, both revealed and concealed. I reveal them now before the Holy Ancient King, for I do this not for my own honor or the honor of my father's house, but so that I do not enter His palace in shame. Furthermore, the Holy One, blessed be He, and all the "Masters of Truth" <note>The souls of the righteous</note> are present here, and they all look upon me, for they all rejoice in this, my wedding feast <note>Rabbi Shimon refers to his death as a 'Hillula' or mystical wedding</note>...

<summary>Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai explains the mystical relationship between the Divine attributes of Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge, describing how Knowledge (Da'at) acts as the "son" and heir who unites the Father and Mother archetypes. He emphasizes that these secrets are being revealed only now, at the moment of his passing, to ensure he enters the afterlife with honor.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Zohar, specifically from the section known as the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly) within the portion of Ha'azinu. The text focuses on the structural emanations of the Divine, particularly the relationship between Justice and Judgment.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

In that world, just as in this one, the righteous person’s portion is blessed. Rabbi Isaac said: All the waters that do not have a holy intention <note>The "waters" here refer to the flow of divine emanation or wisdom</note> upon them... and so he smiled when the King was revealed. One said: Like a king who forgives your sins when he wipes them away and opens. They shall not have the authority to overpower him, and he sat and cast [his prayer] upon his lips and bowed three times, and he was not able to look upon his image <note>original: "diyukneih" - the spiritual form or prototype</note> as it was in him. His mouth said: When they are worthy of all life, they do not gather in shame.

Shame is bent and the branch does not cease, as we read: "and a pomegranate covered from Eden." <note>Deuteronomy 32:34</note> **And it is written: "Is it not laid up in store with Me?"** And they merited from the waters to gaze upon it, for at all times that a dependency is found to see this day, and it did not rise in his will; for with this crown <note>term: Crown (Atara) - the Sephirah of Malchut or the crowning glory of a divine state</note> life and water are crowned. And he opened with delight, words were revealed before him, like a voice that is crowned at the head. And life is this day, and a second to enter his place on another day, for every day stands in his will. And he opened a path to reveal words so that they would not live in shame in the world that was given as a path. Life is written: <note>Psalms 89:15</note> **"Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; mercy and truth go before Your face."**

Who is wise and will look into this, to see the ways <margin>The beard of the Ancient One</margin> of the High Holy One? The beard <note>term: Dikna (Beard) - in the Zohar, this represents the thirteen attributes of mercy flowing from the Divine Countenance</note> of the High Holy One, the beard of truth, of merits that are crowned with the highest crowns. For to the vision of all of them, intentions are hidden, covered by the Hidden High One, the most Hidden of all hidden things. All the levels are to be sawn <note>A reference to the "sawing" or separation of the male and female aspects to allow them to face one another</note> and in that light which is in every single level, that which is revealed is revealed. And all the lights are grasped, this light in this light, and this light in this light, and they are included one in the other, and they do not separate one from the other. The light of all the foundation and the building, which are called the "Repairs of the King" <note>term: Tikunim - the arrangements or rectifications of the divine structure</note> and the "Crowns of the King." Each and every one shines and is grasped in that light which is innermost and does not separate outward. And because all is as one level to be ascended, and all is as one matter, it is crowned and does not separate one from the other for life. And the Hidden One was one; the light that is revealed is called the "Garment of the King," the innermost light.

In that light was that which was not separated and not revealed. And all the intentions and all the crowns are hidden from the Holy Ancient One <note>original: "Atika Kadisha" - the most ancient, primal manifestation of God</note>, the most Hidden of all hidden things, the High Intention. And when they all look to spread out, nothing is found except the High Intention, to be hidden and not revealed in vision... of the glory of the truth, the repairs of truth, the foundations of truth. Two foundations were found as a repair for the Throne of the King, and they are called **Righteousness** <note>Tzedek</note> and **Justice** <note>Mishpat</note>. And they are the Torah and the Perfection, and the Priests are crowned. All the judgments of above and below, and everything is there in Justice and Righteousness. From this Justice [the world] is nourished. And sometimes we call her "King of Righteousness, King of Peace" <note>A reference to Melchizedek</note> when the judgments are crowned from Justice; they are all mercy. That is to say, life covers life. Righteousness and judgments are repaired, and all are as one for the world, in its judgment and in its mercy. And then, for the holy one, the reason they are joined is **Male** <note>Dachura</note> and **Female** <note>Nukba</note>. And all the worlds are in mercy and in joy.

But when the sins of the world gather, and the Sanctuary is removed, and the Male is distanced from the Female, and a powerful, foul life is awakened—woe to the world that is stuck in that time! From this "Righteousness," how many serpents bite in the world, how many righteous people are removed from the world! And why all this? Because the Male is distanced from the Female, and Justice does not draw near to this Righteousness. And about this it is written: <note>Proverbs 13:23</note> **"But there is that which is swept away for lack of justice,"** for Justice is distanced from this Righteousness and is not found, and Righteousness sucks from another place <note>The "Other Side" or forces of harsh judgment</note>. And regarding this, King Solomon said: <note>Ecclesiastes 7:15</note> **"I have seen everything in my days of vanity; there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness..."** "Everything" refers to the gathering of the world called the King's Mouth. And what he called "my vanity" is this Righteousness, the Holy Kingdom <note>original: "Malchuta Kadisha" - the Sephirah of Malchut</note>. For when she is awakened in her judgments, it is written: **"There is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness."** Why? Because Justice is distanced from her. And because of this, **"there is that which is swept away for lack of justice."** Come and see: when a righteous person is found in the world of the Holy Life, even when Righteousness is awakened in its sharpness, the world can be looked upon because of him, and the Holy One, blessed be He, desires his glory and does not fear from...

<summary>This page explains the mystical mechanics of divine providence, focusing on the union of "Justice" (Mishpat) and "Righteousness" (Tzedek). It posits that suffering and the death of the righteous occur when these two divine attributes—representing the Male and Female aspects—are separated, allowing harsh judgment to dominate.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly), where Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai reveals the deepest mysteries of the Divine Countenance before his passing. It follows the discussion of the primordial "Kings of Edom" who perished because they lacked balance.</meta>

## The Assembly of the Holy

If a person is righteous, and while he remains righteous, he does not stand in his own strength but fears even the strict Judgment, and he cannot endure within it, as we have seen in the portion of Balak <note>Zohar Balak 202a</note>. King David initially said, "Examine me, O Lord, and prove me," for he did not fear any judgments, even the lightest of them, and he did not tremble, because there was found in him that which is written: "In righteousness <note>Hebrew: *Tzedek*</note> I shall behold Your face." In "Righteousness" surely I do not fear to stand in His judgments. But after he had sinned, he feared even the standard Judgment <note>Hebrew: *Mishpat*</note>, as it is written:
> "And enter not into judgment with Your servant" (Psalms 143:2).

Come and see: when this "Righteousness" (*Tzedek*) is sweetened by "Judgment" (*Mishpat*), it is then called "Charity" (*Tzedakah*), and the world is sweetened by it and perfected by it, as it is written:
> "He loves charity and judgment; the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord" (Psalms 33:5).

It is found that every day the Holy One, blessed be He, watches over the world so that it is not stirred by the harsh judgments of *Tzedek*, lest it burn the world with its flame, as it is written: "She eats and wipes her mouth." From here onward, each one according to the depth of their power and standing.

In this dwelling, there are merits, and these forms are few to illuminate the world from the four corners. (<margin>Another version: over the world and the world of eyes</margin>) Therefore, these matters are grasped one within the other, and the words written concerning the <term>Ancient Holy One</term> <note>Aramaic: *Atika Kadisha*, the most hidden aspect of the Divine</note>, the Hidden of all Hidden, are explained, and in the end, they are grasped one in the other. From here onward are the matters of the <term>Lesser Countenance</term> <note>Aramaic: *Ze’ir Anpin*, the emotive attributes of God</note>, which are not revealed in the open way; those that were hidden within Him and there they were not yet rectified. Until this point, the words were hidden and enclosed, and all of them are the portions and the inheritance of this heritage, as it is written:
> "Happy is the people for whom it is so..." (Psalms 144:15).

That which we have established—that Father and Mother are grasped like the Ancient One in His rectifications—is because they hang from the <term>Hidden Brain</term> <note>Aramaic: *Mocha Stima'ah*</note> of all hidden things and are united in it. And even though the Ancient Holy One is rectified on His own, when all things are revealed, He is the Ancient One alone; He is He, and all these rectifications are grasped in Him, hidden in Him, and not separated from Him. The Hidden Brain is not revealed, and within it hang "God" and "Mercy" (*Chesed*). What is this Brain? From it they emerge, and in it they hang, and in it they are grasped. The Lesser Countenance hangs and is grasped within the Ancient Holy One. And in this, we have established the words in the proper way, and all of it is the portion of one who enters and exits and knows His ways, so that he does not stray to the right or the left. And for one who does not enter and exit, it would be better for him if he had not been created, as it is written:
> "For the ways of the Lord are right" (Hosea 14:10).

Rabbi Shimon said: All day I have been meditating on this verse which is written: "My soul shall make her boast in the Lord; the humble shall hear thereof and be glad." And I have seen the verse fulfilled entirely: "My soul shall make her boast," certainly, for my soul is bound in Him, flames in Him, cleaves to Him, and through this attachment, it shall ascend to its crown. "The humble shall hear and be glad"—all those righteous and meritorious ones who come with the Holy One, blessed be He, now hear and tremble in the Holy Academy. And because of this, they revealed to me the secret of the King, and His name is exalted. And then "Hadar" returned and dwelled, the God whose kingship returned. For "how the kings assembled, they passed away together." They are called "those who passed away" because they were joined there, as it is written:
> "And he died, and [another] reigned in his stead" (Genesis 36:31).

How much they were in confusion and haste, for they did not endure in their place, because the rectifications of the King were not yet established, and the Holy City and its mountains were not prepared. This is what is written:
> "As we have heard, so have we seen" (Psalms 48:9).

For all of them did not endure, but now it is established on the side of the Male who labored with her. This is what is written:
> "And Hadar reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahav" (Genesis 36:39).

And this is as we have established in the proper way. And in the Book of Aggadah of Rav Hamnuna the Elder, it is said: "And Hadar reigned in his stead." "Hadar" <note>meaning Beauty or Splendor</note> is not like what you think, but as it says:
> "The fruit of a goodly (*Hadar*) tree" (Leviticus 23:40).

And it is found gathered together, as it says:
> "Branches of palm trees" (ibid.)

And it is written:
> "The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree" (Psalms 92:13).

This refers to Male and Female. She is called "the daughter of Matred," the daughter of that place where they labor (*tordin*) without ceasing to cleave, and he is called "Father," and it is written:
> "Man knows not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living" (Job 28:13).

This is the daughter of the dream, from whose side the judgments are grasped, which drive (*tordin*) everything away.

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly) from the Zohar, focusing on the transition from the failed "primordial worlds" to the balanced emanations of the Divine. It maintains the symbolic language of the "Ancient Holy One" as the source of all existence.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

Everything is contained within Him. And thus they draw nourishment from two coverings <note>original: *chafafin* - protective layers or membranes</note> that are hidden in two colors, in Kindness <note>original: *Chesed*</note>. As an example: before the worlds were arranged, the coverings did not gaze upon one another. Because of this, the primordial worlds were not established; the primordial worlds were made without restoration <note>original: *tikkuna* - the process of divine repair and balance</note>. And what was it that was not in the Ancient One? Sparks were engraved like lamps in that pressure of the earth <note>marginal note: another version says "crushed"</note>. When the iron craftsman <note>a metaphor for the divine power of judgment/differentiation</note> prepared to emit sparks in every direction, those sparks that went out were flaming and shining, but they were extinguished immediately. These were the "engravings" of the primordial worlds. Because of this, they were not established and did not endure until the Holy Ancient One <note>original: *Atika Kadisha*</note> was restored and the pressure went out to His craftsmanship.

Regarding this, we have learned in our Mishnah <note>referring to the internal teachings of the Zohar</note> that the spark which emits sparks of sparks does so in three hundred and twenty directions. Those sparks were the primordial worlds; they were engraved and died immediately. Afterward, the craftsman went out to His craftsmanship and was restored as **Male and Female**. Thus, the sparks that were extinguished and died were now established. From the "Lamp of Hardness" <note>original: *Butzina de-Kardinuta* - a powerful, dark light used for measuring and carving out reality</note> came a lamp of strong, powerful striking that struck and engraved. The sparks of the primordial worlds were mixed like a pure lamp and were sweetened one with another when Male and Female were restored.

And what was it? The spirit that is hidden in the Ancient of Days <note>original: *Atik Yomin*</note>. In Him, this path is hidden and included in the lamp that went out from the Lamp of Hardness to be hidden in the inward parts of the tablet. All were joined together and included in one another. A single strong flow went out and spread to this side and that side. Just as the Holy Ancient One is found to have three heads in one, so too everything was prepared in three heads as we have said.

In this **Skull** <note>original: *Gulgalta*</note>, a drop of **Dew** <note>original: *Tal*</note> drips from the White Head and whitens it. This Dew is found in two colors. It wipes away the death of the dead from the Holy Apples <note>a mystical reference to the Divine Countenance or the Garden of Eden</note>. From this Dew of the Skull, the dead are awakened for the World to Come. Because from it, they come to life. This power that falls from this Dew was not prepared except for that time when it is prepared for Israel. As it is mentioned, the Ancient One of all feeds that place which is not found afterward. This is what is written: **"May God give you of the dew of heaven..."** <note>Genesis 27:28</note>. At that time when the place is found, a person's sustenance is prepared before the Holy One, Blessed be He. That flow hangs from the **Divine Influence** <note>original: *Mazla* - literally "luck" or "constellation," but here referring to the beard of the Ancient One from which grace flows</note> certainly. Regarding this, life and sustenance do not depend on merit, but rather the matter depends on *Mazla*.

Everything depends on this *Mazla*, as we have established. The delight of the lips and the will are nullified and lean upon this Skull. This pure path is included in everything, just as it includes everything and everything is included in it to spread out. The coverings on the two sides are all shining. Look at the coverings of the Holy Ancient One; everything is scorched to the curtain. We have learned that because the coverings are scorched, they support everything. No appearance is found in the world except at the time when the coverings are prepared against one another. In the hollow of the Skull, three lights shine. And if you say there are three needed, they are as we have said: Wisdom <note>original: *Chokhmah*</note>, Kindness <note>original: *Chesed*</note>, and their two colors which crown everything in the Head. These drippings of the Head are joined to the Crown <note>original: *Keter*</note> at its sides; they shine and are hidden in the three of the Skull. Each one goes out to its side and spreads through the whole body. These are joined in the two brains, and the third brain includes them and is desired in this knot. It spreads through the whole body and from it are made two colors included in one. His coverings shine in Kindness. These are the engravings of **Knowledge** <note>original: *Da'at*</note>. And it is written: **"For the Lord is a God of knowledge..."** <note>1 Samuel 2:3</note>. Because they are in two colors, actions are weighed for Him. For the Holy Ancient One, we do not write "for Him" <note>referring to a textual variant in the Hebrew Bible</note> so that He may inherit two portions. And it is written: **"With the kind, You show Yourself kind"** <note>Psalms 18:26</note>. And the fellowship is established in truth, as it is written: **"And Jacob told Rachel..."** <note>Genesis 29:12</note>.

<summary>This page describes the mystical creation process, explaining how the initial "sparks" of the primordial worlds failed because they lacked balance. It details the restoration of the universe through the "Holy Ancient One" and the life-giving "Dew" that descends from the Divine Skull to resurrect the dead and provide sustenance.</summary>

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Give Ear <- <note>original: "Ha'azinu" - the title of the Torah portion</note>

This is so! For this Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note> is such, and such is the Will. Thus it is with Rebecca, yet it is not written thus of Isaac, for everything is hinted at in Wisdom. And because of this, it is called the "Face of All," and within it, Faith is seen. Therefore it is written, *And Isaac grew great* <note>Genesis 26:13</note>, and it is not written "he grew bitter." Thus the colors spread throughout the entire body, and in them, the Ancient Holy One—the Hidden of all Hidden—is seen. He is not measured, and they do not see Him, for everything is found in a single Life-force for all. He does not depend on anything, for He is the purity of all, beyond measure and light. Within His Skull hang all those tens of thousands and thousands of sources of hair, which are black and gathered one into another. They are seen as the upper coverings that protect the Head, the Palate, and the Brain that shines from the Palate. Afterward, filaments upon filaments emerge from His coverings, which crown the Head in Wisdom and Brain. They are all held and intertwined in those hairs that are held from the Palate. Because they are mixed with one another and gathered together, all the brains are held by the Supernal Brain. They all wait to be established in the three hollows of the brain, and they mingle with one another as it is written regarding the brain: in all those hidden and revealed tastes and secrets. Therefore, all are brains and are hinted at in Wisdom, etc. Just as they are sawn into His crown and rise into the hollows of the skull, all those curls cover and reveal the side of the ears. And we have established that which is written:
> Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear <note>2 Kings 19:16 / Isaiah 37:17</note>
This implies the wisdom of words: when a person desires the King to incline His ear toward him, he should praise the Head of the King and move the hair away from His ears, and then the King will hear him in everything he desires. In the parting of the hair, a single path is joined—the path of the Ancient of Days. From it, all the paths of the commandments of the Torah are separated, and upon them, all the paths of weeping and wailing are nourished. They hang from every single curl, and they spread trembling to strengthen those who do not know which path is which:
> The way of the wicked is like darkness <note>Proverbs 4:19</note>
And all these hang in strong curls; therefore they are all powerful. We have established that these are the branches that take hold from those who are weighed, as it is written:
> All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth, etc. <note>Psalms 25:10</note>
All these structures wait for the hidden brains of the Head of the Brain. Therefore, all these sides are found... mercy and compassion in those curls of the eyes that are provided from those who are weighed, as it is written: *All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth.* From the second brain, in those strong curls that are provided and hang from those of weeping and wailing, as it is written:
> The way of the wicked is like darkness; they do not know at what they stumble <note>Proverbs 4:19</note>
They are strengthened by water; if not, they would not know in their old age. They do not know and do not wish to know at what they stumble. Do not read "at what" <note>Hebrew: 'Bameh'</note> but "at the Mother" <note>Hebrew: 'B'Ima'</note>, in those who are joined as a Crown to the strength of powerful Might <note>Gevurah</note>. They are joined from those of weeping and wailing from the third brain, in those curls that are gathered, provided, and hang from those that are blackened. They are called "covering bonds" and "lamentation," and regarding this it is written:
> Level the path of your feet <note>Proverbs 4:26</note>
And everything is found in those curls and the hair of the Head. **The Forehead** <note>Metzach</note> of the skull is placed to be remembered <margin>Another version: to be uprooted</margin>—look into it. And all this "Forehead of Grace," etc., is awakened from those who are soft toward those who are not ashamed of their deeds. This forehead is red like a rose, and at the time when the Forehead of the Ancient Holy One is revealed—the Forehead of Vision, the Rest, as we have translated—that time is called **Will** <note>Ratzon - Favor</note> for all. Like a book to its companion, for when great judgment is found in it, the Forehead of the Ancient One rests, and Mercies are revealed to them... between two letters, everything... the Forehead and the wisdom called Forehead in those who are crushed. And just as one washes... and the milk that is prepared for the palate... another animal is removed, and there is a "washing" that spreads through the whole body. Because the cover is like the time of exile, it covers so that the Judgment of the Ancient Holy One will not be awakened. His Forehead and all judgments are subdued and found... and they do not pass. In this Forehead hang all the classes of judgment for all those who are brazen in their deeds, as it is written:
> She hardened her face and said to him <note>Proverbs 7:13</note>
And this is knowledge like the Most High. And behold, these crowns are thirty...

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly) from the Zohar, specifically focusing on the mystical anatomy of the Divine Eyes. It transitions from the description of the "Ancient Holy One" (Arich Anpin) to the "Small Countenance" (Zeir Anpin), contrasting the eye that never sleeps with the eyes that open and close according to human merit.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Give Ear**<-
<note>original: Ha'azinu. This is the title of the Torah portion, Deuteronomy 32.</note>

Why is it written corresponding to the thirty deaths? For there are those below that hang from above, and the crowns revolve. And as we have said, they do not strike the pure one until he ascends and rises to the two knives <note>likely referring to the "two edges" of judgment</note> corresponding to the twenty. It is written "pure" in our Mishnah of Death; we learned that they correspond to when they are covered and included within another. The eyes of the spirit are such; eyes that are not protected from them are such; eyes that stand and do not sleep. And likewise, they are called eyes like... what is "striking"? Everything. "He shall not slumber, the supervision of his fellow," etc., as it is written <note>Psalms 121:4</note> **"Behold, He who keeps Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep."** And it is written <note>Psalms 94:9</note> **"He who plants the ear, shall He not hear? He who forms the eye, shall He not see?"** The arrangement of the eye from the side—which is hidden—is like a burden waiting for the crowns that hang. Even the letter *Vav* is suspended there, ascending to wage war. And then they all stand from their curls, and the eyes are opened. The covering over the eyes—the eyebrows—are desirable, and a thousand and ten thousand masters of shields are below them. These are called the "covering of the eyes." And all those called "the eyes of the Lord" do not open or awaken until the darkness is removed. The coverings of the eyebrows spread out, the lower from the upper. And at the time when the lower eyebrows spread from the upper ones and find a place to look, the eyes are opened and appear like a person awakening from his sleep. They are called "open eyes," and they bathe in His whiteness. And when they are bathed, the judgments against Israel are subdued. Likewise, it is written <note>Psalms 44:24</note> **"Awake, why do You sleep, O Lord? Arise..."**

Four colors are seen in these eyes. We see them as the four compartments of the *Tefillin* <note>phylacteries</note> which are called the "radiance of the brain." These are called His eyes, and the supervision emerges from the hidden storehouse of the Wisdom of the eye, as we have established, for it is written <note>Zechariah 3:9</note> **"Upon one stone are seven eyes."** And those colors flame in their sides. From the darkness emerge others, masters of supervision for Judgment, and these are called "The eyes of the Lord that run to and fro through the whole earth" <note>Zechariah 4:10</note>. It is written **"running"** (feminine) and not **"running"** (masculine) because they are all Judgment. From the green emerge others who stand to reveal deeds, both bad and good, as it is written <note>Job 34:21</note> **"For His eyes are upon the ways of man."** And these are called "The eyes of the Lord that run to and fro" (masculine), because they are for two sides: for good and for evil. From the white emerge all those Mercies, all those good things found in the world to do good for Israel. And then all those three colors that were fighting over them are bathed, and these colors mix with one another and bond with one another. Each one looks to its fellow from its own colors, for the whiteness includes them all when necessary. And a voice hovers over them all. All the colors below—the children of the worlds are not able to look at them—the whiteness of Wisdom, the red, the green, and the dark. When the supervision is one, they all revolve and are bathed in the whiteness. Eyebrows are not found when the eyes flow to supervise, because the eyebrows give place for all the colors to supervise. And if they did not give place, they would not be able to supervise or look. The eyebrows do not stand or exist at the same time; they are complete in opening and closing, closing and opening. And the darkness of the open eye protects them. Because of this, it is written <note>Ezekiel 1:14</note> **"And the living creatures ran and returned,"** which we have established as <note>Proverbs 4:25</note> **"Let your eyes look directly forward."** Jerusalem is your cup, and it is written <note>Deuteronomy 11:12</note> **"The eyes of the Lord your God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year..."** This is Jerusalem, for it is written <note>Isaiah 1:21</note> **"Righteousness lodged in her."** And like Jerusalem, but not Zion, for it is written <note>Isaiah 33:20</note> **"Your eyes shall see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation..."** for they are all Mercy. "Your eyes, your eyes" is written, referring to the Holy Ancient One, the hidden of all. The eyes of the Lord are directed toward both good and evil, according to how the colors are arranged—green and dark. When they are supervised, they all revolve and are bathed in the whiteness. Eyebrows are not found when the eyes of colors supervise. "Let your eyes look directly forward" toward Jerusalem—all for good, all for Mercy, as it is written <note>Isaiah 54:7</note> **"And with great mercies will I gather you."** **"The eyes of the Lord your God are always upon it from the beginning of the year"**—the word "beginning" is written without the letter *Aleph*, <note>original: מרשית instead of מראשית</note> because it does not stand in its permanence. It dwells below and above. It is written <note>Lamentations 2:1</note> **"He cast down from heaven to earth the beauty of Israel."** The word is cast from heaven to earth, as it is written...

<summary>This page explores the Kabbalistic symbolism of the Divine Eyes, distinguishing between the constant, merciful gaze of the "Ancient Holy One" and the multicolored, judgmental eyes of the "Small Countenance." It explains how the colors of the eye (white, red, green, black) represent different spiritual forces and how they affect the world, particularly Jerusalem.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly), where Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai reveals the mysteries of the Divine Countenance before his passing. It follows the description of the Eyes and moves into the mysteries of the Nose and Ears of the "Small Face" (the emotional attributes of the Divine).</meta>

The back of the head and the eyes are supported by the back of the head in the manner of Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note> below, from the moisture that strikes and consumes. It is hidden and His eyes do not see, etc. <note>referring to the eyes of the Ancient One, which never sleep</note>. Return and explain: from the moisture of that support which descends as eye-paint and is not known below. In its surrounding above, it is not actual Judgment, reaching until the nose of the observer, and his cheek is pure to behold, for it is written:
> Righteousness lodged in her <note>Isaiah 1:21</note>
which is the nose of the observer. Come and see, he alone is called "Merciful" <note>original: Rakhamana</note>, like hidden and concealed eye-paint, a matter that is not known until it joins in the vision of the face after the nose, which is called Merciful. And if you say "to join," it is not so, but rather it is revealed in him, and at that time he is called Merciful. And even in this lower one, Jerusalem was not observed to be fought against in this way, to be sustained always by all moisture, as it is written; and "forever" is written where it is not, the Merciful One to the eye of the observer, and further, etc.

---

-> **The Nose** <-

The nose of the Small Face <term>Zeir Anpin; the personification of the six emotional sefirot</term> is the repair of the countenance; the entire countenance is recognized through it. This nose is not like the nose of the Holy Ancient One <term>Atika Kadisha; the highest, most hidden aspect of the Divine</term>, the most hidden of all hidden things. For from the nose of the Ancient One, life of lives for all emerges; from the two nostrils, spirits of life emerge for all. Regarding this and the hair of the cheeks, it is written of it:
> Smoke rose up in His nostrils, etc. <note>Psalms 18:9</note>
In this smoke, all colors are grasped; in it, every single color is grasped. How many darkenings are tied to the pure smoke, and because of this <note>original: u-vegin kach</note>, they are all only sweetened by the smoke of the altar below. And concerning this it is written:
> And the Lord smelled the soothing aroma <note>Genesis 8:21</note>
It does not say "the aroma of the sacrifice." What is "the soothing aroma" <note>original: reach ha-nikhoach</note>? It is the sweetening of the harsh Judgments <note>Din</note> after the spirit. "And the Lord smelled the soothing aroma"—it does not say "the aroma of the sacrifice," but "the soothing aroma," for all the Powers <note>Gevurot</note> are grasped in the nose, and all who are grasped in them are all sweetened. And how many Powers are divided as one, as it is written:
> Who can express the mighty acts of the Lord? <note>Psalms 106:2</note>

And from this nose, from the two nostrils, emerges a spark that consumes all other fires. From one nostril comes smoke, and from one nostril comes fire. And they are found as the altar, fire and smoke. And that Holy Ancient One is revealed, and all is found. This is what he said:
> And for My praise I will refrain <note>original: ekhtom, literally "I will muzzle/nose" my anger</note> for you <note>Isaiah 48:9</note>.
The nose of the Holy Ancient One is long and extended, and is called "Long-Suffering" <term>Arekh Appayim; literally "Long of Nose"</term>, while the [other] nose is small. And when the smoke rises, it acts in haste to execute Judgment. And who prevents it? The nose of the Ancient One. And all is as I said in the Zohar, and the companions were awakened in the Book of Aggadah by Rav Hamnuna the Elder: The nose has two nostrils; from one, smoke rises, and from the other, rest and a good spirit that is within it, and the Brain of the Brain <note>the highest consciousness</term>, as it is written:
> And his fragrance like Lebanon <note>Hosea 14:7</note>.
And regarding the Feminine <note>the Shekhinah</note> it is written:
> And the scent of your nose like apples <note>Song of Songs 7:9</note>.
And if it is so for the Feminine, how much more so in Him; and he spoke well. And what they said, "And the Lord smelled the soothing aroma"—the "soothing" <note>nikhoach</note> refers to two sides of one body, to reveal the Holy Ancient One, the most hidden of all hidden things, for He is the rest and the sweetening for all. And there is sweetening below through that smoke and fire of the altar. And because it comes from two knots, it is written "soothing" <note>in the plural-hinting form</note>, and all is said as we have explained.

---

-> **The Two Ears** <-

The two ears are to hear good and evil, and both of them rise to one, as it is written:
> Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear <note>2 Kings 19:16</note>.
And to the pure one within, it hangs with curved ridges, because below, when a voice enters to be mixed, it enters as a small thing. Sometimes the Brain is in it, but not in haste, for every matter that is in haste is like a crooked wisdom. They are sharpened and hang; all their joints are like wings that catch the voice from the world, and all of them are thus called "the ears of the Lord," as it is written of them:
> For a bird of the heavens shall carry the voice, etc. <note>Ecclesiastes 10:20</note>
"For a bird of the heavens shall carry the voice"—this verse is difficult in its plain sense. The beginning of the verse says:
> Even in your thought, do not curse the king <note>Ecclesiastes 10:20</note>.
"In your thought" it is written, "and in your bedchambers, etc." What is the reason? "For a bird of the heavens shall carry the voice, etc." Is there no reason? Rather, certainly, whatever a person thinks and whatever he contemplates in his heart, he does not perform a deed until he brings it out with his lips, even if he did not intend it. And that word which he brings out cleaves through the air and ascends...

<keywords>Small Face, Holy Ancient One, Divine Nose, Divine Ears, Judgment, Sweetening, Smoke, Soothing Aroma, Long-Suffering, Zeir Anpin, Atika Kadisha</keywords>

--- Page 592 ---
<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly) from the Zohar, specifically within the portion of Ha’azinu. It focuses on the mystical anatomy of the "Ancient of Days" and the "Small Face" (Zeir Anpin), specifically the mystery of the ears and the process by which human speech and prayer are processed by the Divine.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Give Ear (Ha’azinu)**<-

And they <note>the words of prayer</note> ascend and fly through the world, and a voice is formed from them. That voice is struck by the "masters of wings" <note>angels</note> and they raise it up to the King. It enters the ears of the Lord, as it is written: *And the Lord heard the voice of your words* <note>Deuteronomy 5:25</note>, and *The Lord heard and His anger was kindled...* Therefore, the prayer and the petition that a person asks before the Holy One, Blessed be He, must be expressed in words with his lips. For if he does not express them, his prayer is not a "prayer" and his petition is not a "petition." Once the words are emitted, they cleave through the air, ascending and flying, and a voice is formed from them. Those who take them, take them and return them to the Holy Place.

(As it is said, for it is written) regarding the mystery of the King: there are three chambers <note>hollows</note> that drip into the ears. That cavity is like a blue-black vessel, like a spiral <note>original: "כחלזונית" - referring to the cochlea or the curved structure of the ear</note>, like the structure of the ears. The voice travels through that winding path and is found on this side of that dripping chamber. Then it is delayed there and is examined between good and evil. This is what is written: *For the ear tests words...* <note>Job 12:11</note>. Why does the ear test words? Because the voice is delayed in this river of the dripping chamber, in the windings of the ears, and does not enter directly as a blast of breath. Because of this, it is tested between good and evil, until it is tasted and distinguished between sweet and bitter.

In this opening of the ear, there are two other openings: the openings of the eyes, the opening of the mouth, and the opening of the nose. From this voice that enters the opening of the ear, life is drawn into the eyes, and tears are sought from that voice. Life enters the opening of the nostrils <note>term: *Pardashka* - the bridge of the nose or nostrils</note> and they emit the smoke of the descent from that voice. Furthermore, *And the Lord heard and His anger was kindled*—and he was stirred, Heaven forbid, and trembled. Life is drawn from that voice to the opening of the mouth, and he speaks and decrees words from that voice. Everything comes from that voice; it enters the whole body and everything is moved by it.

There are many divisions in this ear, and all those words that are written—these words are written in fire to purify the wicked, and your mouth speaks deceit. This ear is called "Hearing," and in Hearing, the "Repair of the Blemish" is perfected. From how many sources is it perfected? As it is written: *Give Your servant a hearing heart* <note>1 Kings 3:9</note>, and as you say: *Speak, for Your servant is listening* <note>1 Samuel 3:9</note>, and *For we are listening* <note>2 Kings 18:26</note>. In these three, everything is Knowledge (*Da'at*), and everything leans upon Understanding (*Binah*) to be spoken.

And because all the ears come from this voice in this whisper <note>note: the text reads "weakness" but contextually means "whisper"</note> of the Palace, prayers and petitions depend on it, as does the "opening of the eyes." This is what is written: *Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear; open Your eyes, O Lord, and see* <note>2 Kings 19:16</note>. Is not everything dependent on this ear? High mysteries depend on it and do not go outside. For this reason, the ear is winding—to keep hidden the secrets concealed within it. Woe to the one who reveals secrets! Because this ear covers secrets and its internal winding collects them, he who reveals secrets is like those who are crooked, but not like those who are straight. This is the meaning of: *The secret of the Lord is for those who fear Him, and His covenant to make them know* <note>Psalms 25:14</note>. For it is written: "they gnash" and "they pile up words." Those who are crooked collect words and bring them in secret to a hewn place to be delayed. All the openings are opened until the words come out of the opening of the mouth.

These things were investigated by the sinners of the generation, from all those of the Holy One, Blessed be He. As we have learned in our Mishnah: "Slander kills men," and all of them serve "Evil Speech" <note>Lashon Hara</note>. All of this is in one verse, as it is written: *You shall not go as a gossipmonger among your people, nor shall you stand idly by the blood of your neighbor; I am the Lord* <note>Leviticus 19:16</note>. Whoever transgresses this spirit of the verse, it is as if he transgresses everything.

But the portion of the righteous is different, of whom it is written: *...and he who is of a faithful spirit conceals a matter* <note>Proverbs 11:13</note>. They are all "spirit," for their spirit is crowned with holiness and ascends. Therefore, they have all investigated the spirit. And the conclusion of the matter: we have established that anyone who reveals secrets—it is known that according to the teaching, they are cut off from the breath of the Holy King. Therefore, he has no spirit and no place for the spirit. And when his soul <note>original: "נשמתיה"</note> goes out to cleave to the breath of the King, it is not its place. Woe to that man, woe to his soul! But all the ascents of the righteous conceal secrets as long as the Superiors are in the command of the Blessed Holy One. Regarding the high secrets of the Holy King, it is written: *And your people shall all be righteous; they shall inherit the land forever* <note>Isaiah 60:21</note>.

And because...

<summary>This page explains the mystical significance of the ear and hearing, describing how human prayer becomes a "voice" that is processed through the divine "ears" to trigger responses in the eyes, nose, and mouth. It warns severely against revealing secrets and the sin of gossip, contrasting the "crooked" speech of the wicked with the "faithful spirit" of the righteous who guard the King's mysteries.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Small Assembly) within the portion of Ha'azinu. It focuses on the mystical anatomy of the "Beard" (Dikna) of Zeir Anpin (the Lesser Countenance), explaining how its nine configurations receive influence from the thirteen configurations of the Ancient Holy One (Atika Kadisha) to balance judgment and mercy.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

His face has two arrangements of fragrance <note>The "fragrance" refers to the cheeks or the scent of divine favor</note>, all of which are holy. Upon that which is smooth, holiness is received; all hangs upon it, and all hangs upon holiness. These arrangements of fragrance are white and red. Holiness is the bread <note>The sustenance or essence</note> and the vision of holiness for his "apples" <note>The cheeks</note>. Each is distinct, and as we have established in our Mishnah <note>The traditional teachings of the Zohar circle</note>, there is a certain distance between the white and the red, yet they are included as one. From the side of the white, everything shines from the light of the white of the Ancient One. This white watches over the red, and everything is found in its proper order. All judgments that arise <note>Variant reading: (Others say: hang)</note> in the world are mitigated. And so it is found in the scroll, like a light or like a wave <note>Variant reading: (Others say: like a yoke)</note>, and the place is spread out upon the face, even in all its parts. Then everything is found in speech, and then in the sons of holiness it is written, "In the beginning God created" <note>original: "Bereshit Bara Elohim"</note>, and all is in holiness. This is a witness for all, just as the two nostrils are open to breathe out these colors and to blow these colors. When the colors shine, all the worlds are together. At the time when the white shines, everything appears in that color; and when it appears in red, everything appears so in those colors. All these are the arrangements <note>Variant reading: (Others say: corrections)</note> of the fragrance. Regarding the hairs of the beard, you will not find them plucked or sparse; they stand and rise as an offering of fragrance. The hairs are the wisdoms of the beard in a beautiful arrangement. The strength of the Ancient One's upper beard is reflected in this beard of the Lesser Countenance <term>Zeir Anpin: The emotive aspects of the Divine, often associated with the Tetragrammaton</term>. The beauty of this beard is found in nine arrangements. When the holy strength of the beard of the Holy Ancient One reaches this beard, thirteen arrangements are found, and then all are blessed. "Old Israel" <note>Yisrael Saba, a specific mystical configuration</note> is blessed through this, as it is written:
> **Joseph is a fruitful bough** <note>Genesis 49:22</note> 

The arrangements of the beard we have established in the Book; and here I wish to bring everything to its conclusion. Behold, all the arrangements of the beard we have established are from the arrangements of the beard of the Holy Ancient One. We have established that they are all simply called "holy." These are the nine engravings of the first arrangement that go out in the time of holiness. It strikes in the arrangement of the hair of the head from beneath the locks that are over the smooth parts <note>The cheeks</note> and descends before the opening of the ears until the head of the mouth. Behold, this arrangement is not found as a hollow space in the Holy Ancient One. When it flows from the "Constellation" <term>Mazla: The source of influence that "drips" from the beard</term> of the Holy Ancient One, that fountain of wisdom hangs from it. When it is not found, the whiteness is included in its heart—that whiteness which is bound in whiteness and upper fragrance. It goes out and is seen as one, and one arrangement is made. When necessary, this one rises over that one, and one is covered before its companion. All this is necessary: one to perform vengeance and one for mercy. Regarding this, look at this beard of the Lesser Countenance, for as we have established, nine arrangements are found in this beard. The Master opened <note>Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai begins the exposition</note>: they hang in it and spread out on every side. Three hang in the hair beneath the offering of fragrances on this side, and three on that side. And in the "cleaving" <note>Variant reading: (Others say: the preciousness)</note> of the beard, three others hang: one above in the nostrils and two in the corners of the lips that hang down to the navel. All of them are an opening; three from the "snail-shell" <note>A metaphorical term for the curl of the hair</note> of all are found. They all hang in those hairs that hang and spread throughout the body. Because of this, the three that are in the "preciousness" of the beard more than all others, it is written of them with holy death, as it is written:
> **Out of the distress I called upon the Lord** <note>Psalms 118:5</note> 
And three are "The Lord is for me; I will not fear." Behold, we have established them all: "Out of the distress I called upon the Lord" from these sides of the beard that do not spread out, which is a place far from the smooth parts. It is well explained in the Book of the Hiddenness of the Schoolhouse. Thus, the strengths of the beard are from the Upper Kindness <term>Chesed: The Sefirah of Mercy and Expansion</term>, as it is written:
> **Yours, O Lord, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory** <note>1 Chronicles 29:11</note> 
And so on. And all of them were thus. And nine are found hanging in the beard, and before the smooth parts of the face. They do not endure except in another place, as we have established. When the world needs mercy, the Ancient Constellation is revealed, and all these arrangements in the precious beard of the Lesser Countenance are all found to be mercy—even when they perform vengeance upon the enemies of Israel, those who distress them.

<summary>This page describes the mystical "Beard" of Zeir Anpin, explaining how its nine configurations are derived from the thirteen of the Ancient One to balance judgment and mercy. It uses anatomical metaphors to describe the flow of divine light and the mitigation of harsh decrees through the "white" light of the highest crown.</summary>

--- Page 594 ---
<meta>This page continues the discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly) from the Zohar, specifically focusing on the mystical anatomy of the Divine. It transitions from the "Ancient of Days" (Atika Kadisha) to the "Impatient One" (Zeir Anpin), describing how divine mercy and judgment are channeled through the symbolic "Beard" and "Lips."</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Give Ear**<-
<note>original: "Ha'azinu" (Deuteronomy 32:1). This is the title of the Torah portion being discussed.</note>

All the preciousness of the Beard is found in those hairs that hang down; everything depends upon them. All these hairs of the Beard of the *Short Face* <term>Zeir Anpin: the aspect of God that interacts with the world, characterized by a balance of mercy and judgment</term> are hard and strong, for they all submit to judgments at the time when the *Holy Fortune* <term>Mazla: the spiritual flow or "constellation" from the highest divine level</term> is revealed. When he wishes to show a "bald spot" <note>a clearing of judgment</note> below to the harsh masters of accusation, like a captain [steering a ship], then the spirit of the one who is the head moves, and words go out to provoke. Thus, nine rectifications were spoken of; whoever reaches them is established with great abundance. It is necessary to testify that they are all mercies, for at this time we do not speak of the thirteen rectifications <note>The Ancient One has 13 rectifications of the beard, while Zeir Anpin has 9</note>. The matter depends on intention, for one should enter these rectifications by intending toward the "Fortune" and mentioning it. This is the meaning of: **"And now, I pray, let the power of my Lord be great"** <note>Numbers 14:17</note>. That refers to the Holy Fortune, the most hidden of all hidden things, which is holy and does not [waver]. This preciousness depends on the Fortune; and since he used it, mentioned it, and focused his intention upon it, he spoke the nine rectifications that hang in the *Short Face*, so that they may all shine and no anger be found. And everything depends on the Fortune. (Regarding this beard): when the hairs are prepared to be found as a recognized, strong, and regular master. The inner parts of this beard correspond to the side of softness from the *Hidden Ancient One*. They are all **"like the precious oil upon the head, running down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron"** <note>Psalms 133:2</note>.

These hairs do not cover the mouth or the lips; they are all red like a rose, as it is written: **"His lips are lilies"** <note>Song of Songs 5:13</note>. The lips are the distance of Strength <note>Gevurah/Judgment</note>, the distance of Wisdom. Life and death depend on those lips; from them comes the awakening of all who have mercy. Those lips awaken everything, and the masters of judgment are also recorded there, for their dwelling is in them. And because of this, they are called "Watchers," as it is written: **"The matter is by the decree of the Watchers, and the sentence by the word..."** <note>Daniel 4:17</note>. The "Master of the Watcher" in the book of Aggadah <note>homiletic traditions</note> refers to those who awaken judgments for the cheeks, to show mercy above. Therefore, these cheeks awaken the Master of all, and in every way, two types of mercy etc. They are called "Watcher and Holy One," judgment and mercy. And the lips are hard below when the mouth is opened.

The breath that goes out from the mouth—thousands and tens of thousands clothe themselves in it. And when it spreads out, all the "blowers" <note>spiritual forces</note> clothe themselves in it, and they are all called by the letters H (He) and V (Vav). When these go out from the mouth and move on the lips, they support all the masters of the lips until they are all bound together as one in twelve sharp edges, and all of them are made known. They are all found together in great speech, like incense to the root of the crown, until it is written: **"His mouth is most sweet, and he is altogether lovely"** <note>Song of Songs 5:16</note>. All of them, "and the palate shall taste food." And "altogether lovely," not [just] water. However, we translate and rest after it, for these colors are joined as one. The "palate" refers to those hints engraved in his crowns, revealing the letter *Het* which removes kings and establishes kings. The *Het* that removes, descends, and ascends, crowned with the spirit of that decree. With the spirit of the letter *He* and the hook of the tablet of the mountain, to raise the Female <note>the Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note> and to spread within the Female... like the response of the Holy City that is always tied one to the other. They are all "bitter myrrh," the moon is awakened... the moon of the pattern in the wrap, in the error of the running branches that are divided to their sides into engraved spirits. And everything is in the secret of the letters of King Solomon, they were crowned with the eight letters of "all." Likewise, the Temple... and it is written that there is a "thin" deed: **"A still, small voice"** <note>1 Kings 19:12</note>. It purifies and shatters much, and is sweet, etc. King David pushed to the end: **"Moreover, by them is Your servant warned..."** <note>Psalms 19:11</note>. To look through every day to renew them... to taste them as on the day of your crowning, when the King was crowned in the cave... and the power of sin burns at the breadth of the mountain... and the eye is the source... and I do not leave them all day.

Blessed is the portion of one who tastes of the "Ancient One" (what is like the Ancient One) of the King, who tastes of them as they stand. Concerning this it is written: **"Taste and see that the Lord is good..."** <note>Psalms 34:8</note>. And it is written: **"Come, eat of my bread..."** <note>Proverbs 9:5</note>. To spread the Male as Knowledge, and they are filled in order. And friends from the head of the skull... and to spread through the whole body, its holes are seen, and all the deficiencies to fix the building, etc. And all the darkness, and to take the portions of the skull.

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Idra Zuta (The Lesser Assembly) from the Zohar, specifically focusing on the anatomical symbolism of the Divine archetypes (Partzufim) and the union of the Male and Female aspects of the Divine.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

In the skull is a hidden cavity on all its sides, and a light (which is **Wisdom**) is engraved within two brains in this manner. It adheres to the side of the Male; for this reason, it is called "the Right." We have learned that the letter *Shin* <note>original: ש'</note> comprises eight thousand three hundred [worlds], and the hairs of the Female are included between the throats <note>original: גרוני; some versions read נוני, "fish"</note>, as it is written: "and you were not washed" <note>Ezekiel 16:4</note>. All of them are bound together as **Strength** <note>the attribute of Gevurah</note> within five strengths. The Female spreads out on her sides and adheres to the sides of the Male until she separates from his sides and comes to be united with him face to face. When they join, they appear as one actual body.

From here we learn that the Male by himself is only half a body, and all his mercies are divided; so too with the Female. But when they join as one, they appear as one actual body. And look at this: any male who is joined with a female as one is called "one body," and all the worlds are blessed by this, for they are all blessed from a complete body. This is the secret of:
> **"Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and hallowed it"** <note>Exodus 20:11</note>

For then everything is found as one complete body, because the Matron <note>The Shekhinah, the Divine Feminine</note> adheres to the King, and they are found to be one body. Therefore, blessings are found on this day. From here [we learn] that whoever is not found as male and female is called "half a body," and blessing does not rest upon a flawed thing, but only in a complete place and a complete thing—not on half a thing. A half-thing does not endure forever and is never blessed. The beauty of the Female is entirely from the beauty of the Male; we have established these things and they are known among the companions. From this Female, all those below are attached. From here they suckle and through her they are blessed. She is called "Mother" to them all, just as below a mother [provides] for the whole body from herself. Because of this, regarding all others below, it is written:
> **"Say to Wisdom: 'You are my sister'"** <note>Proverbs 7:4</note>

There is Wisdom and there is Wisdom <note>referring to the higher Wisdom of Chokhmah and the lower Wisdom of Malchut</note>. This Female is called Wisdom, but she is small compared to the [higher] Wisdom; therefore she is called:
> **"We have a little sister, and she has no breasts..."** <note>Song of Songs 8:8</note>

For this refers to her in exile, "a little sister." She is small below, yet she is in blessing and is a "treasure" <note>Segulah</note>, for she is the perfection of all. The King, as it is written: "My heart is a wall..." and certainly "like towers..." for these words refer to the Female [acting] for all like towers, which are great mountains that go out from the Supernal Wall.

The Male spreads out to the right and the left in the inheritance of Kindness <note>Chesed</note>. When the two join, he is called <term>Tiferet</term> <note>Beauty/Harmony</note>, and the whole body is established as a great and strong tree, beautiful to look at. Beneath its shade, the beasts of the field find cover, and in its branches dwell the birds of the sky, and there is food for all in it. The arms are Right and Left: in the Right is life and Kindness <note>Chesed</note>; in the Left is death and Strength <note>Gevurah</note>. The inner organs are established in Knowledge <note>Da'at</note>, and they are filled with Kindness and Strength, as it is written:
> **"By Knowledge the rooms are filled"** <note>Proverbs 24:4</note>

Furthermore, the body spreads into two legs, and between them are joined two kidneys, the two testicles of the Male. All the oil, greatness, and power of the Male from the whole body is gathered in them, for all the hosts that go out from him emerge and dwell there. They are called <term>Netzach</term> <note>Victory/Endurance</note>, <term>Hod</term> <note>Majesty/Splendor</note>, and <term>Chesed</term> <note>Kindness</note>. From Hod comes Tiferet and Hod. From Netzach comes Victory. Because of this, <term>Yesod</term> <note>Foundation</note> is the victory. The "seal" of the Male is the end of the whole body and is called <term>Yesod</term>. This is the level that sweetens the Female. All the desire of the Male toward the Female enters the Female through this <term>Yesod</term>, into the place called Zion and Jerusalem, for there is the place of the Female, like the womb below. Because of this, the Lord of Hosts and the foundation of <term>Yesod</term> is written:
> **"For the Lord has chosen Zion..."** <note>Psalms 132:13</note>

To take her for Himself. When the Matron separates and joins with the King face to face on the Sabbath, everything becomes one body. Then the Holy One, Blessed be He, sits upon His throne, and everything is called the "Complete Name," the "Holy Name." Blessed be His Name forever and to all eternity. All these words were collected until the day he <note>Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai</note> was crowned with them for the World to Come; they are revealed here, and they are all the portions of this Matron. When she joins with the King, all the worlds are blessed and are found in the joy of all.

<meta>This page concludes the "Idra Zuta" (The Lesser Assembly) from the Zohar, following the mystical discourses given by Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai on his deathbed. It transitions from high-level Kabbalistic descriptions of divine union to the narrative of his passing.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

Just as the Male <note>The masculine aspect of the Divine, *Zeir Anpin*</note> is comprised of three, and the attributes are in three, so is everything thus; and the conclusion of all is the Body. And the Matron <note>The *Shekhinah*, the feminine Divine Presence</note> is not blessed except through the inclusion of the three. These are the garments of the secret of the Foundation <note>The Sefirah of *Yesod*</note>, and she is blessed in the place called the **Holy of Holies**, as it is written: **"For there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore"** <note>Psalm 133:3</note>. There are three levels above and below, and likewise, no one has permission to enter there except the High Priest who comes from the side of Lovingkindness <note>The Sefirah of *Chesed*</note>. For no priest enters the supernal place except he who is called "Lovingkindness," and he enters the Holy of Holies, and the Female is sweetened and blessed. And it is called the Holy of Holies because it is called Understanding <note>The Sefirah of *Binah*</note>. Zion and Jerusalem are two levels: one is Mercy and one is Judgment. **"Zion shall be redeemed with judgment"** <note>Isaiah 1:27</note>, and of Jerusalem it is written: **"Righteousness lodged in it"** <note>Isaiah 1:21</note>, as we have established. And all the longing of the Male toward the Female is such that from there blessings go forth to all worlds, and all are blessed. This place is called the Holy of Holies, and the Male enters there with that spirit of desire, and all are satiated by the supernal fragrance of the skull of the Male, from the side of the supernal Brain that is hidden within it. And that blessing flows through all the members of the body until it reaches those who are called the "Foundations." And all this hidden light that flows from the whole body gathers there, and these are called the "merits" of the Male, both above and below. From there they go forth, and that hidden treasure of the place gathered there is for him like this holy day—all is white. A man who seeks Lovingkindness enters from that Lovingkindness into the Holy of Holies, as it is written: **"For there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore."**

The Sages taught: The Holy Lamp <note>original: *Botzina Kadisha*, referring to Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai</note> did not finish saying the word "Life" <note>original: *Chayim*</note> before his words became silent. I was waiting for the blessed wisdom, but I did not wait longer, for I did not hear and I did not raise my head, as the light was overwhelming. I was prostrate, and everything was silent. Then I heard a voice that called out and repeated: "Length of days and years of life..." <note>Proverbs 3:2</note>. I heard a voice: "He asked life of Thee, and Thou gavest it him..." <note>Psalm 21:5</note>. All that day, the fire did not cease from the house, and there was no one who could approach him, for they were unable because of the light and the fire that surrounded him all day.

I fell upon the earth and cried out. After the fire departed, I saw the Holy Assembly, the Holy of Holies, who had departed from the world. He was wrapped, lying on his right side, and his face was smiling. Rabbi Eleazar <note>His son</note> his son stood up and took his hands and kissed them, and I licked the dust from beneath his feet. The companions wanted to weep but were unable to speak. The companions began to weep, and Rabbi Eleazar his son fell three times and could not open his mouth. Finally, he opened it and said: "Father, Father! There were three, and now one is crowned. Now the life-force has flown away, and the protectors have departed." <margin>The Female lives by the spirit and is enlarged; all are stained with blood.</margin> Rabbi Chiya stood on his feet and said: "Until now the Holy Lamp has looked <margin>here he exerts himself</margin> upon us; now is not the time for anything but to occupy ourselves with his honor."

Rabbi Eleazar and Rabbi Abba stood up. They carried him, but no one was found with him except Rabbi Eleazar and Rabbi Abba. And then the twelve villages were shaken and moved <margin>for the soul and the protectors and they waited</margin>. The inhabitants of the heights, the celestial beings, were troubled, for they feared he would not be buried there. After that, the bier rose into the air, and fire blazed before it. They heard a voice: "Enter and come, and gather for the wedding feast <note>original: *Hillula*, the celebration of a saint's passing</note> of Rabbi Shimon! **'He shall enter in peace; they shall rest in their beds'**" <note>Isaiah 57:2</note>. When they reached the cave, they heard a voice from within the cave: "This is he who shook the earth, who made kingdoms tremble!" <note>Isaiah 14:16</note>. How many openings in the firmament are found <margin>alt: are silenced</margin> on this day because of you! For all the chariots of the fullness are found in it every day. And all the portions of the World to Come, how many hidden supernal things are enriched for him! Of him it is said: "But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days" <note>Daniel 12:13</note>.

->**Thus far the Holy Lesser Assembly**<-

***

Rabbi Yose said: How beloved are Israel before the Holy One, Blessed be He! He called them a "holy nation," as it is written: **"For thou art a holy people..."** <note>Deuteronomy 7:6</note>. Later, He called them "Holiness," as it is written: **"Israel is holiness unto the Lord, the firstfruits of His increase"** <note>Jeremiah 2:3</note>.

<meta>This page continues the discourse on Parashat Ha’azinu, specifically focusing on the mystical interpretation of the Song of Moses. It transitions from discussing the sanctity of Israel to the alignment of the Sefirot (Divine Attributes) as they are encoded within the biblical verses.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

...its harvest. What is the difference between this and that? Rabbi Abba said: "Higher Holiness" <note>Hebrew: *Kodesh Elyon*</note>—from where do we know this? All are united as one "Holiness" and are called "Holy." They all ascend and are gathered into that supreme place called "Holy." Therefore, we say "Holy, Holy, Holy" <note>The Trisagion from Isaiah 6:3</note>. "Israel is Holiness" <note>Jeremiah 2:3</note> because they are made from these [attributes]. And because Israel is crowned with three levels when they are united as one, they are called "Israel's Holiness."

Regarding the phrase "its harvest," it is written:
-> "For if a man eats of the holy thing unwittingly..." <note>Leviticus 22:14</note> <-
And it is written: "No stranger shall eat of the holy thing." This refers to the mystery of Holiness. Regarding "all who devour it shall be held guilty" <note>Jeremiah 2:3</note>, Rabbi Eleazar said: The prayer that concludes everything is included in "Holy." **Higher Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah Ila'ah: The second Sefirah, representing the first flash of divine intellect</term> is called "Holy." When this Wisdom shines upon the world, it shines as it is written: "And Solomon's wisdom excelled," for the Moon <note>The Sefirah of Malkhut/Kingship</note> stood in its fullness. We have established this: when she is blessed by those holy **Sefirot** <term>Sefirot: The ten creative powers or attributes of God</term>, she is called "Holy" in total perfection. But when she does not shine and is not crowned in perfection, we call her "the Holy Spirit" <note>Ruach HaKodesh</note> and she is not called "Holy" like that which is above. When she is blessed by this **Foundation** <term>Yesod: The ninth Sefirah, the channel of divine life-force</term> and nurses all those below, she is called "Holy" like that which is above, and they are called "Holy of Holies."

It is written: "When I proclaim the name of the Lord..." <note>Deuteronomy 32:3</note>. Why "When I proclaim the name of the Lord"? It is because it is written: "Ascribe greatness to our God." Rabbi Abba said: "Ascribe greatness"—this is **Greatness** <term>Gedulah/Chesed: Loving-kindness</term>. "The Rock, His work is perfect"—this is **Power** <term>Gevurah: Judgment/Strength</term>. "For all His ways are justice"—this is **Beauty** <term>Tiferet: The central balance</term>. "A God of faithfulness"—this is the **Assembly of Israel** <note>Malkhut</note>. "And without iniquity"—this is **Splendor** <term>Hod</term>. "Righteous"—this is **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. "And upright"—this is **Justice** <note>Tzedek</note>. "He is"—this is the totality of the Holy Name of the **Holy One, Blessed be He**.

At that moment, Moses revealed to Israel what is written: "Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day." From all this, we learn that a righteous man who possesses Higher Wisdom, when he is about to depart from the world, must reveal that Wisdom to the holy generations who follow him. As it is written: "Moses spoke... set your hearts," and it is written: "Now therefore write this song for you." If not, it is written of him: "Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it" <note>Proverbs 3:27</note>. Before you depart from the world, while you still have the permission to reveal.

Rabbi Hiyya said: If we learn Higher Wisdom from this verse, so it is for the end of the verse, which ties the "Knot of Faith." As it is written: "He is"—the totality. "Upright and Just is He"—is it not all one? Is there any separation? Rather, all these qualities are gathered and tied together as one. He is, He was, and He shall be. Blessed be His Name forever and ever. These holy words of the Name of the Holy One, Blessed be He, are tied and unified. Happy is the portion of one who calls to the King and knows how to call correctly. For if one calls and does not know whom he calls, the King distances Himself from him. As it is written:
-> "The Lord is near to all them that call upon Him..." <note>Psalms 145:18</note> <-
To whom is He near? The verse concludes: "...to all that call upon Him **in truth**." What is "in truth"? With the **Seal of the King** <term>Gushpanka de-Malka: The divine signet of Truth</term>, which is the perfection of all. As it is witnessed: "You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham." Therefore, it is written "to all who call upon Him in truth." Happy is the portion of one who desires and goes out to know the will of the Holy One, Blessed be He. For it is written: "But the path of the righteous is as the shining light..." and "Your people shall all be righteous."

<summary>This page provides a mystical commentary on the Song of Ha'azinu, mapping the attributes of God (Sefirot) onto the verses of the song and emphasizing the importance of passing down spiritual wisdom before death. It highlights that true prayer requires calling upon God "in truth," which signifies the unification of the divine attributes.</summary>
